items.entry: {@skill Survival},  and choose one from: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Persuasion}, {@skill Stealth}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Thayan trinket|TLotRW}, a locket that contains a small portrait of an old person that you don't recognize, a small glass vial with what appear to be shed skins (snake, insect, or other similar creature), a fancy {@item signet ring|PHB}, shredded clothes (noble's, sailor's, or soldier's), a {@item shovel|PHB}, and a small cedar box that contains 14 gp. The coins are at least 60 years old.

entries.name: How Did I Get These Scars?
entries: Upon emerging from the ruins you either saw your scars in your reflection or someone pointed them out to you. What are they? Where are they located? Do you really want to know?

entries.caption: Location of Scars
rows: Across your face and cheeks
Covering your arms
All across your legs
Haphazardly across your back
Encompassing your chest
Marring your hands and wrists

entries.caption: Type of Scars
rows: Dozens of small, perfect circles
A series of deep slashes that have rudely healed
The faint remains of medical stitches and staples
Deep purple tissue that is intensely itchy
Bright white, old scar tissue that is always warm
Gibberish arcane runes that occasionally weep green fluid

entries.name: Feature: Starbonded
entries: When you are presented with an aberrant creature's natural form, you instantly recall some esoteric bit of lore about that creature. Usually, this information regards the creature's favored diet or habitat, but on rare occasion you may know that creature's name. When this effect is triggered, your scars grow slightly larger or more numerous. If this effect is triggered because you saw a starspawn creature, you feel both kinship and intense revulsion.
Your DM might rule that this effect may only happen once per day, or that the information only comes to you when you next fall asleep.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
entries: Choose two from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Investigation}

items.name: Languages:
entries: One of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
entries: A {@filter simple weapon|items|type=simple weapon;!renaissance;!modern;!futuristic;!treasure (gemstone);!treasure (art object);!treasure (coinage)|Cost=[&0;&1000]|miscellaneous=mundane} worth no more than 10 gp, a memento from a previous client, a set of manacles, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Clientele
entries: It takes special training to protect special clients. Consider what types of clients you specialize in guarding and discuss with your DM if this grants you any other benefit. You can roll on the following table to determine your client specialty, or choose one that best fits your character.

rows: Royalty
Musician or thespian
Taverns
Guild leader
Politician
Merchants
Caravans
None (you freelance)

entries.name: Feature: Got Your Back
entries: You gain a feat of your choice from either {@feat Alert}, {@feat Observant}, {@feat Sentinel}, or {@feat Shield Basher|TPVang}. In addition, those that you have previously worked for may help to cover your lifestyle expenses or get you access to certain events or people normally closed off to individuals outside of their circle.

entries.name: Building a Bodyguard Character
entries: Putting your life on the line for other people tends to shape your outlook and perspective on the world. The Bodyguard Personality Traits table suggests a variety of traits you might adopt for your character.

rows: I'd take a sword in the gut for any of my allies.
'm haunted by memories of a client dying under my watch.
I don't know when to turn 'protector mode' off.
My worry for others affects my self-care. Most notably my hygiene.
Alcohol? I never touch the stuff. Have to stay alert.
I've learned to sleep with one eye open. Gods, I'm tired.
I spent a lot of time learning not to react to things as other people do. It's my job. It doesn't always work.
I do this job because I love the life of luxury my clients provide.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Book|XPHB} (field guide), {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, 2 {@item Pouch|XPHB|Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (overalls), 17 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: You've always had a fascination with the first green buds that sprout after planting. During your formative years, you might have worked on a farm, cultivated a garden, or raised a plant nursery. Your cumulative experience extends to exotic plants from across the 'Verse, teaching you extensive practical botany. You might have harnessed a bit of magic on your quest to understand the natural world, or you might have relied exclusively on science, pH levels, and chemical compositions of a verdant world.

name: Bounty Hunter
entries: You have spent most of your life chasing down those who are running from the powers of the world. Whether hunting slaves in the Underdark, searching for escaped criminals, or taking out poachers, you hunt people the way others hunt animals. Others may see you as cold-hearted or even sadistic, but in truth, you are simply very, very good at what you do.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of dark common clothes, a compass, two incomplete bounties, a souvenir from your latest hunt, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

entries.name: Favored Target
entries: There are as many targets as there are hunters, and you have a particular fondness for one particular type of prey. Roll or choose a favored target from the Favored Target table below.

entries.caption: Favored Targets
rows: Escaped Slave
Poacher
War Criminal
Parole Breaker
Expatriate
Pirate

entries.name: Feature: Sense for Trouble
entries: People tend to give you a wide berth, but you have a sense for those who are particularly disturbed by your presence. If you spend an evening in a town or city, you know about one person (if there is one) who is especially {@condition frightened} of you and others of your occupation.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Bounty hunters are often separated from those who they seek only by the rule of law. Their ruthlessness and efficiency is often seen as cruelty, but they are typically on the right side of those in power. Many hunters have personal codes they follow regarding their prey. Roll or choose one characteristic on each of the following tables.

rows: I always have a backup plan.
I only speak when spoken to.
There is nothing I enjoy more than a tankard of ale at the end of a long day.
I enjoy pain in both myself and others.
Deep down, I really want friends.
I am exceptionally stubborn.
I like animals better than people.
I love trying new cuisines from the places I visit.
Order. Those who break the law must face its punishment, as is just. (Lawful)
Mercy. I hope that somehow, my work can save people from themselves. (Good)
Punishment. The people I hunt will be made to pay dearly for their crimes. (Evil)
Money. This is a job like any other. It just happens to be a bit more lucrative. (Any)
Revenge. Someone from among those I hunt has wronged me. I will have my revenge. (Any)
Pain. I would hurt people just for fun. If the powers that be will pay me to do it, all the better. (Evil)
I have a family member who I allowed to escape from justice.
I killed a man, only to find out later that he was innocent.
I went too far on one job and won the ire of my employer by killing a target he needed alive.
I owe my life to my employer and will do anything they ask of me.
I have a strong sense of fair play and will never attack an unarmed opponent.
I have been hunting one target for years, but they somehow keep evading me.
I don't believe that people can change.
I'm too nice for this job—I can be easily convinced that my employer, and not my target, is in the wrong.
I jump into battle quickly and without preparation the moment I see an opponent.
Every man has a price, and mine is onegold piece more than my next best offer.
I really, {@i really} don't take criticism well.
If my target is attractive, I always go easy on them.

_.displayName: an arcane focus that no longer works

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
entries: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Religion}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
entries: {@item Alchemist's Supplies|PHB}, {@item Herbalism Kit|PHB}

items.name: Equipment:
entries: An old {@item arcane focus|PHB|spell focus} that no longer works, a {@item book|PHB} of Lore, 5 sheets of {@item parchment (one sheet)|PHB|parchment}, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10gp.

entries.caption: Ex-Patron
rows: Archfey
Celestial
Hexblade
Fiend
Great Old One
Undead

entries.name: Feature: Arcane Experience
entries: You weren't a very gifted Warlock but you did have some vestiges of power. There are still simmers of strength within you, lingering from your ex-patron. You gain the {@feat Magic Initiate} feat; you must choose the Warlock class for this.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Warlocks who broke their pacts are typically shaped by several key moments in their history. Why they broke the pact and why they made it in the first place. Some used to belong to cults, others were loners. All of which will affect their ideals and bonds. Their flaw may possibly be why they broke their pact.

rows: I must have every agreement in writing, if there isn't a contract there's no guarantee.
I still idolize my old patron, one day I will regain their respect.
I am still a practicing member of my patron's cult and very few know of my broken pact.
I take every opportunity I can to badmouth my patron and their cult.
I do everything I can to hide the fact I was once a Warlock.
To the best of my ability, I act as though my broken pact doesn't bother me, even though it infuriates me to no end.
I despise Warlocks and other groups like them.
I sometimes pretend to speak with my old patron, as if we were still connected.
{@b Defender}. I cannot stand by while the powerful take advantage of the weak. (Good)
{@b Contract}. A deal made must be upheld. (Lawful)
{@b Weary}. A deal is only as good as the people who make it. (Chaotic)
{@b Enforcer}. A promise cannot be broken, if it is, the breaker must pay. (Evil)
{@b Loner}. I only uphold the deals I find worthwhile. (Neutral)
{@b Forgetful}. A promise is never broken, its fulfillment might just be delayed. (Any)
I've broken promises before and catastrophe followed, I will never do such a thing again.
Everything I do is an attempt to create another pact with a new being.
One day I will re-sign a pact with my old patron. Until then I will do as best as I can to follow their laws.
I will do everything in my power to demolish the patron structure, these beings are unworthy of worship.
I've failed to be a patronie, so one day I will be the patron.
I work to build all my relationships on mutual trust, not a one-sided contract.
I cannot help but take any knowledge I find, hoarding it for myself.
I have been betrayed before and do not trust easily.
I am unsure about most things, regularly going back on deals and promises.
Lying is my forte, I can't help but do it.
I blame myself for every failure, even if unavoidable.
I tend to leave before I get too attached, better to have a broken promise rather than a broken heart.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Hunting|TLotRR}, {@skill Perception}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Carpenter's tools|PHB} or water vehicles

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Rustic, Wary

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Smith's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Proud, Wilful

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A cadet's uniform, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a diploma from a military school, a map, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Pupil of Conflict
entries: Your military training allows you to easily recognize and distinguish weapons, uniforms, military strategies and important military figures, such as notable generals, both historical and modern.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Cadets have been taught to adopt the lifestyle of a soldier, but lack both the tempering of combat experience and the physical and emotional scarring of war. These individuals who seek to fight for what they believe are often idealists and desire to leave their impact on the world through their service to their nation or sovereign. While not true soldiers, they often embody what they envision soldiers to be.

rows: I speak plainly and directly. Not because it's easier, but because it saves time and lives.
I have a tendency to compare situations at hand to famous battles and notable heroes.
I am easily bored; I long for action and excitement.
I readily seek to outperform others in word and deed.
f I give someone my word, I will keep it. Even if it kills me.
I do my best to keep morale up, and if it is a low, I will figure out how to inspire it.
To me, a new weapon is like a shiny new toy, full of possibilities.
I am stoic and professional above all else.
Order. War's main purpose is to exact justice and maintain peace. (Law
Honor. The might doesn't reveal the value of might, but of character. (Any)
Valor. Courage stokes the flame of hope, and inspires others to fight for what is good. (Good)
Tyranny. Only through demonstrations of strength and superiority can any form of respect be earned. (Evil
Glory. Those destined for victory make history, and those who make history rule the world. (Any)
Perseverance. War is never quick and always complicated, but those who fight for the right cause will outlast the most blusterous foes. (Neutral)
The friends I made in training are closer to me than my real family.
I come from a long line of soldiers, and I must continue their legacy.
My mentor died in battle, and I will stop at nothing to avenge them.
The conflict separated me from a person I love, and I'm still searching for them.
My community sees me as a local hero, and I refuse to disappoint them.
I am destined to be a hero, and I will be nothing less than that, or die trying.
I fly into a fit of rage when others disrespect my lands, my king, or my people.
I never wanted to be a soldier, and have no taste for fighting.
I don't take orders from anyone that isn't in a position of authority.
Because I fear my lack of experience, I become paralyzed with indecision.
I am overconfident in my martial skill, and pick fights I don't know if I can win.
I am meant to lead, not to be on the front lines; I'd rather have someone else fight my battles for me.

entries: You were commissioned as an officer, but you never actually made it to the battlefield. Perhaps someone pulled strings on your behalf to save you from conflict, or perhaps the war ended before you had a chance to serve. Rather than being thrown into war, you were left to choose your own path. Are you angry that you never had an opportunity to prove yourself, or glad to have dodged the front lines?

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine which military organization you trained to be a part of, and what lifestyle you have led up until you began adventuring. You might have immediately pursued the lifestyle of an adventurer, served as a military advisor, or even returned to civilian life.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item hunting trap|phb}, 5 {@item rations (1 day)|phb|rations}, {@item hempen rope (50 feet)|phb|50 ft of hempen rope} and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10gp

entries.name: Feature: On the Move
entries: You have learnt to pack fast, travel efficiently and hide well from the monsters of this world. Whenever you are being followed or tracked you know how to leave false tracks behind and cause impediments to your pursuers.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item whip|phb}, a {@item two-person tent|phb}, a regional map, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Poor

entries.name: Overview
entries: You are used to life on the road. You pride yourself at having traveled every major trade way in the Moonsea region, including the best backroads and shortcuts. When traveling these roads, you know where the best inns, campsites, and water sources are located, as well as potential locations of danger such as ambush. Having worked the roads as long as you have, you have made many acquaintances and find it easy to pick up information and rumors floating from town to town. You are skilled with beasts of burden and handling and repairing wagons of all kinds.

entries.name: Feature: Wagonmaster
entries: You are used to being in charge of the operation and your reputation for reliability has you on a short list when the job is critical. Experience has taught you to rely on your gut. Others recognize this and look to you for direction when a situation gets serious. You are able to identify the most defensible locations for camping. If you are part of a caravan outfit, you are able to attract two additional workers that are loyal to you based on your reputation. You have an excellent memory for maps and geography and can always determine your cardinal directions while traveling. Note: This feature is a variant of the Outlander feature.

rows: Any group is only as strong as its weakest link. Everyone has to pull their own weight.
There's always someone out there trying to take what I've got. Always be vigilant.
Anything can be learned if you have the right teacher. Most folks just need a chance.
Early to bed and early to rise; this much at least is under my control.
You can listen to me or don't and wish you had. Everyone ends up on one side of that fence.
Eventually my hard work will be rewarded. Maybe that time has finally come.
A strong ox or horse is more reliable than most people I've met.
I never had time for books, but wish I had. I admire folks who have taken the time to learn.
Service. Using my talents to help others is the best way of helping myself. (Good)
Selfish. What people don't know WILL hurt them, but why is that my problem? (Evil)
Wanderer. I go where the road takes me. Sometimes that's a good thing... (Chaotic)
Fittest. On the open road, the law of nature wins. Victims are the unprepared. (Lawful)
Focused. I simply have a job to do, and I'm going to do it. (Neutral)
Motivated. There's a reason I'm good at what I do, I pay attention to the details. (Any)
My brother has a farm in Elmwood and I've helped him and his neighbors move their goods to Mulmaster and other surrounding towns. Those are good people.
A caravan I lead was attacked by bandits and many innocents died. I swear that I will avenge them by killing any bandits I encounter.
The Soldiery are mostly good guys who understand the importance of protecting the roads. The City Watch is who you have to look out for. If they are inspecting your goods, get ready to pay a fine.
The new commander of Southroad Tower, Capt. Holke, understands the importance of safe roads. He's hired me for several jobs and I'm grateful.
There's always a road I haven't traveled before. I'm always looking for new places to explore.
Wealth and power mean little without the freedom to go where and when you want.
I have trouble trusting people I've just met.
I enjoy the open road. Underground and tight spaces make me very nervous.
I expect others to heed my orders and have little respect or sympathy if they don't.
I am very prideful and have trouble admitting when I'm wrong.
Once I decide on a course of action, I do not waiver.
I like to explore, and my curiosity will sometimes get me into trouble.

name: Caravanners of the Iron Roads
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} Some claim neither Iron Kingdom citizenship nor tribal kinship. These extended families travel the length and breadth of western Immoren, transporting cargo and goods to settlements not easily reached by river or by railroad. These trade routes are known as the Iron Roads.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Anyone can be a member of a Caravanners of the Iron Roads company, as a multitude of skills are required to travel the Iron Roads.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Your company's prestige increases through acts such as: establishing a new trade contract worth at least 500 gp; establishing a new trade route; putting a rival caravan out of business; trading a single item for at least 1,000 gp; defeating a much-reviled band of brigands.

entries.name: Tier 1 — Ostlers
entries: {@b Caravan.} You have {@dice 2d3} wagons large enough to carry goods or a single laborjack, with enough draft animals to pull them. Alternatively, you have {@dice 3d6} mules and draft animals to carry your cargo.

{@b Iron Road Tongue.} You can replace one language you gain from your race or background with Iron Road Tongue. You learn Iron Road Cant, which you can use to pass along secret messages by speaking in code or carving runes. Deciphering the cant requires tools or magic (DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice it).
{@b Life in the Saddle.} You can replace one proficiency you gain from your race or background with proficiency in the Animal Handling skill or the Persuasion skill.

entries.name: Tier 2 — Seasoned Traders
entries: {@b Laborers.} You gain your choice of {@dice 2d4} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower or a clapped-out steamjack and a carriage with fuel for it.
{@b Regular Income.} You can claim a steady income of 100 gp after taxes and can buy new stock to trade at the next town.

entries.name: Tier 3 — Merchants of the Iron Roads
entries: {@b Caravanserai.} You know the location of {@dice 1d4} caravanserai—places along the main trade routes that provide stables, accommodations, and protection. You can easily take long rests at these locations and can withdraw money owed to you or take out up to 200 gp in credit.
{@b Heavy Metal Merchants.} You gain a light laborjack—a Forager class 'jack with a cupernum-grade cortex.

entries.name: Tier 4 — Grand Caravan
entries: {@b Greasing the Gears.} You gain a +2 bonus on Wisdom (Insight) checks and Charisma (Persuasion) checks.
{@b Money Makes the World Go 'Round.} You have a regular monthly income after taxes of 500 gp.

entries.name: Quirks
entries: Roll or choose a quirk: (1) Your company crest is that of a fallen noble family; (2) Your caravan sings ancient songs from the time of the Molgur tribes; (3) Your caravan is part of a more prominent extended family that holds a great festival at the summer solstice; (4) The caravan is hunted by a crime lord from Khador for an item a thief planted in your cargo; (5) The caravan travels the Stormlands and uses unusual beasts to pull your wagons; (6) Your caravan has collected many myths and legends, making the wise elders respected sages; (7) The safety of the caravan has been ensured with an ancient pledge to the infernals; (8) A former member has joined a band of raiders and waits for revenge; (9) You carry a seal of friendship with the Rhulic dwarves for safe passage; (10) Since the Claiming, a debt owed to a merchant in Llael has been made null and void.

name: Caregiver

_.special: A handmade gift from a child you raised

entries: You are a guardian of your society's youngest and most vulnerable members. As a parent, teacher, chaperone, orphanage worker, or bodyguard, you've learned to handle stress, work with others, and stay ever-vigilant.

Work with your DM to determine the role children play in your life as an adventurer. What was the nature of your relationship? If your charges are still dependent on you, where are they now? If not, why? Were they privileged or poor, and did you share this lifestyle? Why do you venture into environments hostile to children?

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One gaming set or musical instrument

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of fine or common clothes, any one gaming set or musical instrument you are proficient with, a handmade gift from a child you raised, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Suffer the Children
entries: Your ability to patiently handle minors sets you apart from most adventurers, and is disarming to strangers. You can easily extract child-related information from parents and teachers. Those that witness you interacting with children will be more willing to offer aid or ask for your help, especially if they care for children themselves.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: For better or worse, the lives of child caretakers are defined by their relationships with their charges.

rows: I'm a hardened multi-tasker, and can quickly adapt to anything life throws at me.
I constantly police the language of others, and can't stand vulgarity. Think of who could be listening!
People assume I'm a harsh disciplinarian, but deep down I'm as soft as butter.
I reluctantly 'parent' my companions. Who else would be the responsible one?
Having spent years caring for the helpless, I tend to over-explain concepts and patronize others.
I believe I know what's best for my child, and openly question the parenting decisions of strangers.
Youngsters flock to me but truthfully, I can't stand them.
I love feeling like others depend on me.
{@bold Knowledge.} We can learn as much from our young as they can from us. (Any)
{@bold Freedom.} I savor the time I don't have to worry about others. (Chaotic)
{@bold Love.} Nothing is more precious than the connection between parent and child. (Good)
{@bold Understanding.} People are shaped by the environment they were raised in. No one is inherently good or evil. (Neutral)
{@bold Responsibility.} We must strive to create a safer world for our young. (Lawful)
{@bold Manipulation.} Children's minds are the easiest to mold and their hearts the easiest to leas astray. (Evil)
My child was taken from me, and I won't rest until I bring them back home.
Everything I do, I do to ensure my family leads a good life.
I regret all the years I wasted caring for ungrateful whelps. Now, it's all about me.
I grew up an orphan, scared and alone. I will do whatever I can do to prevent others going through the same experience.
I'm haunted by the memories of the child that died in my care. I'm traveling to start that life afresh.
I abused my authority as a caretaker, and fear reprisal from the law.
Secretly, I enjoy taking out my frustrations on those who cannot fight back.
I will do, say, or promise anything to stop someone from crying.
If I'm asked a difficult question, I will give a simple lie instead of a complicated truth.
I have little respect for those who aren't parents or child caretakers.
When I'm distracted, I'm liable to talk to adults as if they were children. Particularly if they're short.
Whenever I'm freed of my responsibilities, I go wild.

name: Carnie
entries: You were a purveyor of entertainment, for ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, people of all races. You never stayed in one place for long, forever travelling with your chosen "family" of performers, freaks, outcasts, and wanderers. You know how to draw attention, how to misdirect, lead the eye where you want it to go, and inspire wonder in an audience. Your know that your words don't always have to be honest, you just have to make people want to believe. Whether you were born into the life or not, the life of a carnie prepared you well for travel and adventure.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of colorful clothes, a dice set or a playing card set, a purse containing 10gp.

entries.name: Feature: Friends In Low Places
entries: You are used to rubbing elbows with those who don't fit in with society, and you can fit in among them with relative ease. Outcasts see a kindred spirit in you, and are more likely to share information with you, protect you from anyone searching for you or asking about you, and provide you with shelter they have available, unless you've shown yourself to be a danger to them.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Carnies (or showies, depending on the dialect) tend to be worldly people, who've travelled extensively and interacted with people of all walks of life. Very often, their goals involved manipulating people of all walks of life. Whether they adopt a regal, high-class persona, or they prefer to slum it with the peasants, a carnie knows how to project a boisterous or flamboyant attitude to get as much attention as they might want.

rows: I can't help mentally dissecting people; I am an armchair psychoanalyst.
I  hate not being the center of attention.
I could sell snake oil to a yuan-ti.
I resent the suggestion that carnies are all crooks and thieves.
Don't be mad at m e because you got played.
I can never stay in one place for too long.
I feel at home around common folk, nobility makes me uncomfortable.
Boredom catches up with me easily, but I can always find new ways to inject a little excitement into life.
Spreading Joy. There's no greater feeling than putting a smile on someone's face. (Good)
Fairness. I won't run a work on someone who can't afford to lose a game or two. (Lawful)
People. I'm a people person. I like getting to interact with all kinds that I otherwise might not meet. (Neutral)
In The Hands Of Fate. Life is as random as a shuffled deck of cards. Take the good that comes with the bad. (Neutral)
Freedom. I don't want a job that leaves me tied to one place or one duty. I need to be able to stretch my legs and expand my horizons. (Chaotic)
As Long As I Get Mine. I don't care if I have to lie, cheat, or steal to get ahead, everyone's got to look out for number-one. (Evil)
I'd be dead in a ditch somewhere if not for the carnival folk who cleaned me up, gave me work, and put me on the right path. I owe them my life.
I ran away with the carnival to escape people who were pursuing me... and probably still are today.
I was left in a carnival tent as an infant with only a locket on a necklace. I don't know who my real parents are, but I've travelled far and wide hoping to find them.
I left a luxurious walk of life because I was so enamoured with the pageantry and wild beauty of the carnival, and I've never looked back.
I worked closely with a partner for many years, we were tighter blood-family, and I blame myself for their accidental death.
I can't accept great comfort and luxury, knowing that my old carnival troupe is sleeping on beds of straw. Whatever profit I can pocket, I plan to send back to them.
I'm easily sidetracked by the opportunity to make a quick profit.
I grew up around tamed lions and bears. I assume most animals are as friendly.
I feel the need to inform my party members or travelling companions when someone is an easy mark. I also learned to whisper in a sawmill.
I just can't help wanting to win at everything I do. I am not a "good loser".
I'm used to folks wearing their oddities on their sleeve, so I always wonder what straight-laced people are hiding.
I think I'm the greatest showman that ever lived. I am disastrously wrong.

name: Carnie
entries: You were a purveyor of entertainment, for ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, people of all races. You never stayed in one place for long, forever travelling with your chosen "family" of performers, freaks, outcasts, and wanderers. You know how to draw attention, how to misdirect, lead the eye where you want it to go, and inspire wonder in an audience. Your know that your words don't always have to be honest, you just have to make people want to believe. Whether you were born into the life or not, the life of a carnie prepared you well for travel and adventure.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of colorful clothes, a dice set or a playing card set, a purse containing 10gp.

entries.name: Feature: Friends In Low Places
entries: You are used to rubbing elbows with those who don't fit in with society, and you can fit in among them with relative ease. Outcasts see a kindred spirit in you, and are more likely to share information with you, protect you from anyone searching for you or asking about you, and provide you with shelter they have available, unless you've shown yourself to be a danger to them.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Carnies (or showies, depending on the dialect) tend to be worldly people, who've travelled extensively and interacted with people of all walks of life. Very often, their goals involved manipulating people of all walks of life. Whether they adopt a regal, high-class persona, or they prefer to slum it with the peasants, a carnie knows how to project a boisterous or flamboyant attitude to get as much attention as they might want.

rows: I can't help mentally dissecting people; I am an armchair psychoanalyst.
I  hate not being the center of attention.
I could sell snake oil to a yuan-ti.
I resent the suggestion that carnies are all crooks and thieves.
Don't be mad at m e because you got played.
I can never stay in one place for too long.
I feel at home around common folk, nobility makes me uncomfortable.
Boredom catches up with me easily, but I can always find new ways to inject a little excitement into life.
Spreading Joy. There's no greater feeling than putting a smile on someone's face. (Good)
Fairness. I won't run a work on someone who can't afford to lose a game or two. (Lawful)
People. I'm a people person. I like getting to interact with all kinds that I otherwise might not meet. (Neutral)
In The Hands Of Fate. Life is as random as a shuffled deck of cards. Take the good that comes with the bad. (Neutral)
Freedom. I don't want a job that leaves me tied to one place or one duty. I need to be able to stretch my legs and expand my horizons. (Chaotic)
As Long As I Get Mine. I don't care if I have to lie, cheat, or steal to get ahead, everyone's got to look out for number-one. (Evil)
I'd be dead in a ditch somewhere if not for the carnival folk who cleaned me up, gave me work, and put me on the right path. I owe them my life.
I ran away with the carnival to escape people who were pursuing me... and probably still are today.
I was left in a carnival tent as an infant with only a locket on a necklace. I don't know who my real parents are, but I've travelled far and wide hoping to find them.
I left a luxurious walk of life because I was so enamoured with the pageantry and wild beauty of the carnival, and I've never looked back.
I worked closely with a partner for many years, we were tighter blood-family, and I blame myself for their accidental death.
I can't accept great comfort and luxury, knowing that my old carnival troupe is sleeping on beds of straw. Whatever profit I can pocket, I plan to send back to them.
I'm easily sidetracked by the opportunity to make a quick profit.
I grew up around tamed lions and bears. I assume most animals are as friendly.
I feel the need to inform my party members or travelling companions when someone is an easy mark. I also learned to whisper in a sawmill.
I just can't help wanting to win at everything I do. I am not a "good loser".
I'm used to folks wearing their oddities on their sleeve, so I always wonder what straight-laced people are hiding.
I think I'm the greatest showman that ever lived. I am disastrously wrong.

name: Cartographer

_.special: a scrap of a map to a place you have never been

entries: Governments, rebel groups, and merchant empires - all need maps to exert control and influence. You bring order to uncharted lands by transcribing their details with quill and parchment, thus offering creating a measure of power where there once was none. Perhaps you are drawn by the unfound, or you simply seek to bring order from chaos. Whatever your aims, a cartographer is an agent of discovery and control.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of traveler's clothes, cartographer's tools, a scrap of a map to a place you have never been, and a coin purse containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Surveyor's Eye
entries: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, your eye can immediately determine with great accuracy a question of quantity, distance, or rate in your immediate environment.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Cartographers are defined by their life of travel and discovery.

rows: I don't feel that I've truly understood something until I make a record of it.
I take great artistic pride in my work, often times preferring style and beauty over substance.
I'm driven by a wanderlust that led me away from my native land.
I am very passionate about my work - I once stabbed a man over an argument about proper map projection.
I've gained much perspective from my travels in faraway lands, and sometimes my native culture scarcely feels like home.
I like thorough definitions, sure things, and exacting clarity.
I'm not lost - I am exploring.
Discovery and the use of resources for my people are of higher concern than people or creatures native to that land.
{@bold Awe.} The wide world holds many incredible and beautiful places, and I'm happy to share these places with others. (Good)
{@bold Adventure.} I am driven to discovery by a desire for new experience and excitement. (Chaos)
{@bold Greed.}  With discovery comes resources, and I stand to gain more than anybody. (Evil)
{@bold Civilization.} Civilization and innovation propels us forward, and barbarism only holds us back. (Lawful)
{@bold Excellence.} In all things, I take a certain pride in a job well done and mastery of one's work. (Any)
{@bold Truth.} Things must be represented the way they truly are, with no room for embellishment or obfuscation. (Neutral)
My entire life has been spent looking for a place now lost to antiquity.
I once completed a set of maps which I will never give to the client who commissioned them.
I have a special love for the lands which I have surveyed, and I would fight for their preservation.
I am an established and respected member of my guild, and I value the esteem of my peers very highly.
I am obsessed with finding a new passage through the mountains or seas, and I have a few ideas about how to do it.
The marking of one location is absent from every map I make, because no one must learn of that place's true whereabouts.
I tend to look at the bigger picture, and often overlook the small details.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
I am much more concerned with my legacy and prestige than the accuracy or quality of my work.
If I don't deem something important, I ignore it entirely.
I can't seem to put down roots, and I get anxious about being in one place for long.
I look down on people who have never travelled more than a few miles from where they were born.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Performance}, plus one from among {@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation} and {@skill Persuasion}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|PHB}, a {@item smartphone|TTT}, a bottle of perfume, and a {@item credit stick|TTT} with 1500 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Claim to Fame
entries: In a world where wanna-be socialites, influencers, and the endless tide of advertisements are constantly vying for attention, you managed to stand out. Choose one to three claims to fame or roll on the table below to define your path to the limelight.

rows: Movie Star
Singer/Musician
E-Sports Player
Influencer
Politician
TV Personality
Teen Idol
Kid Actor
Humanitarian
Revolutionary

entries.name: Feature: Conspicuous
entries: People may recognize you if they have interest in topics related to your claim to fame, though they may react positively or negatively. You can always pull strings to get invitations to parties, conferences, and other social events. You have a following on various social media platforms that will help broadcast gossip, rumors, or scandals.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Some people are born celebrities, while others find their fame through dedication and hard work. They often have eccentric personalities, acting and dressing flamboyantly in order to seek attention. These traits are frequently exaggerated, taken to the extreme in the pursuit of greater heights of popularity.

rows: I can't help but be fascinated by drama, real or artificial.
My public and private personas are two very different people.
I love being the center of attention.
I have no idea how the average person lives, and it fascinates me.
I'm a people person, and I love meeting new and exciting individuals.
I'm cool, aloof, and above it all.
I'm not afraid to use my influence and power against those who anger me.
Fame has jaded me, so it's hard to get worked up over anything.
{@bold Change.} I can use my influence to change the world for the better. (Good)
{@bold Exemplar.} Society needs role models to set a good example. (Lawful)
{@bold Fun.} Life's too short to be worrying about consequences. (Chaotic)
{@bold Fame.} I would do anything to get back into the limelight. (Evil)
{@bold Wealth.} There are the haves, and the have-nots. I will not be the latter. (Neutral)
{@bold Artist.} I take pride in my work, and I refuse to put on a half-baked performance. (Any)
Someone was behind my fall from fame, and I will find out who.
I was born destitute, and clawed my way out of the gutter. I won't let anyone take from me what I've earned.
My rival and I have despised each other for years, but recently things have taken a surprising turn.
I will rise to the top of my field and become a household name.
I'm being blackmailed over a terrible secret.
This isn't my usual gig, I'm just tagging along to get in the right frame of mind.
I tend to draw attention to myself when I shouldn't.
I'm an irredeemable gossipmonger, even if I have to make things up.
I think the world revolves around me, and I'm surprised when people don't know who I am.
I expect others to handle trivial tasks for me.
I have an addiction for something scandalous.
I fall into and out of love on a whim.

entries: Fame waxes and wanes, and those who get a taste for it find it sweet, and addictive. You have drunk deeply, finding yourself at the center of attention. Whether it was a lasting fame, or a swift rise to stardom followed by a hasty descent, your status as a celebrity has come to define your life, at least to you.

Of course, all fame is fickle, and your descent from stardom defines you as much as your ascent. Do you quietly shuffle into obscurity, or do you cling to relevance with the death grip of a drowning man. For the latter, you may decide that there's ultimately no difference between fame and infamy.

name: Champion

_: a trophy from a past victory (such as a broken piece of armor or a banner)
a token given to you by a mentor or sponsor

entries: You were born with an exceptional talent for combat, and you've spent your life training and honing your skills in order to become a true master of the art of war. You've fought in countless battles and have won fame and glory with your impressive feats of strength and cunning tactics.

entries.name: Feature: Master of Combat
entries: Your skill with weapons and combat techniques is unparalleled. You have advantage on your first attack roll against any creature that has not yet taken a turn in combat. In addition, because of your reputation as a fearsome warrior, you have advantage on any ability check made in a social situation where your reputation carries weight.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I'm always eager for a good fight, no matter the odds.
I have a quick temper, and I'm not afraid to use it.
I enjoy showing off my skills to impress others.
I'm fiercely competitive, and I hate to lose.
I'm loyal to my tribe, and I will do whatever it takes to protect them.
I'm slow to trust outsiders, but I'm always willing to give them a chance.
I'm passionate about my beliefs, and I can be quite persuasive when defending them.
I'm a natural leader, and I take my responsibilities seriously.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Glory. I want to be remembered as one of the greatest warriors of all time. (Any)
Honor. I fight with honor and expect others to do the same. (Good)
Courage. I never back down from a challenge, no matter how dangerous. (Neutral)
Justice. I will do whatever it takes to protect the innocent and defend the weak. (Lawful)
Loyalty. I am devoted to my tribe and will do whatever I can to ensure their safety and prosperity. (Good)
Strength. I respect those who are strong and powerful, and I strive to become even stronger myself. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I have a mentor who taught me everything I know about combat, and I'm fiercely loyal to that person.
I have a close friend or family member who is also a skilled fighter, and we have a friendly rivalry.
I have a patron who sponsors me in battles and expects me to perform well.
I am determined to uphold the honor of my tribe, and I won't let anyone dishonor its legacy.
I have sworn an oath to protect my people and defend our land from harm.
I seek to prove my worthiness and become the greatest warrior my tribe has ever known.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I tend to be overconfident and underestimate my opponents.
I am often dismissive of those who are not skilled fighters.
I have a weakness for gambling and often make foolish bets on the outcome of battles.
I have a short temper, and I have difficulty controlling my emotions in combat.
I am easily influenced by those with more power and status than I have.
I am eager to engage in combat and often rush into battle without considering the consequences.

_.displayName: A {@item shiftweave|ERLW} garment (capable of shifting between five different outfits)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item shiftweave|ERLW} garment (capable of shifting between five different outfits), one trinket of special significance, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: The Right Face for the Job
entries: Traveler clans use well-established personas to secure shelter and information wherever they go. This could be a priest who will receive sustenance at the local temple, a folk hero who will be sheltered by the common people, or a veteran soldier who can always get a bed at the local garrison. When you're approaching a new community, work with the DM to determine if there could be a persona with roots in that place; as long as you play that role, you can usually obtain modest food and lodging and gain access to local gossip.

In addition, when you encounter other members of your clan, you can ask them for help or information, provided this doesn't place them at risk. However, this is a two-way street; if another member of your clan approaches you with a reasonable request, you're expected to provide assistance.

entries.name: Fledgling Persona
entries: Personas are important tools for traveler clans. Every clan has a set of shared personas, identities that have an established role in a particular region. But these personas need to be refreshed over time, and it's your duty to develop a new persona that can be useful to the clan. Over the course of your adventuring career, you're expected to establish useful connections and build a positive reputation for this identity. You can select your persona from the Personas table or roll randomly, then add details to develop them into a unique identity.

rows: Traveling merchant
Charismatic outlaw
Iterant tinker
Wandering priest
Investigative reporter
Bounty hunter
Grim mercenary
Beloved storyteller

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: While changeling travelers can be tricksters and agents of  chaos, others strive to support strangers and have a positive influence wherever they go. Are you a charming scoundrel, a devotee of the Traveler, or just trying to stay out of trouble?

rows: I love people and seek the stories of each stranger I meet.
I embrace all beliefs, trying a new religion every few days.
I feel obliged to humiliate arrogant and entitled people.
Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.
I thrive on change and hate standing still.
I don't just want to defeat my enemies; I want to make them look foolish.
I'm always looking for weaknesses in others to exploit.
I love uncovering secrets, whether arcane lore or mere gossip.
Freedom. I go wherever I please and don't let rules or laws limit my actions. (Chaotic)
Survival. I will do whatever it takes to ensure the survival and prosperity of myself and the people I care about. (Neutral)
Empathy. I try to understand everyone that I meet, to imagine what it would be like to live their lives. (Good)
Change. We should challenge every tradition and always strive for innovation. (Chaotic)
Predator. Anyone I can deceive deserves their fate. (Evil)
Knowledge. Secrets are the only currency that matters. (Any)
Someone died saving my life, but they live on through me as one of my personas.
I've inherited the persona of a great folk hero, but I'm afraid I can't live up to their reputation.
I've inherited a persona that's become known as an infamous villain, and I'm determined to redeem the identity.
My family was betrayed by a rival changeling clan, and I'm determined to avenge them.
I joined a criminal gang to learn useful skills, then abandoned the identity; I still care about my old comrades, but I'm afraid to go back.
I embarrassed a powerful noble I once served; their hired thugs are looking for me, but someone I love is still in their employ.
I don't really understand the concept of "personal property."
I consider a good story to be more important than the truth, and I'll always add a little flair.
I'm suspicious of everyone and everything.
I live in the moment and never plan for the future.
If someone wrongs me, I won't rest until I've taken revenge.
It's difficult for me to be honest, even with my closest friends.

entries: You're an urban nomad, wandering from city to city, a force for change—much like the Traveler who bestowed you with your supernatural gifts. You spent your childhood traveling with your family, using your abilities to evade your enemies and ensure the single-skins give you whatever you need. Your family is part of a wider network of changeling clans, and you can take advantage of the havens, traditions, and personas your people have sowed across the lands. Most travelers are changelings. If you're not a changeling, you were born to a changeling parent and grew up around them; you may even use a disguise kit or illusion magic to mimic their abilities.

As a traveler, you're most comfortable on the move and dislike staying in any one place for too long. Your people's traditions predate the laws of Galifar, and you have little attachment to any concept of nation or property; your first loyalty is to your family and your friends. Some travelers ignore the laws of the Five Nations, or even see tricking single-skins as a sport and enjoy defying them. However, most respect the people around them; if they acquire an item from a single-skin, they'll compensate with something of equal value. Some sow chaos in the name of the Traveler, while others seek to understand people and serve as a bridge between cultures. What path do you follow?

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) 2 {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, 2 {@item Pouch|XPHB|Pouches}, {@item Shiftweave|ERLW|Shiftweave clothing}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: You're an urban nomad wandering from city to city. You spent your childhood traveling with your family, using your abilities to evade your enemies. Do you strive to be a force for positive change in the world, or are you an opportunist looking out for yourself? Most Changeling Travelers are {@race Changeling|EFA|Changelings}. If you're not a Changeling, you were born to a changeling parent and traveled with them; you could use a {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB} or illusion magic to mimic their abilities.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB}, {@item Shield|XPHB}, {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 6 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: Knights of the Charneault Kingdom are more than soldiers. You're an exemplar of the virtues that maintain peace and prosperity in the realm. Through training and study, you've dedicated your life to upholding noble ideals such as strength, bravery, charity, temperance, and tradition.
You shoulder as a coat of arms your commitments to which you're sworn—those of your household or Knight Chapter. If you are still a squire, yet to accomplish your first quest, your shield is blank.

You might receive many honors during your journeys, though much will be expected of you. Folk may look to you as a protector, leader, or keeper of traditions—or you may be feared as a stern justiciar of the Crown's justice. The path of a knight is difficult and perilous, and not all who walk it maintain their virtues.

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born. As you traveled the circuit from public house to watering hole, you learned to prey on unfortunates who were in the market for a comforting lie or two—perhaps a sham potion or forged ancestry records.

Charlatans are colorful characters who conceal their true selves behind the masks they construct. They reflect what people want to see, what they want to believe, and how they see the world. But their true selves are sometimes plagued by an uneasy conscience, an old enemy, or deep-seated trust issues.

rows: I was left to my own devices, and my knack for manipulating others helped me survive.
I learned early on that people are gullible and easy to exploit.
I often got in trouble, but I managed to talk my way out of it every time.
I took up with a confidence artist, from whom I learned my craft.
After a charlatan fleeced my family, I decided to learn the trade so I would never be fooled by such deception again.
I was poor or I feared becoming poor, so I learned the tricks I needed to keep myself out of poverty.
I fall in and out of love easily, and am always pursuing someone.
I have a joke for every occasion, especially occasions where humor is inappropriate.
Flattery is my preferred trick for getting what I want.
I'm a born gambler who can't resist taking a risk for a potential payoff.
I lie about almost everything, even when there's no reason to.
Sarcasm and insults are my weapons of choice.
I keep multiple holy symbols on me and invoke whatever deity might come in useful at any given moment.
I pocket anything I see that might have some value.
Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do. (Chaotic)
Fairness. I never target people who can't afford to lose a few coins. (Lawful)
Charity. I distribute the money I acquire to the people who really need it. (Good)
Creativity. I never run the same con twice. (Chaotic)
Friendship. Material goods come and go. Bonds of friendship last forever. (Good)
Aspiration. I'm determined to make something of myself. (Any)
I fleeced the wrong person and must work to ensure that this individual never crosses paths with me or those I care about.
I owe everything to my mentor—a horrible person who's probably rotting in jail somewhere.
Somewhere out there, I have a child who doesn't know me. I'm making the world better for him or her.
I come from a noble family, and one day I'll reclaim my lands and title from those who stole them from me.
A powerful person killed someone I love. Some day soon, I'll have my revenge.
I swindled and ruined a person who didn't deserve it. I seek to atone for my misdeeds but might never be able to forgive myself.
I can't resist a pretty face.
I'm always in debt. I spend my ill-gotten gains on decadent luxuries faster than I bring them in.
I'm convinced that no one could ever fool me the way I fool others.
I'm too greedy for my own good. I can't resist taking a risk if there's money involved.
I can't resist swindling people who are more powerful than me.
I hate to admit it and will hate myself for it, but I'll run and preserve my own hide if the going gets tough.

_.special: scroll case stuffed full of notes and anatomical diagrams
small set of sharp surgical blades in leather wrappings

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item healer's kit|phb}, {@item herbalism kit|phb}, scroll case stuffed full of notes and anatomical diagrams, small set of sharp surgical blades in leather wrappings, common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Overview
entries: You are a trained physician. You probably started out as a simple barber surgeon but you've had proper training since then. Maybe you attended one of the Greenhands' training programs at the university, or perhaps you completed an apprenticeship under a master physician. Either way, you know more about the mysteries of the humanoid body than those around you. You can identify wounds and have a strong grasp of the materials and methods needed to attend to them.

entries.name: Feature: Doctor's kit.
entries: Amid the city's rationing, you've learned to make the most of your healer's kit. Instead of 10 uses, you can get 20 uses out of a healer's kit. Another creature who lacks this feature and uses a kit of yours consumes 2 uses of it.

_.displayName: a mark of your community (a signet ring, a religious emblem, or a branded scale)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, a mark of your community (a {@item signet ring|phb}, a religious {@item emblem|phb}, or a branded scale), and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Shared Society
entries: You previously pursued a simple profession among your community before you were chosen. Your community and your role within it have played a defining part in your life. Choose or randomly determine the nature of your community from the table below.

rows: You are part of an isolated clan of barbarians. Each century, a warrior is selected to take on the role of guardian and maintain balance between the elements.
You are a member of a secret society that is searching for a way to prolong life. You are the latest experiment.
A small group of demi-dragons travel the country-side, offering transformation to those who are willing. You accepted, and found a start to a new life.
Selected by your village to confront an ancient dragon, you had expected to meet death. Instead, the dragon agreed to your terms, but bound you in a magical pact.
As an acolyte of a dragon god, your prayers for strength were one day answered. The priesthood has since recognized you as a minor saint.
You were part of an adventurer's guild for years before an unfortunate accident caused your transformation.

entries.name: Feature: Community Support
entries: You are accepted as part of a community that will care for you and provide you with shelter, food, and any information that they can. Your community will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Though different from those around you, you've been accepted as part of the community, and have shared in local values, customs, and daily practices.

rows: I always put others ahead of myself.
I prefer to listen to the opinions of those around me before speaking my mind.
I like to hear myself talk.
I am loyal and dependable to the end.
My life is built on secrets, as is my community.
I always act with great solemnity and ceremony.
I have adopted the persona that my community believes me to be, but that's not the real me.
I feel like an outsider and a fraud, unable to really connect with those around me.
Dedication. I have an important cause that I devote myself to which will benefit everyone.
Tradition. I uphold the traditions of my community and bring honor to us all. (Lawful)
Peace. We can only be truly happy in those rare moments of quiet. (Neutral)
Adventure. Home is well and good, but I only truly live when I break away from daily life. (Chaotic)
Prestige. I will spread my influence far and wide, and use it for my own ends. (Evil)
Bravery. To act when others quake in fear-this is the essence of the warrior. (Any)
I used to work as a craftsman, and I still have a close relationship with the artisan who taught me.
I am a natural-born leader, and have worked for years to coordinate with my community.
My family has taken my transformation poorly.
My community is split into opposed factions, with me at the center of the conflict.
My community has entrusted me with a mission. I must live up to what is expected of me.
I have grown distant from those around me since my transformation. Things can't ever be the same again.
I desperately crave acceptance from those around me. I am terrified of being rejected.
I worry that others now think of me as strange, and obsess over the smallest comment or glance.
I have certain traditions and rituals that I follow routinely. I must never fail to uphold them.
I secretly believe that I am more important than others.
I believe in complicated conspiracy movements that explain the real truth of this world.
I have trouble acknowledging that I have flaws. I get aggressive about it if others confront me about it.

entries: You were chosen by a small community of individuals to undergo transformation. Perhaps you were a promising young warrior who was deemed ready to take part in an ancient ritual, or maybe you were part of a group of zealous dragon worshippers, honored to be selected as a vessel for their devotion. Regardless of how the rest of the world may view you now, you can always count on the small group of people that support you, perceiving you as an exalted idol.

_.special: snipping of a plant that never withers

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item quarterstaff|PHB}, a snipping of a plant that never withers, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 {@item gold|PHB}.

entries.name: All Walks of Life
entries: Ahdryatmin is a truly ancient being, one that has imparted knowledge of the ages to humanoids, dragons, and immortals alike. There is no rhyme nor reason as to who is given an audience with them. Who were you before? Are you still that person now? Have you abandoned your life for a new purpose, or do you try and balance that with the duties of your patron? You can select a Previous Occupation below or roll randomly, then add details to determine just the type of person Ahdryatmin chose to bless.

entries.name: Feature: Lamannia's Touch
entries: You have an affinity with the natural world and the creatures within, including elementals. You can roughly understand what beasts are trying to convey, and animals are overall less hostile towards you unless provoked. Elementals are more inclined to listen to you, consider you as an ally, and come to your aid.

entries.caption: Previous Occupations
rows: Summit Road guide
Monastic scholar
Village artisan
Lightbringer
Riedran refugee
A wandering criminal

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Those chosen by the Mountainsoul are eclectic at best. Are you excited by the prospect of a grand adventure? Do you dread the road ahead? Would you rather go back to the life you once had, or are you happy to start anew?

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I feel more at home with plants and animals than people; they're much better communicators too.
Life on the road scares me, even after all I've seen.
I seem more confident to friends and loved ones.
I search for hidden clues of the world everywhere I go.
I'm obsessed with uncovering the truth, no matter the cost.
I have experienced enlightenment and want to share my findings with others.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Truth.} I want to uncover what other secrets the world may have in store. (Any)
{@b Survival.} The world is harsh, and I will ensure that the people I care about survive and prosper. (Neutral)
{@b Stewardship.} I want to ensure that this world continues for future generations. (Good)
{@b Duty.} I have been given a purpose, and I will see it to its end. (Lawful)
{@b Domination.} The wilds do not pity the weak. (Evil)
{@b Exploration.} I want to see what this world has to offer beyond my hometown. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: Ahdryatmin saved my life. I will do anything to repay such a debt.
Someone I love has gone missing, and I now have the knowledge to find where they went.
Everyone thinks I'm some great hero now, and I don't know how to live up to that.
I was shown the location of a great artifact, and I must secure it before a rival does.
A face keeps appearing to me in a vision; I must find out who they are.
In the wild zone, I saw a vision of the future. I must stop a great calamity before it comes to pass.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: My manners weren't good before I went missing for a year.
I refuse to listen to mundane problems anymore.
I'm often absent-minded, seeing too much at once.
Loud, crowded spaces might as well be Khyber.
I'm overly direct about my quest to the point of rudeness.
I'm brash at the best of moments.

name: Chosen One

_.special: a copy of the prophecy you are named to fulfil
a talisman from the god or the being that chose you

entries: You are destined for something greater—at least, that is what everyone says. You were raised under the assumption that you were fated to fulfill some ancient prophecy. The pressure to meet the impossible expectations set upon you is immense.

items.name: Languages
items.entry: Two exotic languages of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of common clothes, a copy of the prophecy you are named to fulfil, a talisman from the god or other being that chose you, a journal, and a pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Predestiny
entries: It has been determined that you are the fulfillment of a prophecy. Discuss the contents of the prophecy with your DM, how it might play into your campaign, if it's true, and what your character thinks of their mission, or roll on the table below.

rows: Save the world from a dark, evil force
End a major war or other ongoing conflict
Free an oppressed people and raise them to glory
Bring spiritual salvation
Cause the end of the world
The prophecy doesn't mention what I'll do
My cunning, skill, and determination.
The power of some abstract virtue (i.e. love, honor, trust).
An ultimate power I'm only beginning to understand.
An unstoppable weapon only I can wield.
My own death.
The prophecy doesn't mention how I'll do it.

entries.name: Feature: Mark of the Chosen
entries: You have an unusual physical feature that marks you as the chosen one, such as a strange birthmark, odd scar, or unnatural hair or eye color. It is in a visible place, noticeable by most people unless you cover it.

People familiar with the prophecy recognize you immediately. If they believe in and support your quest, they will be more willing to help you, as long as it doesn't put them in danger. They also might ask you to help them with their own problems using your supposed power. If they are against your quest, they will treat you with hostility and may even attack you outright.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The chosen reach adulthood with the weight of the world on their shoulders. Believing that they are destined for great things could bolster their confidence or plague them with doubts.

rows: As an important figure and potential role model, I must hold myself to high standards.
Destiny is on my side, why shouldn't I be optimistic?
My quest is serious. I have no time for revelry or games.
I carry myself with sureness and confidence, whether I feel that way or not.
They must have found the wrong person - I can't be the chosen one.
I've been practicing dramatic speeches in preparation for my final confrontation.
I feel responsible for the lives of everyone I meet.
I don't like people knowing I'm the chosen one. It's uncomfortable when they recognize me.
{@bold Destiny.} I will do whatever is foretold, no matter how difficult. (Lawful)
{@bold Heroism.} I must help the world at any cost to myself. (Good)
{@bold Fame.} I am special, and I want everyone to know of my great deeds. (Any)
{@bold Free Will.} To the hells with the prophecy; I do what I want. (Chaotic)
{@bold Power.} When I acquire the power I am destined to wield, I will rule everything. (Evil)
{@bold Normalcy.} I avoid my quest or seek to finish it because I wish to return to a normal life. (Any)
I do great deeds to bring honor to my family name.
I keep a copy of the prophecy close to me and study it most every night.
If I don't succeed, my homeland will be doomed.
My teacher gave me everything to prepare me for my quest, and I will not let them down.
I am fated to meet my soulmate on my quest. I look forward to it.
I place my life in the hands of the god or other being who chose me.
The great good I do in the future will outweigh any evil I do now.
The prophecy is very vague, and I don't really know what I'm doing.
If I'm fated to do this great thing, nothing can kill me before then! Right?
I care more about taking advantage of my reputation than living up to it.
I fear I am too much a coward to do what I must do in the end.
My quest is far more important than any of the petty goals other people have.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: {@item Calligrapher's supplies|PHB}, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing an {@item ink pen|PHB}, a {@item ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of ink}, ten {@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|sheets of paper}, and 5 gp

entries.name: Chronicle
entries: As a chronicler, you work for an ongoing publication. What's your agency, and what are they best known for? Do you work for the trusted {@i Korranberg Chronicle}, or are you a muckraker for the {@i Daily Prophecy}?

rows: The Korranberg Chronicle. The most trusted source of news across Khorvaire.
The Sharn Inquisitive. A blend of national news and the local gossip of Sharn.
Aureon's Arcanix. A monthly publication on the latest developments in magic.
The Wayfinder's Weekly. A digest of the exciting deeds of legendary adventurers across Eberron.
The Voice of Cyre. A chronicle focusing on the plight of Cyran refugees and helping to preserve Cyran culture.
The Voice of the Flame. A Thrane publication dealing with news and inspiring stories of interest to followers of the Silver Flame.
The Daily Prophecy. A fringe publication focusing on conspiracy theories and bizarre rumors. Headlines like, "Dragons are running Zilargo! King Kaius is a vampire!" are commonplace.
The Library of Korranberg. You gather knowledge on behalf of the grandest repository of information in Khorvaire.

entries.name: Feature: Press Pass
entries: You're an established reporter for a known source of news. You can often get access to restricted events for yourself and your "crew" so you can cover the story. People familiar with your work may be excited to talk to you, and even people who have something to hide may not want to turn you away without explanation. Of course, using your credentials in this way draws a lot of attention!

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You've spent your life asking questions and uncovering secrets. You may be driven by insatiable curiosity, or you could have a deep belief that the people deserve to know all that can be known.

rows: I'm always asking questions, even when it's inappropriate.
I'm constantly taking notes on everything around me.
I frequently narrate the events around me.
I'm sure there's more to the story, whatever the story may be.
I never use one word when I could use five.
I'm always chasing after celebrities.
I'll do anything to get a good story.
I have a pen name and exaggerated personality I use when I'm reporting.
Balance. Revealing the absolute truth is all that matters, regardless of whether it tips the balance towards good or evil. (Neutral)
Honor. The best way to fight corruption and evil is to expose it to the public. (Good)
Revolution. Opponents who can't be fought with swords can be beaten with words. You use your writing to undermine established authority and introduce new ideas. (Chaotic)
Civilization. It's your duty to record the history of your nation and to preserve and celebrate the values of your culture. (Lawful)
Power. Truth is irrelevant. People believe what they want to believe, or what you want them to believe. How can you use your writing to gain power and influence? (Evil)
Entertainment. People need diversion and entertainment. You're not interested in news; you just want to find brilliant stories to share. (Any)
I'm sure that one of the other party members has a grand destiny, and I'm going to record their story from the very beginning.
My family was ruined by a corrupt conspiracy. I'm going to expose this cabal and bring it down.
The people have a right to know the truth.
People need to know about the long-term impact of the war.
I'm going to break the story of the century.
I want my work to bring people together.
I'm convinced there's a vast conspiracy behind everything that goes wrong.
I won't take "no" for an answer.
I've made a lot of enemies with my writing.
I don't trust anyone. Everyone has something to hide.
I'm happy to exploit my friends to get a good story.
Once I've settled on a story, I become completely obsessed with it.

entries: People need news, and you're the one to provide it. You could be an investigative reporter searching for issues of national importance such as conspiracies, corruption, threats of war, or news about the Mourning. You could be gathering gossip, or sharing the tales of bold adventurers, so make sure your friends do something worthy of a story! You could also be a general agent of the Library of Korranberg, always watchful for anything that could expand the repository of general knowledge.

_.special: identification papers marking you as a citizen of your nation
one set of tools you are proficient with

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Identification papers marking you as a citizen of your nation, one set of tools you are proficient with, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Background Feature
entries: Although all citizens of a nation might share the same culture, they are individuals. Select the background feature of any other background listed in the Player's Handbook. You gain that background feature.

entries.caption: Citizen Proficiencies
rows: Aundair
an Aundairian
{@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}
{@item alchemist's supplies|phb} plus one of the following: winemaker's supplies, {@item cook's utensils|phb}, {@item calligrapher's supplies|phb}
Breland
a Brel
{@skill History}, {@skill Insight}
one type of {@item gaming set|phb}
One of your choice
Cyre
a Cyran
{@skill History}, plus {@skill Performance} or {@skill Survival}
one type of {@item musical instrument|phb}, or one of the following: {@item calligrapher's supplies|phb}, {@item jeweler's tools|phb}, {@item painter's supplies|phb}
One of your choice
Karrnath
a Karrn
{@skill Athletics}, {@skill History}
{@item brewer's supplies|phb}, Conqueror {@item gaming set|phb}
Thrane
a Thrane
{@skill History}, {@skill Religion}
one of the following: {@item carpenter's tools|phb}, {@item cobbler's tools|phb}, {@item leatherworker's tools|phb}
Celestial

entries: First and foremost, you consider yourself a true scion of your homeland. The Five Nations are the oldest standing bastions of civilization in Khorvaire and possessed distinct cultural identities before, during, and now after the united Kingdom of Galifar.

Even if you were not born in your country proper, but rather were raised in an expatriate community like those in Stormreach, your community continues the strong traditions of its motherland. After the Last War, the Five Nations were further divided by the Treaty of Thronehold into many different sovereign nations. Though these countries have begun to have solidified their own national identities, most of them are too new or lawless to develop the kind of shared cultural experience that the Five Nations attained over a thousand years. Many citizens of these new nations still cling to the identity of their former parent nation, even if they don't realize it.
Your background grants you equipment, plus skill, tool, and language proficiencies specific to the nation you consider your homeland.

name: Citizen Activist

_.displayName: seminal text that has influenced your activism
notebook written in code with your contacts

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A seminal text that has influenced your activism, a {@item book|PHB|notebook} written in code with your contacts, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries: The system is corrupt. Change will only come if the oppressed come together to resist. Your work may happen out in the open or perhaps in secret. Work with the GM to decide what form your activism takes. Maybe you lead a coalition that lobbies elected officials or nobles for a change in local law. Perhaps you organize jobs, medical care, and food for those who need it. You could lead demonstrations and engage in civil disobedience, distribute literature or tag walls in the city with graffiti that calls attention to unfair taxation, break people out of jail, or redistribute wealth.

entries.name: Feature: Lay of the Land
entries: As someone who spends their time opposing hegemonic power, organizing like-minded people to join your cause, and providing aid to those harmed by the system, you have an intimate knowledge of the power structures in your community, as well as how to navigate them. This includes government bodies, businesses, secret societies, religious orders, guilds, other activist groups, and any other faction that holds sway and influence.

You also know who the leaders of these various entities are, including those who operate clandestinely (at your GM's discretion). In a new place, you can quickly figure out where to go and who to talk to in order to get this information.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Citizen activists are people who live and breathe the idea of being the change they wish to see in the world. Sure, they're everyday people who don't necessarily possess the resources of those in power or with more privilege and access, but what they have is a determination to change things for the better, a deep understanding of how the common person can affect change, and an optimism or even just a bit of hope that change is actually possible. See the tables in the Personal Characteristics section below for more ideas.

items.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: {@skill Intimidation}, choose one from {@skill Deception}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Persuasion}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Survival}.

items.name: Languages
entries: Choose one standard language.

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: Choose one {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}

items.name: Equipment
entries: A worn {@item blanket|phb}, a set of ragged clothing, a {@item sack|phb}, a pair of tough leather gloves, one {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice, a {@item mess kit|phb} and 10 copper pieces.

entries.name: Display of Strength
