Either you were an artisan chef with a fine sense of taste, a master chef who knows dozens on dozens of recipes by heart, or a cook at the mess hall, serving food quickly and on the double. You understand that food has a voice; it can express moods with the right combinations of ingredients, or bring people together with a peaceful meal. What brought you out of the kitchen? A rare ingredient? Maybe your upper chef decided it was time for you to go? Or, maybe, you wanted to go on an adventure to diversify your recipe book? Regardless on why you decided to change pace from your culinary solitude, your cooking and food handling skills will prove vital to an adventuring party. You may even find food where most people don't!

items.name: Languages
items.entry: 2 languages of your choice, from which you derive your culinary terminology and techniques.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item mess kit|phb}, a set of {@item cook's utensils|phb}, a {@item glass bottle|phb|bottle} of cooking {@item oil (flask)|phb|oil}, a {@item Heward's Handy Spice Pouch|xge|spice kit}, several recipe {@item book|phb|books}, a {@item tinderbox|phb}, an {@item iron pot|phb}, your choice of {@item costume clothes|phb|costume} or {@item fine clothes|phb}, an electrum spork or plans for kitchensmith tools, and a belt pouch containing 5gp.

entries.name: Feature: Through Their Stomachs
entries: You are able to earn a comfortable living for free during your downtime, by working as a cook. In addition, you are able to feed your adventuring companions modest meals each day for free, unless the DM discerns that you are in a barren place devoid of anything edible for miles, such as a desert or dungeon. You are also able to use your talents to arrange meetings with anyone interested in a free meal. By offering to a cook a free meal for someone who would appreciate it, you are able to have audience with them over that meal, or they may otherwise simply owe you a small favor.

entries.name: Brigade de Cuisine
entries: {@i Brigade de cuisine} (kitchen brigade in Common) is a system of hierarchy found in restaurants and hotels employing extensive staff, commonly referred to as "kitchen staff" in Common-speaking countries. This structured team system delegates responsibilities to different individuals who specialize in certain tasks. You can alter these titles to suit your language choice for this background.

rows: {@b {@i Chef de Cuisine} or {@i sous chef}.} Manages the kitchen and its staff. The {@i Chef de Cuisine} is typically authorised to write and alter the menu, while a {@i sous chef} is just a manager.

{@b {@i Chef de Partie}.} Manages a portion of the kitchen staff if the team is very large. Examples include {@i Rôtisseur} (roast cook), {@i Entremetier} (entrée preparer), and {@i Pâtissier} (pastry cook). If they do the work themselves, they are called a {@i demi-chef}.

{@b {@i Cuisinier}.} An cook in an independent position which requires no team or division of oversight, so are generally superior to {@i cuisiniers de parti}, but subordinate to all {@i chefs}. Examples include {@i Saucier} (saucemaker), {@i Poissonnier} (fishcook), {@i Boucher} (butcher), and {@i Communard} (Kitchen staff meal cook).

entries: {@b {@i Cuisinier de Parti}.} A subordinate to a chef in a particular area of the kitchen:

items: The {@i Grillardin} (grill cook) and {@i Friturier} (fry cook) answer to the {@i Rôtisseur}.
The {@i Potager} (soup cook) and {@i Legumier} (vegetable cook) answer to the {@i Entremetier}.
The {@i Confiseur} (candy maker), {@i Glacier} (frozen desert maker), {@i Décorateur} (dessert decorator), and {@i Boulanger} (baker) answer to the {@i Pâtissier}.

rows: {@b Apprentice or {@i commis.}} Generally an assistant, they look after the cooking equipment, not the food. A successful apprentice becomes a {@i commis}, who eventually takes on higher responsibilities.

{@b Kitchen Staff.} These positions deal with other tasks around the kitchen, and include the {@i Garde Manger} (pantry supervisor), {@i Aboyeur} (announcer/expediter), {@i Tournant} (spare hand/roundsman), {@i Garçon de cuisine} (kitchen boy), and {@i Plongeur/Marmiton} or {@i Porter} (dish/pot washer). All of these positions are known to be enlisted to do basic/menial food preparation.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Chefs vary widely in temperaments. As professionals, they can be fickle and perfectionists who run their team ragged. However, they are also dedicated to their vocation and skill to ultimately fill up bellies and provide hospitality.

rows: My opinion is relevant - whether you like it or not.
I multitask very well.
I let others know I expect them to work as hard as I do.
I make noises which indicate my mood when I eat.
When insulted, I hurl even greater insults (or food) back.
I like to take my time and savor each moment.
I try to keep things as clean as possible.
I am always on the lookout for something novel and exotic.
{@b Creativity.} I don't even follow my own recipes, I just follow my gut instinct! (Chaotic)
{@b Knowledge.} You can learn a lot about people from what they choose to eat. (Neutral)
{@b Hierarchy.} I know my place. Know yours. (Lawful)
{@b Generosity.} My gift is for all to enjoy! (Good)
{@b Community.} I am just one contribution which keeps this society together (Neutral)
{@b Fame.} I will be known as the greatest master chef for all time! (Any)
My grandmother had a secret recipe she took to her grave. I am trying to replicate it.
There is a famous chef who I idolize.
I am putting together a book of recipes from around the world!
While other lands have vibrant cuisine, nothing beats a meal in the home country.
I use only the elaborate techniques of my master, even when preparing simple dishes.
I always keep a bottle of my favorite spice or herb on hand.
I'd rather eat nothing than something bland, stale, burnt, undercooked, or otherwise beneath me.
I am comedically competitive.
I am a gluttonous pig.
I whine and complain when uncomfortable.
I have little to no tolerance for frivolity.
I have troubles trusting others with their assigned tasks, especially if I assigned them.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Insight}, plus one from among {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Perception}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One from among vehicles (land) or vehicles (water)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a set of handcuffs, an old uniform, and a {@item credit stick|TTT} with 500 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Lawman
entries: You've been a part of the force, and the force will always be a part of you. You know how to cut through the bureaucracy of the local precincts and you know how to work the legal system in your favor. Other cops will ignore your minor crimes and misdemeanors. You have an easier time negotiating with security forces to question witnesses, access crime scenes, bail out the jailed, or avoid consequences.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Those who choose to take up the badge are a diverse cast, and come to the force for different reasons. They are often jaded and cynical from their constant contact with the underbelly of society. However, they are also often fiercely loyal to their partners and allies, and will have their backs through thick and thin.

rows: I'm suspicious by nature because everyone has a secret they want to hide.
I have a set of codes that I live by, and there are some lines I won't cross.
I have a strong sense of community, I like to get to know each and every member.
I won't betray those I form a bond with, even if it costs me everything.
I'm polite and empathetic to those in need.
I'm the wiseguy who tends to crack jokes under stress.
I tend to shoot first and ask questions later.
I may have watched too many cop movies.
{@bold Duty.} The day I got my badge, I swore an oath: to protect and serve. (Good)
{@bold Authority.} Without law, society falls to anarchy. I am the law. (Lawful)
{@bold Greed.} Rules are for others, why not enjoy the fringe benefits along the way? (Chaotic)
{@bold Oppression.} Those who don't do what I tell them will get what they deserve. (Evil)
{@bold Shades of Grey.} There's no good or bad people, everyone's just trying to get by. (Neutral)
{@bold Comrades.} Whatever happens, I've got their back, and they've got mine. (Any)
My family member was a cop too, until they were killed on the job. Now I'll do anything to find out who did it.
There are criminals, and there are scum. I can get along with criminals, but I'll clean up the scum.
A murder case I investigated went cold a long time ago, but I know the killer is still out there.
Crime is just a symptom of a greater societal disease.
A job is a job, so long as I get a paycheck.
My partner died because of decisions I made, and now I have to live with that.
I tend to take a stand when I should probably run or shut up.
When the shit hits the fan, I go into self preservation mode.
I've got a mean streak a mile wide.
There's no such thing as excessive force.
When I get in a position of power, I tend to abuse it.
I'm a bit of a control freak, everything has to be just right.

entries: The buildings dress themselves in neon advertisements for criminals big and small, the drugs get more addictive year by year, the weapons get bigger and badder, but the streets, they never change. Scum prey on the weaknesses of others, only to be crushed beneath the heel from someone higher up the food chain.

From atop their steel towers, the suits run a similar game, but they posture and pretend like it's somehow more sophisticated when the result is the same: broken people and shattered dreams. In this urban jungle, between glittering skyscrapers and lawless slums, you rode the edge with a gun and a badge.

You may have been a beat cop, a detective, a SWAT officer, or a humble desk jockey. At some point in your career, the time came to look toward justice and the law, or the other way. Perhaps you were offered a bribe, or were pressured by others, but you knew it was time to decide: do you serve the people, or yourself?

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item two-person tent|phb}, {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, a {@item holy symbol|phb}, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Poor

entries.name: Overview
entries: You are one of hundreds of refugees that were driven from Hillsfar or that fled the destruction of Myth Drannor and who now shelter in hidden camps under the northern eaves of the Cormanthor Forest. If you up grew in the camps, you have never been to a settlement other than the village of Elventree. As a guest of the elves, you have learned their ways and the ways of the forest. You are also a traumatized, as residual wild magic, energies released by the fall of Thultanthar upon Myth Drannor, and the constant fear of raids hunting for non-humans to fight in Hillsfar's Arena have taken their toll on you, as they have on everyone in the camps.

entries.name: Feature: Shelter of the Elven Clergy
entries: The clerics of Elventree have vowed to care for the Cormanthor refugees. They will help you when they can, including providing you and your companions with free healing and care at temples, shrines, and other established presences in Elventree. They will also provide you (but only you) with a poor lifestyle. Note: This feature is a variant of the Acolyte feature.

rows: I long for a home that never really existed, whether in the camps, Hillsfar, or Myth Drannor.
Though I am not an elf, I am a fervent, radical worshipper of the elven gods.
I live in the moment, knowing my life could be turned upside down any day.
I appreciate beauty in all of its forms.
I hate the dark elves and the Netherese for each driving the elves out of Cormanthyr in the past.
I am a forest bumpkin who grew up in a tent in the woods and is wholly ignorant of city life.
I was raised alongside children of many other races. I harbor no racial prejudices at all.
The elves have just the right word for so many things that cannot be expressed as well in other languages. I pepper my speech with elven words, phrases, and sayings.
Patient. The elves have taught me to think and plan for the long-term. (Lawful)
Rebellious. Governments and politicians drove my family to the camps. I subtly defy authority whenever I think I can get away with it. (Chaotic)
Self - Absorbed. I've had to look out for number one so long that it has become second nature. (Any)
Wanderlust. I want to see as much of the world beyond the camps as I can. (Any)
Generous. I give everything I can to help those in need, regardless of who they are. (Good)
To the Abyss with Them. The people of Hillsfar cast me out. I won't risk my hide to help them. (Evil)
The elves took me in when I had nowhere else to go. In return, I do what I can to help elves in need.
I seek revenge against the people of Hillsfar for driving my family into the forest.
My family lost everything when they were driven from Hillsfar. I strive to rebuild that fortune.
The forest has provided me with food and shelter. In return, I protect forests and those who dwell within.
I am deeply, tragically in love with someone whose racial lifespan is far longer or shorter than mine.
Members of my extended family did not make it to the camps or have been kidnapped to fight in the Arena. I search for them tirelessly.
I am very uncomfortable indoors and underground.
I am haughty. I grew up among the elves and emulate them. Other races are crude in comparison.
Elf this, elf that. I am sick and tired of the elves.
I am a miser. Having lost everything once before, I clutch my possessions and wealth very tightly.
I am a moocher. I am so used to others providing for me that I have come to expect everyone to do it.
I believe the gods have cursed me, my family, and all of the Cormanthor refugees. We are all doomed, doomed I tell you!

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Riddle|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Pipe|TLotRR|Pipes}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Secretive, Subtle

_.displayName: A set of artisan's tools of your choice

entries: A master artisan never wants for work. But mastery takes decades, so you elected to take a shortcut and studied advertising. You sell your goods with nothing more than a clever pitch, without the slightest concern for their quality.

Often, you make shoddy replicas that pass as real treasures made by master artisans under rudimentary inspection. Why build your own reputation when you can benefit from someone else's hard work? If found out, you can always peddle your wares to the next set of unsuspecting customers, most of whom will never know they purchased a fake.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Forgery kit|phb}, one type of {@item artisan's tools|phb} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item artisan's tools|phb} of your choice, 10 forged certifications of authenticity, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp, and 50 counterfeit silver pieces

entries.name: Fake Specialty
entries: Choose two options or roll twice on the table below to determine the business or industry whose phony goods you peddle.

rows: Alchemists and apothecaries
Armorers, locksmiths, and finesmiths
Brewers, distillers, and vintners
Calligraphers, scribes, and scriveners
Carpenters, roofers, and plasterers
Cartographers, surveyors, and chart-makers
Cobblers and shoemakers
Cooks and bakers
Glassblowers and glaziers
Jewelers and gem cutters
Leatherworkers, skinners, and tanners
Masons and stonecutters
Painters, limners, and sign-makers
Potters and tile-makers
Shipwrights and sail-makers
Smiths and metal-forgers
Tinkers, pewterers, and casters
Wagon-makers and wheelwrights
Weavers and dyers
Woodcarvers, coopers, and bowyers

entries.name: Feature: Sham Product
entries: When you craft an item with a set of artisan's tools, you can use materials equal to a tenth of the item's actual cost. When you do so, the item's apparent quality and value are equivalent to the real thing, but it breaks after a number of uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). An item that is not used or expended, such as jewelry, breaks when it takes any damage.

An Intelligence (Investigation) check with a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier reveals the item as a fake. The investigator has disadvantage on the check if it does not have proficiency in the artisan's tools necessary to make the item.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Counterfeiters are master salesmen and excellent at justifying their own actions to themselves. Some harbor feelings of guilt, while others dive gleefully into their carefully-crafted personas. A minority have no idea they make subpar goods at all, fooling themselves as well as others about the quality of their craft.

rows: Fraud is my art, and showmanship my craft.
I keep getting too attached to customers and feel guilty for deceiving them.
I'm terrified of torches and pitchforks.
I avoid long goodbyes.
Swagger and bravado are constants in my life.
I wish I could be as good as a real artisan.
I charge less than legitimate sellers to get business and feel better about my lies.
My goods aren't subpar...I'm trying my best!
{@b Technicality.} I don't make false promises about my goods. Instead, I let customers draw their own conclusions. (Lawful)
{@b Fulfillment.} It makes me happy to sell poor customers a version of products they could never otherwise afford. (Good)
{@b Defiance.} I was kicked out of a guild, so I make cheap goods to spite them. (Chaotic)
{@b Fraud.} I target the most gullible or stupid customers and squeeze them for everything they're worth. (Evil)
{@b Wealth.} I want to get rich quick and this is the easiest way to do it. (Neutral)
{@b Skill.} Even though my trade is founded on lies, I put my best effort into every forgery. (Neutral)
I want to find revolutionary ways to produce cheaper goods.
Corruption seeps into every corner of the guilds...I'll outcompete them with low prices.
I'll do anything to make money for people back home who need it.
I want to prove myself to a genuine artisan who I admire.
I pursue wealth and fame to win someone's love.
I'll keep going no matter how many times I'm caught.
I stick to my story to the bitter end, even when caught.
I'll tell any lie to make a sale.
If I can't get a buyer, I'm happy to steal.
There's no such thing as too much money.
I've killed to keep my fraud secret, and I will again.
I convince myself every sucker deserves their loss.

name: Courier Brigade Cadet

_.special: old uniform issued by the courier brigade

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An {@item Explorer's Pack|PHB}, {@item cobbler's tools|PHB}, {@item climber's kit|PHB}, {@item hooded lantern|PHB}, {@item lock|PHB}, an old uniform issued by the courier brigade, and 11 gold flowers.

entries: You were a cadet with the noble Courier Brigade, where you trained at arms, learned to traverse the landscape quickly and quietly, and practiced the hallowed task of properly delivering a package. The couriers' code—"Deliverance through delivery"—taught you that your purpose is to be of service to others, and that one of the highest virtues is seeing things through to the end. For more on the Courier Brigade, see page 17.

entries.name: Feature: Pocket Map
entries: You have an old worn out pocket map of the island from your time as a cadet. The map is inscribed with a handful of paths known only to the Courier Brigade.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} set of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} of your choice, a unique piece of jewelry, a set of {@item fine clothes|PHB}, a handcrafted pipe, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: Servant's Invisibility
entries: The art of excellent service requires a balance struck between being always available and yet unobtrusive, and you've mastered it. If you don't perform a visible action, speak or be spoken to, or otherwise have attention drawn to you for at least 1 minute, creatures nearby have trouble remembering you are even in the room. Until you speak, perform a visible action, or have someone draw attention to you, your proficiency bonus) to notice you. Otherwise, they conduct themselves as though you aren't present until either attention is drawn to you or one of their actions would take them into or within 5 feet of the space you occupy.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Court servants tend to be outwardly quiet and soft-spoken, but their insight into the nuances of conversation and societal happenings is unparalleled. When in crowds or around strangers, most court servants keep to themselves, quietly observing their surroundings and later sharing such observations with those they trust.

rows: Unless I must speak, I hold my breath while serving others.
It takes all my effort not to show the effusive emotions I feel when I help others. Best to quietly serve.
It's getting harder to tolerate the prejudices of those I serve daily.
Though the old ways are hard to give up, I want to be my own boss. I'll decide my path.
Serving my family and friends is the only thing I truly care about.
City life is killing my soul. I long for the old courtly ways.
It's time for my fellows to wake up and be taken advantage of no longer.
It's the small things that make it all worthwhile. I try to be present in every moment.
{@bold Family.} My family, whether the one I come from or the one I make, is the thing in this  most worth protecting. (Any)
{@bold Service.} I am most rewarded when I know I have performed a valuable service for another. (Good)
{@bold Sloth.} What's the point of helping anyone now that I've been discarded? (Chaotic)
{@bold Compassion.} I can't resist helping anyone in need. (Good)
{@bold Tradition.} Life under my master's rule was best, and things should be kept as close to their ideals as possible. (Lawful)
{@bold Joy.} The pursuit of happiness is the only thing worth serving anymore. (Neutral)
My family needs me to provide for them. They mean everything to me, which means I'll do whatever it takes.
My kin have served this holding and its lords and ladies for generations. I serve them faithfully to make my lineage proud.
I can't read the inscriptions on this odd ring, but it's all I have left of my family and our history of loyal service.
I'm with the best friends a person can ask for, so why do I feel so lonesome and homesick?
I've found a profession where my skills are put to good use, and I won't let anyone bring me down.
I found peace in a special garden filled with beautiful life, but I only have this flower to remind me. Someday I'll remember where to find that garden.
I would rather serve darkness than serve no one.
I'm afraid of taking risks that might be good for me.
I believe my master's people are superior to all others, and I'm not afraid to share that truth.
I always do as I'm told, even though sometimes I don't think I should.
I know what's best for everyone, and they'd all be better off if they'd follow my advice.
I can't stand seeing ugly or depressing things. I'd much rather think happy thoughts.

entries: Even though you are independent now, you were once a servant to a merchant, noble, regent, or other person of high station. You are an expert in complex social dynamics and knowledgeable in the history and customs of courtly life. Work with your GM to determine whom you served and why you are no longer a servant: did your master or masters retire and no longer require servants, did you resign from the service of a harsh master, did the court you served fall to a neighboring empire, or did something else happen?

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One kind of {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} or {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} or {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} (same as above), Family Heirloom, {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: You were either born into a role within the courts or power structures of your area, or you worked your way into the company of the powerful or elite through perseverance, skill, trickery, or some combination of those. You draw upon the power of your institutions to gain what you need—but you're always at the mercy of those institutions as well.

You may have a specialized role within the system, such as a court jester or someone with influence. Or you may occupy a more generic role as a hanger-on, whose role is undefined but whose power rests simply in being connected to someone with the power to get what is needed.

name: Coven Witch
entries: You are a witch, a member of a coven that lives out in the wilds. You are wise and knowledgeable regarding aspects of nature, plants, magic, and a multitude of obscure arcane arts. You often dwell within nature's deep forests, elaborate caves, sun scorched deserts, or frigid taiga along with your fellow coven witches.

As a part of being a member of a coven, you work towards the greater good and the goals of the coven itself. You trade magical secrets with your fellow members, and will sometimes venture off to help with some task your coven needs. Some covens will keep generally to themselves and work towards helping nature, while others will play a more active role in relation to some community, whether that is to harm it or to aid it.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: Any two skills of your choice

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose one from {@item Alchemist's Supplies|phb}, Herbalism Kit, {@item Poisoner's Kit|phb}, or {@item Woodcarver's Tools|phb}

items.name: Languages
items.entry: {@language Witchtongue|YAG}, and one language of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: An athame, a cloak, a small pouch of local herbs, a {@item sickle|phb} or wooden {@item staff|phb}, a {@item waterskin|phb}, and the fur of an animal.

entries.name: Feature: Witch's Wisdom
entries: You are a practitioner of ancient, obscure magic crafts. As such, most people have mixed opinions of you and your skills, and some may seek you out for aid or guidance. If so, you can receive a small fee from them in exchange for your services (the fee is determined by the DM). Services that one may ask of you can range wildly, from questions regarding how best to tend to their fields, whether to place or remove a curse on someone else, or for homeopathic medical aid. Your DM can assist you in determining the nature of other meetings you may have with others.

You also know a set of secret codes, runes, and symbols that you can use to identify other witches, who can provide you with access to a hidden safe house, free room and board, or assistance in finding information. These witches never risk their lives for you, though they will assist you in what you ask so long as they are not in danger.

entries.name: Witch Coven Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

For you, your DM may rule that you can acquire a small extended list of spells based on your coven and the type of magic that it practices. For example, if your coven practices dark arts and forbidden magic, your DM may grant you an extended spell list of additional spells that involves enchantment or necromancy. Or, if your coven focuses on wielding the power of nature, your DM may grant you an extended spell list of additional spells that involve spells from the druid spell list. Should your DM grant you an extended spell list, the spells in said list are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class. (If you are a multiclass character with multiple spell lists, these spells are added to all of them.)
Below is an example of an extended spell list that your DM may use or allow for a character. The below extended spell list is for a character that practices 'green magic' or nature wielding magic.

entries.caption: Witch Coven Spells (Example)
rows: Cantrip
druidcraft, thorn whip
1st
entangle, speak with animals
2nd
beast sense, moonbeam
3rd
conjure animals, plant growth
4th
dominate beast, guardian of nature
5th
druid grove, tree stride

entries: Should your GM grant you an extended spell list, your magic can vary in terms of its appearance. Some witches call forth mangled roots and dark colored vapor when casting their spells. Others conjure ethereal shapes of animals, and others imbue their spells with warming, golden lights. The style of your magic is usually influenced by the nature of your coven.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Witches are, as a whole, a varied lot of individuals. Their personalities and mannerisms can differ drastically from one to another, even within a coven. Many witches believe in being themselves, though many witches are mindful of both themselves and their surroundings, and know when and where it is best to reveal their true personalities. Given that many people may either be seeking them out for either assistance or to hunt them down, witches are careful of who they reveal themselves around.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I often find more meaningful friendships in animals than I do people outside of my coven.
You can insult me all you want to, but don't you dare insult my coven.
I laugh at those who try to constantly stay clean and are afraid to get dirty.
The only rules that I truly adhere to are the unspoken laws of nature and the rules of my coven.
I begin every morning with a small ritual that keeps me calm and clears my head.
I believe that the wilds will ultimately reclaim civilization. In time.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Coven. I would do anything for my coven. (Any)
Nature. Living amongst the native flora and wildlife is the true way to live. (Neutral).
Ancestors. We must strive to emulate our ancestors and make them proud. (Any)
Pride. Only those who understand the old magics can understand true power. (Evil)
Independence. My coven and I will do whatever it takes to maintain our way of life. (Chaotic)
Openness. I am willing to show the ways of my coven to those who are willing to learn and respect them. (Good)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: Many of the members of my coven wish to keep our ways secret to others. I aim to change that.
My coven has been at odds with many other covens.
I am often finding myself doubting the leadership of my coven.
The leader of my coven has been training me to eventually take over as the coven elder.
I love my coven with every fiber of my being. I will protect them till my dying breath.
I had to leave my old coven behind to join a new one. The events that lead to this are... complicated.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I have a habit of being suspicious of most people.
Having seen how some of my fellow witches are treated, I am either too open or too harsh with many people I encounter.
I can often come across as frightening even when I am not trying to be.
When I see an animal being harmed that was not defending itself, I can become quite angered.
I sometimes have a habit of speaking what I really want to say in Witchtongue.
I feel compelled to curse those who have done me or my friends wrong.

items.name: Specialty
entries: There are many kinds of criminals, and within a thieves' guild or similar criminal organization, individual members have particular specialties. Even criminals who operate outside of such organizations have strong preferences for certain kinds of crimes over others. Choose the role you played in your criminal life, or roll on the table below.

rows: Blackmailer
Burglar
Enforcer
Fence
Highway robber
Hired killer
Pickpocket
Smuggler

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other. Or maybe you were a lone wolf, fending for yourself against the local thieves' guild and more fearsome lawbreakers.

Criminals might seem like villains on the surface, and many of them are villainous to the core. But some have an abundance of endearing, if not redeeming, characteristics. There might be honor among thieves, but criminals rarely show any respect for law or authority.

rows: I resented authority in my younger days and saw a life of crime as the best way to fight against tyranny and oppression.
Necessity forced me to take up the life, since it was the only way I could survive.
I fell in with a gang of reprobates and ne'er-do-wells, and I learned my specialty from them.
A parent or relative taught me my criminal specialty to prepare me for the family business.
I left home and found a place in a thieves' guild or some other criminal organization.
I was always bored, so I turned to crime to pass the time and discovered I was quite good at it.
I always have a plan for when things go wrong.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
The first thing I do in a new place is note the locations of everything valuable—or where such things could be hidden.
I would rather make a new friend than a new enemy.
I am incredibly slow to trust. Those who seem the fairest often have the most to hide.
I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
I blow up at the slightest insult.
Honor. I don't steal from others in the trade. (Lawful)
Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them. (Chaotic)
Charity. I steal from the wealthy so that I can help people in need. (Good)
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy. (Evil)
People. I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a trip down the Styx for all I care. (Neutral)
Redemption. There's a spark of good in everyone. (Good)
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.
I will become the greatest thief that ever lived.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
If there's a plan, I'll forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll ignore it.
I have a 'tell' that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
An innocent person is in prison for a crime that I committed. I'm okay with that.

Criminals serve and thrive off the seedy underbelly of society. While many people run afoul of the law, this background is for people who make their livelihoods entirely outside the law. Rarely respected or honoured within society, Criminals often hide their true profession from others.

entries.name: Burglar
entries: Burglars break into and steal from houses, storefronts, and warehouses, primarily operating out of major cities and ports. While thieving is a risky pursuit, the hardest part can be finding a buyer for rare and valuable items. The more unique the good, the more likely its original owner will want it returned, cutting your profit margin considerably.
Goods and valuables generally need to be sold through a fence: someone who will purchase your stolen goods, sell them to unknowing customers, and take a cut of your profits.

entries.name: Surveillance
entries: Upon spending an hour observing it, and successfully completing a medium-DC Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can map the general layout of a building. This includes the guard routes and rotation times, building entrances and exits, and the potential locations of valuables.

entries.name: Rank 1 - Snatcher
entries: Breaking into homes in the lower end of town is generally your trade. Authorities only worry about civilians with the power to cause a stir; everyone else is on their own. Locks in this end of town are easy to pick, if there is a lock at all. For the same reason, though, there is less to steal.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A safehouse in the poor district, used to store stolen goods and serving as emergency lodgings.
You have blueprints of a grand estate including secret entrances and passageways.

entries.name: Progression
entries: You rob a well-to-do store in a reputable district, gaining notoriety and a big payday.

entries.name: Rank 2 - Burglar Specialist
entries: Working in a team, while risky, allows for heists that would be beyond the reach of any one 93 Criminal burglar, no matter how skilled. Increasingly, when someone has an ambitious crime planned and needs to assemble a team of "the best," they reach out to you.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A team of specialist thieves who operate under your instruction to execute more ambitious heists.
A contact working inside an establishment which you plan on robbing, who provides you information on the routine of the occupants, the location of valuable items, and escape routes.

entries.name: Progression
entries: Membership in an established Thieves' Guild in a major city or town.

entries.name: Rank 3 - Heist Master
entries: Your skill as both a burglar and a leader has grown considerably over time. Whether by virtue of your own confidence or a message from the divine, you believe that you are capable of executing a major heist, with the right preparation and henchmen of course. Will it be a priceless painting you have been tasked with acquiring for a prospective buyer? A slovenly prince whose private affairs you seek to meddle in, having acquired his signet ring?

entries.name: Holdings
entries: You hold a senior position in the Thieves' Guild, instructing junior members in lockpicking, housebreaking, and evading law enforcers.
You uncover evidence of an attempted assassination on the life of a noble whose estate you robbed.

entries.name: Progression
entries: You orchestrate a large-scale heist to rob the estate of a local noble.

entries.name: Rank 4 - Prince of Thieves
entries: You have squirreled away enough gold to live comfortably for the rest of your life. However, you now steal to satiate a greater motivation through the exchange of private information, blackmail, and the acquisition of rare and powerful artifacts. After all, knowledge is power, and you've risen to a level where power is mandatory.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: Your own estate with a household of staff, acquiring and selling rare and valuable items through your own circle of thieves, fences, and buyers.

Criminals serve and thrive off the seedy underbelly of society. While many people run afoul of the law, this background is for people who make their livelihoods entirely outside the law. Rarely respected or honoured within society, Criminals often hide their true profession from others.

entries.name: Charlatan
entries: Merchants are the lifeblood of trade, and can be found anywhere from hawking goods in local marketplaces, to having established their own stores selling artisan wares. Merchants typically belong to a Merchant's Guild, and pay a yearly sum to register for protection by local law enforcement, though this varies by province. Merchants buy, sell, and trade wares of all sorts, knowing not just the price of everything but how to haggle that price up or down at will.

entries.name: False Identity
entries: Upon spending an hour writing and talking to the right people, and succeeding on a medium-DC Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check, you can create yourself a new identity with fake identification.

entries.name: Rank 1 - Peddler
entries: You are used to lying through your teeth, telling people whatever they want to hear in order to separate them from their money. It keeps you fed and one step ahead of the law, but you'll need a way to run bigger scams if you want to make real money.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A stash of counterfeit items that you sell and scam people with.
A secluded stoop that you use as a shelter against the elements near your place of "business".

entries.name: Progression
entries: You are recruited by a gang of Hustlers, or create your own group, to participate in more organized and larger-scale scams.

entries.name: Rank 2 - Hustle
entries: You have started to work in a group as a face man, expanding your "clientele" with more lucrative cons, such as passing off coloured glass as gemstones, or bleeding wealthy marks dry with long cons.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A group of miscreants that assist your cons, with whom you split the spoils of your larceny.

entries.name: Progression
entries: You must acquire or create plans for a large-scale con and procure the necessary elements.

entries.name: Rank 3 - Con Artist
entries: You have become more daring in your approach, orchestrating swindles that require planning, resources, and teamwork in pursuit of a big payday. You may set your gang about duplicating famous paintings to be sold in foreign cities, for example, or forging property title deeds in order to sell a building you do not own.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A team of charismatic swindlers and skilled forgers who can recreate items at your request with great accuracy and detail.
An unmarked warehouse in a disreputable part of town, where you can store and create forged items and oversee your operations.

entries.name: Progression
entries: Successfully executing a grand con that draws the outrage of a great noble household, religious faction, or other powerful institution. It also makes you famous among other criminals.

entries.name: Rank 4 - Mastermind
entries: You have become something of a legend within the underground. Up-and-coming swindlers approach you to learn at your feet. Whether you pass on your skills or fleece your new flock is up to you.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: Many detailed plans of cons you have devised or procured.
A network of talented individuals who work at your behest, aiding you in orchestrating your ploys.

Criminals serve and thrive off the seedy underbelly of society. While many people run afoul of the law, this background is for people who make their livelihoods entirely outside the law. Rarely respected or honoured within society, Criminals often hide their true profession from others.

entries.name: Cutthroat
entries: Some crooks lie to get what they want. Some steal it when its owner isn't looking. Then there are those who walk up to a target and explain the deal: give me what I want or bad things will happen to you. Call it "protection" or call it extortion, it is perhaps the most straightforward form of crime, favoured by the violent and the ruthless.

Most Cutthroats start out working in a preestablished gang, collecting fees and extracting payments on behalf of a boss. A small gang might be responsible for shaking down a handful of businesses, while the most powerful of crime lords may influence prominent cities or regions.

entries.name: Underground Connections
entries: Upon spending an hour asking around, and succeeding on a medium-DC Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, you can prove your credibility and find a contact in a local gang, Thieves' Guild, or underground network. This contact begins as friendly to you and will assist you with matters related to their criminal endeavours.

entries.name: Rank 1 - Tough
entries: Working the impoverished regions of town, you're a criminal who will mug those who walk down the wrong alley at night, or extort unwary travelers for safe passage along a road.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A hideout where you can seek shelter from the elements, and from local law enforcement.

entries.name: Progression
entries: Acquire a building to use as a centre of operations for your illicit activities, and a handful of other criminals willing to follow your lead.

entries.name: Rank 2 - Crew Leader
entries: Being the leader of your ragtag team comes with some nice perks. Shop owners shower you with gifts and praise in order to remain on your good side during your weekly rounds. Some will even go out of their way to source rare and valuable items that you require, if they believe doing so will earn your favor.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: A group of thugs that you command, overseeing their various ploys.
Knowledge of back alleys and slipways that allow you and your group to escape unpursued by local law enforcement.
A rundown establishment that you and your fellow henchmen operate out of.

entries.name: Progression
entries: Your group of thugs has progressed in size to exert control over an entire village or district within a city.
A sizable collection of shop owners that you can regularly exploit for "protection".

entries.name: Rank 3 - Gang Boss
entries: You are now a big fish in a small pond, often butting heads with rival gangs. Your presence is not quite strong enough to force your competition out of your territory. Whether you make a bid for control or they do, one thing is for certain: there will be blood in the streets.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: Multiple warehouses and business fronts to launder and store your spoils until a suitable buyer can be located.
A network of contacts that you use to acquire and sell illicit goods.

entries.name: Progression
entries: You must overthrow a rival crime lord, or claim the territory of all surrounding rival gangs.

entries.name: Rank 4 - Crime Lord
entries: You sit at the top of the criminal pyramid of your city or region. While there are still gangs that you don't directly control, they know to stay well clear of your territory.

entries.name: Holdings
entries: An expansive territory that you control, overseeing the criminal businesses within the city and taking a cut of their profits in exchange for protection.

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Faithful, Generous

entries.name: Feature: Leverage
entries: You can exert leverage over one or more individuals below you in the guild's hierarchy and demand their help as needs warrant. For example, you can have a message carried across a neighborhood, procure a short carriage ride without paying, or have others clean up a bloody mess you left in an alley. The DM decides if your demands are reasonable and if there are subordinates available to fulfill them. As your status in the guild improves, you gain influence over more people, including ones in greater positions of power.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Members of the Golden Order range from the decadent nobility at the top of the oligarchy to the debt-ridden wretches at the bottom. You fall somewhere between those extremes, so you might behave with the arrogance of the very rich or the humility of the impoverished.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I am always willing to act in accordance with the financial incentive offered.
Debts are never meant to be forgiven.
I am accustomed to enjoying the finest pleasures money can buy.
No one could doubt that I am a cut above the masses of pitiful peasants that infest the city.
I can't stand to spend a zib more than necessary to purchase what I need.
I hate it when people try to make light of a serious situation.
I want to make sure everyone is aware of how wealthy, powerful, and important I am.
I can't think of anything to look forward to.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Wealth}. I will do whatever it takes to become as rich as the oligarchs. (Evil)
{@b Power}. One day, I will be the one giving orders. (Evil)
{@b Prestige}. I want to be admired, respected, feared, or even hated for my position and wealth. (Evil)
{@b Stability}. The economy functions best when chaos is kept under control and everyone knows their place. (Lawful)
{@b Eternity}. I want to live forever\u2014in the flesh as long as possible, and as a spirit afterward. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: The unbearable weight of my debt has driven me to desperation.
I'm duty-bound to obey the dictates of an ancestor  Order.
I value my worldly goods more highly than my mortal life.
An oligarch publicly humiliated me, and I will exact revenge on that whole family.
My faith in the Order never wavers.
I want to prove myself more worthy than an older sibling and thereby ensure that I inherit a greater share of my parents' wealth.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I hold a scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever\u2014but could also earn me the favor of The Golden Eagle.
I'm convinced that everyone I know is plotting against me.
I'll brave any risk if the monetary reward is great enough.
I am convinced that I am far more important than anyone else is willing to acknowledge.
I have little respect for anyone who isn't wealthy.
I'll take any opportunity to steal from wealthier people, even for worthless trinkets.

entries: You are a member of the Golden Order and have been profiting off of your wares or services, or you have been persuading key members of the government to allow you more freedom in getting the money you deserve. You have been recently promoted to a Crow of the Order.

name: Cult Assembly
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} You are part of a group devoted to an unpopular, or perhaps dangerous, deity—remnants of an infernalist cult, adherents to an aspect of the Devourer Wurm, fringe worshippers of Cyriss, or devotees of one of the Defiers of the Wicked Harvest.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Any character can belong to a Cult Assembly company, but it must include at least one character proficient in the Religion skill.

entries.name: Downtime: Indoctrination Rituals
entries: By spending at least 5 days in intense religious rituals, you can indoctrinate attendees into your beliefs. At the end of this time, your company earns {@dice 2d6} new followers who are commoners devoted to the cult's leaders. Followers pay 1 gp each day to the cult and obey the orders of the cult's leadership.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Prestige increases through acts such as: inducting an influential person into your cult; defeating a rival organization; recovering a relic or religious text important to your deity; performing a significant ritual; witnessing a manifestation of your god; or consecrating a place of significance.

entries.name: Tier 1 – Fringe Cult
entries: {@b Life in the Shadows.} Your company can easily find a safe place in slums, abandoned warehouses, derelict factories, and similar locations to convene and practice your faith.
{@b Coded Speech.} You can replace one language you gain from your race or background with a unique language based on your worship.

entries.name: Tier 2 – Devoted Following
entries: {@b Acolytes.} You gain {@dice 2d10} new members (CR 1/4 or lower) who serve the cult as aides, guards, and messengers and attend important rituals.

entries.name: Tier 3 – Keepers of the Faith
entries: {@b Faithful Masses.} You can expect a 10 percent discount on goods and services from vendors in your local area. Additionally, you gain {@dice 2d10} acolytes with a challenge rating of 1/2 or lower.
{@b Tithes.} Each week, you receive {@dice 1d6} gp per class level as a tithe from the faithful.

entries.name: Tier 4 – Eye of the Gods
entries: {@b Devotion.} You and all members of your cult gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. You also gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to convince cult members to follow your commands.

_.displayName: a trinket or symbol representing your cult

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Choose one between {@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}; and one between {@skill Persuasion} or {@skill Survival}

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Choose one between {@language Deep Speech}, {@language Infernal} and {@language Sylvan}, reflecting the cult to which you belonged

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a brimmed cloak, a trinket or {@item holy symbol|PHB|symbol} representing your cult, a piece of jewelry worth 10 gp, a {@item hooded lantern|PHB}, five {@item Oil (flask)|PHB|flasks of oil}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Cult Secrets
entries: You know the secret signs, phrases, rituals, and traditions of your cult, and can recognize them anywhere. In addition you can recognize similar signals from other cults. Furthermore, you have advantage on checks made to pass yourself off as a member of similar cults, potentially gaining trust or access to resources.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Whether you are a current or former member of a cult, your experiences have shaped you. As a follower, you are guided by deep-seated beliefs and rituals, while as a former member, your past continues to haunt you, and you may be driven by a desire for redemption or revenge.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I always keep my thoughts and emotions hidden, a habit from my cult days.
I am curious about other belief systems and constantly compare them to my own.
I feel most comfortable following rituals and routines.
I am always questioning everything and seeking deeper meanings.
I feel lost and disconnected after leaving my cult.
I can be charismatic and persuasive when I need to be.
I distrust authority figures and institutions.
I have a habit of slipping into old cult phrases or mannerisms.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Freedom}. I have left the cult and cherish my newfound liberty. I'll never let anyone control my life again. (Any)
{@b Unity}. As a current cult member, I believe that our unified purpose is more significant than individual desires. (Lawful)
{@b Knowledge}. The cult's teachings are hidden truths that the world deserves to know. (Any)
{@b Purity}. As a former cultist, I realize the cult's teachings were wrong. I seek to cleanse myself and the world of its influence. (Good)
{@b Domination}. I believe the cult's teachings should be enforced, creating a new world order. (Evil)
{@b Redemption}. I have done terrible things in the name of the cult. I must atone for my sins. (Good)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I left someone I care about behind in the cult and am determined to rescue them.
I am still part of the cult, and I will protect my brothers and sisters at all costs.
Someone I loved was sacrificed for the cult's cause. Their memory haunts me.
I harbor a dangerous secret about the cult that others would kill to uncover
The leader of the cult still holds a dark sway over me, and I struggle against their influence.
I am seeking revenge against those who forced me out of the cult.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I am paranoid and distrustful, always expecting a cultist to appear and enact revenge.
I secretly miss the structure and unity of the cult and sometimes consider returning.
I am easily swayed by charismatic leaders.
The cult's influence has left me with warped moral views that others find shocking or abhorrent.
I will go to any length to destroy the cult, even if it harms innocent bystanders.
I struggle with guilt over the actions I took as part of the cult.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} (your choice), art object (worth 10 GP), {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Hooded Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Oil|XPHB} (5 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP.

_.displayName: a prayer book written in cipher or code

entries: Some say that only two things differentiate a cult from an established religion: scale and popularity. You know otherwise. The cult to which you belonged skirted the edge of social acceptability and basic human decency, and centered around a single, charismatic leader. A witness to degenerate rituals and horrific religious punishments, only your iron will or unyielding zeal kept you from utter insanity.

Whether you belong to a sweeping conspiracy that controls society from the shadows, a remote compound dedicated to your cult's master, or an extremist offshoot an established faith, your membership in the cult determines every aspect of your behavior. Did you leave the cult and swear off their values forever? Are you on the run from their agents, who want to force you to return? Or are you a trusted lieutenant yourself, prepared to go out into the world to spread your faith or enact its terrible plans?

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Two {@table exotic languages|phb} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A mysterious holy symbol, a prayer {@item book|phb} written in cipher or code, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Cultist Creed
entries: Every belief system builds itself around an all-encompassing worldview. The collection of extremists to which you belonged is no different, and venerates a particular creature or set of ideals.
Choose one of the subjects and ideologies below, or roll once each table to decide the subject of your cult's veneration and the core motivation of its behavior toward it.

rows: Aberration
Dragon
Fallen celestial
Fey
Fiend
Humanoid cult leader
Local monster
Undead
Apocalyptic
Cargo Cult
Orgiastic
Political
Proselytizing
Racial superiority
Religious Schism
Sacrificial
Secessionist/isolationist
Self-torment
Servitude
Terrorist

entries.name: Feature: One Among Many
entries: Others shun and fear your cult. Whether you are a true member or an apostate, you can use the mere implication that they support you to browbeat hapless locals into submission. Through fear, you can convince them to grant you favors that they would have otherwise rejected, or overlook your actions lest they incur the wrath of your cult. Though this technique may backfire on those who see through your facade or learn to see you as a manipulative figure, you're able to leave an impact on the uninformed through social pressure, the threat of violence or assimilation via a powerful social tool among the masses.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Many cultists are zealous and offputting, with blind devotion to an ideal that seems nonsensical or even dangerous to others. This devotion is often ironic, and they compensate for any internal doubts with ever-greater zeal. A few, however, are ardent missionaries ready to debate and disseminate their ideas to bring more loyal converts into the fold.

rows: I idolize (or fear) the subject of my cult above all else.
Nothing can shake my beliefs.
When opportunities arise, I share my faith with enthusiasm and sincerity.
I like to leave signs that a member of my cult was present, such as graffiti or dropped notes.
I become violently angry when someone contradicts my worldview.
I enjoy dropping hints that I know things that others could never imagine.
When I look at someone, I think about how they could best serve my cult.
I believe in endless self-improvement, so I can better serve the cult.
{@b Loyalty.} Nothing can shake my faith, and I follow orders to the letter. (Lawful)
{@b Tolerance.} I tolerate others' views, since I have to make a good impression for my people. (Good)
{@b Ascendancy.} I believe I know better than our leader, and plan to overthrow them. (Chaotic)
{@b Sadism.} My cult does terrible things to good people, and I enjoy it. (Evil)
{@b Scholasticism.} I wish to study our core tenets to learn why we believe the things that we do. (Neutral)
{@b Evangelization.} Spreading my faith is important. (Any)
I would happily die for the cult if ordered to do so.
My cult was destroyed, and I will bring the perpetrators to my own sick justice.
I will hunt down and reconvert apostates, and kill them if they refuse.
I'm hunting the lost relics or foundational tomes of my esoteric faith.
Our leader disappeared, and I must find them.
I'm on a holy mission, and will not be swayed.
I don't follow the instructions of anyone other than the cult's leader.
I argue philosophy every chance I get; even if it's polite, it wastes everyone's time.
Violence is the only solution when dealing with heretical enemies.
I resort to torture and abuse before considering more peaceful resolutions.
People who don't follow our religion aren't people at all.
I am unyielding and inflexible in my thinking.

name: Cultist
entries: Once, perhaps not too long ago, you served alongside your fellow neophytes. You worshiped a dark creature or eldritch god, performed sacraments, and adorned yourself with the suitable tattoos or ceremonial scars. You basked in this dark glory with your fellows, feeling the clarity of purpose that comes with service to a higher power.
You may still serve your cult, or you left them behind in your search for other things. In either case, you have been marked by your connection to dark cults.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Lightly tattered robes, a symbol of devotion, a blasphemous holy text, a curved ritual dagger, a poisoner's kit, and a small pouch containing 5 gp.

entries.name: Change of Heart
entries: Many adventurers used to be cultists, leaving behind that life in search of new or different things. Work with your DM to determine what caused you to break from your cult, or roll on the table below.

rows: I witnessed a particularly gruesome rite and ran for my life.
I botched a ritual which slaughtered other members of my circle. Only I survived.
I asked the wrong kind of questions. The others planned to sacrifice me, but I escaped.
Adventurers hunted down my brethren, and only I was able to escape.
The other cultists disappeared through a portal to a land of unspeakable horrors. Terrified, I stayed behind.
The others took their own lives to ascend. I could not.
I no longer believed in what we were doing. It seemed wrong, somehow.
A friend or family member rescued me, taking me away by force.

entries.name: Feature: Secret Signs
entries: You know the secret symbology of your cult, which is used by members to identify themselves to fellow adherents. Some influential persons or townsfolk may be members of your cult, and with a subtle gesture or hand sign you can discern who follows the ways of your dark patron.

Cloisters of your cult may be hidden in different towns. These signs can identify such cloisters, and if they are still active the adherents there may feel obliged to provide you and your companions with food and lodging.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A cult washes away doubt and instills faith; this simple fact reverberates all throughout a cultist's life. Even if a cultist has forsworn their service, they are still deeply affected by their old life.

rows: Everything is a sign of coming doom. Every. Single. Thing.
The world outside is so exciting! Now I can do everything the dark lord forbid, like drinking wine, or wearing shoes!
If I'm not stopped, I will openly reminisce about my olds days in the cult all day long.
I can't help but check my cult's holy scriptures for advice about any given situation.
It's no big deal; it's not the end of the world. That's not for another five years, three months, ten days, twelve hours...
I'll happily inform those I meet of the many ways in which they are being heretical.
I hate my cult for what they made me do and what they made me become.
The dark lord used to order us to do everything, and it's a little hard for me to live without that structure.
{@bold Loyalty.} One must commit themselves to their beliefs unwaveringly. (Lawful)
{@bold Redemption.} I believe that evil deeds can be repented. I must believe. (Good)
{@bold Independence.} I'll never be bound in servitude again. (Chaotic)
{@bold Power.} My dark patron holds power, but I plan to be stronger than they'll ever be. (Evil)
{@bold Secrets.} The lore of my cult is historically important, and I must preserve it. (Neutral)
{@bold Revision.} My cult's holy book is wrong. I must learn about the outside world, and fix the book's errors. (Chaotic)
I must discover the truth behind the entity I worshipped, even if it kills me.
I yearn to reconnect with the people from my life before the cult.
I must free other people from unwitting service to dark masters.
A monstrous, immortal guardian of the cult is hunting me. I pray it never finds its prey.
I sold my soul in service to dark powers, and now I seek to reclaim it.
The day of reckoning is coming, and my knowledge is the key to stopping it.
If I ever had the chance, I'd definitely rejoin my cult.
I'm a little too into blood sacrifice.
Knowledge is more important than sanity.
I'm often more interested in than frightened of abominable eldritch monsters.
I'm too willing to follow orders without thinking.
Murder was significantly less frowned upon by the cult than it is in the outside world.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Arcana|PHB}, {@i choose one} (Cultist Affinity table language recommended)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|PHB}, {@item Costume Clothes|PHB|Costume (cult garb)}, {@item Amulet|PHB|Holy Symbol (Amulet: cult insignia)}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Ability Scores:
items.entry: Increase one of your starting ability scores by 2 and another by 1, or increase three scores by 1 each.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@i choose one} (Cultist Affinity table language recommended)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Costume|XPHB|Costume (cult garb)}, {@item Amulet|XPHB|Holy Symbol (Amulet: cult insignia)}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

_.displayName: a set of dark common clothes, including a hood

items.name: Languages
items.entry: Deep Speech, one of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item holy symbol|phb}, a set of dark {@item common clothes|phb}, including a hood, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Global Outreach
entries: Though few in numbers compared to other religions, the reach of your cult across the world is still somewhat substantial. You're able to spot other believers in almost any large city. Other cultists will be eager to help you in your journeys. This could be in the form of providing shelter for you, or helping to find information in the city for you.

You have spent your life in worship of a being that very few people believe exists. Somewhat crazed in your service, you seek to live out the teachings of the cult you're a part of. The nature of your belief isn't neccessarily evil, just more fanatic than other beliefs.

Work with your DM to determine the object of your worship. It may be a god that has long been forgotten by most, or that very few worship due to their nature. It may even be a ficticious deity, with your cult unknowingly carrying out the will of a god that never existed. Choose the nature of your work with the cult as well. Were you the right hand of the leader? Or simply a traveler looking to spread the reach of your deity.

_.special: symbol of the Great Old Ones (derived from the Elder Sign)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A symbol of the Great Old Ones (derived from the Elder Sign), incense, a piece of chalk, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Madman's Knowledge
entries: You have been touched, however slightly, by the wisdom of the Great Old Ones. Your education in eldritch knowledge might erode your sanity, but you are well-informed of other cults and faiths. You know covert signs used by other cultists to identify themselves and communicate, and you know the names and titles of the Great Old Ones. You are also familiar with the rituals and practices of these cults.

entries.name: Great Old One
entries: Cultists can worship a number of strange entities from the cosmos, but the cautious tend to focus their worship on one or two, as offending a Great Old One carries terrible risk.
Select one from or roll on the following table to determine the Great Old One you once worshipped or continue to worship.

rows: Atropus
Demon-Sultan Azathoth
Mak Thuum Ngatha
Mother Kos
Nyarlathotep
Sithrak
The Yellow King
Yog-Sothoth

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Cults of the Great Old Ones, like cults of other faiths, practice in secret to avoid detection by the leading faiths of the region and to avoid prosecution of heresy. Cultists blend into the crowd as best they can, meeting their conspirators exclusively in secluded locales or under cover of night.

Still, the waning effects of the Great Old Ones often leaves them with strange quirks or odd behavior. The jittery, unsettling shopkeep in town might very well be a member of the cult. Anyone could be, for that matter.

rows: I drift off in trance-like daydreams.
I obsess over esoteric knowledge others deem vague or apocryphal.
In times of quiet, I repeat an inhuman chant under my breath over and over again.
I keep a dream diary, in which I record half-asleep ramblings which I attempt to divine while awake.
I profess that the day the Old Ones Return is soon, no more than a few weeks away. When the dates arrives to no avail, I shift the date a few weeks later.
I see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, we just need to listen.
I am comfortable in vast libraries or furtively reading in a basement, but crowds intimidate me.
I keep a pet rat in my pocket and imagine it's little squeaks are intelligible, and horrifying secrets.
{@b Atonement.} I have abandoned the cult of the Old Ones and wish to make things right by stopping them. (Good)
{@b Truth.} I search for eldritch wisdom that might reveal the nature of the multiverse to me. (Lawful)
{@b Chaos.} The boundless, alien Far Realm is the state that all universes should be in. Our universe is merely an anomaly. (Chaotic)
{@b Power.} The Old One I worship will make me powerful when he returns, crushing my enemies before me. (Evil)
{@b Dreams.} The only true way to understand the will of the Great Old Ones is through dreams. (Neutral)
{@b Secrecy.} The fools of the world do not understand the Old Ones, and their nature must be kept secret until their Return. (Any)
I search for the site of the Vast Gate, where the Great Ones are predicted to Return.
I owe my life to the cult who raised me. Though I never knew my parents, I inherited a wealth of wisdom.
I will destroy every last member of the cult that brainwashed me.
The final component of a powerful ritual is locked away within my skull. I fear unlocking it will drive me mad.
Members of the cult covertly help each other gain power and authority. We shall rule this nation.
I wish to open a portal to the Far Realm and see it for my very eyes.
I am intensely paranoid of every bump in the night and of every person's motivations.
I latch on to incredibly mad schemes of which I rarely think all the way through.
I may be losing my grip on reality.
Sometimes I am overjoyed with the world and sometimes I face crippling depression.
For days on end I can forget important things, like eating, because I am deep in research and contemplation.
No one is more dedicated to their mad religious traditions than I am.

entries: Aligning oneself against the Old Ones is suicide. They cannot be slain; they are greater than death. They cannot be stopped; they are older than time. Ultimately, the only sensible conclusion is to serve them. In doing so, perhaps you can stave off there ire, or even, perhaps, understand some modicum of their great wisdom.

You were inducted into a cult of the Great Old Ones and have learned their ways in secret. Covertly, by discovering ancient insights and performing dark rituals, your organization works in the shadows to hasten the day the Old Ones return. You have seen the face of madness in this organization, and have glimpsed the unspeakable.

Perhaps you have reformed completely and resent the other cultists of the Great Old Ones, seeking to undermine their efforts, or perhaps you are still a member of the cult, and pay tribute in secret, furtively working to advance the organization's goals. Regardless, you have intimate knowledge of the occult, and terrifying insight into realms beyond our own.

_.special: An item that signifies the nature of your curse (a contract, a mystic sigil, or a cursed item that you wear)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An item that signifies the nature of your curse (a contract, a mystic sigil, or a cursed item that you wear), one {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: Shelter for the Stricken
entries: Your story evokes sympathy in a select few, and those few are willing to offer you food, shelter, and secrecy. Perhaps you have loved ones who keep a space for you ready, or maybe you excel at finding those who are willing to listen to your story and offer support. Your allies will help you as they can, but they will not risk their lives for you.

rows: I earned the ire of a god and have been given a set of tasks to complete that will lift my curse.
I was tricked by a fey or other creature and lost my humanity until the day I forget my past life.
I awoke in a wizard's workshop, having been gifted life from nothing. Now I must earn my further existence.
I signed a contract that would change me into something I was not. In return, I owe a debt.
A dragon or other creature cursed me to walk ten thousand miles in a form of their likeness.
The magic of a cursed item changed me.

entries: If the source of your curse is an item, choose from the table below, or decide on an appropriate item yourself.

rows: A golden armring
A pendant bearing a mystic symbol
A book of indecipherable lore
An elaborate magical machine which swapped my old body for the form I now bear
A soulgem of a creature whose visage I now share
A polished chunk of amber with a tiny creature within

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Though anyone can fall victim to a curse, it is your attitude towards what has befallen you that reveals who you are.

rows: My curiosity comes with a price, and that's okay.
I've become obsessed with experimenting with and resolving the terms of my curse.
I try to go on living as always, but things are different.
My life has been turned around and I deeply resent it.
Being cursed has kindled an occult interest in me.
I'm not cursed, I'm blessed! I wish I could share this.
I deserved this curse for all the sins I've wrought.
I've grown more comfortable in my new form.
Selflessness. Whatever befalls me, I want to help others in any way I can. (Good)
Discipline. It is more important than ever that I remain vigilant and in control. (Lawful)
Acceptance. The mistakes of the past are better left forgotten. I lead a new life now. (Neutral)
Exuberance. Who cares about consequences? I'll live life to the fullest! (Chaotic)
Greed. I was cursed for my tainted greed, yet still I want more. (Evil)
Pride. I deserve my own success, and will fight fiercely for every victory. (Any)
I have a close friend who readily accepts my change.
I still keep in loose contact with my family. They don't know about my curse.
I've found it difficult to relate to the people I used to, and instead prefer the company of a beloved pet.
My curse was inflicted in service to the love of my life.
It was my hated rival who cursed me.
Since being cursed, I increasingly prefer the company of others that are like myself.
I dwell long on my mistakes and fall into despair.
I get angry when reminded of what cursed me.
I think everyone is constantly judging me.
I failed, and I can never make up for it.
I don't believe anyone can ever love me like this.
I won't acknowledge that I did anything wrong to deserve this curse.

entries: You've been changed by mystical means. Some creature or event has cursed you with a magical transformation, giving you your current form. Perhaps you gave offense to a vengeful god, wore a cursed item, signed an arcane contract, or were tricked by an entity such as a fey or elder dragon. Whatever the reason, you are stuck with your curse until some condition is fulfilled, and must learn to see the world from a new perspective.

name: Cursed

_.special: memento from a time before you were cursed

entries: Before you began your life as an adventurer, it was changed by a single event that caused you to be cursed. You now bear a curse that both magic and medicine alike have yet to lift, and you fear that you may never be rid of it. Because of this event, certain elements have great importance in your life. Choose a terrible event, a curse mark, and a curse breaker from the options below, or roll a 1d10 for each table.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine the nature of your curse, how you acquired it, and what kind of effects, both positive and negative, that the curse has upon you. Is it one that has been passed down through your family? Or is it one you acquired during your travels throughout the land?

rows: You angered a local witch after double crossing her.
While out exploring, you stumbled upon a magical object. Touching it placed a curse upon you.
You and other members of your village performed a ritual that went horribly wrong. You all now bear a curse.
An otherworldly being descended upon your city. Those who survived were wracked with a terrible curse.
You had your fortune told, and ignored the omens.
While fighting an otherworldly or undead creature, you came in contact with them, and they placed a powerful enchantment upon you.
Whilst visiting in a vast library or museum, you broke your way into a restricted area, and found a forbidden tome that you proceeded to open.
You used to worship a particular god, but then angered them. They have since brought down their wrath upon you.
Your curse is hereditary, and was passed onto you without your will or say in the matter. Members of your family have been dealing with this curse for generations.
In a state of bitterness and anger, a former lover of yours went to a sorceress and had them place a harmful effect upon you.
Your eyes are an unnatural color, such as purple or red, or appear like cat or reptile eyes.
Your body is covered in tattoos consisting of words and phrases in a forgotten language.
Your tongue is long and forked.
When you bleed, your blood appears black and thick.
Your hand has a small, black mark upon it that cannot be removed.
Your hair or fur is ashen colored, and cannot be dyed into a new color.
Your body is covered in burn marks that you cover in bandages and wraps.
When you speak, a second voice seems to follow yours, slightly echoing your words.
Your lips, tongue, teeth, eyes, fingers, hands, and feet appear blackened and constantly covered in black ash.
Somewhere on your body is a brand mark that appears to be some kind of magical seal.

entries.name: Breaking the Curse
