items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Generous, Wilful

name: Glimmerwood Kriel
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} Your company is a tribe that lives deep in the Glimmerwood. Here, within the dense forests and far from civilization, your tribe is able to live off the land and conduct life in the traditional way of your people. The Ryn consider the woods haunted, allowing the people of the woods to live in seclusion and peace.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: At least one member of a Glimmerwood Kriel company must be a trollkin. Other members ideally should be trollkin, or members of other races that claim kinship with the trollkin and make their homes within the woods.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Your company's prestige increases through acts such as: driving off a rival tribe from your people's ancestral land; rediscovering a lost holy site or krielstone; slaying a dangerous beast; reclaiming an ancient Molgur relic worth at least 1,000 gp; binding a large, monstrous troll to your kriel.

entries.name: Tier 1 — Tribal Woodsmen
entries: {@b Encampment.} You have a well-built collection of shacks where you can rest, house your mounts, and store food, equipment, and livestock.

{@b The Kulgat Oath.} All members of your kriel are assumed to have formed around this blood ritual. You have advantage on ability checks related to social situations when you meet a stranger who is related by blood or oath to the kriel's trollkin.

{@b Voice of the Ancestors.} You can consult your company's krielstones and scrolls for lore regarding the local lands. You can replace one proficiency from your race or background with proficiency in your choice of the Religion skill or the History skill.

entries.name: Tier 2 — Clansmen
entries: {@b Shrine.} You can research the temple scrolls as a downtime activity (at least 8 hours). After this time, you can choose one 1st-level spell you know and replace it with another one from the appropriate spell list. Fell callers who engage in this downtime gain a bonus use of their Fell Call feature for the next 24 hours.
{@b Tribe.} You gain {@dice 1d4} hirelings willing to defend your home. Hirelings must have a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower.

entries.name: Tier 3 — Kriel Warriors
entries: {@b Kuar.} A druid who spends time here can replace one known spell of 3rd level or lower with another from the druid spell list and can produce a 1st-level spell scroll. Additionally, a character who spends {@dice 1d6} days of training and 50 gp of material can attempt an animus shaping on a warbeast.
{@b Warriors of the Land.} You gain {@dice 1d6} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1 or lower.

entries.name: Tier 4 — Legends Writ Upon the Stones
entries: {@b Masters of the Beasts.} Your company now breeds warbeasts. You can bond with one additional warbeast you share a resonance with.

{@b A Song of Stone and Thunder.} When interacting with others, you can replace Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks with Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, you can perform a number of extra fell calls equal to your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Quirks
entries: Roll or choose a quirk: (1) Your settlement includes an ancient tree where rituals are made in the name of Dhunia; (2) The quitari of your kriel is that of an older, once-lost kriel to which you are related by blood; (3) Your settlement sits on a locus of ley lines suffused with energy; (4) A band of raiders is led by a former member of the kriel ousted due to a crime; (5) Your krielstone and scrolls belong to a more ancient Molgur tribe and tell of ancient wars; (6) Your settlement is renowned for the ale or spirits it brews; (7) Your settlement is a small offshoot of a larger kriel that you must respond to; (8) Your kriel is made up of members of several fallen kriels; (9) A strange beast stalks your territory; (10) Your settlement adheres to a strict code of honor and will never cheat others or kill those who surrender.

name: Greylords Covenant

_: a staff inlaid with Greylord runes

entries: You are a member of the Greylords Covenant, the arcane branch of both the Khadoran Army and the Khadoran government. As such, you've worked alongside accomplished arcanists, patriots, and soldiers in one of the most formidable occult organizations in western Immoren.

entries.name: Feature: Chapter House
entries: The Greylords Covenant maintains public chapter houses in most significant Khadoran towns and secret facilities in the major population centers of other nations. At the GM's discretion, you can contact one of these locations and request reasonable aid if you are in good standing with the organization.

entries.name: Feature: Uchenik Training
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Spellcasting, Warcaster Magic, or Pact Magic class feature.
Add the spells on the Uchenik Training Spells table to the spell list for your spellcasting class. If you are a multiclass character with multiple spell lists, add these spells to all of them.

entries.caption: Uchenik Training Spells
rows: Cantrip
ray of frost
1st
fog cloud
2nd
gust of wind
3rd
glyph of warding (cold damage only)
4th
ice storm
5th
cone of cold

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Greylords combine their mastery of magic with many other disciplines, such as intelligence gathering and national security. Their ideals are shaped by the militant training they undergo. Their flaws often emerge in response to the kind of work they do for their government.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: My loyalty to Khador and my Empress is undying.
People find me distant and cold, but I am watching and listening to everything.
Offer me a mystery or riddle to grab my attention.
I strive to excel at everything I put my mind to.
Failure is the best teacher, but it is harsh and unforgiving.
I am deeply concerned about the welfare of my comrades and will do anything for them.
The ends justify the means, and I will not waiver in my duty.
I require all available information about a situation before I commit to a course of action.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Nation. My nation and its people are all that matter. (Any)
Security. There is no price too high to keep the empire safe. (Lawful)
Influence. The higher I rise in the ranks of my order, the more significant my say in its future. (Neutral)
Law. Adherence to the law is the only thing that keeps civilization united. (Lawful)
Discipline. Because of my arcane power, I must maintain a strict code of personal conduct. (Good)
Secrets. Everyone is hiding something. By learning what that is, I gain power over them. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I am beholden to the patron who sponsored my training.
I am bound by duty to bring a fugitive of my chapter house to justice.
I work to be seen as a hero to my people.
A comrade died so that I might live. I work to honor that sacrifice.
I learned a dark secret and must keep it hidden.
I have a lost love whose heart I hope to reclaim through great deeds.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: Chain of command is to be obeyed, whether I agree or not.
I cannot abide insults to my integrity or honor.
I find solace only in the bottom of a bottle.
I am an exceptionally harsh judge of character, my own included.
My abilities make me superior to others.
Trusting others is nearly impossible for me.

name: Griffon Knight

_.special: a handwritten notebook filled with notations about magic items found/experienced

entries: You are, or were, a member of the Griffon Knights, the lawkeepers of the town of Alamontyr and its patrolled territory. Not only have you been highly trained to an elite fighting standard, and through familiarty with the Shield Duke become familiar with what superb, even-handed, and far-sighted leadership is, you have gained experience in the use of magic items (mostly wands provided by the Duke for lancetip deployment) in combat.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One type of gaming set or musical instrument

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of fine clothes, your badge of office, a handwritten notebook filled with notations about magic items found/experienced, a set of manacles, and a purse containing 25 gp

entries.name: Elite Lawkeeper of Alamontyr
entries: Disciplined in combat and personal deportment and speech, practised in co-ordinated (group formation) combat, searches, and alertness at all times of surroundings, and sufficiently familiar with the wares made by the crafters of Alamontyr to readily find and identify tiny makers' marks and judge if a particular item is counterfeit or really the work of the crafter it purports to be. Familiar with the details (pitfalls, side effects, and strengths) of the use in battle of a range of magic items.

entries.name: Feature: Nose for Trouble
entries: Your experience in finding and punishing counterfeits, and dealing with lawbreakers generally, gives you a feel for the criminal element in Alamontyr. You can adeptly pick out members of the local thieves' guild or criminal front, and are likely to spot hired spies at work. You also have an affinity for local law enforcement and can quickly locate members of the local watch or constabulary. Your background also affords you with much higher credibility when interacting with other law enforcement.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Griffon Knights are known for their dedication to their order as well as their high level of training. Use the tables below, either making specific selections or rolling randomly, as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity

rows: I am polite to the point of absurdity.
I have lost too many fellow service members to trust others too easily.
I am disgusted by the petty criminal activity I see everywhere.
I have a story from my past service analogous to every situation imaginable.
Nothing scares me, not even cold porridge.
I like being in control and issuing orders.
I have a crude sense of humor.
Direct and simple action is always the right path.
Protection. My oath was to protect the innocent. (Good)
Law. Rules, ordinances, and laws must be followed absolutely. (Lawful)
Free Thinking. The letter of the law is not important, it is the intent behind the law. (Chaotic)
Strength. Might makes right. (Evil)
Impartiality. Your guilt or innocence is not for me to decide. (Neutral)
Duty. Not on my watch. (Any)
No one left behind, ever.
Only the smart survive. Discretion is the better part of valor.
Honor is everything.
I'll never forget being betrayed by that sweet face.
I will lay down my life for my fellows.
I will protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I am quick to judgment and too stubborn to admit it.
I quietly despise the weak.
I really hate cats.
I frequently lose my temper.
I blindly obey the law, even if doing so does harm.
I am haunted by a poor decision I made that cost the lives of fellow service members.

entries.name: Feature: Snivelling Grot
entries: You're nothing special.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: a set of {@filter Artisan's Tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (your choice), a walking stick, a trinket from another culture, {@item traveler's clothes|phb|traveling clothes}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} with 5 gp

entries.name: An Odd Bird
entries: Among birdfolk you are somewhere between an oddity and an outcast. Some consider your aversion to heights a rejection of birdfolk culture, leading many to find you off-putting. Choose how your community regards you or roll on the table below to determine how you fit in.

rows: I am considered weak or unskilled and many treat me like a fledgling.
I am looked upon as a traitor to my people.
My family wants me to return to the perch, but I just can't.
I am not welcome back in my home perch.
I am viewed as an oddity, someone for others to laugh at and tease.
I have found a new community on the forest floor.

entries.name: Feature: Find Another Path
entries: Since you have lived your life close to the ground, you are familiar with the undergrowth in the same way other birdfolk are familiar with the canopy. You can always recall the general layout of the terrain around you while traveling along the forest floor. If your path is ever blocked by an obstacle that requires you to climb or otherwise gain height to circumvent it, you can always find a way around, so long as such a path exists. Additionally, you are adept at finding shelter in the Wood while traveling, and can usually locate a suitable safe shelter (a cave, a tree hollow, or bramble thicket) somewhere on the forest floor for you and up to five other creatures.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Birdfolk who are grounded often find ways to cope with their aversion to canopy life. Some have completely forsaken their old lives in favor of new ones in undergrowth communities, while others keep ties with family and friends in the perches where they were born.

rows: I always second guess my choices.
I have learned to not let the comments of others affect me.
I'm eager to show the benefits of my unique perspective.
I'm slow to trust someone new, but open up over shared hardships.
I manufacture difficult situations to prove my abilities.
I get embarrassed easily, even when someone tries to compliment me.
I will deny my fears to everyone.
I want to see how others handle situations I'm afraid of.
Adversity. Others think of me as weak, but I will prove my worth with hard work and determination. (Lawful)
Encouragement. I try to seek out and support others like me who are seen as outcasts. (Good)
Exploration. I yearn to experience unique cultures and discover new places. (Chaotic)
Safety. In this dangerous world, it's best to keep your head down and stay cautious. (Neutral)
Rebellion. Who cares what others think of me, so long as my actions reflect how I feel in my heart? (Chaotic)
Compromise. The best way to respect each other's differences is to find a solution that doesn't exclude anyone. (Good)
My family has been the subject of ridicule ever since I left my home perch.
A bully from my childhood now holds a position of power in my home perch.
I follow the teachings of a wise outcast I met in my travels.
I feel kinship to a culture outside my own.
I won't tolerate anyone who insults me or my friends.
I have found a new family on the forest floor, and they mean more to me than anything.
I am incapable of action when I'm at great heights.
I lash out at the slightest insult.
I keep a distance from others so they won't learn of my fears.
I project my insecurities onto others.
I am uncouth and mannerless.
I find hard to trust other birdfolk.

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Your feet ache when you remember the countless hours you spent at your post in the tower. You were trained to keep one eye looking outside the wall, watching for marauders sweeping from the nearby forest, and your other eye looking inside the wall, searching for cutpurses and troublemakers.

rows: My family has served as guards for generations, and I was expected to follow suit.
I wanted to protect my community from the dangers that plagued my childhood.
A mentor saw potential in me and trained me in the ways of the guard.
I sought steady work and a chance to make a name for myself.
I was inspired by a heroic guard who saved my life as a child.
The guard offered me a second chance after a troubled youth.
I am always alert, even in moments of supposed safety.
I have a strict sense of duty and get restless when idle.
I make lighthearted jokes to ease the tension of dangerous situations.
I find it hard to trust people, always questioning their motives.
I am polite and respectful, especially to those in positions of authority.
I keep my gear meticulously clean and take pride in my uniform.
I am slow to anger but unstoppable when my patience runs out.
I see every situation as a potential threat and plan accordingly.
Responsibility. It is my duty to protect the innocent and maintain order. (Lawful)
Compassion. Even the guilty deserve fair treatment and a chance for redemption. (Good)
Freedom. I believe that authority should only exist to serve the people, not to control them. (Chaotic)
Power. To maintain order, one must wield absolute authority. (Evil)
Duty. My loyalty lies with those I serve, not abstract ideals. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I strive to become a legendary protector whose name will be remembered. (Any)
The town or city I protected will always have my loyalty, no matter where I go.
I will never forget the captain who taught me everything about being a guard.
A comrade died under my watch, and I will do whatever it takes to honor their memory.
I still carry the token of someone I failed to protect as a constant reminder.
There is a dangerous criminal I swore to track down and bring to justice.
My family depends on me, and I will never let them down.
I'm quick to enforce rules, even when bending them might be wiser.
I have a hard time letting go of past failures, often blaming myself.
I can be overly suspicious, seeing threats where none exist.
I struggle to act without clear orders, fearing the consequences of initiative.
I'm stubborn and unwilling to admit when I'm wrong.
I distrust those in positions of power, assuming corruption.

name: Guardian

_.special: ring of keys that go to where you are stationed

entries: You were trained and provisioned to be a guardian to a special place. Whether you were brought up in a family that has always been guardians, or decided to become one out of choice, you are a staunch defender and warrior. Perhaps you guard a temple or sacred site from those who wish to take it. Or, you could have been a member of a royal guard or protected a city from invaders.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine what kind of organization you were a part of, how your training was, and what kind of place you swore to protect. Was it an ancient temple dedicated to the gods? Or was it a city which you loved dearly, and would give your life to protect?

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a set of {@filter medium armor|items|category=basic|type=medium armor}, a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon=sor} of your choice, a banner, a ring of keys that go to where you are stationed, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Guardian's Connections
entries: You have a special position due to your profession as a guardian. Other guardians, regardless of whether or not they work with you or not, recognize your nature as a guardian, and will show their respect. You can also invoke your status as a guardian to gain access to the occasional restricted area, provided that you have not shown yourself to be a threat. Additionally, you can requisition simple equipment from other guardians, so long as they are equipped to do so.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: For those who are guardians, the law and upholding of vows and honor are important, regardless of what, where, or whom you serve. Thus, guardians tend to be those with a firm understanding and respect for rules and structure, while also being people who are strong and brave.

rows: I take great pride in guarding what I have sworn to protect.
While I once had a passion for what I guard, it has been a rather dull experience so far.
I tend to create little stories in my head to occupy my time.
I may adhere to my post with honor and dignity, but I do enjoy a good distraction every now and then.
I tend to enjoy the company of those who adhere to the law.
Protecting the innocent is the most admirable thing that one can do.
I know that the place I defend will play a role of great importance in the events to come.
I guard one who is going to change the world.
Honor. I adhere to the strict rules and requirements of being a guardian. (Lawful)
Sacrifice. I will lay down my life if need be for those that I protect. (Good)
Power. I know how to wield my position to obtain what I want. (Evil)
Determination. I will stop at nothing and will do anything to protect that which I guard. (Chaotic)
Defense. I chose this path, and it is one that I swear to uphold the tenets of. (Lawful)
Protection. I will defend the one I am told to protect. (Any)
I am the guardian of an heir to a fallen empire. I will restore them to power, but until then I must keep them hidden and safe.
My closest friends are the priests and priestesses of the temple I protect.
I am the sole surviving guardian of an ancient and forgotten magical structure.
An otherworldly entity instructed me with guarding a portal to their realm.
I uphold the laws and tenets of the city I have vowed to defend.
Through heat and rain and storm, I shall stand as a shield that protects my master.
Those who break the law are the worst society has to offer, and I show them no pity or remorse.
I often find myself wishing for a life of guarding something more worthwhile.
I don't often agree with how my charge acts and thinks, to their continuous consternation.
I talk a big game, but deep down I doubt myself constantly.
I am secretly scared of dying for my cause.
I feel as though I will never be seen as worthy by those I protect, and thus I do anything I can to feel as though I have value.

items.name: Languages:
entries: One of your choice between the standard languages.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, an elven tattoo, a {@item book|phb} of elven poetry, and a {@item pouch|phb|purse} containing 25 gp

entries.name: Feature: Forgotten Wisdom
entries: Those who live with the elves often are granted access to the Library. Lore from a world that has ended, has been saved and meticulously archived there. You have a +3 to {@skill History} checks to recall lore and if your check fails you have {@chance 50|50%} chance of knowing someone that might know more.

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You came of age outdoors, far from settled lands. Your home was anywhere you chose to spread your bedroll. There are wonders in the wilderness—strange monsters, pristine forests and streams, overgrown ruins of great halls once trod by giants—and you learned to fend for yourself as you explored them. From time to time, you guided friendly nature priests who instructed you in the fundamentals of channeling the magic of the wild.

rows: I grew up in the wild, and guiding others through it came naturally to me.
A mentor taught me how to navigate the wilderness and understand its secrets.
I once got lost in the wilderness, and surviving the ordeal inspired me to help others.
Exploration and discovery have always been my passion, and guiding lets me pursue them.
I needed to escape a troubled past, and the wilderness became my refuge.
I was asked to guide someone important through the wild, and it became my calling.
I feel at peace when I am surrounded by the wilderness, and I dislike staying in cities for long.
I have a keen eye for details, always noticing tracks, weather changes, and subtle shifts in my surroundings.
I love sharing stories of the strange places I've explored, even if I embellish them a little.
I am calm and patient, knowing that nature cannot be rushed.
I am fiercely protective of those under my guidance and take any harm that comes to them personally.
I have an adventurous spirit and seek to uncover the unknown, no matter the risks.
I have little tolerance for arrogance or people who underestimate the wilderness.
I carry a memento from a past expedition, which inspires me to keep pushing forward.
Respect. The wilderness is a powerful force and must be treated with reverence. (Good)
Freedom. The open road and untamed wilds are where I feel truly alive. (Chaotic)
Protection. It's my duty to safeguard travelers and preserve the natural world. (Lawful)
Discovery. Every journey brings the chance to learn something new and uncover hidden wonders. (Neutral)
Power. The secrets of the wilderness can give one immense strength if properly harnessed. (Evil)
Balance. I strive to maintain harmony between civilization and the natural world. (Any)
I owe my survival to a hermit or druid who taught me the ways of the wild.
There is a hidden place I discovered that I will do anything to protect from outsiders.
I guided a group of travelers once, and they became like family to me.
I am searching for a legendary location I've only heard about in whispered tales.
A former companion died under my guidance, and I seek redemption for that failure.
I have sworn to defend the natural world from those who would exploit or destroy it.
I am overconfident in my knowledge of the wilderness and sometimes take unnecessary risks.
I have a deep-seated mistrust of those who live in cities or lead settled lives.
I struggle to connect with others, preferring solitude over companionship.
I find it hard to resist the allure of rare treasures hidden in the wild.
I hold grudges against those who disregard or harm nature.
I sometimes prioritize my curiosity and need for exploration over the safety of others.

name: Guide

_: a map of a local area
a collection of local stories and legends

entries: You are an expert in navigating the wilderness, whether tracking, mapping, or using some other means. You either work for hire as a guide or volunteer to help others navigate dangerous and unknown terrain.

entries.name: Feature: Expert Guide
entries: As a master of the wilderness, you can navigate even the most difficult terrain and find hidden paths that others might miss. Whenever you lead a group through the wilderness, add your proficiency bonus to the passive Wisdom (Perception) score of each other member of the group. Additionally, you can use your knowledge of the local area to provide information about landmarks, hazards, and resources.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: My approach to navigation and survival is patient and methodical.
I am always on the lookout for new routes and shortcuts through the wilderness.
I am confident that I can lead others through even the most challenging terrain.
I am quiet and observant, and I always scour the natural world for signs and clues.
I am friendly, outgoing, and quick to make friends and allies.
I am competitive, driven, and always eager for a new challenge.
I am loyal and protective and will put myself in danger to protect others.
I am stoic and unemotional, and I rarely show my true feelings.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Discovery. It is my duty to explore new places and uncover new secrets. (Lawful)
Adventure. Life is an adventure, and I'm here to go on it. (Chaotic)
Protection. I must protect the wilderness and those who travel through it. (Good)
Leadership. I must lead others through the wilderness, regardless of the consequences. (Lawful)
Exploration. I must explore and document the world around me. (Neutral)
Survival. It is my duty to ensure the survival of my group, no matter the cost. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I have a beloved pet that I take with me wherever I go.
I owe my life to a stranger who saved me during a journey.
I have a deep connection to a particular place in the wilderness.
I am dedicated to preserving the beauty of the natural world.
I have a close friend who is always by my side on my journeys.
I have a burning desire to prove myself worthy of my guide's mantle.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: My overconfidence in my abilities can make me reckless.
I am often so focused on reaching my destination that I ignore warnings or advice.
I am quick to judge others and slow to listen to their opinions.
I am overly competitive and often push myself and others too hard.
I am easily distracted by the beauty of the natural world.
I am quick to anger when I feel threatened or disrespected.

name: Guttersnipe

_: a disguise kit or thieves' tools

entries: {@b Weapon Proficiencies:} Daggers.

Living within the cities of the Iron Kingdoms can be difficult for those outside the dominant culture. Gobbers and some of the bogrin who try to make a living in these cities are often pushed to the fringes, where they refine their talents to excel at burglary, espionage, and shadowing others.

entries.name: Feature: Contortionist
entries: You are slim, gangly, or double-jointed and can squeeze through narrow gaps with ease. You don't have disadvantage on attack rolls or Dexterity saving throws while squeezing, and squeezing doesn't cost you extra movement. You also have advantage on checks to wriggle free of bonds and restraints.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: If it isn't nailed down, it's mine.
I have a little rhyme I like to repeat to myself when I pilfer unattended coins.
Everyone has a tale to tell, and those stories are worth money to the right person.
I'm just doing what you don't have the guts to do for yourself.
Some people deserve to be hoodwinked.
I'll score big one day and leave this stinking city behind.
I try to give back to my people because if we can't trust each other, who can we trust?
Often the best thing to do is sell stuff back to the very people you have stolen it from.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Self-Possession. Take what you can, give nothing back. (Chaotic)
Survival. Better them than me. (Evil)
Family. You can always rely on family, and they rely on you. (Lawful)
Daring. You must take chances to score big. (Chaotic)
Trickster. Speak fast enough, distract them, and they will never realize what they are missing. (Neutral)
Honor. I might be a thief, but I'm not a killer. (Good)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I carry a pocket watch I stole from a famous actor.
Under the layers of rags, a pendant made by a sibling out of scrap hangs around my neck.
The home where my fraternity makes camp is deep within the Undercity.
I keep a scratched gold crown at the bottom of my pack. It has always brought me luck.
An alchemist is hunting me down for the schematics I stole.
I'm loyal to the fence who knows how to quickly get a reasonable price for what I lift.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I whistle the same tune to amuse myself.
I have a nervous twitch in one eye.
I lie, even to my own family.
Sometimes I don't know when to shut my mouth, especially when I am with someone I dislike.
I always want a second helping of food.
I don't take lightly being made a fool of.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: {@item Hacking Tools|UAModernMagic}, a face mask, a set of dark {@item common clothes|PHB} including a hood, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Username
entries: You have created a faceless network persona tied to your hacking exploits, and are acquainted with other like-minded hackers who are friendly to this persona. Additionally, you can forge digital documents and identification, as long as you have seen an example of the kind of document you are trying to copy.

entries.name: Variant Feature: Blackmail
entries: If your character has a hacker background, you may select this background feature instead of Username.

You can exert leverage over one or more Imperial commoners and demand their help as needs warrant, provided you have access to your {@item hacking tools|UAModernMagic}. For example, you can have a message carried across a neighborhood, procure a short carriage ride without paying, or have others clean up a bloody mess you left in an alley. The DM decides if your demands are reasonable and if there is sufficient data to blackmail them with.

You have embraced the modern age and the advent of technology, and understand how to use it to your advantage. As a hacker, you are adept at breaking into networks and systems, and overriding technological devices. Perhaps you are working for one of the Reckoner gangs or the Saiba Futurists, or perhaps you are a lone wolf using your skills for your own ends.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: {@item Hacking tools|TTT} and one type of {@item gaming set|phb}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of common clothes, a smartphone, a data drive, a universal cable, a wireless transceiver, a set of augmented reality gear (sunglasses, goggles or contact lenses), and a credit stick with 500 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Hacker Type
entries: Hackers are divided up into several different types, depending on what lines you're willing to cross. A white hat hacker is often a paid corporate employee or a contractor. A black hat hacker is a criminal who uses their talents for personal or political gain. A grey hat hacker is somewhere in between, often breaking into systems only to show a corporation the flaws in their security, or to show off. You can select your hacker type from the table below or roll to select it randomly.

rows: White Hat
Black Hat
Grey Hat
Amateur

entries.name: Feature: Hacker Etiquette
entries: You know the hacker lingo and slang, and you fit right into hacker culture. You know a well-informed hacker group that you can contact for help, though it might not be cheap. You also know online marketplaces where you can buy and sell valuable and potentially illegal data.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Hackers tend to be detached from the real world, preferring the internet, where they are free to exercise their talents and enjoy surfing the infinite ocean of data. They seem odd or quirky to others who aren't as fluent in internet culture. However, they are often driven by certain motivations to work with others and venture outside of their bubble.

rows: The meat world sucks, I only feel at home when I'm online.
People who can't protect their systems deserve what I do to them.
I can't stand being lonely, it drives me crazy.
I'm endlessly curious, and I'll dig deep to uncover the truth.
I'm a smooth operator, and I keep cool under pressure.
I'm very excitable and full of energy.
People say I'm easily spooked, but I just like to stay on my toes.
I've been told I'm emotionally numb, whatever that means.
{@bold Hope.} I can't help but take on charity cases if it feels right. (Good)
{@bold Community.} Hackers have a code, and for good reason. (Lawful)
{@bold Troll.} It's fun to fuck with people who take things too serious. (Chaotic)
{@bold Cold.} People are unreliable and expendable. (Evil)
{@bold Binary.} There are people in my world, and people outside it. (Neutral)
{@bold Equalizer.} Someone needs to hold the elite and powerful accountable. (Any)
I'm going to be the best, and the whole world will know me.
During a job, I discovered something I really shouldn't have, and now I'm in danger.
A hacker friend of mine wasn't who they claimed to be, and I feel betrayed.
I befriended a rogue AI on the internet, and it has some interesting requests.
My family doesn't know what I do, and it needs to stay that way.
I've decided to spend more time outside of my comfort zone.
I'm so cautious that I miss a lot of opportunities.
I'm addicted to consuming certain media.
I get anxious and jittery if I'm away from the internet for too long.
I get extremely competitive, past the point of reason.
I make overly complicated plans which tend to fall apart.
Nobody gets my references and jokes.

entries: A figure huddles in the corner of a filthy room littered with empty noodle pouches and energy drink bottles. The moldy, sagging ceiling drips into a series of overflowing buckets, water pooling before it leaks down into the room below. A dog shouldn't be made to live in such squalor. The figure doesn't seem to mind.

After all, they're in the middle of grabbing a list of some mid-level manager's account credentials after he was stupid enough to leave it in plaintext in a barely hidden file in some directory labeled 'Documentation'. Their immaculate avatar, a gleaming humanoid figure made of color shifting crystals, takes hold of the golden key to a treasure trove and holds it high.
The huddling figure, its head held upright by a cable running from a port in the back of their neck to a wall socket, lets a thin smile cross their face.

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: You can speak, read, and write {@language Draconic|PHB}.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@filter tool|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=tools;artisan's tools} you are proficient in (if any), a set of {@item fine clothes|PHB} (as those raised by half dragons tend to be vain in the same way dragons are), and a {@item pouch|PHB} with 20 gold.

entries.name: Feature: An eye for treasure
entries: You've seen your fair share of treasure over the years, as many half dragons (and those raised among them) tend to have the same love for treasure as all dragons have. You can use your knowledge of luxurious goods to help identify worth (but not magical properties) and to bargain a fair selling or buying price from shopkeepers. With time others may seek out your knowledge of antiquities, and your knowledgeable view is valued by those of high society.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The coloration of your half dragon community shapes a large part of your life; as those living there often have characteristics that reflect the temperament of the dragon ancestors tied to that coloration. The characteristics in the tables below however are fitting for all half dragon broods.

rows: I face dangerous situations with a cheerful smile as if it's a challenge.
Nothing can shake my greed for treasure.
I expect everyone to fear or respect me.
I go out of my way to help an innocent in need.
My age allows me to see humor in almost every situation. (Half Dragon).
I can't stop talking and expect everyone to listen to me.
I can't shake a desire to fight anyone encroaching on what I believe to be mine.
My pride won't let me back down from a challenge.
{@b Greed.} Coins and shiny baubles are all I care about. (Evil)
{@b Tradition.} I am a vault of stories, and they must be preserved for future generations to learn from. (Lawful)
{@b Power.} I will become as powerful as I can possibly be, and use that power as I see fit. (Any)
{@b Freedom.} To fly is to be free, and I'll do anything to be able to take flight. With wings or otherwise. (Chaotic)
{@b Aspiration.} Someday I'll be able to ascend to dragonhood, and become a full dragon. (Neutral, Half Dragon)
{@b Duty.} It is my duty to continue to protect those I care for, as well as any innocents who need my help. (Good)
I owe a great debt to my family and village, who have always supported me.
Territory was stolen from me or my people, and I'll do anything to get it back.
Those who gain my trust have a friend for life.
Those who dare insult me or belittle dragon kind will rue the day they incurred my wrath!
A valuable possession was stolen from me and it will be mine again.
I will protect my friends, my family, and my people.
I believe myself to be far superior to those around me.
I can not pass up a chance to gain a pretty trinket.
When I speak I expect others to listen, and once I start telling a story I won't let anyone leave until I finish.
I constantly forget that I'm not a full dragon yet, and it's gotten me into trouble on occasion. (Half Dragon).
I have a reputation for arrogance since I feel that I can take on any challenge.
I can't sleep unless I have gold coins under my pillow.
I tend to be prideful, and I expect others to recognize my greatness.
I hold a grudge against anyone who has disrespected me in the past, even if the slight was minor.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Amethyst)
entries: Half amethyst dragon communities are reclusive, and often underground. Those that make contact with other races prefer to trade with gnomes and dwarves. These communities often produce gifted psychics, and wage war against mindflayers wherever they find them.

This type of half gem dragon are less common than half sapphire dragons, and usually don't form communities of their own. Because of this they are not an option for the half dragon brood background (page 92). Instead, they often join half sapphire dragon communities.

entries: Reference {@link Legacy of Dragon|https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nielsdejong/legacy-of-the-dragon-a-dragon-themed-supplement-for-5e}. Please credit if you repost elsewhere.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Black)
entries: Half black dragons tend to be survivors in an ever changing world, willing to use any trick they can to thrive. They have also found an appreciation for metal working, creating tools of war unmatched by most other races.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Blue)
entries: Half blue dragons tend to serve their full blooded kin, working as Stormscale agents or sorcerers to aid them. Even so, they interact a lot with mortal societies, using their draconic charms to negotiate prices when trading, and their skill at disguises to complete their missions.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Brass)
entries: Half brass dragons love interacting with other races and cultures, and their communities often bring forth great intermediates, as well as gifted paladins.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Bronze)
entries: Half bronze dragons tend to build mighty cities out of stone, usually near bodies of water, and often have strict yet fair laws. Sharks are a delicacy among them. Their communities often raise relentless yet just crusaders, and they are the most militaristic of the half dragons.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Brown)
entries: Half brown dragons tend to serve their full blooded kin, working as Earthscale agents or sorcerers to aid them. Even so, they interact rarely with mortal societies, using their draconic charms to negotiate prices when trading, and their skill at disguises to complete their missions.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@filter tool|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=tools;artisan's tools} you are proficient in (if any), a set of {@item fine clothes|PHB} (as those raised by half dragons tend to be vain in the same way dragons are), and a {@item pouch|PHB} with 20 gold.

entries.name: Feature: An eye for treasure
entries: You've seen your fair share of treasure over the years, as many half dragons (and those raised among them) tend to have the same love for treasure as all dragons have. You can use your knowledge of luxurious goods to help identify worth (but not magical properties) and to bargain a fair selling or buying price from shopkeepers. With time others may seek out your knowledge of antiquities, and your knowledgeable view is valued by those of high society.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The coloration of your half dragon community shapes a large part of your life; as those living there often have characteristics that reflect the temperament of the dragon ancestors tied to that coloration. The characteristics in the tables below however are fitting for all half dragon broods.

rows: I face dangerous situations with a cheerful smile as if it's a challenge.
Nothing can shake my greed for treasure.
I expect everyone to fear or respect me.
I go out of my way to help an innocent in need.
My age allows me to see humor in almost every situation. (Half Dragon).
I can't stop talking and expect everyone to listen to me.
I can't shake a desire to fight anyone encroaching on what I believe to be mine.
My pride won't let me back down from a challenge.
{@b Greed.} Coins and shiny baubles are all I care about. (Evil)
{@b Tradition.} I am a vault of stories, and they must be preserved for future generations to learn from. (Lawful)
{@b Power.} I will become as powerful as I can possibly be, and use that power as I see fit. (Any)
{@b Freedom.} To fly is to be free, and I'll do anything to be able to take flight. With wings or otherwise. (Chaotic)
{@b Aspiration.} Someday I'll be able to ascend to dragonhood, and become a full dragon. (Neutral, Half Dragon)
{@b Duty.} It is my duty to continue to protect those I care for, as well as any innocents who need my help. (Good)
I owe a great debt to my family and village, who have always supported me.
Territory was stolen from me or my people, and I'll do anything to get it back.
Those who gain my trust have a friend for life.
Those who dare insult me or belittle dragon kind will rue the day they incurred my wrath!
A valuable possession was stolen from me and it will be mine again.
I will protect my friends, my family, and my people.
I believe myself to be far superior to those around me.
I can not pass up a chance to gain a pretty trinket.
When I speak I expect others to listen, and once I start telling a story I won't let anyone leave until I finish.
I constantly forget that I'm not a full dragon yet, and it's gotten me into trouble on occasion. (Half Dragon).
I have a reputation for arrogance since I feel that I can take on any challenge.
I can't sleep unless I have gold coins under my pillow.
I tend to be prideful, and I expect others to recognize my greatness.
I hold a grudge against anyone who has disrespected me in the past, even if the slight was minor.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Fang)
entries: Half fang and half gray dragons are the most vicious of all half dragons. Fang dragons don't have a breath weapon, but make for it with their ferocity. They have a bite that drains the life and even soul of their victims. Gray dragons were created by Tiamat from fang dragon eggs, and "improved" by giving them a breath weapon and turning them into chromatic dragons. However, half fang dragons (and dragonborn) also have a breath weapon, which they believe is a gift (or curse) from Tiamat. They have a life draining bite similar to their dragon ancestor, and often that dragon's temper as well. They do not form communities, and either live a life of solitude or join other half dragon communities. Those that ascend to dragonhood become gray dragons.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Gold)
entries: Half gold dragons have an affinity towards magic and the divine, and many renowned clerics and monks were raised in their communities. The worship of Asgorath and Bahamut, as well as the Arcana and Dragon domains, are popular among clerics that come from such communities.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Moonstone)
entries: Moonstone dragons are native to the feywild, but from time to time there are those that move to the prime world and even bond with mortal partners. Like their full blooded kin, half moonstone dragons tend to be peaceful and prefer to exchange stories or ideas. If pressed, they will use their magic to subdue their foes rather than kill them. They don't create settlements of their own, and prefer to dwell among elves or other half dragons.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Silver)
entries: Half silver dragons are often found in human villages and cities, either living among them (in disguise or as half dragons), or in their own conclaves. They love humanity's drive and how it forces them to action.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Song)
entries: Song dragons often apear as comely female mortal women, and as such it is not uncommon for them to have mortal partners, and half dragon offspring. Like half steel dragons, these half dragons will appear as their mortal parent's race if they are raised among them; such as Narnra Shalace, daughter of Elminster, who believed she was a human for a part of her life. They don't have settlements of their own, and instead join the Confluence or organizations like the Sisterhood of Essembra. The rules under "Playing as a Half Steel Dragon" can be applied to half song dragons as well.

entries: Many half steel dragons are unaware of their true heritage, as their appearance is that of a (half) human from birth if they live among humans. Those that are aware are part of a secret organization known as the Confluence.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (Topaz)
entries: Half topaz dragon communities are reclusive, and often underground. Those that make contact with other races prefer to trade with gnomes and dwarves. These communities often produce gifted psychics, and wage war against mindflayers wherever they find them.

This type of half gem dragon are less common than half sapphire dragons, and usually don't form communities of their own. Because of this they are not an option for the half dragon brood background (page 92). Instead, they often join half sapphire dragon communities.

entries.name: Half Dragon Brood (White)
entries: Half white dragons are survivors whose tribes try to steer away from other cultures, unless those cultures encroach on their (often expanding) territories. Their societies are less developed compared to those of the other races, as they tend towards tribalism.

name: Hanabi Engineer (Prosthesis Adept)

a: a {@item Basic Prosthesis|RyokoGuideToYokaiRealms} with an integrated weapon of your choice

entries: Behind every great adventurer is a greater engineer—a source of incredible prostheses, gleaming armour, and deadly magic items. You are an expert of your craft, a virtuoso of assembly and artifice, buoyed ever onward by restless intellectual curiosity and love of the job. As an associate of the College of Hanabi, a school of pyrotechnicians, alchemists, and inventors, you likely began work as an apprentice for a skilled craftsperson to a town or as a weapons manufacturer for a powerful clan. Your talents may have led you to travel, discovering exotic components from which you crafted unique wares for adventurers much like yourself. In a world of warriors, monsters, and magic, your technological prowess is always in high demand.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: {@filter Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@filter Artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (same as above), 2 {@item pouch|PHB|pouches}, {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a basic prosthesis with an integrated weapon of your choice, and 5 gp; or (B) 50 gp

entries.name: Optional Feature: Hanabi Apprentice
entries: As an associate of the College of Hanabi, you have access to a large network of tinkerers, merchants, and manufacturers. You know the right technical jargon to seamlessly integrate with other inventors, and you can count on the support of the college for information and lodgings in communities where it has a strong presence. Alumni of the college might be able to procure "top shelf " components and magic items unavailable to those outside the clique, or they may put you in touch with affluent merchants or tribes interested in purchasing your wares.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Being a hanabi engineer requires a mind simultaneously capable of bombastic imagination and intense focus. You see opportunity in every obstacle and delight in solving problems in the most overengineered fashion possible. Your enthusiasm for your work is inspiring, but long, isolated years of meticulous training and craft may have left you a little lacking in social situations. Alas, there is no machine that can make you better at dealing with people... yet.

rows: Excessive verbosity is prized among my idiosyncrasies.
I tend to get extremely excitable when discussing my passions.
I love to blow stuff up.
I am swiftly irritated by philistines who fail to appreciate my artistry.
I articulate every word with wild gestures and movements.
I sleep hanging upside down; the rush of blood to my head often sparks great ideas.
Ambition. I strive to be recognised as the best in the world at what I do.
Altruism. I aim to make the world a better place using my gifts.
Money. I intend to amass great wealth on the back of my talents.
Teacher. I live to pass down knowledge, and I take great delight in teaching others all that I know.
Progress. I aspire to wake up every day a little better than I was the day before.
Chore Aversion. I am willing to work extremely hard to find a way to be lazy. If it takes a week to make a tool that handles a boring job that would have taken me 10 minutes, so be it.
I am deeply attached to my tools, giving them names and talking to them as I work.
I count several famous inventors and merchants among my close friends.
I blew up my first workshop at the age of nine and have gone through several more over the years. Numerous landlords have bounties on my head.
I have dear friends who count on me for their prostheses and gear. I devote countless hours to caring for them at no charge.
A rival engineer once stole an invention of mine and claimed credit. I will never forgive them and secretly seek revenge.
I am under contract from a noble to produce an immensely complex and powerful item, reporting regular updates on its construction to them.
If anything I create is less than perfect, I throw it away in disgust.
I often forget to charge for my work. The joy of creating is all I need.
My eagerness to explosively solve my problems sometimes gets me into more trouble than it's worth.
I put my trust wholeheartedly in technology, dismissing any potential magical or social solution to a problem.
I get anxious when plans go awry, making it a struggle to adapt on the go.
I spend every penny I earn immediately; there always seems to be something new to buy.
