name: Judge

_.special: scroll declaring your authority signed by a king or other official
formal uniform you wear to court

entries: Your duty is to uphold laws. Before becoming an adventurer you presided over a court or tribunal, managing proceedings and sentencing criminals to punishments fit for their crimes. Your job required a deep understanding of the law which you used to resolve conflicts both clear-cut and indefinite.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A scroll declaring your authority signed by a king or other official, a book of law, a formal uniform you wear to court, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Legal Authority
entries: You are familiar with the letter of the law and the workings of the courts. If you or your party gets into legal trouble, you are well equipped to represent them in a court of law. You may know of legal loopholes that will help your case, or have personal connections to legal professionals that can assist you.
If in a foreign land, you are able to track down their system of laws you can learn the shape of their legal system after studying their laws for a single day.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A judge's career is centered on issues of right, wrong, and punishment. They are accustomed to being respected and in control.

rows: I quote the law like a religious fanatic quotes scripture.
I bang my weapon like a gavel whenever I want a rowdy group's attention.
I remain impartial when making decisions, even where most would be influenced by biases and loyalties.
Evidence is necessary to back up any claim.
I insist on settling all disagreements through court proceedings, or as close to that as I can manage.
I have to hear all sides of a story, but I secretly hate listening to people whine about how unfairly they're treated.
I am happy to make sacrifices for the sake of fairness.
I will not attack a person unless someone can prove they are doing something wrong.
{@bold Law.} I will follow the letter of the law always, no matter what I believe. (Lawful)
{@bold Justice.} My duty is to mete out punishments that are merited by their crimes. (Good)
{@bold Reform.} Laws can be corrupt, and I strive to free people from the bad ones. (Chaotic)
{@bold Punishment.} I will punish all those who have committed great evils. (Any)
{@bold Control.} I enforce the law only where it benefits me. (Evil)
{@bold Stability.} The purpose of law is to keep civilization from collapsing. The spirit of that goal is more important than the letter of the law. (Neutral)
I once allowed a dangerous criminal to go free, and I don't plan to let them get away again.
All those who strive to uphold the law are my allies.
I have sentenced an innocent man to a horrible punishment, and that guilt still haunts me.
There is an ethical cause that I would give my life for.
I dream of memorizing the laws of every civilization.
I am enamored with the legal system of my own culture, and want to spread its tenets everywhere.
Mercy is a foreign concept to me.
I am unwilling to admit when I am wrong.
I become unreasonably enraged at even the slightest injustice.
I expect others to adhere to the law, but I am above it.
If there isn't a law in the books to handle a dilemma, I can't make a decision.
The punishments I deal are cruel and unusual.

entries.name: Variant Judge: Lawyer
entries: Your home is a place where the legal system gives prosecutors and defendants the right to hire a legal specialist to argue their case. You know the law as well as any judge, but your job is to use it to protect your client. Replace your History proficiency with Persuasion.

name: Juju Savant
entries: Your ancestors were magically trained historians. Once per day you can touch a historic relic and roll an Intelligence ({@skill History}) check to get some flashbacks on things that happen around that item.

name: Jundarl

_.special: A well-worn animal pelt you use as both clothing and blanket
a small memento from your previous life

entries: You are of the bloodline of a family who lived for generations in the hot forest of Jundarwood (also known as "Old Shadow") in the western Border Kingdoms, and through drinking its waters and eating its fastgrowing plants and small animals, gained the trait of healing swiftly and even regenerating lost organs, limbs, and other body parts. Like other Jundarls, your hair and nails grow with astonishing speed, so if you don't trim often, you're always shaggy, and if you "let yourself go" can become as hairy as a bear (concealing your facial features and hiding tattoos and scars), with nails like (brittle, low-strength) bear-claws.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A well-worn animal pelt you use as both clothing and blanket, an herbalism kit, and 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: Fast Healing
entries: While the rapid growth of your hair and nails may have their drawbacks in civilized society, your body's rapid healing makes getting over life's everyday bumps and bruises a bit easier. At the end of a long rest, the jundarl gains a number of temporary hit points equal to their proficiency bonus. Given enough time, this unusual healing ability can actually regenerate lost digits or even whole body parts. However, this process is slow. The jundarl can regenerate approximately one pound of lost body parts/material for each month spent resting.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Jundarl tend to be on the reclusive side simply as a function of their appearance. However, they are certainly not solitary individuals by default. Given assiduous and daily grooming, one would never be able to tell a Jundarl apart from any other Borderer. Those Jundarl who weary from the necessary trimming and cutting that is required to blend into "normal" society tend to be loners who live in isolation Because of their obvious physical differences from the rest of society, Jundarl are often wrongly accused of beastly behaviour, not unlike the bias faced by lycanthropes. Use the tables below, either making specific selections or rolling randomly, as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity.

rows: I've have been accused of so many things I did not do based on my appearance, that I am very slow to judge others.
I always root for the underdog and go out of my way to help those less fortunate than myself.
I am quite convinced that I have the right answer for every question, every time.
I can't stand dairy in any form.
I'm above such concepts as etiquette and social expectations.
I'm very easily distracted and struggle to stay on any task.
All we need is love.
I am impatient with people the are less intelligent than me, which means just about everyone.
A Better World. My life is dedicated to uplifting those around me. (Good)
Order. Without structure, all is lost. We must follow the rules! (Lawful)
Whatever. Everyone needs to, like, chill, man. (Chaotic)
Pain. Only through a measure of suffering can one find the truth. (Evil)
Respect Others. There is no absolute truth. Each must find their own path. (Neutral)
Respect Life. We all have a role to play in this universe and should be allowed to play it. (Any)
Because of persecution suffered as a child, I am dedicated to building a more inclusive world.
I am driven by my fear of failure.
I lost someone very close to me long ago. Everything I do is dedicated to their memory.
I am focused on revenge. Revenge against those who killed my family long ago.
My only source of peace is unspoiled nature. Iwill do anything to preserve it.
Striving for justice in an unjust world is my burden to bear.
My fear of being accepted makes me quiet and withdrawn.
I deeply resent people who talk too much.
I am extremely self conscious about my bad breath, so keep others at least arms' length away.
I simply cannot abide losing an argument, so I never acknowledge defeat.
I am greedy, like really greedy. Where is my precious?!
I can't stand high society types or any form of foppery.

name: Kaiju Tracker
entries: Across a twisted landscape uprooted by destruction and chaos, you follow the mighty footfalls of kaiju. You are a brazen traveller who tracks Gargantuan creatures over the realms, from icy mountain top to toxic swampland, ever seeking a glimpse of your primal quarry. The trail of a kaiju is a hard one to follow, and the skills you've gained during your travels have kept you alive and fed.

Perhaps a kaiju destroyed your home and family, and you seek it in the hope of exacting vengeance. Maybe you track kaiju in order to predict their movements, evacuating communities in their path and leading kaiju far from civilisation. It could be that you are simply a thrill seeker, chasing kaiju across the world to revel in the eye of the storm as they rampage. Whatever your motivation, your tale is one of endless migration, awe, and danger.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Herbalism kit|PHB}, {@item backpack|PHB}, {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a {@item hunting trap|PHB}, a grappling hook prosthesis*, {@item hempen rope (50 feet)|PHB}, and 5 gp; or (B) 50 gp

entries.name: Optional Feature: Trail of Destruction
entries: Nonmagical difficult terrain doesn't impede your movement.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A life trailing a path of carnage has shown you much of the worst that people can suffer—shattered communities, broken families, and mass extinction are intimately familiar to you. It has also shown you the resilience of those who survive, the hope that can blossom in the wake of catastrophe, and the fragility of even the mightiest of kingdoms. Many kaiju trackers are gruff and nihilistic, inured to the suffering of others. Some are motivated by an unconquerable hatred or fascination with kaiju, finding purpose in their eternal chase. No matter their idiosyncrasies, all those who place themselves in the path of a kaiju share one trait: a near-suicidal level of bravery.

rows: I live for the thrill of danger! Certainty of death? Small chance of success? What are we waiting for?
I have seen devastation and loss that would break most people. I have survived by closing my heart to it.
I will never settle down. I need to always be on the road, and I'll die on my feet.
Every dawn, without fail, I take an hour to clean and sharpen my weapons.
I love myths of heroes and villains. I constantly retell old folktales and draw parallels to real life.
I try to conscript anyone I meet into joining me on foolhardy adventures.
Vengeance. Once wronged, I never let go. I am seeking a way to exact vengeance on those who have done me harm.
Travel. I want to see everything and be the first to traverse every plane in existence.
Harvester. I believe the secret to mythical elixirs and weapons lies in harvesting components from incredible creatures. I want to harvest the bodies of gods.
Hasty. If something is worth doing, it's worth doing now. I have no time for debate or consideration.
Guardian. I struggle to connect with people, but I want to keep them safe, even if they never know who I am.
Legend. I want to be remembered and leave a legacy that bards will sing of for generations.
There are many monsters in this world. I will protect those who cannot protect themselves.
A kaiju destroyed my home and people. It will die by my hand, or I will die trying.
Those I travel with are closer than kin.
I am enamoured with kaiju—their size, grace, and power. I wish only to observe and understand how such beings exist.
My faith has been shaken upon seeing the devastation wrought by the evils in this world. I am struggling to overcome my doubt in the god I have long served.
I make friends with animals quickly and loathe to harm beasts, even dangerous ones.
My obsession with killing monsters risks turning me into one.
I judge myself harshly. A single failure is enough to send me spiralling into despair.
My thrill-seeking behaviour puts me and others at risk.
My word is absolute; I struggle to entertain other perspectives or ideas.
My love for treasure and gold often leads my morals astray.
Only the mission's success matters; the body count is irrelevant.

name: Kayazy

_: a dark-colored set of common clothes with a hood

entries: You are related to one of the kayazy, Khador's infamous merchant princes. By tradition, members of the kayazy are leaders of both legitimate commercial industry and the criminal underworld. You are a valued member of the organization and can expect to draw support from it when needed.

entries.name: Feature: History of Violence
entries: You've been on both sides of so many ambushes that you are very accustomed to situations turning violent in the blink of an eye. You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity checks when determining initiative. Additionally, you cannot be surprised by humanoids in an urban environment.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Things are seldom black and white among the kayazy, and a pragmatic outlook is almost a requirement. Coin is the great equalizer, and everything has a price.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: Trust is only as strong as the coin backing it up.
I am swift in action, silent in deed.
I calculate every risk and am prepared in any situation.
I judge by actions, not words.
I'm always fidgeting if I'm not doing something.
Gallows humor is the only humor I have.
I'm haunted by the things I've done.
I believe nothing is straightforward or simple.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Cunning. You don't have to outfight an opponent you can outthink. (Any)
Tradition. The old ways must be respected. (Lawful)
Greed. Honor and duty are for poor people. I just want more wealth. (Evil)
Freedom. This life allows me to choose my path. (Chaotic)
Power. When you have power and influence, you can do anything. (Any)
Family. Without my family, I am nothing. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I am still obligated to the terms of a contract I have yet to fulfill.
I seek to undo a horrible wrong from my past.
I was betrayed by a comrade. I will have my revenge.
I will do anything to acquire great wealth.
I believe in those I fight with, and I will atone for my past by ensuring their future.
I send most of my gains to my struggling family.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I will take just about anything of value that isn't nailed down.
If it comes to money or those I care about, I care about the money.
I am confident in my abilities and have trouble tolerating differing opinions.
I put too much trust in family, and it might get me killed.
I fixate on problems and have trouble letting go of a goal.
I am secretly in the government's employ and have infiltrated the organization to keep tabs on its activities.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Old Lore|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Calligrapher's supplies|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Honourable, True-hearted

_.special: small trinket evocative of Sarlona's ancient past

items.name: Skills:
items.entry: Choose two from among {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Medicine}, and {@skill Nature}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A collection of research notes, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a {@item quill|PHB}, a bottle of ink, a small trinket evocative of Sarlona's ancient past, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 {@item gold|PHB}.

entries.name: Research Specialties
entries: As a Keeper of the Word, you are a scholar of some renown and respect. Most keepers spend their entire life devoted to aspects of Sarlona's history, some of which are niche even by your order's standards. You can select a Research Specialty below or roll randomly, then add details to determine how you ended up studying this subject over any other.

entries.caption: Research Specialties
rows: Rhiavhaaran sea shanties
Interactions between different planes
Pre-Sundering Khaleshite culture
Psionics and their history on Sarlona
Wild zones
Borunan war poetry

entries.name: Feature: Preservation of Knowledge
entries: You have easy access to all of Adar's libraries and stores of knowledge, most of which are concentrated in the nation's monastery-fortresses. This can range from knowledge of Pre-Sundering Sarlona to spells that can be copied into spellbooks. Dangerous spells and objects may be restricted until you have proven yourself to the wider organization. Should you uncover or develop previously unknown arcane spells, powers, or items, you are expected to contribute to the organization's overall knowledge.

entries.name: Suggested Traits
entries: Keepers of the Word come in all shapes and sizes. Are you pursuing knowledge for your own sake? Are you learning the history of Sarlona to reclaim your people's ancient histories? Or are you secretly looking to take all of that power for yourself?

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I write everything down. Everything.
Other cultures fascinate me, especially if they're still alive after all this time.
I always keep trinkets on me; never know when you might need a Dolurrhi husksteel coin!
If I see something new, I will ask questions until the sun goes down.
The quieter the space, the better I work.
Given enough time, I will end up inventing something, and it will be someone else's problem.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Knowledge.} I want to learn everything I can, no matter the danger or cost. (Any)
{@b Power.} The ancient sorcerers broke their world. I want that power for myself. (Evil)
{@b Innovation.} The past is a good foundation; progress comes from making their notes better. (Chaotic)
{@b Generosity.} The more we know, the better people's lives become. (Good)
{@b Preservation.} So much was lost in the Sundering. We cannot lose more of our history. (Neutral)
{@b Traditions.} Sharing knowledge and keeping our structure ensures our order endures. (Lawful)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: My teacher killed my classmates, and I want revenge.
My ancestors fled from the place I now try to study.
I want to rise in the ranks of the Keepers, someday becoming a teacher myself.
I was almost killed for something I wrote down; I want to find out why.
An ancient text appeared in my study, and I'm too curious to leave well enough alone.
A loved one died trying to uncover a piece of our past; I want to finish their research so they can rest.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I have a one-track mind on the best of days.
Hiding something from me is akin to betrayal.
I'm far too fond of cruel spells and stories.
Give me enough time and I will end up creating trouble.
I'd rather die than keep a secret from other Keepers.
Aloof is probably too kind a word for me.

_.special: set of trinkets from various Khyber demiplanes

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A hooded lantern and oil, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a sturdy bag, a set of trinkets from various Khyber demiplanes, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 20 {@item gold|PHB}.

entries.name: Belly of the Beast
entries: Familiarity with Khyber is a dangerous thing. The longer you spend within the Dragon Below, the more it changes you, both physically and mentally. You can select a Scar of the Realm Below or roll randomly, then add details to determine how you survived the encounter that scarred you for life.

entries.caption: Scars of the Realm Below
rows: A symbiont has attached to your arm; it's harmless — for now.
Your humming sounds more like buzzing.
Your shadow moves on its own, whispering secrets to everyone you pass by.
You lost a finger — or maybe it never existed in the first place.
Sickly green light pours from your eyes and mouth.
You always taste blood on your lips.

entries.name: Feature: Reliable Routes
entries: You have been into the Realm Below more times than you can count. You know of reliable routes between demiplanes, and you know the safest — though not safe — paths through. You can barter with other Khyber couriers for new paths after gaining their trust. As a Khyber courier, you may be asked to deliver letters or packages to far-flung locales in exchange for knowledge, or people may seek you out to pay for these services. At your DM's discretion, you may also have contacts who live within the Realm Below, though they will not always be friendly to you.

entries.name: Suggested Traits
entries: Not just anyone runs into Khyber on the regular. What made you take up this job? What has made you stay? Have you kept your morals and your sanity, or have you decided that those are for less... enlightened minds?

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I perform bizarre rituals before doing anything—and I mean anything.
I'm overly polite to everyone I meet.
I'm jumpy on a good day; anyone would be in my line of work.
Favors are easier to carry than gold, and in my line of work, almost always more useful.
I will never turn down exploring somewhere bizarre, especially if it's a place I've never been before.
I routinely forget that mundane animals don't spit acid. Or fire. Or try to pull water from my skin.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Service.} Through acid rain or radiant shine, the job must be done. (Any)
{@b Curiosity.} There are wonders amongst the dangers, and it calls to me. (Chaotic)
{@b Influence.} The more factions I know, the more people I can call on for favors. (Neutral)
{@b Corruption.} Khyber has claimed me, and I want it to claim others as well. (Evil)
{@b Communication.} Keeping my people connected is how we will continue to survive. (Good)
{@b Survival.} I will do anything to survive the Realm Below. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I have a message with no address and must find its recipient.
My best friend went missing in Khyber and I have been trying to find them—or what's left of them.
I fled into Khyber to escape Riedra; I promised that I would come back for someone I left behind.
I was entrusted with information that only one person may ever hear; I must find them.
I was forced to leave something behind in Khyber; I'm not getting it back unless I go back into that hell.
A mysterious patron offered me a deal in Khyber, and I do not know when they will come to collect.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I am intensely paranoid.
Displays of magic freak me out, especially if it looks gruesome.
I believe I am surrounded by Cultists of the Dragon Below.
I have an irrational hatred for all kinds of plants.
I'm convinced I'm being watched at all times.
I refuse to help people when I'm on a job; those screams might be a trap.

name: Knight Exemplar
entries: You are one of the elite armored warriors of the Menite faith. You live by a strict code of absolute obedience to the Menite Temple's priests, especially those in the scrutator caste, and follow every order without question or hesitation.

entries.name: Feature: Righteous Anger
entries: You have been trained to fight alongside a group of other knights and to protect those who stand beside you. When an enemy attack damages one or more of your allies while they are within 10 feet of you, you gain +2 STR and +2 AC for 1 round. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Knights Exemplar tend to be both virtuous and vengeful. A Knight Exemplar who witnesses the sacrifice of a comrade in arms will stop at nothing to obtain vengeance.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am engrossed in the history of Menoth's greatest heroes and often discuss their words and deeds.
Failure to maintain my routine causes me great distress—distress that I am quite willing to pass on to others.
I am constantly optimistic, even when it isn't warranted.
Showing others respect is very important to me.
Having lost too many of my fellow knights, I am slow to make friends with my fellow warriors.
Overcoming great darkness has made me callous to many other dangerous situations.
I am jaded from constant battle and see little reason for hope in the material world.
Only humanity can feel Menoth's true righteousness and attest to his will. All other species are therefore innately suspect.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Scripture. I am personally dedicated to the laws and dictates of scripture, which I prioritize over my health and well-being. (Lawful)
Selfless. Sacrifice for others is my ultimate motivation. Only self-sacrifice will let me claim my place in Urcaen by Menoth's side. (Good)
Avenger. Those who have harmed the faithful deserve only death, no matter the cost. (Evil)
Beneficent. I fight for the betterment of my fellow man, either in deed or in battle. Being a knight means helping the helpless. (Good)
Aspiration. I seek to prove myself to both Menoth and his church in order to acquire a station worthy of my deeds. (Any)
Orthodox. All must adhere to the dictates of scripture. Failure to do so will only lead them to damnation. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: During the recent horrors, I rescued a small group of refugees who have become my surrogate family.
Several artifacts were stolen from my town's temple after its decline, and I will stop at nothing to reclaim them.
I owe a great deal to my spiritual mentor, an elderly scrutator.
I have become wary of a specific branch of the church, and I am locked in a dangerous game of cat and mouse with them.
My every service is rendered unto the ordinary people in the Creator's name.
A heretic killed a vital member of my temple, and I have devoted myself to righteous vengeance.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I sometimes doubt the power of the Creator in light of all that has happened to western Immoren in the last decade.
My thinking is rigid, and I view the world in black and white.
Unless I have a specific reason to do otherwise, I place absolute faith in the clergy.
I have a penchant for claiming vengeance for even minor slights.
Once I have an important goal or quest, I fixate on it to the near exclusion of all else and am unwilling to accept failure.
I implicitly distrust those who have no specific faith or whose faith does not match my own.

_.displayName: emblem of the symbol of the Silver Thorn denoting your rank as a Knight

_.special: the tool you choose for this background's tool proficiency (artisan's tools)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: An {@item emblem|phb} of the symbol of the Silver Thorn denoting your rank as a Knight, the tool you choose for this background's tool proficiency ({@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}), and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Overview:
entries: You are one of the Knights of the Silver Thorn, an arbiter of the covenant that binds the people of Gaea. You have been knighted by a Warden in front of the Bonsai on Tenrou island after years of training. You have likely been granted a degree of automonany allowing you to travel the land as you please. You have the title of 'Sir' or 'Lady'.
You can start with one of your two {@b Features}. If you later lose your squire, or gain a new one, your feature changes to the other.

entries.name: Feature: Arbiter
entries: You receive shelter and succor from members of the Silver Thorn and those who are sympathetic to its aims. This help comes in the form of free shelter and meals, and healing when appropriate, as well as occasionally risky assistance, such as a band of local citizens rallying to aid a sorely pressed Knight, or those who support the Silver Thorn helping to smuggle a Knight out of town when he or she is being hunted unjustly.
If you register a squire with your Warden, you lose this feature and gain the {@b Squire} feature.

entries.name: Feature: Squire
entries: You have taken on a squire. You are responsible for their training and wellbeing, they are an extention of you and your place within the Silver Thorn. Your squire has a full set of characterisitcs, use the tables for the {@background acolyte} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for their traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit their identity as a Silver Thorn operative. For instance, consider the words "faith" and "faction" to be interchangeable. Your squire also has two flaws instead of one.

Your squire will fight for you in combat. You select your squire combat statistics from among the following choices: {@creature bandit}, {@creature guard}, {@creature noble} or {@creature tribal warrior}. Your squire's creature choice has the following changes, their alignment changes to any lawful alignment, their weapon changes to a {@item shortsword|phb}, they use a {@item shield|phb}, their armor changes to {@item hide armor|phb}. You control your squire in combat, but your DM might take control of your squire if they expereience fear, stress or wavering loyalty.
Your squire can be any playable race. Out of combat your squire is controlled by your DM as a loyal NPC.

Your squire evolves as you level up. Every time you level up, you can spend 8 hours of training to increase your squire's hit die by one. Your squire's proficiency bonus increases by 1 when yours does, and when your level Feature is an Ability Score Improvement your squire can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or they can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
If your follower leaves your service or dies, you must inform your Warden and you lose this feature and gain the {@b Arbiter} feature.
If you gain a squire at a later level you can spend a week of training to increase their statistics to become what they would be if they were in your service from level one.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background acolyte} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a Knight of the Silver Thorn. (For instance, consider the words "faith" and "faction" to be interchangeable.)

Your bond might be associated with other members of the Silver Thorn, or a location or an object that is important to them. The ideal you strive for is probably in keeping with the covanent or principles of the Silver Thorn, but might be more personal in nature.

name: Knights of the Prophet
entries: You are a member of one of the largest orders of knights serving the Church of Morrow. Although you are not forbidden from defending your nation, you have taken solemn oaths to protect and preserve the church itself above all else.

entries.name: Feature: Morrow's Guidance
entries: You felt the touch of Morrow on your life before you joined the order, and you can still feel his hand guiding you to defend his church. You can pray to Morrow to give you guidance in a task related to your calling. When you use this feature, you gain advantage on any roll for an action that takes no longer than a single round. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
Additionally, at the GM's discretion, you can seek aid or council at the main chapter house for the Knights of the Prophet in the Sancteum or at any of the major chapter houses in Highgate and Ceryl.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Knights of the Prophet act as the military wing of the Church of Morrow. A life of balancing goodness and fighting is challenging but ultimately fulfilling.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I tend to be too quick to trust. People often call me gullible.
I hate even the smallest lies so much that I often say painfully true things that make others shy away from me.
The loss of many comrades in arms haunts me and makes it difficult for me to create new friendships.
I have a lesson for every situation drawn from either scripture or experience.
Very little can shake my optimistic outlook on the world—not even the Claiming itself.
I can find the right words to inspire people in even the darkest times.
I speak formally at all times and do not like it when others use vulgar language.
I look down on nobles who treat commoners poorly.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Valor. Vanquishing dark forces from the world for humanity's benefit is my ultimate duty and goal. (Good)
Knowledge. Gaining knowledge of the world is the best way to improve it. (Neutral)
Honesty. People's paths should reflect honestly on themselves. (Any)
Charity. I attend to the Prophet's will not only through conflict, but also by relieving the suffering of the downtrodden. (Good)
Faith. I am an instrument of the Prophet, and his revelations help me accomplish his will. (Lawful)
Freedom. Tyrants and dictators cannot be allowed to lord over the people. (Chaotic)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: A thief stole from my church and killed an innocent soul in the process. I will bring this criminal to justice.
I will follow any orders from the church, even if I harbor doubt about them.
Before becoming a knight, I learned the sword from a kindly swordmaster. I have lost track of my teacher but look forward to our reunion.
I was raised in an orphanage dedicated to my god. I return to offer aid whenever possible.
The Claiming left me with only one surviving family member, whose safety is paramount to me.
I made a powerful enemy of a specific group of cultists when I revealed them to the church.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am often far too truthful for my own good.
I find it difficult to imagine that a person can truly be good without faith in the Prophet.
I secretly take great pleasure in killing my foes and fear someone will uncover my true nature one day.
Once set on a path, I will ignore almost everything else to attain my goal.
Although it was not directly Morrow's doing, I have a hard time maintaining my faith after the culmination of the course he and his sister put humanity on.
I take tremendous pride in my skills and deeds. All those who fail to show me the respect I deserve are suspect.

name: Labor Boss

_: a set of rugged work clothes

entries: Before your life as an adventurer, you led laborers on the docks of a port city or in the heart of a factory district. You have experience directing the activities of those under you, even when they would rather be in charge, and you have an eye for the essential parts of a task.

entries.name: Feature: Easy Employment
entries: Your years of experience make you a highly desirable asset in any labor market, and you can easily find work during any downtime. If you spend your time between adventures practicing a profession, you can maintain a comfortable lifestyle. In addition, you save an amount of gold per day equal to half the result of an Athletics or Intimidation check.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Labor bosses are stern folk who take pleasure in seeing a job through to completion. They are the first to step up to a challenge and pit their strength and wits against whatever problem is at hand.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: If a job's worth doing, it's worth doing right.
I work as hard as I play.
I am far craftier than I let on.
Camaraderie with my fellow workers is important to me.
I have always been a serious person. People often call me gruff.
At the end of the day, people only respect a firm hand.
I can maintain an upbeat attitude through most events.
Routine is important to me. Even if I'm on the road, having a ritual keeps me grounded.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Union. When the voices of the workers unite, we cannot be ignored. (Good)
Opportunity. Labor may be challenging, but it offers work in every city and port. (Neutral)
Independence. Being in charge means that no one can tie me down. (Chaotic)
Respect. I afford others the same respect they give me. (Neutral)
Profession. I'm good at what I do, and it puts food on the table. (Any)
Master. I like being able to order other people around and make them listen to me. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: The first crew I ran became a surrogate family. I still have strong ties to them.
After an unfortunate workplace death, I have been blacklisted in a particular city.
A person I had to fire has it in for me.
I have a reputation for being a bit of a tyrant.
My sibling left to become an adventurer, and now I seek to reconnect us.
I ran such an efficient crew that I was able to create a good relationship with our wealthy benefactor.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am frugal to the point that people often call me a penny-pincher.
I'm quick to anger when confronted.
Some people I have worked with call me a bully.
My disillusionment with my day-to-day life has caused me to become a risk-taker.
I have a fairly severe drinking habit.
I have trouble keeping track of money. If I'm not very careful, I can lose an entire month's wages before I know it.

name: Laboring Ancestry
entries: You descend from some Animal Spirit good at moving things, such as Horse Spirit. Once per day you can push, drag or lift double the usual weight for one round.

name: Land's Children
entries: Your ancestors lived secluded lives deep in nature and you have gained an innate connection with it. You gain advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) checks relating to terrain and weather for a specific biome (roll on {@table Biome List|WagaduChronicles|Biomes Table})

items.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Religion}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
entries: {@filter Land-based vehicles|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}{@item herbalism kit|phb}

items.name: Languages
entries: One of the following: Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal

items.name: Equipment
entries: A {@item holy symbol|phb}, {@item diplomat's pack|phb}, 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: The Inquisitor's Stare
entries: You've seen more fear and pain each day that most people see in a lifetime. With a mere glance, you can tell if someone is hiding something, if they are in pain, and if they are about to succumb to injuries. Once per day, you can automatically succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check or know if a living creature is at less than 10% of its maximum hit points.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You find yourself in constant conflict between your old mind set and your new life. The motivations and beliefs that led to your inquisitional pursuits were strong, and the feelings and experiences that turned you from that path were equally strong.

rows: Whatever I believe is true at the moment is the only truth.
The various realities you have seen make it hard for you to know what is true and what is not.
I feel great shame over my actions as an inquisitor.
I believe that my enemies are waiting around every corner.
When I get tense, I like to dance and pray to relieve the tension.
No matter what you've seen or done, I can top that.
Nature, and the creatures in it, must be protected at all cost.
The blessing of the fey that I received is a power, and like any power it is meant to be exploited.
Everything in the world is in balance, and anything that breaks that balance must be destroyed.
Individuality is the most important part of life. Those who aren't free aren't really alive.
We don't know what others have been through. Judge not.
The only beauty is perfection.
I care for a small forest creature that is always nearby. It is my best friend.
I have a small, tightly knit group of friends that mean the world to me.
An older relative has always been my guiding light in this dark world.
The love of my life passed on, but I keep a token from them close to me at all times.
My commitment to an ideal is the only bond I need. As long as I'm true to that, I'm true to myself.
One of my adventuring campaigns is my closest ally. After all, they are the people I must trust to survive.
I'm special, and everyone should know it.
I often forget what I'm doing and start daydreaming about a far-off paradise.
I know the correct answer to all of life's problems, and I'm happy to share my wisdom with everyone.
I overindulge in some of the less healthy habits.
I hold others to high expectations that I could never reach myself.
I have trouble deciding on the best course of action, especially in tense situations.

entries: The powerful and fickle fey-folk of your area have taken note of you, and your existence pleases them. Whether you were born under a lucky star, had a favorable run-in with a nature spirit, or simply were in the right place at the right time, the nature spirits favor you with small gifts and boons. You find small trinkets in your shoes when you wake up in the morning. Beasts of the forest and field are more receptive to your presence and your training. Will this blessing somehow turn into a curse later in your life? That remains to be seen!

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Club|XPHB}, {@item Navigator's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: You spent years traveling the countryside as a member of the Arcanist Inquisition, seeking out heretics and blasphemers, daemons and arcanists. Your work uncovered hidden evil that likely saved the lives of countless innocents. However, on more than one occasion, your or others' zeal brought low innocents.

After a crisis of conscience, you left the ranks of the inquisitors. Leaving the Inquisition is itself a dangerous prospect, but you could no longer abide. Maybe someone you love and care for was accused falsely or maybe arcane affinities would have led to their destruction. Maybe you are that accused person. Maybe the last investigation you carried out opened your eyes to new realities. Now you are living with a target on your back. Your former peers don't take kindly to people leaving their ranks. Those you persecuted have not forgotten your deeds. But life must still be lived, and there's more than one way to find and destroy the evil in the world.

name: Law Dogs
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} You and your fellow characters are professional law enforcers and bounty hunters who make your living tracking the most dangerous criminals, dismantling criminal enterprises, and putting a stop to nefarious activities.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Any character can belong, but the company must include at least one character proficient in Investigation or Insight.

entries.name: Downtime: Uphold the Law
entries: You can patrol the streets during downtime, reassuring locals and deterring lawbreakers. For a number of days equal to the days spent, you gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks to gain information from local citizens.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Prestige increases through acts such as: foiling a criminal plot; placing a known criminal into custody; recovering stolen goods; preventing an innocent person from being wrongfully punished; resolving a case with irrefutable evidence; or protecting the innocent and upholding the law.

entries.name: Tier 1 – Rookies
entries: {@b Badges.} You have a badge or writ of authority giving you the legal right to enforce laws, take captives, and interrogate suspects.
{@b Precinct House.} You have access to a minor precinct house with a small barracks, a holding cell, and a secure storage room. You are not expected to pay to maintain it but do not own it outright.

entries.name: Tier 2 – Law Enforcers
entries: {@b Armory.} You have access to an armory affiliated with a major law-enforcing body. It contains adventuring gear and weapons worth 25 gp or less. You can requisition items but are responsible for their care and must return them after completing a case.
{@b Fearful Reputation.} You gain a +2 bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks involving lawbreakers and their associates.

entries.name: Tier 3 – Peacekeepers
entries: {@b Broad Authority.} You have complete access to the facilities of any city watch or garrison while pursuing a criminal target.

{@b Request Backup.} While pursuing a criminal, you can request {@dice 1d6} city watch plus one watch commander, or one laborjack. These forces remain under your command for 24 hours or until a task is completed. You cannot request backup again for 24 hours after using this benefit.

entries.name: Tier 4 – Justiciars
entries: {@b Legal Immunity.} Your company can operate with near impunity. Barring extraordinary circumstances, you are immune to reprisal for actions that occur during your pursuit of a criminal. Abuse of this privilege could lead to its revocation.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Book|XPHB} (legal reference), {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, 10 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: You've dedicated years to studying legal definitions and memorizing case law. Perhaps you dealt with high-class criminal trials, or maybe you filed monotonous paperwork and handled divorce proceedings. It's possible you still have a license to practice law on several planets and clientele who rely upon your expertise, or you might have left it all behind in spectacular fashion. Wherever you travel, your legal acumen will likely serve you well.

name: Leaping Spirit
entries: You descend from a far-jumping Spirit such as Frog Spirit. Once per day you can jump triple the usual distance or height.

_.special: a wood figure made in the likeness of an ancestor

_.displayName: a gaming set in which you are proficient

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill History}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
entries: {@filter Vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Languages
entries: One of your choice

items.name: Equipment
entries: A set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a wood figure made in the likeness of an ancestor, a {@item signet ring|PHB}, a {@item gaming set|phb} in which you are proficient, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15gp

entries.name: Feature: Good Reputation
entries: Since your family name is known, you can reap many benefits by flying the flag of your heritage. People in positions of power and privilege are willing to take a meeting with you and grant you favors. The DM decides the extent and effect of these favors, but they shouldn't involve lavish gifts or great personal risk to the granter.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You've lived a different life than those less famous than you, and probably don't know yourself as well as you should. Since birth you've been told you are special and destined for greatness, which is an idea you may be eager to prove or disprove. You're used to being under pressure and to folks talking about you both to your face and behind your back. As you start your adventuring career you have a choice to make. Most people of a heroic lineage who adventure either embrace the family name or try to get out there and make their own way. The result, however, is the same–a determined hero trying to show the world they're something more just a lucky kid with the right parents.

rows: I am polite and humble to all who fawn over me.
I'm sure you've heard of the great heroes of my family, but let me tell you anyway.
I am quiet in public and don't enjoy being noticed.
I boast about how I will put my ancestors' deeds to shame.
I am attracted to people who don't fawn over me right away.
I often find reasons to excuse myself from large groups of people who love me for my name.
I am able to fake smile for anyone, even if I hate that person.
I always ask for people to give me free stuff because I can.
{@b Family}. I intend to uphold my family name. (Lawful)
{@b Superiority}. I was born better than everyone and so I deserve better than everyone. (Evil)
{@b Individuality}. I am {@i not} my family's name and will make my own legend. (Chaotic)
{@b Leadership}. I feel a call beyond my heritage to protect the people who look to me. (Good)
{@b Aspiration}. I want to make the people who believe in me proud. (Neutral)
{@b Generosity}. I was lucky to be born into this family and I will give back to those less fortunate. (Good)
I wield the same weapon my ancestor used.
No one knows the real me like my childhood best friend.
A parent won't respect me until I make good on the family name.
I would do anything to protect the town where I grew up.
I have my eye on a quiet cottage to which I plan to retire.
I feel like the only person who really gets me is my dog.
I can only handle so much fawning before I explode in anger.
If not praised constantly, I doubt myself.
If you speak ill of my ancestors, I will punch you in the face.
I prefer to have someone else fix my personal problems.
I put down others to boost my own confidence.
If something is fashionable, I avoid it at all costs.

entries: You have heroes in your family background and the story of your ancestors is known far and wide. Perhaps your parents were a famous adventuring duo, or a grandparent hunted and killed great evils. Maybe your heroic bloodline has many heroes within it going back as far as any can remember. Whatever the case, the deeds of those who came before you are great and the public's expectation of your accomplishments is even greater. The weight of your family name affects all you do.

_.special: a shard of crystal from your own body

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item jewler's tools|phb}, a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb;scag|type=instrument|category=}, a shard of crystal from your own body, a set of {@item common clothes|phb} and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10gp.

entries.name: Crystal Color and Type
entries: Your crystal formations on your body often fade from flesh to crystal, and in some instances, you can see veins and other bodily functions going on underneath and through these crystals. And the type of ley-line rift you encountered often determines the color of the crystals growing on your person. You will often feel a type of attraction to the types as well, often keeping them on your person if you encounter them.

rows: Red - Fire
Purple - Necrotic
Yellow - Acid
Clear - Force
Cyan - Cold
Opaque - Radiant
Blue - Lightning
Pink - Psychic
Black - Thunder
Green - Poison

entries.name: Feature: Magically Touched
entries: Through your encounter with the ley-lines, you have become a living example of what can happen when people stray too close or even fall into these rifts.

Your self has become a symbol of scientific study, and often find scholars you meet attempting to break parts of yourself off. You may enjoy the attention or not, but you cannot help but attract those intelligently inclined to study you in some way or another. Regardless of this, it is a curse and a blessing.

Smoothskin folk see you as some sort of blight from The Catacylsm, and often will shut you out or refuse service to you entirely. Often, you will find Beastfolk in turn may worship you as a deliverance from their primitive forms. Regardless of how you feel about these two forms, it is a curse and a blessing.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: These crystals have become a fascination of mine. I must study them.
I am rude to those whom ask rude questions about me.
I sometimes pawn off parts of myself as gemstones.
I want to know how my affliction came to be.
Wizards and legends of old are a fascination to me. I will collect all their stories.
History and legends are two different things. I will study the difference.
I will search for some sort of enlightenment with or without my affliction.
I seek to fully understand the world and all of its machinations.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Order. I am an example of what can happen when nature is destroyed. The balance is fragile. (Lawful)
Live and Let Live. I am what I am, there is no changing that. I accept myself. (Neutral)
Changed. This event has changed me, and I see the world in tints and hues of change. (Chaotic)
Chaos. Chaos will overcome all, and I will be the one to spread it using this unique gift. (Evil)
Gift. This is a gift bestowed upon me. I will use it to do good in the world. (Good)
Knowledge. The study of the ley-lines is in disrepair, and I will fully understand all of its effects. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I was with one other when we fell into the rift. We split soon after.
My loved one left me, seeing me as an abomination when the crystals started growing.
I became a sort of study for wizards when the crystals grew. I am still accepted there.
When I fell, I lost my the memories of parts of my life.
When I fell, I was nurtured back to perfect health by a village healer. I never got their name or thanked them.
There is a cult in my name attempting to capture me.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: My emotions have been heightened.
I have become gullible to those whom play my emotions.
I often prefer to keep bright, shiny objects on my person.
I have found that I do not feel physical pain.
My sense of self-preservation has been obliterated.
Death and life no longer means anything to me.

name: Lionblood Storyteller
entries: Your ancestors were famous Izingonyama storytellers. Once per day you gain advantage on a Charisma (storytelling) check.

_.special: A copy of Azusa's diary (a sacred prayer book)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A copy of Azusa's diary (a sacred prayer book), {@item tattooist's tools|PS-Kg}, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Living History
entries: You have tattoos of Kamigawa's history on your skin. When you enter a location of historical significance, your tattoos come to life to tell the story of the location's original purpose and important events. In addition, they can help you identify art objects and other items of cultural importance.

You were trained in the ways of the Living Historians, preservers of history in ink. As a member of their order, you were given the tattoos that mark Kamigawa's history. Perhaps you remain with them still, or perhaps you forge your own path to not only record history, but make it.

_.displayName: dark common clothes including a hood

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: The Jesters emblem, a crimson colored mask, a {@item Disguise Kit|phb}, a set of dark {@item common clothes|phb} including a hood, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Feature: A Favor in Turn
entries: You have gained enough clout within the Jesters that you can call in a favor from your contacts, should you be close enough to a center of Jester activity. A request for a favor can be no longer than 20 words, and is passed up the chain to an undisclosed higher-up for approval. This favor can take a shape up to the DM's discretion depending on the request, with varying speeds of fulfillment: If muscle is requested, an NPC Jester minion can temporarily aid the party. If money is needed, a small loan can be provided. If you've been imprisoned, they can look into breaking you free, or paying off the jailer.

The turn comes when a favor is asked to be repaid. The favor debt can be called in without warning, and many times with intended immediacy. Perhaps the player is called to commit a specific burglary without the option to decline. Maybe they must press a dignitary for a specific secret at an upcoming ball. The Jesters could even request a hit on an NPC, no questions asked or answered. The DM is to provide a debt call proportionate to the favor fulfilled. If a favor is not repaid within a reasonable period of time, membership to the Jesters can be revoked, and if the debt is large enough, the player may become the next hit contract to make the rounds.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background Criminal} background in the PHB as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a member of the Jesters. Your bond is likely associated with your fellow Jester members or the individual who introduced you to the organization. Your ideal probably involves establishing your importance and indispensability within the Jesters. You joined to improve your livelihood and sense of purpose.

You have been working your way up the chain of command within the Jesters. You might have deceived many or killed some important targets for the guild and have earned yourself a promotion to Living Shadow, gaining your first colored mask within the guild.

name: Lodge Berserker

_.special: A symbol of your berserker lodge

entries: You joined one of Rashemen's many berserker lodges and are indoctrinated as one of its valued members. Members consider one another part of an extended family, happily helping their fellows whenever possible. While traditionally, foreigners refer to all Rashemaar warriors as "berserkers," only members of berserker lodges are considered so within Rashemen. Each lodge has its own personality, expressed by their fighting styles and appearance. Lodge are protected by their own telthor, usually of a creature related to the lodge's name. The members of each lodge are grouped into "Fangs," elite fighting forces ready to answer the Iron Lord's call to defend the nation. Initiation rites vary by lodge but invariably require a demonstration of fighting prowess and completion of various tests such as all-night drinking contests or single handed battle against every member of the lodge. Have you joined one of the large, well-known lodges or are you a member of a small lodge few have heard of? Whatever the case, most Rashemaar look to you with respect and admiration.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose two from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Survival}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A symbol of your berserker lodge (examples include a stag horn for the Great Stag Lodge, a web embroidered cloth for the Ettercap Lodge, or a claw necklace for the Snow Tiger Lodge), a gaming set you are proficient in, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Lodge
entries: While there are many berserker lodges throughout Rashemen, some only numbering a handful of warriors, these are some of the largest and most well known. You can roll on the table below, choose a lodge from the list, or create your own.

rows: Ettercap. This lodge is popular around the Running Rocks and the High Country where climbing skills are useful. As part of their initiations, they are known to subject members to poisons of various creatures. Members often wear cloth embroidered with spider or web motifs.

Goblin. Popular among the more populated regions of Rashemen, this lodge is known for their guerrilla fighting tactics. When going into battle, Goblin Lodge berserkers frequently wear cowls made of leather or fur.

Great Stag. One of the largest lodges, Great Stag members are often the first to charge into battle, forcing their way past their allies to strike at the largest foes. Lodge members commonly carry items carved from deer antlers.

Ice Troll. This lodge is considered one of the toughest, and its members take great pride in their ability to withstand enemy attacks. They toughen their skins using strange elixers crafted by the Old Ones. When entering battle, Ice Troll Lodge members often paint their faces in shades of blue.

Owlbear. This lodge is famous for their love of firewine, feasting, and brawling. Their halls include sturdy-built furniture that can withstand their frequently violent celebrations. Often, its members wear spike studded armor to augment their grappling assaults. Their greatest warriors array themselves in cloaks festooned with owlbear feathers.

Snow Tiger. This small but fearsome lodge is known for their powerful charging attack. Many use claw bracers to great effect while fighting. Their members commonly wear necklaces, bracelets, and charms crafted from the teeth and claws of predators.

White Dragon. One the oldest and largest lodges are famous for their ability to survive the harsh winters of Rashemen. Weapons and armor made from dragon scales, teeth, and claws are carried with reverence by the most veteran members.
Wolf. The members of this popular lodge are skilled at throwing their enemies to the ground. This lodge commonly wears cloaks made of wolf fur.

entries.name: Feature: Recognized Member
entries: As a member of a berserker lodge, most common folks of Rashemen look upon you with reverence. Your presence assures a limited acceptance by the Rashemaar of any foreign companions you travel with. If you come to a community with a hall for your berserker lodge, you and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free food and lodging of a modest standard within the hall

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Members of berserker lodges revel in its warrior culture. Competition with members and other berserker lodges is seen as a way to define status and honor. Though the Rashemi would never support a gladiatorial arena, it is not uncommon for settlements to host regular athletic competitions and brawling matches where participants pummel each other for increased respect and recognition.

rows: I loudly express my opinions for all to hear.
Talking is a waste of time. It is only actions that get things done.
If I am idle for too long, I must find a way to release my aggression.
I can control my anger even under the most difficult circumstances.
I am utterly confident in everything I say and do.
I am fascinated by the customs of people from other lands and pester them to tell me about where they come from.
Feasting. Drinking. Fighting. There are no better things in life.
I love my weapons. There, I said it.
Honor. Without honor we are nothing (Lawful).
Power. The strongest make the rules. It is known. (Evil)
Freedom. We must be free to pursue our own paths. (Chaotic)
Greater Good. Our lodge becomes greater when we help those in need. (Good)
People. Ideals are meaningless words. The people I care about are all that matter. (Neutral)
Glory. Through battle I will earn glory for my lodge and myself. (Any)
My lodge is my family. Nothing is more important than the people of my lodge.
I will be the greatest berserker in all of Rashemen.
The Red Wizards killed someone I hold dear. I will make them pay.
The spirits of the land will be here when we are gone. We must pay them respect
The Witches of Rashemen saved my family. I owe them my life.
A mysterious voice on the wind calls me to a greater purpose. I will make a difference in the lives of all I meet.
I love to drink, feast, and fight, but I don't know when to stop.
If you are not from Rashemen, you cannot be trusted.
I am willing to take risks, even if it puts others in danger.
I cannot forgive any slight and look to punish those who have done so.
The weak are not worth of my time or effort.
I don't need to make a plan, only the weak do.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or {@filter vehicles (water)|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (water)}.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@filter trinket|items|search=trinket} of your past (a necklace, ring, sword, severed finger or hair, etc.), a set of worn {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} you are proficient in, a scroll detailing your life up to this point, a {@item backpack}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} with 15 gp in it.

entries.name: Feature: Survival Instincts
entries: Having survived for some years, you are able to make simple survival necessities. You can make fires, craft shelters, cook food, etc. without having to make a {@skill Survival} check. Also, you may know several townspeople, hunters, and shop owners from your travels alone. Landmarks and places of interest may also be familiar to you.

rows: When the going gets tough, you get going.
You never back down from a challenge, no matter the danger.
No matter the danger, you just refuse to let anything kill you.
The events you survive traumatize you, and the phantoms of your past haunt your dreams.
You seem unfeeling and apathetic to others, but you just refuse to allow anyone to get close to you so you can't lose anyone close to you again.
You love the rush of near-death experiences, and thus you are constantly seeking a bigger challenge to survive.
You wish that you could live a normal life, but know fate has chosen something else for you.
You like to crack jokes and make puns when you feel that you have got the advantage, or that you need to secure it.
{@b Change.} Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)
{@b Greater Good.} It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for themselves. (Any neutral)
{@b Might.} The strongest are meant to rule. (Evil)
{@b Self-Reliance.} I live on because of my own grit and determination(Any)
{@b Destiny.} My life as been blessed by fate and I live to help those who can't help themselves. (Good)
{@b Ancestry.} I live by a strict set of moral codes written by my ancestors, and I live by them to do them proud. (Lawful)
My trinket is a symbol of my past life, and I carry it so that I will never forget my roots.
Someone out there might have also survived, and I need to find them.
My actions go to assist the people.
I want a bard or playwright to chronicle my adventures.
I am loyal to my friends as long as they promise not to die and keep that promise.
I have bonds to no one.
I feel as though I can't trust anyone lest they die.
I feel almost no emotion.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
I don't save people who can't save themselves.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
My obsession with the past has left me blind to the present.

entries: You were a sole survivor of a major life-threatening event. Maybe your village or city was attacked by some great evil, or maybe you were tricked by some greater power. No matter the details, everyone other than you died, and you survived. Where were you when it happened? What age? Were you a small child, or a young adult? What attacked you? Was it one thing, or a group? What effect did this have on you? Were you traumatized, or were you strengthened by it? Did you run away, or did you fight it? Are there any remnants you kept or anything left, or was it all destroyed? Whatever the case may be, you walk on, carrying the weight of those who died. You might even be able to "hear" the voices of the people who died. They might be angry with you, or they might be forgiving. Maybe you lost a loved one or a childhood sweetheart, and maybe they also survived, or maybe they died. If they died, have they forgiven you? If they lived, do you seek to find them and them you? Regardless, you carry on without anyone but your memories of the ones you'd lost. You are a survivor; the lone survivor.

items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or {@filter vehicles (water)|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (water)}.

items.name: Equipment
