_.displayName: dark common clothes including a hood

_.special: set of tools to match your choice of tool proficiency

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Deception}, plus your choice of one from among {@skill Stealth} and {@skill Sleight of Hand}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Your choice of one from {@item Thieves' Tools|phb}, {@item Forgery Kit|phb}, or {@item Disguise Kit|phb}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of dark {@item common clothes|phb} including a hood, a set of tools to match your choice of tool proficiency, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: A Favor In Turn
entries: You have gained enough clout within the Myriad that you can call in a favor from your contacts, should you be close enough to a center of Myriad activity. A request for a favor can be no longer than 20 words, and is passed up the chain to an undisclosed Spireling for approval. This favor can take a shape up to the DM's discretion depending on the request, with varying speeds of fulfillment: If muscle is requested, an NPC Myriad minion can temporarily aid the party. If money is needed, a small loan can be provided. If you've been imprisoned, they can look into breaking you free, or paying off the jailer.

The turn comes when a favor is asked to be repaid. The favor debt can be called in without warning, and many times with intended immediacy. Perhaps the player is called to commit a specific burglary without the option to decline. Maybe they must press a dignitary for a specific secret at an upcoming ball. The Myriad could even request a hit on an NPC, no questions asked or answered. The DM is to provide a debt call proportionate to the favor fulfilled. If a favor is not repaid within a reasonable period of time, membership to the Myriad can be revoked, and if the debt is large enough, the player may become the next hit contract to make the rounds.

While the skill sets are similar in many ways, working with the Myriad brings some different benefits and challenges. The Myriad specializes in slavery and exotic trade, so you have access to servants and rare materials at times without using your A Favor In Turn ability. However, your access to contacts is far more limited, and should you be found out as Myriad by a member of the Clasp, you will quickly find yourself hunted. Note: This feature is a variant of the {@background Clasp Member|TalDorei} feature.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background Criminal} background in the PHB as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a member of the Myriad. Your bond is likely associated with your fellow Myriad members or the individual who introduced you to the organization. Your ideal probably involves establishing your importance and indispensability within the Myriad. You joined to improve your livelihood and sense of purpose.

_.special: A mysterious trinket from your past life

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or one type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=musical instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A mysterious trinket from your past life, a set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=musical instrument} (one of your choice), a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: Unexpected Acquaintance
entries: Even though you can't recall them, someone from your past will recognize you and offer to aid you — or to impede you. The person and their relationship to you depend on the truth of your backstory. They might be a childhood friend, a former rival, or even your child who's grown up with dreams of finding their missing parent. They may want you to return to your former life even if it means abandoning your current goals and companions. Work with your GM to determine the details of this character and your history with them.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You may be bothered by your lack of memories and driven to recover them or reclaim the secrets of your past, or you can use your anonymity to your advantage.

rows: I'm always humming a song, but I can't remember the words.
I love learning new things and meeting new people.
I want to prove my worth and have people know my name.
I don't like places that are crowded or noisy.
I'm mistrustful of mages and magic in general.
I like to keep everything tidy and organized so that I can find things easily.
Every night I record my day in a detailed journal.
I live in the present. The future will come as it may.
{@bold Redemption.} Whatever I did in the past, I'm determined to make the world a better place. (Good)
{@bold Independence.} I'm beholden to no one, so I can do whatever I want. (Chaotic)
{@bold Cunning.} Since I have no past, no one can use it to thwart my rise to power. (Evil)
{@bold Community.} I believe in a just society that takes care of people in need. (Lawful)
{@bold Fairness.} I judge others by who they are now, not by what they've done in the past. (Neutral)
{@bold Friendship.} The people in my life now are more important than any ideal. (Any)
I have dreams where I see a loved one's face, but I can't remember their name or who they are.
I wear a wedding ring, so I must have been married before I lost my memories.
My mentor raised me; they told me that I lost my memories in a terrible accident that killed my family.
I have an enemy who wants to kill me, but I don't know what I did to earn their hatred.
I know there's an important memory attached to the scar I bear on my body.
I can never repay the debt I owe to the person who cared for me after I lost my memories.
I am jealous of those who have memories of a happy childhood.
I'm desperate for knowledge about my past, and I'll do anything to obtain that information.
I'm terrified of meeting someone from my past, so I avoid strangers as much as possible.
Only the present matters. I can't bring myself to care about the future.
I'm convinced that I was powerful and rich before I lost my memories—and I expect everyone to treat me accordingly.
Anyone who shows me pity is subjected to my biting scorn.

entries: Your origins are a mystery even to you. You might recall fragments of your previous life, or you might dream of events that could be memories, but you can't be sure of what is remembered and what is imagined. You recall practical information and facts about the world and perhaps even your name, but your upbringing and life before you lost your memories now exist only in dreams or sudden flashes of familiarity.

You can leave the details of your character's past up to your GM or give the GM a specific backstory that your character can't remember. Were you the victim of a spell gone awry, or did you voluntarily sacrifice your memories in exchange for power? Is your amnesia the result of a natural accident, or did you purposefully have your mind wiped in order to forget a memory you couldn't live with? Perhaps you have family or friends that are searching for you or enemies you can't even remember.

items.name: Ability Scores:
items.entry: Increase an ability score by 2 and another one of your choice by 1, or increase three different ability scores by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: You gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} (any), {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Pouch|XPHB|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: You've never studied arcane science, but you have an intuitive talent for artifice. Perhaps you grew up on battlefields, scavenging parts from {@creature Warforged Titan|ERLW|Warforged Titans} or shattered floating fortresses. Your work isn't pretty—and often seems like it shouldn't work—yet you can do things no {@creature Magewright|ERLW} can match.

name: Nature's Thug
entries: You descend from aggressive Spirits such as Sharks or Hippo Spirits and you gain advantage once a day on a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check if done in a specific biome (roll on {@table Biome List|WagaduChronicles|Biomes Table})

A.special: unused punch card from a job you quit

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Gaming Set|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) two {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} of your choice, {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Bucket|XPHB}, {@item Jug|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, {@item Backpack|XPHB}, an unused punch card from a job you quit, an unopened self-help pamphlet, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As a NEAT (Not in Employment, Adventuring, or Training), you might be either loafing, burned out, or just between things. You never got your invitation to mage school, your warrior dreams died in basic training, and your adventuring resume is a blank sheet. You have no training, no references, and no marketable skills. This world is a confusing place, and you're muddling through it one awkward mistake at a time.

rows: I dropped out of my apprenticeship to pursue a gaming career, which went nowhere.
I kept leaving jobs until the townsfolk stopped hiring me.
I kind of just don't give a shit.
My parents kind of just forgot to encourage me to better myself.
My application to mage school was rejected, big time.
My dreams of being a powerful fighter died when I blew out my knee.
I confidently walk into every situation, even when I have no idea what's happening.
I will talk for hours about lore, especially to people who are uninterested.
I have many contradicting opinions from the scrolls I read in my spare time.
I constantly lie about my education and work history.
I have a refined sense of taste, but only when it comes to chicken tenders.
I approach every task with reckless optimism and zero follow-through.
I always assume someone else is in charge, and I always need to be told what to do.
I think I'm being gangstalked. I might be. I'm not sure.
Freedom. I don't want to be tied down by expectations or employment. (Chaotic)
Comfort. I avoid danger, discomfort, and expectations wherever possible. (Neutral)
Ignorance. If I don't know I'm in danger, it can't hurt me. (Neutral)
Improvisation. Planning is just failure in slow motion. (Chaotic)
Nonchalance. If I don't care, I can't be disappointed. (Neutral)
Delusion. I am destined for greatness, probably. (Any)
Don't tell them this, but I owe everything to my parents for letting me crash in their cellar.
I carry a badge from a job I got fired from. I pretend it's a medal.
I once promised a tavern owner I'd return with rent. I haven't. I must never go back.
One of my cousins is mildly famous, and I constantly reference them as if that gives me credibility.
I still send messages to my old party even though they left me behind three quests ago.
Someone gave me a map. I assume it leads to treasure, but I just haven't had the time to check.
I am constantly falling for pyramid schemes and cults.
I've become too comfortable lying to friends and family about my employment status.
I sabotage myself the moment something starts going well.
I run from problems instead of solving them. Sometimes literally.
I insist I can do things I clearly can't, like swordplay or basic arithmetic.
I have absolutely no sense of time or direction.

name: Nentyarch Follower
entries: The Circle of Leth and their force of Nentyar Hunters have protected the Dalesfolk and the forests of the land for hundreds of years. This group is overseen by the Nentyarch, an archdruid of remarkable power who oversees these groups from an old wood elf stronghold at Yeshelmaar in the Forest of Lethyr. As a Nentyarch Follower you respect the Circle of Leth. You believe in the sanctity of the great forests surrounding the Dale and you hope to purge the land of the fiendish hosts that still infect it. Honest people of the Dale should be protected, but the spread of civilization shouldn't call for the felling of further forest. Nature itself needs protection from the depredations of those who do not place enough value on its continued existence.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One artisan tool of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A hunting knife, a healer's kit, a set of traveler's clothes, a sprig of mistletoe, and a pouch containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Dalefolk Hospitality
entries: The Nentyarch and the Circle of Leth have long looked after the people of the Great Dale. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate within any of the many small villages or farmsteads that exists in the Great Dale and the Forest of Lethyr, provided you have not shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from anyone who might oppose the Nentyarch or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As a Nentyarch Follower, you believe in protecting the people of the Great Dale and the sanctity of nature.

rows: If the Dalesfolk are threatened, I will do whatever I can to help them.
The comforts of civilization are nice, but the majesty of nature is a wonder to behold.
I always explain my ideas by relating them to something in nature.
Being polite is a waste of time.
I believe in the interconnectedness of all life.
I have trouble paying attention when there are lots of people around.
I am incredibly patient.
I believe actions speak louder than words.
Balance. Balance is important in all things. Excess in any direction leads to weakness. (Neutral)
Power. In the wild, the weak are culled and the strong survive. (Evil)
Independence. The peoples of the Great Dale should be free to live the life they choose. (Chaotic)
Nature. The lands will outlast us all. They are more important than our fleeting creations. (Neutral)
Integrity. My word is my bond. (Lawful)
Charity. It is right to help those who are in distress. The greater the need, the greater the call to help. (Good)
The Circle of Leth saved my village. I am forever indebted to them.
My village was destroyed by demons. They will be avenged.
I've lived in this place all my life. I will do everything I can to protect it.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
Although I am new to this land, I feel I need to do my part to make it a safer place.
I've seen forests cleared to fill a noble's pocket with coin. I intend to make sure that never happens again.
I'm a fraud. There's no way I can live up to people's expectations.
I'd prefer to stay alone in the woods then to deal with people.
I don't understand the value of money.
I believe that the ends justify the means.
I cannot resist the temptations of civilization and overindulge in its pleasures.
I don't trust anyone, not even my closest friends

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Stealth|PHB}, and one other of your choice from the following list: {@skill Arcana|PHB}, {@skill History|PHB}, {@skill Religion|PHB}, {@skill Nature|PHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Leatherworker's Tools|PHB}, {@item Book|PHB} (one creature type), {@item Hooded Lantern|PHB}, {@item Hunting Trap|PHB}, {@item Oil (flask)|PHB} (3 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Ability Scores:
items.entry: Increase one of your starting ability scores by 2 and another by 1, or increase three scores by 1 each.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, and one other of your choice from the following list: {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Religion|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Leatherworker's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Book|XPHB} (one creature type), {@item Hooded Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Hunting Trap|XPHB}, {@item Oil|XPHB} (3 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: No Longer Free from Care and Fear

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Investigation}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: A {@item gaming set|PHB} or a {@item musical instrument|SCAG} of your choice

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Inquisitive, Rustic

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You were raised in a castle, surrounded by wealth, power, and privilege. Your family of minor aristocrats ensured that you received a first-class education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented. Your time in the castle, especially the many hours you spent observing your family at court, also taught you a great deal about leadership.

Nobles are born and raised to a very different lifestyle than most people ever experience, and their personalities reflect that upbringing. A noble title comes with a plethora of bonds—responsibilities to family, to other nobles (including the sovereign), to the people entrusted to the family's care, or even to the title itself. But this responsibility is often a good way to undermine a noble.

rows: I come from an old and storied family, and it fell to me to preserve the family name.
My family has been disgraced, and I intend to clear our name.
My family recently came by its title, and that elevation thrust us into a new and strange world.
My family has a title, but none of my ancestors have distinguished themselves since we gained it.
My family is filled with remarkable people. I hope to live up to their example.
I hope to increase my family's power and influence.
My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.
No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.
I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.
Respect. Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Responsibility. It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)
Independence. I must prove that I can handle myself without coddling from my family. (Chaotic)
Power. If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Evil)
Family. Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)
Noble Obligation. It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Good)
I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.
Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.
I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.
My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.
I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.
In fact, the world does revolve around me.
By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

_.special: book containing notes on magic as taught to you by your royal teacher

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A scroll of pedigree, a signet ring, a set of fine clothes, a book containing notes on magic as taught to you by your royal teacher.

entries.name: Royal Mage:
entries: You were trained by a royal mage in the arts of magic, though how successfully is up to you. Royal mages are close to knights in their rank among most nobility, that being on the lower rungs of the ladder. As a royal mage, you know at least one spell, regardless of class restrictions, that being detailed in the Noble Magic feature, which you may take in place of the Position of Privilege feature.

entries.name: Feature: Noble Magic
entries: As you were taught by a royal magic tutor, magic orders tend to assume you are experienced in magic, though it may or may not be true. Nobles and non-nobles alike will assume you are a wise authority when you speak on the topic of spells, magic items, creatures, or history. You also know the cantrip Noble Sign, which allows you to produce a symbol of your nobility anywhere within 5 feet of you or on an item, the effect produces dim light with a 5 foot radius for as long as it lasts, the effect lasts for 1 minute.

_.special: small banner with your symbol of nobility
item you always carry on you with a symbol of your nobility or family

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A small banner with your symbol of nobility, a scroll of pedigree, an item you always carry on you with a symbol of your nobility or family, a set of fine travel clothes, a set of meditation clothes, and a purse containing 25 gold.

entries.name: Samuraihood:
entries: Samurai are a different class of nobility from others, with their own hierarchy and structure. Others tend to view them with respect, acting as stalwart judges and defenders of the people, though some can become terrifying in their cold logic and strict lawfulness.

You may consider adding to your equipment a small banner carrying a symbol of your nobility, such as a sheet of paper with a crest drawn in ink or a wooden scroll with a crest burned into the surface. You may also consider noting that one piece of your equipment is embellished with the same symbol, or a more personal one, such as a crest on your chest armor or hilt of your sword.
You may choose to take the Judgement of the Wise feature over the Position of Privilege.

entries.name: Feature: Judgement of the Wise
entries: People respect your and your judgement, making it easier to persuade people to a course of action or even punish someone for a wrong. Even if you do not know what you are talking about, some people are inclined to assume you do, especially when you maintain your calm. You are also trained in meditation and often take time to think on complicated matters in hopes of unraveling them.

name: Nomad
entries: Nomads are people which have no single place to call home. Many travel with an entire community and carry with them rich cultures, but some travel in much smaller groups or alone. Nomads are seldom fully welcomed by larger, more static societies, which view them as outsiders and fear their otherness. But tinkers, itinerant healers, and theatre troupes are seldom turned away.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of travelling clothes including a cloak, a staff, and a belt pouch containing 5 gp

entries.name: Nomadic Type
entries: Unconnected as you are to any greater society, you survive by alternative means. Your lifestyle is characterized by your activities, which determines a second proficiency provided by this background. Below are examples; you may work with your DM to create a different nomadic type as needed.

rows: Pastoralist (Animal Handling)
Hunter-gatherer (Survival)
Performer (Performance)
Healer (Medicine)
Raider (Athletics)
Craftsman (Expert Craftsman*)
Con Artist (Deception)
Merchant (Persuasion)
Prophet (Religion)
Chronicler (History)

entries: {@note *An expert craftsman chooses one type of artisan's tools. You gain proficiency with those tools and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check that uses those tools.}

entries.name: Feature: Worldly
entries: Your unceasing travel of the world has allowed you to glean insights and connections into settlements you travel to. Work with your DM to determine where you have travelled in your past, if only generally. When you visit a settlement you have visited before, you know one local who can point you toward a good place to stay a night.

When you visit a settlement you have not visited before, you may spend 10 minutes observing the new location. If you do, the DM provides you with one significant observation about the location's culture. You may glean one new piece of information each day.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Nomads are continually at the outside of larger society, which separates them from many conventional social norms and customs.

rows: I am slow to trust people that are not members of my social group.
I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. High-minded values and ideas teach you nothing about the world as it is.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I travel incessantly because no place could bear to keep me for very long.
I never feel satisfied in one place for long, and I quickly feel the need to move on.
I don't mind fleecing someone if they don't know the true price of what they seek.
I feel that I must share my gifts with all places in the world, not just one land or kingdom.
I enjoy travelling to new lands and making new friends over a flagon of ale.
{@bold Tradition.} The long standing traditions of my people must be honored and upheld. (Lawful)
{@bold Community.} We have to take care of each other, because no one else is going to do it. (Good)
{@bold Creativity.} The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)
{@bold Loyalty.} I do not give my word of friendship easily, but when I do it is for life. (Any)
{@bold Live and Let Live.} Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)
{@bold Retribution.} Those that have wronged me in the past will suffer in the way that I have suffered. (Evil)
I would do anything for the members of my nomadic community.
I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.
I will bring down terrible wrath on the evildoers who destroyed my family.
I am on the run from a greater power than myself, and if I stop moving then they might find me.
I have been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
No one else should have to endure the hardships I've been through.
I'll never fully trust anyone other than myself.
I turn tail when things look bad.
If there's a plan, I'll forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll ignore it.
I believe that my profession is the most important craft to pursue, above all other ideals.
I disdain the laws of other societies, and I have no compunctions against breaking them at a whim.
I am deeply mistrustful of the members and customs of other societies.

name: Northern Crusade

_: an emblem of the Northern Crusade

entries: The Protectorate of Menoth launched the Northern Crusade at the same time that Hierarch Voyle declared the nation's independence from Cygnar. No matter when you joined the Crusade, you were there when it ended—left without a purpose, your faith nearly shattered.

entries.name: Feature: Faith in What's Real
entries: Your experiences in Llael have left you disillusioned with your former faith. You have learned that blindly following the words of others is sometimes neither the best nor the safest path. You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks the first time you interact with a creature.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Former members of the Northern Crusade are often disillusioned and distrustful of others. Despite these changes, some maintain a semblance of firm conviction in their religion.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I have a scriptural quote for any situation I find myself in.
I am quick to anger.
I have a soft spot for children.
I often take time to enjoy the simple things in life.
I have a somber demeanor.
My moral code is essential to me and often dictates my actions.
Others gain my trust slowly, but once they have it, it is hard to lose.
I carry out my goals with unflinching persistence.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Dedication. Despite the end of the crusade, I am still dedicated to its ideals. (Lawful)
Hopelessness. I have seen the ending of not just my organization, but the world I thought I knew. I seek new meaning but am uncertain I will ever find it. (Chaotic)
Reform. To create something useful and just, we must cast the old order aside. (Chaotic)
Faith. It is in the faith of the Creator, not the worldly church, that we find meaning. (Neutral)
Justice. I seek justice for all who have suffered wrongdoing. (Lawful)
Vengeance. Those who pervert the Creator's will deserve only punishment. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: My time in Llael has created deeper connections there than in my homeland.
Powerful members of the church sponsored my training and were extremely angry with me when I joined the crusade rather than their force.
During my time in the crusade, I learned a terrifying truth about one of my superiors, who now has it in for me.
I became affiliated with a specific resistance group in Llael and still have friendly contacts there.
I have a secret in my past I will do anything to hide.
I was an orphan, and a kindly older couple raised me.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: Anyone who besmirches my honor deserves retribution.
Violence is always the ultimate solution.
I am brutally honest.
After losing many comrades, I have become extremely jaded.
I often find solace at the bottom of a tankard of ale.
After the horrific events of the Claiming and everything that transpired afterward, I have become disillusioned with my religion.

_.special: A book collecting all the songs, poems, or stories you know

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Perception} plus one of your choice from among {@skill History} or {@skill Performance}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A book collecting all the songs, poems, or stories you know, a pair of {@item snowshoes|IDRotF}, one {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=musical instrument} of your choice, a heavy fur-lined cloak, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Skaldic Specialty
entries: Every minstrel excels at certain types of performance. Choose one specialty or roll a d8 and consult the table below to determine your preferred type of performance.

rows: Recitation of epic poetry
Singing
Tale-telling
Flyting (insult flinging)
Yodeling
Axe throwing
Playing an instrument
Fire eating or sword swallowing

entries.name: Feature: Northern Historian
entries: Your education and experience have taught you how to determine the provenance of ruins, monuments, and other structures within the north. When you spend at least 1 hour examining a structure or non-natural feature of the terrain, you can determine if it was built by humans, dwarves, elves, goblins, giants, trolls, or fey. You can also determine the approximate age (within 500 years) of the construction based on its features and embellishments.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Northern minstrels tend to either be boisterous and loud or pensive and watchful with few falling between these extremes. Many exude both qualities at different times, and they have learned how and when to turn their skald persona on and off. Like other northerners, they place a lot of stock in appearing brave and tough, which can lead them unwittingly into conflict.

rows: I will accept any dare and expect accolades when I complete it.
Revelry and boisterousness are for foolish children. I prefer to quietly wait and watch.
I am more than a match for any northern reaver. If they believe that is not so, let them show me what stuff they are made of.
I yearn for the raiding season and the tales of blood and butchery I can use to draw the crowds.
Ragnarok is nigh. I will bear witness to the end of all things and leave a record should there be any who survive it.
There is nothing better than mutton, honeyed mead, and a crowd in thrall to my words.
The gods weave our fates. There is nothing to do but accept this and live as we will.
All life is artifice. I lie better than most and I am not ashamed to reap the rewards.
{@bold Valor.} Stories and songs should inspire others — and me — to perform great deeds that benefit us all. (Good)
{@bold Greed.} There is little point in taking action if it leads to living in squalor. I will take what I want and dare any who disagree to oppose me. (Evil)
{@bold Perfection.} I will not let the threat of failure deter me. Every deed I attempt, even those I do not succeed at, serve to improve me and prepare me for future endeavors. (Lawful)
{@bold Anarchy.} If Ragnarok is coming to end all that is, I must do what I want and damn the consequences. (Chaotic)
{@bold Knowledge.} The north is full of ancient ruins and monuments. If I can glean their meaning, I may understand fate as well as the gods. (Any)
{@bold Pleasure.} I will eat the richest food, sleep in the softest bed, enjoy the finest company, and allow no one to stand in the way of my delight and contentment. (Any)
I have the support of my peers from the skaldic school I attended, and they have mine.
I will find and answer the Unanswerable Riddle and gain infamy.
I will craft an epic of such renown it will be recited the world over.
All my companions were slain in an ambush laid by cowardly trolls. At least I snatched up my tagelharpa before I escaped the carnage.
The cold waves call to me even across great distances. I must never stray too far from the ocean's embrace.
It is inevitable that people fail me. Mead, on the other hand, never fails to slake my thirst.
Only a coward retreats. The valiant press forward to victory or death.
All the tales I tell of my experiences are lies.
Critics and hecklers will suffer my wrath once the performance is over.
Companions and friends cease to be valuable if their accomplishments outshine my own.
I once burned down a tavern where I was poorly received. I would do it again.
I cannot bear to be gainsaid and fall into a bitter melancholy when I am.

entries: While the tribal warriors residing in other parts of the wintry north consider you to be soft and cowardly, you know the truth: life in northern cities and mead halls is not for the faint of heart. Whether you are a larger-than-life performer hailing from one of the skaldic schools, a contemplative scholar attempting to puzzle out the mysteries of the north, or a doughty warrior hoping to stave off the bleakness of the north, you have successfully navigated alleys and stages as treacherous as any ice-slicked ruin. You adventure for the thrill of adding new songs to your repertoire, adding new lore to your catalog, and proving false the claims of those so-called true northerners.

name: Northkin Fire Eaters
entries: Trollkin who make their homes far to the north of Khador ferment potent liquors that warm the body and chase away the chills. These trollkin both drink this alcohol and weaponize it, spitting gouts of the volatile liquids at enemies while igniting it.

entries.name: Feature: Fire Breathing
entries: Each keg of liquor has 3 charges. Drinking from a keg takes an action and expends 1 charge. After drinking, you can spray forth the alcohol and ignite it. As a bonus action, you can exhale fire at a target within 10 feet of you that you can see. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can't exhale fire unless you have a lit torch in hand or another source of open flame. This damage increases by {@dice 1d6} at 5th level, 10th level, and 15th level.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I love good food and show my appreciation with bellowing belches.
I have on my person a salted fungus that tastes of licorice and that others can smell if I am near.
Studying the types of trees around me and learning which birds make homes in those trees is how I stay calm.
I love a good arm-wrestling.
I enjoy drinking from a horn passed down within my family.
I can't help but tell exaggerated tales of my victories when sitting around a campfire.
I am proud of my brews and don't take criticism well.
I sing, even if I am told I am tone deaf.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Profession. I love my job, and I enjoy others enjoying my work. (Any)
Respect. If you honor me and my kin, I will return the favor. (Neutral)
Fun Loving. Drink and song are what fills life with meaning. (Chaotic)
Brute Force. I am bigger and tougher, and that makes what I say law. (Evil)
Experimentation. Sometimes inspiration and taking risks is how you create new things. (Chaotic)
Kinship. Threaten my family, my kriel, and you threaten me. (Good)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I may have moved to another kriel, but I still miss my family in the north.
I got very, very drunk in Corvis, and I am banned from the city limits.
A rival blamed me for an accident and fled after I revealed them as a liar.
A cousin is the warchief of a related kriel and is seeking to destroy his enemies.
My alcohol was presented to a chieftain, who still speaks of it with pride.
I've a reputation as being a pyromaniac.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I have a short temper and will take to smashing things up around me.
I'm clumsy, even for a trollkin.
Everyone comments on how lazy I am. They are right.
I don't follow orders, which gets me and my friends into trouble.
I won't back down from a challenge, no matter the risk.
If you can't hold your liquor, I won't show you respect.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Handaxe|xphb}, {@item Longbow|xphb}, {@item Arrows (20)|xphb}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|xphb}, {@item Quiver|xphb}, and 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Occult Bushwhackers
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} A band of bushwhackers is a collection of hunters, bone grinders, trappers, explorers, and mystics who learn all they can from the land and carve out a territory from which they gather resources to trade or fashion into weapons, alchemical serums, and fetishes.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Any character can belong to an Occult Bushwhackers company, but it must include at least one bone grinder.

entries.name: Ritual Workings
entries: If you are an alchemist, you can make use of one formula or talisman that you don't currently know a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once).

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Your company's prestige increases through acts such as: discovering an ancient Molgur relic or ritual site; capturing or killing a dangerous creature; fashioning a powerful fetish worth at least 1,500 gp; discovering a rare or exotic plant or creature and presenting it to a notable chieftain or lord; developing a powerful new alchemical formula or fetish.

entries.name: Tier 1 — Poachers
entries: {@b Camp.} You have access to regular hunting grounds, tents, a large cauldron for cooking and brewing, and a modest collection of alchemical ingredients. You can craft an extra alchemical item during a short or long rest.
{@b Hunting Grounds.} You can replace one proficiency from your race or background with proficiency in the Survival skill.

entries.name: Tier 2 — Skilled Hunters
entries: {@b Well-Stocked Provisions.} If you spend at least 8 hours in camp researching, you can choose one common formula you know and replace it with another, or choose one 1st-level spell you know and replace it with another from your spell list. After a long rest at your camp, you regain two uses of your field alchemy kit.
{@b Whipper-In and Kenneler.} You gain {@dice 1d8} hirelings who act as kennelers and whipper-ins. Hirelings must have a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower.

entries.name: Tier 3 — Big Game Hunters
entries: {@b Improved Provisions.} As a downtime activity, a member can choose one known uncommon formula/talisman and replace it with one uncommon formula/talisman or two common formulas/talismans. After a long rest at camp, you regain five uses of your field alchemy kit.
{@b Trophy Hunters.} You gain a +2 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks when dealing with other alchemists and bone grinders.

entries.name: Tier 4 — Monster Slayers
entries: {@b Master Alchemists.} When interacting with others, you can replace Charisma (Intimidation) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks with Intelligence (Arcana) checks.

{@b Monster Slayers.} Once per turn, you can add your Wisdom modifier to your attack roll against a Large or larger creature. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened by Large or larger creatures.

entries.name: Quirks
entries: Roll or choose a quirk: (1) Your company is a ragtag collection of hunters and bone grinders from other tribes; (2) Your company was founded after you defeated a savage beast that was raiding a village; (3) You were originally outriders and scouts for your tribe, but you returned to find many of your people dead; (4) Your company was formed by a notable patron who calls upon you at inopportune moments; (5) One of your founding members left after you discovered them stealing and poaching—they are now a sworn enemy; (6) Your company follows a peculiar tradition and wears a unique pendant from the time of the Molgur; (7) Your company is followed by a small annoying creature that steals items but acts as an early warning; (8) Your company has existed for decades, passing down hunting grounds through family bloodlines; (9) Your company was founded during a great ritual meal; (10) The fleeing skorne forces have left vast swathes of land unclaimed, creating prime hunting grounds.

name: Occult Detective

_.displayName: book discussing local religions and religious movements

entries: You are an investigator, one who studies magic or otherworldly entities and deities. You specialize in finding out the reasons and people behind occult activities, and trying to put a stop to them. Perhaps you were inspired to choose this life because of a terrible past. Or, you may have an innate talent for rooting out the unfamiliar.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine what kind of occult investigations you often do, how your skills have developed, and what kinds of occult findings you have discovered. Was it a religious group trying to perform some forbidden ritual? Or is it some type of monster that has been killing the people it has been hiding amongst?

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Investigation}, and one from: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Survival}

items.name: Languages
items.entry: Two exotic languages (Abyssal, Celestial, Deep Speech, Draconic, Infernal, Primordial, Sylvan, or Undercommon)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A vial of holy water, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, three wooden stakes, a silver ring, an empty {@item vial|phb}, a {@item book|phb} discussing local religions and religious movements, and a {@item whip|phb}

entries.name: Feature: Occult Awareness
entries: Though others may have to go through a variety of loops and paperwork to gain access to areas heavy with occult activity, you have an easier time with acquiring access to scenes and places rife with paranormal occurrences, or know of people who can get you into them.

You also have a wealth of knowledge related to obscure or underground religious groups and sects, and have an easier time noticing clues and traces of the occult. Additionally, you are likely to gain special treatment by those who have hired you for their services in tracking foul creatures and other occult signs.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Many occult detectives and investigators see a lot of strange and frightening things in their lifetimes, from horrible crimes to witnessing creatures from other realms be summoned in places they should not be. As such, to grow old in this profession is seen as incredible, and those that do are often shaped by their experiences into living a hardened and sometimes lonely life.

rows: I take my profession seriously, and hope to rid the world of terrors.
While I do enjoy company, I am wary to make lifelong friends, as I have had many end in terrible ways.
The gods don't do enough in the world.
I can't help but inspect every corner of every room at least once. You can never be too sure.
I have a small hobby that keeps me sane.
I don't think I could ever have a family. Not after what I have seen.
I laugh and taunt my foes when I have the upper hand.
Not all I track down are evil. Some are just people trying to experiment with new things.
Justice. I will bring every monster and dark practitioner of magic to answer to the law. (Good)
Tenets. There are strict rules that I must adhere to while working. (Lawful)
Temptation. I can be persuaded to look the other way, if provided the right compensation. (Evil)
Methodology. I get the job done, anyway I can. (Chaotic)
Knowledge. I long to know why most people do the things they do. (Any)
Focus. I don't involve myself in the morality of situations and motivations. I just focus on the job at hand. (Neutral)
It is because of the occult that I no longer have a family.
I don't view all occult practices as bad. I'm just good at tracking them.
I picked up a thing or too after having fallen for a member of a secretive religious group.
I try to protect the innocent from things beyond their control.
I try to show mercy whenever I can.
I try not to focus on what happened on a job once its done. If I do, it will wear me down.
Deep down, I have a lot of things I am afraid of. I just can't speak of them.
I drown myself in drinks and gambling when my mind is heavy.
I don't want to find myself slipping into becoming some of the things I have seen.
It's hard for me to open up to others.
I am too confident in my abilities and tracking skills.
I want to have a family one day, yet I don't know if I will live long enough to see that happen.

_.displayName: Three scroll cases, one with a false bottom

entries: Some knowledge is forbidden. Occultists are the dark side of academia, who hunt secrets that should have been locked away forever. Favoring taboo subjects, occultists bribe, blackmail, and butcher their way into the forbidden sections of sophisticated libraries and private collections. Obsessive to a fault, these scholars summon creatures and breach seals that should have been left unbroken, all in the pursuit of knowledge. More than one reckless occultist has risked the world's safety for the sake of the answer to an esoteric question only they care about.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of {@item Calligrapher's supplies|phb} or {@item Thieves' tools|phb}

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: One {@table exotic languages|phb|exotic language} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Three {@item map or scroll case|phb|scroll cases} (one with a false bottom), a bottle of {@item ink (1-ounce bottle)|phb|ink}, a quill, a piece of charcoal, five {@item candle|phb|candles}, a piece of chalk, an empty {@item vial|phb}, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Deepest Lore
entries: Though you study many subjects and master many more, you have an area of interest that fascinates you above all others. This enthusiasm is both a blessing and a curse; it makes you a noteworthy figure in your chosen field but your obsession lures you to dangerous situations and places. Choose a topic or roll on the table below.

rows: Aberrations and the Far Realm
The origins of life, and immortality
Curses, hexes, and omens
Devils or demons
Elemental chaos
Hypnotism and mind control
Necromancy and the undead
Subconsciousness and dreams

entries.name: Feature: Secret Texts
entries: Foolish moralizers do their best to censor the secrets you seek, but you are wise to their tricks. When you look at an object or surface that has or once had writing upon it, you can tell if the text has been written over, blotted out, erased, burned off, carved away, or otherwise modified. You cannot uncover its original meaning without other skills or techniques. You can also tell if invisible ink, spells, or other methods were used to hide writing on a surface, but can't discern its contents or meaning without other methods.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Occultists are obsessed, knowledge-hungry, dangerous, and off-putting. They are slaves to their mission to gather knowledge, whether they intend to hoard it or share it with the world. They are often willing to sacrifice anything to obtain ultimate knowledge.

rows: I often forget to eat, sleep, or bathe when engrossed in a new tome.
Sharing my findings with a willing listener makes me happy.
I'd do anything for a new source of information.
Intricate plans guide every moment of my day.
I collect idols, amulets, and other trophies from my findings.
I hum forgotten hymns in a language no one can speak.
I worship forgotten gods instead of the pantheon typical of my people.
I only let a fraction of my true knowledge slip through; enough to intrigue, but nothing more.
{@b Chronicle.} No matter my fate, I must record what I find for those who come after me. (Lawful)
{@b Preparation.} To fight evil, one must know it. Ignorance makes us weak. (Good)
{@b Defiance.} I refuse to let my small-minded peers dictate what I study. (Chaotic)
{@b Jealousy.} I don't grow close to people; they will steal my secrets if I let my guard down. (Evil)
{@b Truth.} The only dangerous knowledge is hidden or misrepresented. (Neutral)
{@b Fervor.} I'll gather new knowledge no matter the cost to myself or others. (Any)
I want to learn more about my area of study... which terrifies me.
I had a premonition of a terrible evil and became an occultist to better understand the vision.
I forgot my goals a long time ago. Now I research for its own sake.
I will use my findings to enrich and empower myself.
Inadequacy fuels me; I want to learn things nobody else does so I'll feel special.
My mentor disappeared in search of a mysterious power and I'll do whatever I can to get them back.
I like to terrify others with my findings, on purpose.
Mortals are a currency that I can trade with higher powers for secrets.
I enthusiastically murder to keep my studies secret.
When I work on a risky project, I put others in danger before myself.
After I learn all I can from a teacher, peer, or student, I betray or discard them.
Nothing matters save my obsession. Nothing.

_.special: A book of obscure lore holding clues to an occult location
a leather-bound journal in which you record your secrets

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A book of obscure lore holding clues to an occult location, a {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, a quill, a leather-bound journal in which you record your secrets, a {@item bullseye lantern|PHB}, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: Strange Lore
entries: Your passions for forbidden knowledge, esoteric religions, secretive cults, and terrible histories brought you into contact with a wide variety of interesting and unique individuals operating on the fringes of polite society. When you're trying to find something that pertains to eldritch secrets or dark knowledge, you have a good idea of where to start looking. Usually, this information comes from information brokers, disgraced scholars, chaotic mages, dangerous cults, or insane priests. Your GM might rule that the knowledge you seek isn't found with just one contact, but this feature provides a starting point.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Occultists can't resist the lure of an ancient ruin, forgotten dungeon, or the lair of some mysterious cult. They eagerly follow odd rumors, folktales, and obscure clues found in dusty tomes. Some adventure with the hope of turning their discoveries into fame and fortune, while others consider the answers they uncover to be the true reward. Whatever their motivations, occultists combine elements of archaeologist, scholar, and fanatic.

rows: I always ask questions, especially if I think I can learn something new.
I believe every superstition I hear and follow their rules fanatically.
The things I know give me nightmares, and not only when I sleep.
Nothing makes me happier than explaining some obscure lore to my friends.
I startle easily.
I perform a host of rituals throughout the day that I believe protect me from occult threats.
I never know when to give up.
The more someone refuses to believe me, the more I am determined to convince them.
{@bold Domination.} With the power I will unearth, I will take my revenge on those who wronged me. (Evil)
{@bold Mettle.} Each nugget of hidden knowledge I uncover proves my worth. (Any)
{@bold Lore.} Knowledge is never good or evil; it is simply knowledge. (Neutral)
{@bold Redemption.} This dark knowledge can be made good if it is used properly. (Good)
{@bold Truth.} Nothing should be hidden. Truth is all that matters, no matter who it hurts. (Chaotic)
{@bold Responsibility.} Only by bringing dark lore into the light can we eliminate its threat. (Lawful)
One or more secret organizations are trying to stop me, which means I must be close to the truth.
My studies come before anything else.
No theory, however unbelievable, is worth abandoning without investigation.
I must uncover the truth behind a particular mystery, one my father died to protect.
I travel with my companions because I have reason to believe they are crucial to the future.
I once had a partner in my occult searches who vanished. I am determined to find them.
When stressed, I mutter theories to myself, sometimes connecting seemingly unconnected or random events, to explain my current predicament.
It's not paranoia if they really are out to get me.
I have a habit of lying to hide my theories and discoveries.
I see secrets and mysteries in everything and everyone.
The world is full of dark secrets, and I'm the only one who can safely unearth them.
There is no law or social convention I won't break to further my goals.

entries: At your core, you are a believer in things others dismiss. The signs abound if you know where to look. Questions beget answers that spur further questions. The cycle is endless as you uncover layer after layer of mystery and secrets.

Piercing the veil hiding beyond the surface of reality is an irresistible lure spurring you to delve into forgotten and dangerous places in the world. Perhaps you've always yearned toward the occult, or it could be that you encountered something or someone who opened your eyes to the possibilities. You may belong to some esoteric organization determined to uncover the mystery, a cult bent on using the secrets for a dark purpose, or you may be searching for answers on your own. As an occultist, you ask the questions reality doesn't want to answer.

name: Oeblar

_.special: a set of dark common clothes including a hood

entries: You grew up in the "lawless" town of Oeble, and so are personally familiar with large numbers of thieves, brigands, smugglers, poisoners, outlaws, bounty hunters, fences of stolen goods—and many of the ruses, swindles, and dodges they employ. You also know of some "safe houses" in Oeble where you can hide—if you can pay their stiff fees—and where to procure good disguises and to hire bodyguards or actors to portray roles for you (such as fictitious family members, business compatriots, slaves, and sages).

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One type of gaming set, thieves' tools

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A poisoner's kit, a set of dark common clothes including a hood, and a pouch containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: Poison Expert
entries: You can recognize many poisons and sleep-draughts by taste, smell, and hue, and know where to go to obtain such (and other illicit or contraband) substances. Because so many of these noxious substances originate in the Underdark, you are also resistant to Drow Poison.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: While not necessarily hardened criminals themselves, Oeblar are certainly not put off by criminal activity or lawlessness. Activities such as smuggling, kidnapping, and theft are all functions of normal life for the Oeblar. As such, Oeblar can adopt just about any wider world view, as long as trust in or respect for law or authority is not part of its basic makeup. Use the tables below, either making specific selections or rolling randomly, as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity.

rows: I am pretty sure that your stuff should be my stuff.
I am afraid of the dark.
I am not a morning person. Do not bother me with anything before highsun (noon).
I have a compulsive sweet tooth.
I don't cotton to strangers. You must earn my trust.
I am terribly insecure so always act tough and never admit to being wrong.
I am incredibly goal-oriented. I will let nothing stop me when I have set a goal.
I am fragile and will cry in the face of any cruel insult or jibe.
Property. You are entitled to your things for exactly as long as you are strong enough to protect them. (Chaotic)
Freedom. No thinking being should ever be caged. Jails and prisons are for the morally bankrupt. (Chaotic)
Charity. There is enough wealth in this world in order to share a measure of it with all. (Good)
Greed. Mine! It will all be mine! (Evil)
People. I can take or leave just about anyone. If you are right by me, you can expect the same in return. (Neutral)
Restitution. Everyone makes mistakes. So, everyone should be afforded the chance to make things right. (Good)
I owe some money to some bad people. I need to pay them back soon or it will be bad, very bad.
I have a little sister that relies on me. I must make money one way or the other.
My family's business was forced to close because of outrageous "protection" fees. I will make the local crime boss responsible pay.
I will build a vast criminal empire.
I have done some things that I am not proud of. I hope to do enough to balance the ledger out.
I watched someone I cared very much about die because of a mistake that I made. I will carry that burden with me for the rest of my days.
When the going gets tough, I get going.
All I care about is money.
I don't work well with others.
I really like pie. I don't allow bakeries to be closed (and keeping me from sampling their wares).
I will betray anyone and anything for enough money.
I saw a valuable thing years ago. I constantly dream of stealing it and making it mine.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Travel|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: Land vehicles

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Fair-spoken, Faithful

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Travel|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Brewer's supplies|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Inquisitive, Wary

items.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: {@skill Nature}, {@skill Survival}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
entries: {@item tinker's tools|phb} or {@item woodcarver's tools|phb}

items.name: Languages
entries: Any one common language

items.name: Equipment
entries: One set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: Insightful Flashbacks
entries: While you don't remember your time away from the civilized world, you occasionally have glimpses of what happened. When you are making an ability check to know or remember something about a monster or some other piece of lore, you can reroll a check that gave you no information. If the new check provides information, you cannot use this ability again until you gain a level. This represents your subconscious mind reminding you of details you witnessed while you were lost.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As one of the Taken, your experiences changed and shaped you even if you cannot remember the exact details. Even more dramatically, how you were treated upon your return by those around you.

rows: I am easily startled, jumping at the slightest sound.
Other people irritate me, but I love the company of animals.
I cannot abide silence, so I surround myself with noise whenever possible.
I often forget what day or month or year it is.
I use the attention of my time missing to make myself important and noticed.
I am restless, never satisfied with what I have or what I am, always seeking more.
Innocents need protection. I won't let what happened to me happen to others.
That which does not kill you makes you stronger. Conflict begets strength.
The world is a cruel place. In the end we are all ground down to dust.
Mysteries abound, and the point of life is to solve as many of them as possible.
The only way to avoid being a victim is to be the aggressor.
Passing on your knowledge and wisdom to others ensures you will live forever.
You were taken with another, and that person was returned as well. You are bound to them forever.
You were found with a strange object in the woods. That object never leaves your possession.
While others shunned you on your return, your pet never left your side. This unusually long-lived pet means the world to you.
When you returned, the community rallied around you to care for you. You guard that community fiercely.
An elder who was also taken as a child listens to you and helps guide you on your path forward.
A faerie grove in the forest near you is the only place where you are truly at peace.
I suffer nightmares that I cannot recall when I wake, and the lack of sleep makes me prone to fits of anger.
I seek money and power regardless of the cost to my soul.
I am rude to others as I tend to speak what's on my mind rather than filtering myself.
My quest for justice sometimes interferes with my common sense.
I am indifferent to the suffering of others.
I believe lies, which makes me easily duped by those with ill intent.

entries: On the fringes of the civilized world, parents warn their children not to wander away from their homes, especially at night. The many creatures that haunt the forests, from the faerie-folk to the minions of the Great Beast, spell doom for the innocent who stray too far into the darkness.

You failed to heed your parents' warnings, and you were taken. In fact, those who know of your experience use that word to describe you: Taken. You do not remember what happened to you while you were away, but through some mysterious and possibly fortunate circumstances, you wandered back into town after months or years of going missing. Maybe the fairies whisked you off to some magical realm. Maybe evil cultists of an Arch Daemon held you prisoner, planning to sacrifice you to their dark leader when the time was right, and you found a way to escape. Maybe one of the Beast's warped and feral minions took a liking to you and kept you as a pet. Whatever your story, you can't remember your time away. But that doesn't mean you weren't changed by it.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: On the fringes of the civilized world, parents warn their children not to wander away from their homes, especially at night. The many creatures that haunt the forests, from the faerie-folk to the minions of the Great Beast, spell doom for the innocent who stray too far into the darkness. You failed to heed your parents' warnings, and you were taken. In fact, those who know of your experience use that word to describe you: Taken.

You do not remember what happened to you while you were away, but through some mysterious and possibly fortunate circumstances, you wandered back into town after months or years of going missing. Maybe the fairies whisked you off to some magical realm. Maybe evil cultists of an Arch Daemon held you prisoner, planning to sacrifice you to their dark leader when the time was right, and you found a way to escape. Maybe one of the Beast's warped and feral minions took a liking to you and kept you as a pet. Whatever your story, you can't remember your time away. But that doesn't mean you weren't changed by it.

name: Order of No Quarter

_.special: a wanted poster with your name on it

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: {@item thieves' tools|phb}, a stole belt pouch containing 35gp and a wanted poster with your name on it

entries: The Order of No Quarter is a villainous group of knights created by the Enchantress for her nefarious purposes. In addition to their individual skills in combat, each knight has a specific role in the Order, and loyal minions under their personal employ. You found yourself among their rank for a time, and perhaps you still ally yourself with them.
Ask yourself what brought you to the Order? Who are the other members? Do you share a true common goal, or is it an alliance of convenience?

entries.name: Feature: Notorious Villain
entries: In every town you will find shelter, striking fear into the hearts of the common folk, hoping to avoid your wrath. You may also find respite amongst scum and villainy, should your goals align. Your presence may also draw the ire of would-be heroes seeking to make a name for themselves.

name: Order of Wizardry

_: proof of membership in the Order of Wizardry

entries: Widely known and respected as an institution for training those of arcane aptitude, the Order of Wizardry has been home to you and many other mages eager to progress along the established ranks of their craft.

entries.name: Feature: Order Lodge
entries: The Order maintains public lodges in most of the major cities in Cygnar and Ord and recently began reestablishing its facilities in Llael. It also maintains secret facilities in other nations' population centers, but these are available to members only with specific permission. At the GM's discretion, you can contact one of these locations and request reasonable aid if you are in good standing with the organization.

entries.name: Feature: Magus Training
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Spellcasting, Warcaster Magic, or Pact Magic class feature.
Add the spells on the Magus Training Spells table to the spell list for your spellcasting class. If you are a multiclass character with multiple spell lists, add these spells to all of them.

entries.caption: Magus Training Spells
rows: Cantrip
mage hand
1st
detect magic
2nd
magic weapon
3rd
dispel magic
4th
arcane eye
5th
scrying

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Defined by their study and dedication to magecraft, members of the Order of Wizardry are well suited to long periods of research and introspection on arcane matters. Their greatest flaw is often hubris, a reflection of their elevated opinion of themselves.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I like trying to figure out how things work. Don't leave mechanika around me if you don't want it taken apart.
There are rules to everything, and I remind people of that regularly.
I've seen a lot, so I'm tough to rattle.
I am comfortable being in charge, even if I was not asked.
I don't put myself above others, but I do hold myself to higher standards.
You can have all the money and fame in the world, but a fireball will still ruin your day.
I take pride in how much others rely on me, and I offer aid whenever I can.
I read every chance I get. An expansive vocabulary enables an extensive arsenal.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Glory. I will go down in history as one of the greatest arcanists of the age. (Any)
Comfort. I would like to live a life of quiet luxury, although I have to earn it first. (Neutral)
Knowledge. I seek to further my knowledge of the arcane, even if it means studying the darker side of things. (Any)
Order. I am committed to my order, not to ideals. (Lawful)
Power. I see the arcane as a tool to acquiring great personal power. (Evil)
Mastery. I seek to perfect my understanding of the arcane at any price. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I made off from the Order's library with a tome I should have left behind.
My goal is to be published as one of the preeminent scholars of mechanikal theory.
I was run out of my institution and must work to clear my name.
I made a horrible miscalculation on a spell as a student, and someone was seriously injured. I will never be so careless again.
A patron paid for my studies, and I now owe that individual a rather large favor.
I am tortured by dreams of finding a relic long thought lost.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I cannot walk away from any chance to increase my knowledge.
I cannot hide my disdain for those I scorn, and it gets me into trouble.
When something goes wrong, I start pointing fingers.
I have several vices that part me from my coins very quickly.
When things turn from good to bad, I am the first to flee.
For better or worse, I have absolute faith in the leaders of my order.

entries: Whether you committed a terrible crime or your people banished you due to circumstances beyond your control, you have no place to call home. Your shallow friendships end as fast as they begin, and you struggle to form stable relationships of any kind.

You drift from place to place or inhabit the very edge of a town or city. When you dare venture into civilization, you draw the eyes of all you meet, who whisper as you walk by. Though not often met with violence, you may find yourself "encouraged" to leave by authorities, or have businesses close their doors to you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A tent, {@item blanket|phb}, {@item tinderbox|phb}, a spare pair of shoes, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Original Sin
entries: No group banishes one of their own without justification, though the legitimacy of their grievance is often questionable. Choose a transgression or roll on the table below to determine why your homeland cast you out.

Some sins are entirely outside your control, while others involve your past mistakes or use you as a scapegoat. Your reputation often precedes you, which makes socialization difficult even as you travel. While you can find far-off lands that know nothing of your past shame, you likely struggle to integrate and adopt their foreign ways.

rows: Betrayal or desertion
Contagious disease
Crime
Curse
Desecration
Forbidden love
Prophecy
Racial conflict

entries.name: Feature: Emergency Stash
entries: Accustomed to self-sufficiency, you rely on yourself and your foresight to survive. When you enter or leave an area that you have visited once before (such as a town or a large forest), you can excavate a hidden cache of food, water, and a simple weapon. The food and water can sustain a single humanoid for 3 days. If you attempt to excavate a second cache before 30 days pass, you must roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, you find another.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Outcasts are, as a rule, haunted by the dozens of betrayals they experience over the course of their lives. Many are wary and slow to trust, though desperate for companionship. Their experiences intensify their good and evil inclinations, further separating them from the masses with their extreme behavior.

rows: I am desperate for companionship of any kind.
The most basic kindness is enough to win my loyalty.
I prefer this solitary lifestyle.
I am uncomfortable in crowds and other social settings.
I am slow to trust but loyal to the end.
I haven't learned my lesson, and will stubbornly repeat the same mistake.
I always expect the worst of people.
I lie as easily as I breathe.
{@b Penance.} They were right to banish me. I accept my punishment. (Lawful)
{@b Support.} When I meet others in similar situations, I share my experiences to help guide them. (Good)
{@b Liberation.} The society that banished me felt stifling. Now I'm free to express myself. (Chaotic)
{@b Spite.} I'll take whatever I want from the society that rejected me. (Evil)
{@b Survival.} I focus on my everyday needs rather than dwell on the past. (Neutral)
{@b Discovery.} I don't understand why I was banished, and want to find out. (Any)
I was wrongly accused and hope to set the record straight.
I yearn to return home a changed person.
I can protect others from my fate...if only I could get them to listen.
Through introspection and exploration, I hope to find a way to forgive myself.
Tearing down corrupt social structures is the only way to achieve the justice I crave.
I'm being hunted—and will do anything I can to hide.
I refuse to trust anyone with my deepest emotions.
I bear a grudge against everyone involved in my banishment, including bystanders and people absent.
I push everyone away, even the sympathetic.
I replay the last days of my life before my exile over and over again in my mind.
I intentionally terrify others with my presence because I enjoy their fear.
Now that I've committed one crime, I have no reason not to commit many more.

name: Outcast

_: a musical instrument (one of your choice)
a set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)
a small bag of trinkets and mementos from your tribe

entries: You have been cast out from your community, tribe, or society. Perhaps you were accused of a crime you did not commit or violated a cultural taboo or law. Regardless of the reason, you've learned to survive on your own in an often hostile and unforgiving world.

entries.name: Feature: Outcast's Resilience
entries: You've learned to survive on your own in harsh and unforgiving environments. You are adept at finding shelter, hunting for food, and avoiding danger. You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to forage for food, track prey, and find suitable shelter in the wilds.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am fiercely independent and prefer to rely on myself rather than others.
I take great pride in my tribe's heritage and traditions.
I am slow to trust others because I don't want to be betrayed again.
I am quick to anger and act recklessly when my pride is threatened.
I am fiercely loyal to those I trust.
I am wary of strangers but will extend a helping hand if necessary.
I am a bit of a loner, but I still enjoy the company of close friends.
I am haunted by my past, and I strive to make amends for my mistakes.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Honor. No matter how low I have fallen, I will do whatever it takes to restore my honor. (Lawful)
Survival. I protect myself and those I care about, no matter the cost. (Neutral)
Freedom. I won't be tied down by anyone or anything. (Chaotic)
Community. I strive to protect and preserve any community I find myself in. (Lawful)
Vengeance. I seek revenge on those who have wronged me. (Evil)
Redemption. I will make amends for my past mistakes and prove myself worthy. (Good)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I will do anything to protect my former tribe and those I left behind.
I owe a debt of gratitude to those who have helped me on my journey.
I will never forget the person who drove me from my home.
I am determined to clear my name and restore my honor.
I will take any opportunity to make a new home for myself and my loved ones.
I am committed to helping those in need, no matter the danger.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I have a hard time controlling my temper and often act before I think.
I am quick to judge and slow to forgive, even for minor offenses.
I have a hard time trusting others and often assume the worst of people.
I will go to extremes to get revenge on those who have wronged me.
I am overly proud and will not accept help from others.
I am haunted by my past and often feel guilty for my mistakes.
