entries.name: Feature: Medical Marvel
entries: Your dramatic and sudden recovery from the Weeping Pox—as well as the physical changes to your appearance because of the disease—has made you a marvel to the people around you. Though you may be treated differently as a strange oddity, your new status does have potential perks. You can ask for small favors, from meals to places to rest, and find the common folks willing to oblige, even if they are slightly afraid of you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As one of the Pox-Touched, you faced down a terrible fate and lived to recount the experience. Such a terrible experience, and the joyful escape from that fate, leaves a lingering effect on those who go through it.

rows: I'm overly conscious of what the Weeping Pox did to my countenance.
I hear the voices of all those who died from the disease, and I speak on their behalf.
I have come to deeply respect the work of the alchemists and potion-makers of the world.
I fear disease after having almost succumbed to one.
I process everything I see and experience verbally.
I prefer darkness and solitude to light and company.
Death is powerful and wonderful, a transformation rather than an ending.
We should be judged for how we treat the powerless, not the powerful.
Knowledge is the key to defeating any problem.
Discipline and rigor are the best tools against the chaos of the world.
Self-reliance is the key to survival. Others may let you down.
One person's ideal is another's flaw. Ideals should be malleable.
I do what I do for all those suffering from horrible maladies. They deserve respect, empathy, and assistance.
The book of cures that my doctor left me is incomprehensible to me, but I carry it with me everywhere.
My pet was with me during my recovery, and it reminds me of all that I have.
My parents never gave up on me, and I visit them whenever I can.
I have a twin who I cannot stand but would do anything for.
I owe my life to the itinerant healer who healed me.
Cleanliness is the most important virtue, and no one around me is ever clean enough.
One of the herbs that helped heal me is something I must take every day or I feel terrible.
I'm easily distracted.
When innocent people are being hurt, I fly into a blind rage that's hard to control.
Since the Weeping Pox could not kill me, I'm obviously indestructible.
My appearance means more to me than I should.

entries: When you fell ill with the Weeping Pox, you assumed you would die from it, as had so many before you. Your neighbors shunned you, fearing that you would spread the disease to them and their families.

Then a miracle happened. A stranger came to you and offered to help. The stranger brought forth strange medicines, providing you with curative draughts and elixirs. And just as the disease reached its worst stages, the symptoms began to vanish. Before long, you were cured of the disease. The sores and scars of the disease, however, still play across your body—an unsubtle reminder of the terrible scourge you faced.

The stranger left you after the treatments concluded, but you retained some of the knowledge that the healer used while caring for you. Those who marvel at your recovery also fear you: they harbor some suspicion that you made deals with dark powers to drive away the disease.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

Your neighbors shunned you, fearing that you would spread the disease to them and their families. Then a miracle happened. A stranger came to you and offered to help. The stranger brought forth strange medicines, providing you with curative draughts and elixirs. And just as the disease reached its worst stages, the symptoms began to vanish. Before long, you were cured of the disease.

The sores and scars of the disease, however, still display across your body—an unsubtle reminder of the terrible scourge you survived. The stranger left you after the treatments concluded, but you retained some of the knowledge that the healer used while caring for you. Those who marvel at your recovery also fear you: they harbor suspicion that you made deals with dark powers to drive away the disease.

a pair of manacles and a length of chain

entries: Confined in the damp, rotten bowels of cities and castles, prisoners are lifelong captives left to rot in dingy cells. Forgotten save for their few abusers and even fewer friends, many wretches go months or years without a glimpse of the sun or a friendly face. Weighed down by the remains of their physical and spiritual confinement, escaped prisoners often struggle to reintegrate into normal society.

Many feel these wretches deserve their lot. They suffered a fate more terrible than death, reserved only for the worst criminals. These starved, desperate, and traumatized creatures can barely be described as human. They evoke pity on sight, but when they snap, rage built by decades of abuse bursts forth in a horrific surge of hatred for everyone and everything around them.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Torturer's implements|Abidalzims}, one {@item gaming set|phb} or {@item musical instrument|phb}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of rags that were once {@item common clothes|phb}, a pair of {@item manacles|phb} and a length of chain, a {@item pole (10-foot)|phb|10-foot pole}, a {@item sack|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing miscellaneous small coins worth 5 gp

entries.name: Grim Keepsake
entries: A special torture marked your time in prison. Mutilations are likely, as are pieces of equipment placed around or in your body. These trappings have become part of your identity, accompany you in your freedom, and on the rare occasion that you remove them (if possible), you keep them close.
Choose a keepsake or roll on the table below.

rows: Iron mask or helmet
Chains or manacles
Tattoos or brands
Scars
Flayed skin
Amputated parts

entries.name: Feature: Pariah
entries: Your demeanor betrays your past and makes members of polite society uncomfortable. You can use this discomfort to your advantage; you can slip into places others couldn't as guards and passers-by look away to avoid eye contact, or put others on the back foot in social situations such as haggling. Those used to the traumatic and the wretched, like jailers or veteran soldiers, have no such reaction.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: In many cultures, no one is lower than a lifelong prisoner. Years isolated from the rest of society mark them as eternal outcasts, fit for nothing beyond an early and shameful death.

rows: I snatch up vermin and eat them on reflex.
Now that I have a chance to bathe, I preen over my own reflection.
I rub my wrists or ankles as a nervous tic.
I struggle without strict, enforced routine.
I crave the illicit substances common in my prison.
I am aggressive with people who remind me of rival prisoners.
No one is more vicious to people found innocent in controversial trials than I am.
I love being hurt.
{@b Penance.} My crimes were terrible and my sentence warranted. I served my time with honor. (Lawful)
{@b Atonement.} I will do right by the victims of my actions, whether they know it or not. (Good)
{@b Liberation.} I'm free! Now I'll find a way to free my fellow prisoners, at any cost. (Chaotic)
{@b Dominance.} I learned that might makes right. (Evil)
{@b Negotiation.} I have a knack for figuring out what people want, and how to get it. (Neutral)
{@b Innocence.} I was falsely accused, and will prove it. (Any)
I am terrified of an authority figure obsessed with hunting me down.
I refuse to sleep without my back to a wall.
I shy away from open spaces and the sun.
I do everything I can to feel well and healthy.
I unconsciously rub my scars while thinking.
I have a new lease on life and spread joy wherever I go.
I lash out at anyone who reminds me of my tormentors.
I refuse to improve my hygiene or health.
I try to hoard food, clean water, and medical supplies.
I kill quickly before taking the chance to talk or think.
I pick at wounds, refusing to let them heal.
I'm sadistic, like my captors. I learned from the best.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB} (shiv), {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: Something from your past landed you in prison. Your transgressions might be real or imagined, against a just society or a corrupt one. Regardless of how you became a prisoner, you have learned to survive within your environment.

As a prisoner, you've had to learn to deal with guards, other prisoners, and the unpleasant environment. Part of that survival was learning to find, craft, or steal small items that make your incarceration more tolerable. Whether your release was long ago or about to happen, your time as a Prisoner has changed you.

name: Privateer
entries: You are a privateer, buccaneer, or pirate. Issued a letter of marque from one of the Iron Kingdoms, you've most recently hunted and captured the ships of enemy nations or fought your former fellows as they preyed upon merchant ships.

entries.name: Feature: Legal Authority
entries: You have detailed documentation that grants you permission to prey upon the ships of enemy nations. Choose one nation: Cygnar, Khador, Ord, or the Protectorate of Menoth. You have a reasonable expectation of assistance from this nation's naval authorities and can, at the GM's discretion, avoid legal repercussions for your actions as long as you can prove that such actions hurt your nation's enemies.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Privateers begin their careers for many reasons, but their ideals are shaped by a desire to stick with the trade because of their love of the sea and lack of faith in traditional authority. Superstition is common among them.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I have been to many ports of call and have seen much of the world, so I have little bias when it comes to other nations' cultures.
I put absolute faith in a myriad of superstitions and apply them to numerous situations on both land and sea.
Almost any disagreement can be settled with a drink, and for those that can't—well, that's what these fists are for.
I always make sure everyone gets their fair share in any interaction.
I challenge any leaders I see as unfit or undeserving.
I value my freedom above all else and cannot abide seeing anyone else tethered or oppressed.
I have no interest in "saving my coin" or "hoarding wealth" if there is a game of chance to be had.
I will take any opportunity to show off or enhance my reputation.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Crew. My crewmates are more important to me than any code of ethics. (Any)
Plunder. In the end, all I'm looking for is the next big score. (Any)
Freedom. My ship gives me the freedom to go wherever my heart desires. (Chaotic)
Fear. If people fear me, it means they respect me. (Evil)
Charity. The wealth I steal on the seas can change the lives of the less fortunate. (Good)
Code of Conduct. I plunder only from those my letter of marque permits me to. (Lawful)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: There is a price on my head.
I am searching for a long-lost treasure.
I want to captain a vessel.
I have vowed revenge on the person who forced this life upon me.
I seek to be reunited with a lost love.
My crew is my life, and I protect them at all costs.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: If my real name were to become widely known, my family would be disgraced.
I react violently to any perceived slight.
I do not know when to quit if dice are involved.
I get despondent if I am away from the sea for too long.
I am incapable of running from a fight.
Since I expect everyone to take full advantage of any perceived weaknesses, I don't show any.

name: Prodigy
entries: You are someone with an innate talent and prowess at a particular skill, or even several. Beginning at a young age, others watched as you outshone all of your peers with an incredible display of your talents. You may have been someone blessed at birth, or even prophesied. Or perhaps you were someone who just simply had a knack for a particular skill.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine what skills or abilities you are prodigious in, how others have reacted to your talents, and what kind of experiences this life has brought you. Was it that you were a brilliant academic or intellectual? Or was it the case that you had mastered a specific skill or techniques regarding combat?

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Two tool sets or instruments of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a quill, an inkpot, a {@item book|phb|blank journal}, one {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} set of your choice, and a small {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Prodigious Skill
entries: Your talents and skills mark you as a very special individual. Wherever you go, curious glances are sent your way, and you are often the point of affection, admiration, or even jealousy.

You can use this attention to gain access to people and places that others might not otherwise have, and for your traveling companions. Experts or masters in a field related to your talents will be particularly curious and may even ask you to show off your skills.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The life of a prodigy is one riddled with success after success, and they are often the talk of the town. Some prodigies have to learn how to deal with the attention they receive, while others acquire confidence and even cockiness with the acknowledgement of their unique abilities.

rows: I like any time that I get to display my talents.
While I understand my talents are impressive, I think that I always have room to improve.
I try not to draw too much attention to myself. It can be unsettling.
My talents are a major part of what defines me.
I often find myself trying to focus on things I can't do well.
I like knowing that there are things that I do surprisingly well.
I like to sit and listen to others discuss their methods and techniques.
I sometimes pretend to mess up to let others have a moment to show their skills.
Selfish. My talents are special, and I should be treated with respect and great treatment. (Evil).
Display. I take any moment to show off. (Chaotic)
Divinity. I believe that my skills are a blessing from the gods. (Any)
Instructional. I try to use my skills and knowledge to help others. (Good)
Humble. I know I have talent, but I try to make a point to not show off (Good)
Results. I don't focus on anything except the outcome. (Neutral)
My parents always tried to show me off and push my limits.
I have someone that I tutor and teach about the subject and skill I am
I have had to deal with jealous people all my life.
I just want to be treated like a normal person.
I have quite a few people who are admirers of my skills.
I deserve all of the great treatment that people give me.
I can get very cocky. A lot.
Even though I have skill, I always compare myself to others.
I wish I could have people notice other aspects of my personality and not just my skills.
I see myself as merely an efficient tool.
I can't seem to shake the feeling that I am just being used.
I act really confident to hide my doubt.

name: Professor

_.special: letter from a dead colleague posing a question you have not yet been able to answer

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A bottle of black ink, a quill, a small knife, a letter from a dead colleague posing a question you have not yet been able to answer, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries: You have spent a number of years teaching in the highest levels of academia. Whether you were teaching the science of engineering lightning rails, the art of crafting spells, or just teaching gym class, you lived a comfortable, and likely intellectual, life.
You can speak at length on your chosen subject, but you may lack common sense in other areas.

entries.caption: Why I left University
rows: I haven't; I'm on sabbatical, researching in the field.
I haven't; classes have been suspended following a disaster at the University that left part of the campus in ruin.
I resigned following a deep personal tragedy.
I resigned in disgrace over a scandal with a student.
I was fired when a rival stole my research and claimed it for himself.
I was forced into retirement due to old age.

entries.name: Feature: Collegiate Connection
entries: You have at least one professional connection within the University. Whether this individual was formerly your student, a fellow professor, or the headmaster himself, he or she can provide insight and information into the University, along with a safe place to retire for up to a month, provided that you concede to handling much of their menial paperwork.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Professors are defined by their scholar pursuits and their connection with the University. This position is lofty, granting resources to aid in research, but is also isolating. Processors are likely to be erudite, with a number of strange quirks.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I know the name of every famous wizard, king, and engineer of the last hundred years.
I am aloof, and spend much of my time with my face buried in a good book.
I constantly misplace my small personal possessions. My friends never dare lend me things.
I can't see my hand in front of me without my spectacles.
Don't even ask about borrowing my books or scrolls. They're mine.
No matter where I end up, the first place I locate is the library.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
Forbidden knowledge mesmerizes me.

rows.name: Knowledge
entries: The path to a better world comes through learning the truth in all things. (Neutral)

rows.name: Excellence
entries: I seek perfection in all things. (Lawful)

rows.name: Education
entries: No one should be barred from pursuits of the mind. (Good)

rows.name: Power
entries: The University's influence is power. (Evil)

rows.name: Rediscovery
entries: Recovering forgotten knowledge is a noble pursuit. (Neutral)

rows.name: Success
entries: Sometimes getting to the top requires stepping on a few people. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I seek an ancient scroll that might illuminate a secret that has perplexed me for decades.
I seek to make discoveries so profound, I am rocketed to position of headmaster at the University.
One of my siblings has left a blight on my otherwise unblemished family name. I seek to sort out the truth in this matter.
Someone had been publishing books and papers under my name, directly undermining my research. I must find this person and restore the integrity of my research.
I've compiled a list of places and things, which I've only read about, to see in the real world.
I have a pet theory that I intend to try out in the real world.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am often so engrossed in thought that I don't hear what others are saying around me.
I am often condescending to less-educated people, which includes practically everyone.
I'm convinced of the superiority of my chosen subject, compared to other subjects within the same field.
I am quite careless with money, and am often in debt.
I have a number of nervous compulsions and tics, which come out in times of stress.
I have a habit, (I'm insistent it's not an addiction) to a smoking herb.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Krash|DarkMatter24} (6 cans), {@item Interface Rig|DarkMatter24}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (hoodie); 22 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: Countless hours in front of an {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24} has graduated you from clumsy blocks of code to svelte, elegant functions that work your digital will. You might have interned at a tech conglomerate, worked freelance, or took up programming as a pastime. In the structure of coding languages, you've learned how to solve dynamic problems and speak with machines on a fundamental level—building blocks that can help you navigate every level of the 'Verse.

_.displayName: an {@table 25 gp art objects|dmg|art object} worth no more than 25 gp given to you by a favorite client

entries: You have a knack for the world's oldest profession, where you work for the pleasure of others. Whether in private or in public, you can identify viable targets for seduction, and have a knack for worming your way into their good graces before you please them.

Life as a prostitute, even a high-class one, is often dangerous. Some clients grow far too attached and develop expectations that threaten your life or livelihood. Others are sadistic, and their pleasures deal lasting damage to your mind and body. Society often views members of your profession as used-up and disposable, leaving you vulnerable to dangers that others could easily avoid.
Regardless, you act as a provider of relief and pleasure for your clients, and you can be secure in the knowledge that there will always be demand for your services.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@item gaming set|phb} or {@item musical instrument|phb} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item gaming set|phb} or {@item musical instrument|phb} (your choice), an {@table 25 gp art objects|dmg|art object} worth no more than 25 gp given to you by a favorite client, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Social Status
entries: Your social status determines how you find work. You may have hawked your services on the street (where you sold your body for copper coins), been a professional in a reputable establishment, or a sophisticated courtesan on an aristocrat's arm. You may have been prepared from a young age for this role, or sold into slavery as an adult.
In general, the more expensive your social status, the safer your lifestyle before you became an adventurer. Choose one of the roles below, or roll on the table.

rows: Sex slave
Street walker
Brothel worker
Escort
Priestess
Courtesan

entries.name: Feature: Eyes up Here
entries: Your charisma and the alluring nature of your profession attracts attention. You can exploit the lust and jealousy of others to make others focus on you, forcing them to drop their guard and prevent them from noticing things they might see otherwise. For example, seducing a guard lets you distract him until your party sneaks past him or your knife appears at his throat.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Most prostitutes are not as promiscuous as commonly believed, but all are shaped by both memorable and traumatic experiences. Many genuinely enjoy their work and the wealth it brings, while others prostitute themselves temporarily or out of necessity.

rows: I stay upbeat no matter how bad my circumstances get.
I'm blunt and honest about the nature of my work, and see no shame in it at all.
I resent my profession and the fact that I need it.
My clientele disgusts me.
A gentle touch and a sweet word will get you places.
I get as much pleasure as my clients, if not more.
I drown my shame with vice and addiction.
I will never forget a face or a name.
{@b Regulation.} I am a fervent believer in the use of legislation to protect workers like me. (Lawful)
{@b Intimacy.} I provide comfort to the hurting and pleasure to the miserable. (Good)
{@b Art.} I see my work as a form of self-expression, and reject moralizers. (Chaotic)
{@b Manipulation.} Prostitution gives me access to many secrets and opportunities for blackmail. (Evil)
{@b Devotion.} Prostitution is a sacred duty in my religion and a critical part of my faith. (Neutral)
{@b Wealth.} Work is work. I'm in demand, and it makes me rich easily. (Any)
I will use my connections to climb to the top of the social and economic ladder.
I will open my own brothel, and ensure prostitutes who work for me live safely and comfortably.
I have a keepsake of a client I was once close to. I can't bear the thought of losing it.
Once I have enough money to live comfortably, I will quit this lifestyle and never return.
A client humiliated or even assaulted me, and I will avenge myself.
I care about the others I work with like my own family.
I assume any kindness or courtesy I receive is motivated by lust.
I think the best of my clients too easily, which in my career is naive and dangerous.
I care only about the coin provided, not the duties or dangers of my job.
I have fallen into other self-destructive habits like gambling and addiction.
I am crass and crude about my encounters, and like to bring them up in inappropriate situations.
I will do anything to undercut the competition.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Nature}, {@skill Medicine}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Herbalism kit|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Honourable, Subtle

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: The Amaranth Syndicate medallion, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Ear to the Ground
entries: You are in frequent contact with the Amaranth Syndicate. These people can be found all around Adoya, but mostly in the larger cities. This connection comes in the form of a contact in any city you visit, a person who provides information about the people and places of the local area.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background Criminal} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your bounty hunter's traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a bounty hunter.

For instance, your bond might involve other bounty hunters or the individuals that employ you. Your ideal could be associated with your determination always to catch your quarry or your desire to maintain your reputation for being dependable.
You are a known member of the Amaranth Syndicate, the faction of bounty hunters. You have already completed many bounties and have recently earned a promotion to become a Prowler.

name: Public Intellectual

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of two of the following: {@skill History}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Religion}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of one set of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} or a {@item disguise kit|PHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a set of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} or a {@item disguise kit|PHB}, one tool of your craft (such as a {@item writing kit|Arcadia9}, a religious item, an {@item Musical Instrument|PHB|instrument}, or a {@item Costume Clothes|PHB|costume}), and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries: You're known for speaking out against—or in favor of—a regime, political organization, religious body, or other entity that holds state power. Perhaps you're a dissident or even an exile (work with the GM to figure out what fits best in your campaign). Your mastery of political science, ethics, and philosophy allows you to express complex ideas about governance, political systems, and history with ease. Perhaps you wrote and distributed tracts and pamphlets urging people to recognize a particular injustice. You might be a clergy member who gives weekly sermons about this or that law, policy, or ruler. Maybe you're a creator whose art contains subtle (or not-so-subtle) critiques of those in power. Work with your GM to determine what kind of reputation you have.

entries.name: Feature: Your Reputation Precedes You
entries: People are familiar with your work and recognize you on sight. Some are eager to show their respect, while others consider you a nuisance or even a threat. This minor celebrity allows you access to places and people that might not otherwise be afforded to you, such as a noble court; the chambers of elected officials, community leaders, or clergy members; an elite social club; or a secret hideout.

entries.name: Medium
entries: YYour medium determines how you get your message to your audience. Roll or choose from the table below, or work with your GM to come up with an idea that isn't on the table.

rows: Art (novels, plays, poetry, or visual art)
Performance (acting, dance, or music)
Scholarly writing
Public speaking
Sermons
Community leadership

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Public intellectuals spend their time thinking critically and deeply, reflecting, and analyzing. They generally have an area of expertise and spend their time generating writing or art to share their analyses and opinions. They can be fiery and intense or quiet and reflective. They might be stubbornly opinionated or open-minded and curious. Either way, they're passionate about ideas and analysis. See the tables in the Personal Characteristics section below for more ideas.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of common or fine clothes, a musical instrument (one of your choice), a symbol of your punkness (mirrorshades, anarchy earrings, spiked gloves), and a credit stick with 1500 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Rabble Rouser
entries: When you perform, you can always attract a crowd. If you perform well, you can make the crowd rowdy, or even make them start rioting if they're predisposed to do so. Additionally, you always know someone willing to sell you explosives.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Punk rockers have a reputation of going against the grain of society. Paradoxically, this means that a punk rocker's characteristics may be decided by the society they inhabit. A punk rocker who is not against the establishment is just a popstar.

rows: My personal volume setting is always at '11'.
I have a stage presence that is at odds with my normal demeanor.
I am larger than life in every way I can be.
People fear me, and they should.
I'm at the center of a roiling storm of fury, joy, and confusion.
I'm stoic and imposing.
Let's be real: the best part is the sex and drugs.
I know a song for every situation.
{@bold Anger.} People think they're better than me. I'll take them down a notch. (Chaotic)
{@bold Leader.} I can bring about real change through my music. (Good)
{@bold Nihilist.} The world is corrupt, and it needs to fucking burn. (Evil)
{@bold Rockstar.} Whatever else happens, I want to be rich and famous. (Neutral)
{@bold Troupe.} Me and my bandmates can take on the world. (Any)
{@bold Anarchy.} Anarchy! Anarchy! Anarchy! (Chaotic)
My band and I went through a bad breakup. If we could have just one reunion tour...
I was arrested for a crime I didn't commit because I pissed off some rich shithead.
I need to find the ultimate instrument for a showdown with a devil.
I replaced the previous lead member of my band, and now they hate me.
I put on the worst performance of my life, and I will never live it down.
While high, I came up with the greatest song, then forgot it. I must find it again.
I'm a loose cannon and I love it.
I get in a lot of arguments. Some might say too many, but they're wrong.
I'm constantly binging and purging something.
Don't you know who I am?
I get irrationally mad when people try to tell me what to do.
I am constantly playing music.

entries.name: Variant Feature: Roadies
entries: If your character has a punk rocker background, you may select this background feature instead of Rabble Rouser.

You have three roadies who assist you out of devotion to your music or your cause. These roadies can perform a variety of tasks. They can be your hype men, take care of your instruments and set up for concerts, or act as backup performers in a pinch. Though they are loyal, they are not sheeple, and will not willingly go into combat or die for you. If you treat them like shit, they might abandon you.

Society is corrupt, people are callous and hateful, and the man is always trying to keep you down. It's enough to drive a person crazy, except the whole world is already crazy. This broken civilization needs rebels who are willing to stand up and scream at the top of their lungs that something is wrong.

Half the battle is looking the part. Typically, you might wear slick black leather covered in spikes, have flashing LED tattoos all over your body, and wear your bright pink mohawk proudly. Of course, what's more important is breaking the norms of society and rebelling against the status quo to inspire others. In the heart of every oppressed office drone is the spark of anarchy, just waiting to be kindled.

name: Raised By Yokai
entries: You were not raised among your kin. Yours was a childhood of magic, adventure, and isolation from others of your kind, for you were raised by a yokai spirit. It could be that you were abandoned by your parents, that your people were lost in a kaiju rampage, or that you followed a mesmerising creature deep into the jungle.

The circumstances of how you came to find your yokai family may not be known to you, but you owe your life to their protection and guidance. Perhaps they sustained you with magic, taught you to forage, or stole things they thought you might need from travelling caravans. In their care, you have come to know magic that no other Humanoid has seen and know the world to be singing with all manner of incredible, invisible life.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) A {@item dagger|PHB}, a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}, 2 {@item pouch|PHB|pouches}, {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a {@item lamp|PHB}, a vial of {@item Basic Poison|PHB}, a rare gem worth 10 gp; or (B) 50 gp

entries.name: Optional Feature: Natural Envoy
entries: You grew up surrounded by yokai and understand their ways and quirks better than most. You have advantage on ability checks to peacefully interact with Beasts and Yokai.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Being raised apart from the rest of the world has its benefits. You have learned much of the natural world and its secrets but know very little of Humanoid societies. It is easy to feel a little out of place entering a new world of cities, laws, money, and property, but there are great wonders to discover as well, such as bonds of fellowship, community, and romance.

rows: I revere the natural world, finding tremendous delight in even the simplest aspects of nature.
I care little for fancy foods or exuberance. I am baffled by the obsession with money shared by most Humanoids.
I prefer the company of animals and spirits. I find other people tiresome and dull.
Having grown up surrounded by magic, I am extremely difficult to impress. Even the most dazzling displays of power from great wizards and sorcerers seem utterly mundane.
Having been raised outside of typical societies, I am acutely aware of my unfamiliarity with most customs and go to tremendous lengths to avoid offending people.
I become anxious and fidgety if I spend too long sitting or lying down, especially while indoors.
Family. I want to reconnect with my kin; I am searching for my people and discovering my history.
Unity. I have seen firsthand the patience and kindness of spirits. I wish to bring the material and spiritual realms closer together, creating a more harmonious world.
Power. I grew up around powerful magic, and I'm looking for more.
Independence. I don't care what anyone else thinks or does. I didn't need them before, and I don't need them now. I'm on my own incredible journey, and they're lucky to have a cameo in it.
Kindness. I survived due to the nurture and protection of gentle yokai. I wish to extend that same gift of kindness to others.
Mischief. I've embraced my chaotic life, and I take great pleasure in spreading a little chaos wherever I go.
My familiar and I share a bond so deep that we can't survive without each other.
Unbeknownst to me, my direct kin are famous, wealthy, and looking for me.
I trust the yokai who raised me more than any Humanoid ally.
The yokai who raised me departed this world when I came of age. Now I search for where they went.
My true kin were killed by a mysterious organisation, leaving me an orphan. I'm hunting them down to inflict retribution.
I have strange dreams of kin I've never known being snatched away. I love my yokai family, but I'm secretly beginning to wonder if I was stolen by them as a child.
The letter of the law means absolutely nothing to me; I am guided solely by my own moral compass.
I hide my past, fearing I'll never truly fit in with other people.
I believe myself to be better than others; having been raised by yokai, I've witnessed magical feats that most could never dream of.
I am very slow to trust Humanoids and find it hard to take them at their word.
I am extremely swift to anger when I believe someone has disrespected nature or the spirits that dwell therein.
I put too much faith in my own abilities; I believe myself to be almost invincible.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose two from among one type of {@item gaming set|PHB}, {@item tattooist's tools|PS-Kg}, {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}, and {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=|type=vehicle (land)|category=}

items.entry: Your choice of {@item tattooist's tools|PS-Kg} or a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}, one {@item gaming set|PHB}, an oni mask, a dark set of {@item common clothes|PHB} including a hood or straw hat, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Reckoning
entries: No matter where you go, your tattoos mark you as a member of a reckoner gang. You can get away with minor criminal offenses, such as refusing to pay for food at a restaurant or breaking down a door at a local shop, if no legal authorities witness the crime. Most people are too daunted by you to report your wrongdoing to the Imperials.

entries.caption: Reckoner Gangs
rows: Dokuchi — A ninja gang that silences and strikes from shadow
Hyozan — Specialize in poisons, illegal enhancements, and magic tattoos
Mukotai — Tech users that specialize in stealth and subterfuge
Okiba — An exclusively nezumi biker gang

entries: The reckoner gangs of Kamigawa are ancient and feared. Perhaps you joined them seeking glory, or perhaps it was a necessity to survive in the Undercity. Your tattoos now mark you, with respect if you climb their ranks, or as a traitor if you try to leave.

_.displayName: Vestments and a holy symbol of your previous cult

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Vestments and a {@item holy symbol|phb} of your previous cult, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Wicked Awareness
entries: Your time worshipping in secrecy and shadow at the altar of malevolent forces has left you with insight and keen awareness to those who still operate in such ways. You can often spot hidden signs, messages, and signals left in populated places. If actively seeking signs of a cult or dark following, you have an easier time locating and decoding the signs or social interactions that signify cult activity, gaining advantage on any ability checks to discover such details.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background Acolyte} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to match your ties to your intent on fleeing your past and rectifying your future. Your bond is likely associated with those who gave you the insight and strength to flee your old ways. Your ideal probably involves your wishing to take down and destroy those who promote the dark ways you escaped, and perhaps finding new faith in a forgiving god.

Since the Divergence, the influence of the Betrayer Gods was sealed away with the rest of the pantheon and a time of religious rediscovery began anew. Through the small net of the Divine Gate, however, the will of the darker deities could still reach out, could still whisper and promise. The rise of cults are scattered and separated, with little to no unity between the greater evils. Hidden hierarchies of power-hungry mortals corrupt and seduce, promising a sliver of the same power they had been promised when the time comes to reap their harvest.

You once belonged to such a cult. Perhaps it was brief, embracing the rebellious spirit of youth and curious where this path may take you. You also may have felt alone and lost, this community offering a welcome you had been subconsciously seeking. It's possible you were raised from the beginning to pray to the gods of shadow and death. Then one day the veil was lifted and the cruel truth shook your faith, sending you running from the false promises and seeking redemption.
You have been freed from the bindings of these dangerous philosophies, but few secret societies find comfort until those who abandon their way are rotting beneath the soil.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Disguise Kit|PHB}, {@item Steel Mirror|PHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.entry: Increase one of your starting ability scores by 2 and another by 1, or increase three scores by 1 each.

items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB}, {@item Mirror|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

_.displayName: a holy symbol of your previous cult

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Vestments and a {@item holy symbol|phb} of your previous cult, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Fell Teachings
entries: You were inundated with knowledge about one of the {@book Betrayer Gods|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Betrayer Gods}, and know by heart everything from their basic commandments to some of their most esoteric secrets. Choose one of the {@book Betrayer Gods|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Betrayer Gods}. You have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) checks to know information about their faith, including obscure secrets unknown to most worshipers.

Additionally, you can work with your GM to create a secret that you learned during your time in the cult. This secret might be the seed of a conspiracy, a myth of a legendary hero whose true meaning has mutated over the years, or even the location of a fabled artifact of the gods.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The life of every former cultist is defined to some degree by the process of fleeing the past, and of trying to make a future away from the beliefs that once claimed them. Your bond is likely associated with those who gave you the insight and strength to flee your old ways. Your ideal might involve your desire to take down and destroy those who promote the evil you escaped, and perhaps finding new faith in a forgiving god.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Personality Traits
rows: I need a {@item dagger|phb} close at hand at all times. Just in case they find me.
I can't believe I'm out here fighting monsters. After everything I've been through, why can't I find a normal life?
I need a stiff drink before I do anything stressful these days. I know it's a problem. Just...let me have this.
Murder is okay when it's for a good cause! I didn't tear my past out by the roots so I could let evil people cause more harm.
My past is filled with stories like you wouldn't believe. Ones that'll really make your skin crawl. Do you want to hear...?
Yeah, I'm crying. I do that. Get over yourself.
I know you've told me your name twice already, but that's not good enough. How can I be sure you are who you say you are?
My mind is always racing. I can't...I just need to...you have to give me a second—or else I can't...organize my thoughts.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Ideals
rows: {@b Life}. I've spent too long shackled to an evil master. No matter what happened before, I deserve my freedom now. (Chaotic)
{@b Redemption}. People can change, but redemption must be something they choose for themselves. If they do, it is my duty to help them along that path. (Good)
{@b Power}. When I abandoned the cult, it wasn't out of some misguided sense of righteousness. That pathetic organization was merely a shackle on my potential. (Evil)
{@b Vengeance}. The cult has poisoned my life. I will see all its followers suffer. (Any)
{@b Hierarchy}. The cult was vile, but its strength was in stability and organization. As long as good folk lack unity, evil will always triumph. (Lawful)
{@b Reparations}. As a cultist, I harmed people whose names I'll never know. I feel obligated to repay my debt by aiding others. (Good)

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Bonds
rows: My cousin escaped the cult with me. I lost track of them when we fled, but I know they're alive. I can feel it.
I was saved from the cult by a priest of one of the {@book Prime Deities|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Prime Deities}. If not for that sign of faith, I would surely be lost.
I was told by the person who saved me that a sage once said: "Life needs things to live." I don't know what that means, but I've dedicated my existence to finding out.
One of my cultist parents had a change of heart when I was a teenager, and we fled together in the dark of night. I didn't want to leave, but I understand now that their courage saved my life.
I was bested by a warrior when I fumbled a cult-ordered assassination. I don't know why that person took pity on me, but they gave me purpose when I was lost.
Now that I've saved myself, the only person important to me is my former cult leader—because I've sworn that they'll die by my hand.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Flaws
rows: I'm haunted by what I saw in those ritual chambers. Every time I see blood, I...oh, gods, I can't bear to even think about it.
I ran from the cult long ago. But deep down, there's a part of me that still thinks they were right about certain things.
I can't help but feel a rush whenever I see a life snuffed out before me. Just one more kill... just one more.

Organized religion terrifies me. {@book Betrayer Gods|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Betrayer Gods} or {@book Prime Deities|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Prime Deities}...it doesn't matter. The sight of the faithful freezes my blood cold.
Oh, I always tell the truth. Always. I've never had to keep a secret from anyone, so of course I'll be open with you.
I don't trust easily. If you grew up being lied to about every little thing? The fundamental nature of the world? You wouldn't, either.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB}, {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}, Bag of Trinkets from Travels, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: Valikan raiders search for many things: food, goods, weapons, and thralls. You were one of those taken by the clans because you had skills that the clan lacked in their cold northern home. Once you arrived, you were given a choice: join the clan or find your own way home. You chose the latter. You then had to find your way through the cold and dangerous lands of Valika—and whatever other lands separated you from your home.
You had to be ever watchful of other threats, hiding when danger presented itself. No place is safe, and you must take every opportunity to advance toward your goals.

name: Resistance Veteran

_: a souvenir from your battles for the Resistance (a Khadoran insignia, a charred coin, etc.)
a set of common clothes with a dark hooded cape

entries: Whether you were a loyal citizen of Llael or a Cygnaran soldier fighting for Llael's independence, you were trapped in southeast Llael after the fall of the capital. You spent many long, bleak years fighting but never gave up the dream of restoring the nation.

entries.name: Feature: Underground Networks
entries: You have first-hand knowledge of the secrets a city can hold and know how to communicate with the many underground elements found in urban settings. While you are in an urban area, you have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to find information about the location of black markets, criminal enterprises such as smuggling rings, and other similar subversive aspects of a city. While you are in Llael, you double your proficiency bonus for these checks.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Veterans of the Resistance tend to be driven individuals. Their drive to realize their ideals borders on obsession, if not outright mania. Although pragmatic or even cynical, they care deeply for their fellows and all who are oppressed.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I have great faith that we ordinary people can overcome any hardship if we all work together.
I am and always have been a realist. The occupation of Llael only solidified my outlook.
I have a lackadaisical attitude, but it is merely cover for my scheming nature.
When forced into a leadership role during the Resistance, command came naturally to me.
I never trust those with authority; instead, I work under them only out of necessity.
For anything done in the name of the greater good, the ends always justify the means.
After seeing the horrors of war, I have come to view violence as a last resort.
I am always optimistic and happy, even when faced with difficult circumstances.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Change. The old world is gone. It is time to make a new one. (Chaotic)
People. The people who struggled by my side matter much more than ideals. (Neutral)
Tradition. If we do not preserve what remains of our culture, we will forget who we truly are. (Lawful)
Obligation. My people have suffered. I fight every day so that they will never go through such pain again. (Good)
Punishment. Some of those responsible for our suffering have yet to be punished for their actions, but I will see to it that they are. (Evil)
Reconstruction. One way or another, I'll see my home return to its former glory. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: During the occupation, I was secretly working for a deposed politician who now has power again.
I was tasked with assassinating a Khadoran official. I succeeded, but that person's family now knows my name and face and has sworn to claim vengeance.
I was a government official before the occupation, but after everything was taken from me, I gave up my old identity entirely.
While on a mission into occupied Llael, I took several street urchins under my wing. To this day, I still look after them.
I lost track of my sibling during the occupation and the Claiming. I hope one day we will be reunited.
When I first joined the Resistance, a grizzled veteran taught me the ropes. I still owe this old-timer a great deal.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I have become irrevocably scarred after watching the massacre of my friends and family during the Claiming.
I am deeply devoted to the idea that embracing anarchy is the only way to truly claim one's freedom.
I have a troubling vice in alcohol and an addictive personality.
I lie so often, not even I can unravel all the untruths anymore.
There can be no peace until vengeance has been wrought in full. Those who do not understand this are naive.
I can't resist a pretty face.

name: Retired Adventurer

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: {@item fishing tackle|phb}, a set of traveler's clothes, a {@item bedroll|phb}, a small lockbox containing 10gp, a keepsake of a loved one, and 3 days worth of rations.

entries: In your prime you were a great adventurer. After years of inactivity, the call to Adventure causes you raise arms once again in hopes of restoring the world back to its proper place.

entries.name: Feature: Dreams Of Morrow
entries: You often dream about your goals and may have premonitions about the future. When you sleep your dreams will be numerous. These dreams will fill you with the strength needed to face the new day. You can find comfort even on the bare earth as long as the warmth of a campfire brings you solace.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies

entries.name: Feature: C-List Celebrity
entries: Whenever you are in a civilized area that knows of your past adventures, you can live an aristocratic lifestyle for free as people wish to honor your past deeds. You can also use your influence to gain audiences with important political figures and get random gifts from admiring fans. However if you choose to use your influence in this way, it also alerts anyone in the area looking for you of your location and draws attention to your party.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As a voice of experience in your party, you know the danger of the road you walk. You understand when to be cautious and when it is time to take a risk. You have the right advice, warnings, and stories for all situations. Even if you don't know what you're doing, your past makes others look to you for leadership.

rows: I have no idea how to tell a short story.
I'm sure of my first instincts and always act on them.
Anyone younger than I am needs my advice.
I don't enjoy physical contact with others unless it is my fist in their faces.
I show my numerous scars to help drive points home.
When I laugh, the volume of my voice fills up the entire room.
Nothing pleases me more than a good meal, good company, and job well done.
I often correct others when their lack of manners offends me.
{@b Generosity}. Everything I have I share with those around me and in need. (Good)
{@b Good Times}. I take advantage of every opportunity to have fun. (Chaotic)
{@b Power}. Those who don't tremble at my name will have reason enough to do so soon. (Evil)
{@b Logic}. Emotions shouldn't make decisions for us. (Lawful)
{@b Greater Good}. I would gladly give my life to defend those who can't defend themselves. (Good)
{@b Live and Let Live}. Just because we disagree doesn't mean we have to kill each other. (Neutral)
I never found that magic item I wanted in my early career.
There's more than a few broken hearts in my past.
There is an inn I frequent where no one knows about my past life and I'd like to keep it that way.
I can't go back to the town I accidentally partially leveled.
My old adventuring companions get together now and then to relive the good old days.
A famous song is actually about one of my greatest battles.
I don't take the advice of others because I know best always
Violence solves most problems.
Ale is my very, very best friend.
I really don't know when to shut up.
I tend to fall asleep at times when I should be alert.
I am sarcastic at all times, especially when least appropriate.

entries: You lived a life of adventure already and retired to something quieter. You thought you were done and to that end may have given away all your old gear and spent all your treasure. Little did you know something would pull you back into your old life. If you choose this background, you have some exciting questions to answer.

You determine what your past looked like. What adventures have you already had? How much time did you spend adventuring before retirement? Who was your most-hated enemy? Who did you adventure with? Why did you hang it up?

Something happened that made you lose your edge and finely honed adventuring skills. Has age or luxurious retirement made you soft? Did a physical or magical accident take some abilities from you? Did a supernatural force steal your mojo?

You have decided to walk the road of adventure once again. Why? Was it because you ran out of gold and want to earn some more the only way you know how? Did you become restless in retirement and are now seeking the thrill of battle? Are you out to prove you can still live up to your legend? Are you out for vengeance? A noble quest? To tie up one final lose end you didn't realize until now was undone? Whatever the reason, you're back on the road and ready to dive into another dungeon.

name: Retribution of Scyrah

_: a ring with a concealed Retribution of Scyrah emblem

entries: You are one of the Iosan zealots who believe that human arcanists' eradication will restore your gods. Your devotion to the Retribution of Scyrah is certain, no matter how you served.

entries.name: Feature: Intense Training
entries: Members of the Retribution undergo intensive training that breaks them down and remakes them into weapons for their gods. Whenever you make a skill check using tools you are proficient with and spend at least 10 minutes working on the task, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Firm resolve is a hallmark of most members of the Retribution, but this steadfast determination can blind them to alternative ways of thinking. By keeping themselves moving toward their goal, members of the Retribution hope to outpace the cruel reality of their situation.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: Since birth, I have had a hard time expressing nearly any emotion.
For anything done in the name of the greater good, the ends always justify the means.
I have a short temper.
I am incredibly dedicated. Once I set a goal, I will do everything in my power to attain it.
I tend to be too serious for my own good.
I have always found it easier to lie than to be honest.
I find dangerous situations exhilarating.
Performing my duties with precision is extremely important to me.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Obedience. Following the orders of those above us keeps us all safe. (Lawful)
Duty. I swore an oath to fight until my last breath. I will not betray it. (Lawful)
Nation. Ios and its people are all that matter. (Any)
Vengeance. I seek to bring death to those who have sullied Scyrah. (Evil)
Comrades. My loyalties lie with my comrades in arms, not with any code of ethics. (Neutral)
Discipline. I am extremely disciplined when it comes to honing my martial prowess. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: A swordmaster taught me my skills at a young age. I still look up to this teacher.
A particular human mage has eluded me but will fall to my blade one day.
When I first joined the Retribution, I angered a superior officer, who still has it in for me.
I joined the Retribution in order to be seen as a hero to my people.
All I do with my free time is train.
I fight to honor the memory of a close comrade in arms.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I follow any order even if, deep down, I know it is wrong.
I try to hide it, but I delight in violence.
I stay and fight even when all hope is lost.
My great pride in myself borders on hubris.
I will have my revenge on anyone who sullies my honor.
Ever since the Claiming, I have secretly been losing faith that the gods can be restored.

name: Retribution Remnant
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} The Claiming came and, with it, the end of your gods. With the road ahead uncertain and Ios now a kingdom of the dead ruled by eldritch, the only option was back out into the badlands and on to make some sort of life as soldiers with no kingdom or gods.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: All members are presumed to be Iosans, with most being former members of the Retribution of Scyrah, though such companies may have accepted members from other races and kingdoms.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Your company's prestige increases through acts such as: recovering an Iosan myrmidon; recovering an Iosan cortex; finding some sign of the elven gods' return; defeating a major raiding party attacking Iosan refugees; negotiating a favorable mercenary contract.

entries.name: Tier 1 — Echoes of Scyrah
entries: {@b Arcanist Armorer.} You receive a 10 percent discount on costs to repair your weapons and gear with a trusted arcanist weaponsmith.

{@b Mercenary Charter.} Your company holds a mercenary charter allowing you to legally fight within the borders of the Iron Kingdoms. The charter details civilian treatment, loot distribution, and contract obligations. Contracts are worth no more than 200 gp at this tier.
{@b Sellswords.} You can go looking for contracts as a downtime activity. Gathering such information costs {@dice 1d4} gp per day for {@dice 1d4} days.

entries.name: Tier 2 — Shadows of Scyrah
entries: {@b Forgotten of Scyrah.} You gain your choice of {@dice 1d6} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1/2 or lower, or a myrmidon with a challenge rating of 4 or lower that will require time and money to bring up to full working order.

{@b Mementos of Scyrah.} An Iosan arcanist who finishes a long rest at camp and meditates in the presence of the relics can choose one spell of 1st or 2nd level and replace it with another from the warcaster spell list, or produce a spell engine that can generate {@dice 1d4} 2nd-level spells.

entries.name: Tier 3 — Wraiths of Scyrah
entries: {@b Eyes of Lacyr.} When you make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you have advantage on the roll. You can't use this effect again until you finish a short or long rest.
{@b Trained Soldiers.} You gain {@dice 1d10} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1 or lower who act as privates and {@dice 1d4} hirelings with a challenge rating of 2 or lower who act as sergeants.

entries.name: Tier 4 — Remembrance of Scyrah
entries: {@b Beacon of Ios.} When interacting with others, you can replace Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks with Intelligence (Religion) checks.

{@b Militant Order.} You gain {@dice 1d10} hirelings with a challenge rating of 2 or lower and {@dice 1d4} hirelings with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. In place of half the hirelings, you can choose to gain a myrmidon with a challenge rating of 4 or lower.

entries.name: Quirks
entries: Roll or choose a quirk: (1) You have a few books from the city of Shyrr detailing operas you once saw there; (2) Your company is made up of members from numerous houses of Ios bound together as refugees; (3) You have skorne artifacts, including an oculus, in your collection of loot; (4) All members wear small slivers of white marble with blue veins cut from a stone from the Great Fane of Lacyr; (5) You have a patron who funds your company in return for loyalty and aid; (6) Your company resides in an Iosan outpost haunted by one of the riven; (7) The last of a noble bloodline died in battle leading some of your company—you have taken on their name; (8) Your company includes some Nyss elves and the two peoples exchange culture and expertise; (9) The loss of your gods has turned you toward Dhunia or the Wurm; (10) You have a contact within the borders of Ios and await the right time to claim a cache of weapons.

name: Revolutionary

_.displayName: book of history from your homeland

_.special: small brooch or pin bearing an insignia

entries: You are someone who has felt the spark of revolution within you. You are brave, and know that a change is needed for society to progress. It could be that there is an oligarchy or dictatorship that has your homeland under harsh rule. Or, it could be that the social and political systems of your country are failing to change with the times.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine the nature of your revolutionary position, how others are reacting to these views, and what impact your views have had so far. Is it the case that you are one of many, and there is a revolution currently underway? Or is it the case that you are one of the few who think this way, and the road ahead will be a difficult one?

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a {@item dagger|phb}, a {@item book|phb} of history from your homeland, a flag or banner, a small brooch or pin bearing an insignia, and a small {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: One of the People
entries: Your connection to other revolutionaries gives you a feel of how the populace, or at least a part of them, are feeling. You can easily find outposts and hidden groups who are a part of or are similar to your revolution and its ideals, and you can pick out the places of underground political activity in a community.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Those who hold onto and act upon revolutionary ideas are going to face many obstacles in their lives. Even if many feel the same, there are those, particularly those in power, who will try to stop you. This leads many revolutionaries to hold a specific world view.

rows: I often read books about politics and economics.
I live life in the moment, knowing that any day could be my last.
I actually have no personal quarrel with those in power, but the system has to change.
I despise any type of nobility or royalty.
I know that there are both good and bad people in every walk of life.
If you want to know anything about my homelands culture, I am the one to go to.
I am most at home when amongst the common folk.
I am joyous with my friends, and harsh to those in power.
Change. I will try everything I can to bring about a new paradigm in my homeland. (Any)
Anarchy. The current system does not work, yet none will. (Chaotic)
Defiance. The current leaders do nothing to help those in need. I aim to change that. (Good)
Spite. I aim to overthrow the rules of my land purely because I do not like them. (Evil)
Catalyst. I know the current system doesn't work, but I don't care or know what system will replace it. (Neutral)
Revision. I aim to set forth a new system that will help with all who live in my country. (Lawful)
I have a close friend who is a member of a royal family.
I am secretly the illegitimate child of one of the leaders.
I will live to see change happen, or die trying.
I dream of a day where we can all live in peace again, though things must happen before that can be obtained.
My family was harmed by the rules of my homeland.
I have seen many of my close friends die in service to the cause.
I secretly doubt that any real change will happen.
I am slow to trust any outside of my close circle.
I am too trusting of some of the common folk.
I am suspicious of every guard, watchman, or noble.
I have an addiction.
I am quick to action, slow to words.

_.special: trinket from your time in Riedra

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A trinket from your time in Riedra, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a set of artisan's tools (your choice), a {@item knife|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 {@item gold|PHB}.

entries.name: Why Did You Leave?
entries: For all the horrors that Riedra inflicts upon its people — the lack of privacy, intense social control, lack of choice and free will — there are many benefits. No one goes hungry. People are safe from war and disease. Everyone has a bed to sleep in and clean clothes to wear. For many in Riedra, this is enough — why wasn't it for you? You can select a Tipping Point below or roll randomly, then add details to determine your former place in Riedran society.

entries.caption: Tipping Points
rows: You learned who really rules Riedra, and you fled before anyone could find out.
You were part of a rebel group that was infiltrated by the Thousand Eyes. Everyone in your sect is now dead.
You developed sorcerous magic, and you know you wouldn't live long if someone found out.
Someone you loved vanished — and you know they will never return.
An Adaran saved your life, planting a seed of doubt into the motives of the Unity of Riedra.
You were a victim of Riedra's oppressive caste system, and you wanted to experience true freedom.

entries.name: Feature: Lingering Memories
entries: You are well-integrated into the cultural norms and practices of Riedra. You know how to act around Riedran guards and people in positions of authority, passing yourself off as a loyal member of society. If you are a changeling, people treat you with great respect. While other Sarlonans may trust you less, it is easier for you to blend into Riedran spaces, and you will be questioned far less than an outsider.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: As a Riedran refugee, you are starting from scratch. How has your time away from the Unity changed you? What do you miss? With every choice in the world now available, what do you even want to do?

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I am anxious around people with more authority than me.
I'm not about to be told what to do ever again.
Out of habit, I still give prayers to the il-altas to protect me.
I cling to people who can give me a sense of purpose.
Injustice and oppression make me violently angry — emphasis on the violently.
I used to have status, and the lack of automatic respect has been jarring at best.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Freedom.} I will never trade security for personal choice ever again. (Chaotic)
{@b Righteousness.} Free of Riedra, I've been given a chance to try and make my world better. (Good)
{@b Safety.} The most important thing is that I live long enough to enjoy my new home. (Neutral)
{@b Devastation.} Riedra deserves to burn to the ground, and I don't care who gets hurt in the process. (Evil)
{@b Revelry.} I have been given the chance to be myself, and I am living life to its fullest. (Good)
{@b Rebellion.} There are people still worth fighting for in Riedra. (Good)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: A good friend of mine is still in Riedra, and I want to try and get them out.
I would do anything to protect my newfound refugee community.
I stole something important from an Inspired — and I know I'm hunted by the Thousand Eyes.
My birth parents fled Riedra long ago, and I want to find out if they made it out alive.
I need to pay back the Summit Guide who got me out.
The Inspired and the Thousand Eyes killed someone I knew well; revenge will not be enough for me.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I have no idea how to advocate for myself.
My illiteracy doesn't help me on the best of days.
I panic if I am given orders, even by a close friend.
I still think the people around me are dealing with demons.
The lack of structure fills me with choice paralysis.
I hold little sympathy for the people I left behind; they are little better than sheep to me.

items.name: Specialty
entries: To determine the nature of your scholarly training, roll a d8 or choose from the options in the table below.

rows: Alchemist
Astronomer
Discredited academic
Librarian
Professor
Researcher
Wizard's apprentice
Scribe

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You spent your formative years traveling between manors and monasteries, performing various odd jobs and services in exchange for access to their libraries. You whiled away many a long evening studying books and scrolls, learning the lore of the multiverse—even the rudiments of magic—and your mind yearns for more.

Sages are defined by their extensive studies, and their characteristics reflect this life of study. Devoted to scholarly pursuits, a sage values knowledge highly—sometimes in its own right, sometimes as a means toward other ideals.

rows: I was naturally curious, so I packed up and went to a university to learn more about the world.
My mentor's teachings opened my mind to new possibilities in that field of study.
I was always an avid reader, and I learned much about my favorite topic on my own.
I discovered an old library and pored over the texts I found there. That experience awakened a hunger for more knowledge.
I impressed a wizard who told me I was squandering my talents and should seek out an education to take advantage of my gifts.
One of my parents or a relative gave me a basic education that whetted my appetite, and I left home to build on what I had learned.
I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.
I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries—or I like to boast that I have.
I'm used to helping out those who aren't as smart as I am, and I patiently explain anything and everything to others.
There's nothing I like more than a good mystery.
I'm willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment.
I... speak... slowly... when talking... to idiots,... which... almost... everyone... is... compared... to me.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I'm convinced that people are always trying to steal my secrets.
Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)
Beauty. What is beautiful points us beyond itself toward what is true. (Good)
Logic. Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking. (Lawful)
No Limits. Nothing should fetter the infinite possibility inherent in all existence. (Chaotic)
Power. Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Evil)
Self-Improvement. The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)
It is my duty to protect my students.
I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets that must not fall into the wrong hands.
I work to preserve a library, university, scriptorium, or monastery.
My life's work is a series of tomes related to a specific field of lore.
I've been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
I sold my soul for knowledge. I hope to do great deeds and win it back.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
Most people scream and run when they see a demon. I stop and take notes on its anatomy.
Unlocking an ancient mystery is worth the price of a civilization.
I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.
I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
I can't keep a secret to save my life, or anyone else's.

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Sailors can be a rough lot, but the responsibilities of life on a ship make them generally reliable as well. Life aboard a ship shapes their outlook and forms their most important attachments.

You lived as a seafarer, wind at your back and decks swaying beneath your feet. You've perched on barstools in more ports of call than you can remember, faced mighty storms, and swapped stories with folk who live beneath the waves.

rows: I was press-ganged by pirates and forced to serve on their ship until I finally escaped.
I wanted to see the world, so I signed on as a deck-hand for a merchant ship.
One of my relatives was a sailor who took me to sea.
I needed to escape my community quickly, so I stowed away on a ship. When the crew found me, I was forced to work for my passage.
Reavers attacked my community, so I found refuge on a ship until I could seek vengeance.
I had few prospects where I was living, so I left to find my fortune elsewhere.
My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.
I work hard so that I can play hard when the work is done.
I enjoy sailing into new ports and making new friends over a flagon of ale.
I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
My language is as foul as an otyugh nest.
I like a job well done, especially if I can convince someone else to do it.
Respect. The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)
Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)
Freedom. The sea is freedom—the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)
Mastery. I'm a predator, and the other ships on the sea are my prey. (Evil)
People. I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)
Aspiration. Someday, I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)
I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.
The ship is most important—crewmates and captains come and go.
I'll always remember my first ship.
In a harbor town, I have a paramour whose eyes nearly stole me from the sea.
I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.
Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmates, plundered our ship, and left me to die. Vengeance will be mine.
I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
I can't help but pocket loose coins and other trinkets I come across.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Backpack|XPHB}, {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (jumpsuit), {@item Wrenchinator|DarkMatter24}, 4 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: With a ship and a bit of luck, you scavenged derelict ships and crash sites for components and cargo. Each job was perilous in its own way, from ships infested with husks, to pirate attacks, to Dark Matter engines on the verge of implosion. Too often, the best loot is within an utter deathtrap. Salvage work taught you how to spot treasure among trash, how to notice when a ship is too quiet, and how to get out alive.

name: Salvager

_: a set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)
a small collection of salvaged items (gears, screws, springs, and so on)

entries: You are skilled in the art of salvaging material from junkyards, battlefields, and other abandoned places. You have spent years perfecting your craft, and you have a knack for repairing and repurposing discarded items in order to sell them to the highest bidder.

entries.name: Feature: Salvage Hunter
entries: Years of experience have given you a keen eye for spotting valuable items among piles of junk. When you enter a new area, you can quickly assess the value of any discarded items you come across and can determine which items are worth keeping and which aren't. Additionally, you have a network of contacts in the world of salvage, and you can use your knowledge to track down specific items or to connect with potential buyers.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I'm always looking for a hidden gem among the junk.
I'm always tinkering with something, even when I don't need to.
I'm a scavenger at heart, and I'm not afraid of a little digging.
I'm always looking for ways to improve my craft.
I'm patient and methodical in my work.
I'm a creature of habit who prefers to follow a set routine.
I like to keep my salvage to myself until the right buyer comes along.
I'm quick to jump on any opportunity to make a profit.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Innovation. I believe that anything can be salvaged and put to use with enough creativity and effort. (Lawful)
Profit. I'm always looking for a way to make a quick buck. (Neutral)
Exploration. I'm driven by my curiosity to explore the unknown. (Chaotic)
Preservation. I believe that we must preserve the past in order to move forward. (Good)
Greed. I'm not above taking advantage of someone's misfortune in order to get ahead. (Evil)
Resourcefulness. I'm used to making do with whatever I can find. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I owe my success to a mentor who taught me the ins and outs of salvaging.
I am always on the lookout for my next big score—the one that will set me up for life.
I'm searching for a rare item that I've been told will make me wealthy.
I'm on a mission to recover a lost family heirloom.
I have a rival who is always trying to one-up me.
I have a special bond with a particular item I've salvaged.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am always on the lookout for new salvage opportunities, even in the midst of danger.
I am always tinkering with something, even if it doesn't need fixing.
I hoard my salvage, even if it means denying others what they need.
I am never satisfied with my work and am always striving to improve.
I'm easily distracted by shiny objects.
I am paranoid about losing my salvage and will go to great lengths to protect it, even if that means hurting others.

entries: You don't do well with authority. You may have started with Arcanix or the Twelve, but you were thrown out after challenging the system one too many times. You're brilliant—but determined to find your own path.
