items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|type=artisan's tools|category=}, a token you found when you were revived, {@item common clothes|phb}, traveling cloak, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10gp.

entries.name: Do You Remember Your Past Life?
entries: Do you remember? Being reawakened, sometimes centuries after your own death can be a daunting task. Perhaps time has taken its toll. Perhaps you fully remember your past life. Or perhaps everything is just a vague mist.

entries.name: {@coinflip Do You Remember Your Past Life?||Yes|No}
Feature: The Line Between
entries: Common undead magic somehow does not work on you. Things such as a cleric's "Turn Undead" just doesn't work on you for some reason or another. This may be because of some part of the ritual or spell that revived you, or some other dark matter. Regardless, things that should often hurt undead often don't.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I often lie about my condition, even though I know what I am.
I often tell the blunt truth about my condition.
Those that pester me with questions will recieve blunt answers.
Insults directed at me get insults directed right back.
I judge people by their actions, not words.
Those like me have my upmost respect.
I hate every necromancer, regardless of if they're good or bad.
I often have trust issues, sometimes those sentiments are directed at my friends or traveling companions.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Life and Death. I find myself on the line between teh two. I will do whatever to preserve balance. (Lawful)
Undead. I am still me, regardless of my form. You are you and I am me. (Neutral)
Whatever. Just because I am undead doesn't mean I won't try to live my life out as normal. (Chaotic)
The Same. Those that frown upon me will understand my struggle. In time. In one way or another. (Evil)
Understanding. I strive to teach those around me of my predicament. We can live in harmony. (Good)
Survival. I will do anything to ensure the survival of myself and those that trust me. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: The one whom revived me brought me back in good faith. I will see to it they are repaid.
The one whom revived me brought me back in bad faith. They will pay for it.
I am from a long distant past, and my friends and family are all long dead.
I am a lover of someone currently, but they don't know my condition.
I am a patron of a disguise maker, and I owe them everything.
My condition is maintained until a condition is met. I will complete the terms of the deal.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I often pretend to be a full undead to scare people.
I often drink my past away.
I lose myself in the modern times.
I will go to great lengths to tell my full story.
I am haunted by the memories of my past.
I am often struck with moments of deja-vu. No idea why it happens.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of dice or deck of cards, a {@item shield|PHB} bearing your previous employer's symbol, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a {@item hooded lantern|PHB}, a {@item signal whistle|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Specialization
entries: Each person or location that hires a sentry comes with its own set of unique needs and responsibilities. As a sentry, you fulfilled one of these unique roles. Choose a specialization or roll a d6 and consult the table below to define your expertise as a sentry.

rows: City or gate watch
Bodyguard or jailor
Caravan guard
Palace or judicial sentry
Shop guard
Ecclesiastical or temple guard

entries.name: Feature: Comrades in Arms
entries: The knowing look from the caravan guard to the city gatekeeper or the nod of recognition between the noble's bodyguard and the district watchman — no matter the community, city, or town, the guards share a commonality of purpose. When you arrive in a new location, you can speak briefly with the gate guards, local watch, or other community guardians to gain local knowledge. This knowledge could be information, such as the most efficient routes through the city, primary vendors for a variety of luxury goods, the best (or worst) inns and taverns, the primary criminal elements in town, or the current conflicts in the community.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You're a person who understands both patience and boredom, as a guard is always waiting for something to happen. More often than not, sentries hope nothing happens because something happening usually means something has gone wrong. A life spent watching and protecting, acting in critical moments, and learning the details of places and behaviors; all of these help shape the personality of the former sentry. Some claim you never stop being a guard, you just change what you protect.

rows: I've seen the dregs of society and nothing surprises me anymore.
I know where to look to spot threats lurking around a corner, in a glance, and even in a bite of food or cup of drink.
I hate standing still and always keep moving.
My friends know they can rely on me to stand and protect them.
I resent the rich and powerful; they think they can get away with anything.
A deception of any sort marks you as untrustworthy in my mind.
Stopping lawbreakers taught me the best ways to skirt the law.
I never take anything at face-value.
{@bold Greed.} Threats to my companions only increase my glory when I protect them from it. (Evil)
{@bold Perception.} I watch everyone, for threats come from every rank or station. (Neutral)
{@bold Duty.} The laws of the community must be followed to keep everyone safe. (Lawful)
{@bold Community.} I am all that stands between my companions and certain doom. (Good)
{@bold Determination.} To truly protect others, you must sometimes break the law. (Chaotic)
{@bold Practicality.} I require payment for the protection or service I provide. (Any)
My charge is paramount; if you can't protect your charge, you've failed.
I was once saved by one of my fellow guards. Now I always come to my companions' aid, no matter what the threat.
My oath is unbreakable; I'd rather die first.
There is no pride equal to the accomplishment of a successful mission.
I stand as a bulwark against those who would damage or destroy society, and society is worth protecting.
I know that as long as I stand with my companions, things can be made right.
Sometimes I may overindulge in a guilty pleasure, but you need something to pass time.
I can't just sit quietly next to someone. I've got to fill the silence with conversation to make good company.
I'm not very capable in social situations. I'd rather sit on the sidelines and observe. People make me nervous.
I have a tough time trusting strangers and new people. You don't know their habits and behaviors; therefore, you don't know their risk.
There is danger all around us, and only the foolish let their guard down. I am no fool, and I will spot the danger.
I believe there's a firm separation between task and personal time. I don't do other people's work when I'm on my own time. If you want me, hire me.

entries: In your youth, the defense of the city, the community, the caravan, or your patron was how you earned your coin. You might have been trained by an old, grizzled city watchman, or you might have been pressed into service by the local magistrate for your superior skills, size, or intellect. However you came to the role, you excelled at defending others.

You have a nose for trouble, a keen eye for spotting threats, a strong arm to back it up, and you are canny enough to know when to act. Most importantly, though, you were a peace officer or a protector and not a member of an army which might march to war.

name: Servant
entries: You understand wealth, power, and privilege - you just never had any of it yourself. Those with noble titles, merchant empires, and large castles need people to take care of their day-to-day affairs, and you know that life well.

You lived -or live—your life in service to a family of middle or higher class. You are more familiar than most with the ins, outs, and back roads of the upper crust of society. Interacting with the rich and powerful has taught you much about their world and given you some keen and humble insights into human nature.

Work with your DM to determine your place of service in the world and the master who you've served. Are you an indentured servant, working off the final years of debt to an unkind master? Do you serve your master's family, just as your ancestors served them before you? Do you hope to rise in your position of service in the household over a number of years, or is this only temporary work for you?

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose two from {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Insight}, and {@skill Perception}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of serving clothes, a set of common clothes, a gaming set (your choice), a token of your service (e.g., embroidered napkin, contract of service, stolen silverware), and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Profession
entries: The serving duties of most households are in a hierarchy based on merit and years served.

rows: Butler
Housekeeper
Cook
Groundskeeper
Field Hand
Chauffeur
Child Rearer
Bodyguard
Menial Laborer
Sex Worker

entries.name: Feature: Position of Service
entries: Interacting with upper classes takes a certain amount of tact, understanding, and deft side-stepping. It also fuels a special kind of camaraderie with the serving class, no matter who they serve. If you interact with nobility, then you know how to give them shows of deference and respect that they expect from those of lower status. If you interact with the serving class, you can use your similar experience to ingratiate yourself to them and cause them to interact with you more favorably.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Life as a servant shapes you -some find a good place in their service, some are broken by it, and some chafe against it all their lives.

rows: I've scraped shit from a wooden floor and eaten food that was unfit for my master's table. I'm not afraid to stoop down a bit to get things done.
Service to something greater than myself allows me a place and purpose in the world.
I placed myself in service to a noble because I find the world of finery, status, and extravagance to be thrilling and I wanted to be closer to it.
I know that nobles are no different than the common folk, because I've changed noble diapers and seen great men die to common illness.
As a rule, I enjoy serving others and allowing my assistance to guide them in their pursuits.
I'd been in service to one family for most of my life, and now that I am free I will make the most of my new life.
No matter the company I keep or the situation I find myself in, I will hold myself to the laws of propriety.
When something needs to be done, hard work and diligence are better than doing a sloppy job.
{@bold Respect.} Respect is due because all people, regardless of station, deserve to be treated with honor. (Good)
{@bold Dignity.} More than anything else, I will not abide a stain on my character or a question about my moral standing. (Any)
{@bold Loyalty.} I do not give my word, service, or friendship easily, but when I do it is for life. (Lawful)
{@bold Excellence.} In all things, I take a certain pride in a job well done and mastery of one's work. (Neutral)
{@bold Independence.} I know that those I served are no better than those serving, and I seek to break down those barriers of thought and act. (Chaotic)
{@bold Power.} By being a cunning counselor and firm servant, I can gain power through those that I serve - by any means necessary. (Evil)
Nothing is more important than service to my master's family.
I am the last remaining person that knows my masters' secret, and I must act upon it.
I am in love with a noble from a house that I served in, and I would do anything to keep their safety.
I will get revenge on the evil forces that destroyed my master's family line.
No one in my family ever had their names inscribed in legend - it is up to me to start a tradition of greatness.
I have a responsibility to support and fight for the common folk, not the nobles.
Because of my years of service to difficult masters, I behave as though I am inferior to others around me.
I hear veiled references to my inferior status in every word offered by nobles, and I am quick to anger towards them.
Unless it is really important to me, I tend to allow others to make my decisions for me.
I can't help myself- sometimes I steal small, expensive items that I believe no one will miss.
I expect others to hold themselves to high standards of code and propriety, and look down on those that fall short of my expectations.
Most of the time, I want to only do the bare minimum to avoid the displeasure or ire of those more powerful than me.

entries.name: Variant Servant: Slave
entries: You spent your labor working at much the same job as any other servant, but you were not paid for your labor and your very body was owned by another. Most institutions of slavery allow for other debasements to be visited upon its slaves.

If you are currently a slave, you have a master which the legal system dictates you must answer to. If you are free, you start with documents proving your freedom as your token of service. In any case, you start with only 2 gp.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Persuasion}, plus one from among {@skill Insight} and {@skill Performance}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of fine clothes, a cosmetic pouch, a piece of fancy looking jewelry, a can of pepper spray, and a credit stick with 1000 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Sex Worker Profession
entries: There is a wide variety of professions related to sex work.

They range from streetwalkers calling out to passing strangers, to highly paid escorts who are hired to accompany executives to corporate events, and everyone in between. With modern technology, virtual reality porn stars create realistic (or unrealistic) simulations and distribute them across the internet.

rows: Streetwalker
Porn Star
Stripper
Escort
Webcam model
Phone sex operator
Dom
Brothel worker

entries.name: Feature: Solidarity
entries: You share a common bond with other sex workers, and will usually find assistance in your times of need. You can find shelter or lay low at brothels, strip clubs, and other similar locations. Your previous clients will typically be friendly to you, and may be willing to help you out with information or support.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Sex workers cater to certain clienteles, and have shaped their appearance and demeanor around attracting their attention. When they're not working, they may have a different persona.

rows: I'm quick with a joke and a smirk.
I'm flamboyant around strangers, but I'm more subdued around those I trust.
I've got a vulgar mouth, and I'm not afraid to use it.
I'll cut anyone who crosses me.
I stand and speak my mind in the face of oppression.
I tend to make myself look small and unthreatening.
People tell me I'm wise, but I've just seen too much.
Flirting is a good icebreaker, regardless of the occasion.
{@bold Angel.} I take people's minds off their worries, even if it's just for a moment. (Good)
{@bold Beauty.} People desire me and adore me, and I love it. (Any)
{@bold Carefree.} Who cares about tomorrow? I live for today. (Chaotic)
{@bold Puppeteer.} I don't care who I have to manipulate or hurt along the way. (Evil)
{@bold Revenge.} Someday, I'll pay back the people who wronged me. (Neutral)
{@bold Curiosity.} People fascinate me, and I love learning what makes them tick. (Any)
The client died, and the blame was put on me. I'll learn the truth.
A friend in my line of work disappeared one day, and I won't just let it go.
I fell in love with a client, but circumstances tore us apart.
Everything I do, I do for my family.
For the longest time, it felt like I was going nowhere. I need to change that.
I will do what I can to elevate others and defend the vulnerable.
I get deeply offended when people reject me.
I'm so used to faking my emotions that even I can't tell when I'm being genuine.
I often let my desires drown out common sense.
Sometimes my playful banter cuts deeper than I intend.
I am slow to make friends, and slower still to trust them.
I interpret people's words as suggestively as possible.

entries: On neon-lit street corners, in dimly lit brothels, in noisy strip clubs, and in high society lounges, people practice their profession in the carnal arts. You count yourself among their number. In the sleepless cities, there's always clients in need of comfort, and willing to pay for it. Some might find your line of work shameful, demeaning, or disgusting. Others see it as necessary and beneficial for society. However, many in your position just see it as another job.

_.special: transparent cylinder of shadow that has no opening

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item forgery kit|phb}, a transparent cylinder of shadow that has no opening, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and 15 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modest

entries.name: Overview
entries: You grew up at a time when the wizards of Netheril were at war with the elves of Cormanthor. You recall sitting cross-legged hearing the stories of the glorious Thultanthar, also called the Shade Enclave and the City of Shade, and aspired to study there and maybe even did, for a time. Your dreams came crashing down a few years ago when Thultanthar fell from the sky upon Myth Drannor.

You know that there was a Netherese Garrison stationed near Hillsfar and have heard rumors that its downfall came from traitors within the ranks. You remain loyal to Netheril and seek other Shade loyalists and fanatics in the Cormanthor forest and the areas surrounding Hillsfar.

entries.name: Feature: Secret Society
entries: You have a special way of communicating with others who feel the same way you do about the Shade. When you enter a village or larger city you can identify contact who will give you information on those that would hinder your goals and those would help you simply because of your desire to see the Shade Enclave return in all its glory. Note: This feature is a variant of the Criminal feature.

rows: I am a bully; I try to hide it though.
I let my actions speak for themselves
I am important; I will not let anyone forget that.
You are either with me or against me.
I know it is only a time before I am betrayed by those I care for.
I never understand why people get so emotional.
They are out to get me. It is only my cunning that keeps me ahead of them
Everyone has a choice, the one I make is always right though.
Hope. I know even if I need do evil acts, history will be my redemption. (Chaos)
Dedicated. I can do anything I put my mind to (Lawful)
Exciting. I have found the truth of the Shadovar and want to share it with everyone. (Any)
Frugal. I horde my possessions knowing that someday I will be called upon to give everything I have to the cause (Any)
Eloquent. I use my words to sway others to my beliefs. (Any)
Compassionate. It is through love that others will join in our cause. (Good)
They say the Shade broke the bonds of mortality; I want to find out how.
The whispers in my head remind me that there is power to be found in the shadows.
For the glory of Netheril, I will grow in power.
I once lived in Hillsfar, I was chased out before I was able to say farewell.
My true love was a killed by the Red Plumes; I plot to make them suffer.
I had a loved one die in the arena at Hillsfar; I am out to prove I am stronger than them!
I always over exaggerate my abilities.
I cannot bear to let those I care for out of my sight.
I am incapable of standing up for myself.
The group I am with has committed atrocities; I am always worried their actions will become public.
I always enjoy a good mug of ale... or five.
I know what I do is wrong, but am afraid to speak up about it.

name: Shadowmaster's Agent

_.special: a set of dark common clothes including a hood

entries: You're an agent of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm, a thieves' guild that is strongly linked to the worship of Shar. The Shadowmasters rule Telflamm in secret through their web of spies and thieves, rivaling the influence and power of the local nobility and clergy. You are, or at least were, just one tendril of the sprawling shadow that the Shadowmasters cast over the city. You might have even briefly escaped the guild and its machinations, but, willingly or not, everywhere you go, you further the seedy agenda of the guild's elite, the shadowlords.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Deception}, and one from {@skill Sleight of Hand} or {@skill Stealth}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A crowbar, a set of dark common clothes including a hood, a holy symbol of Shar, black priestly robes, a Shadowmaster guild insignia and 10 gp in a belt pouch.

entries.name: Feature: Dark Intel
entries: The Shadowmasters are adept at gathering information and have eyes and ears everywhere. In every town, city, or other settlement, you know of another Shadowmaster Agent who you can rely on to fill you in on basic information about the settlement's main features, figures, locations, and organizations, as well as other underworld activity in that settlement.

entries.name: Spell List
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

If you are a spellcaster, the spells on the Shadowmaster's Agent Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class. (If you are a multiclass character with multiple spell lists, these spells are added to all of them.)

entries.caption: Demon Tainted Spells Table
rows: Cantrip
{@spell chill touch}, {@spell minor illusion}
1st
{@spell expeditious retreat}, {@spell silent image}, {@spell sleep}
2nd
{@spell crown of madness}, {@spell darkness}, {@spell flaming sphere}
3rd
{@spell haste}, {@spell nondetection}
4th
{@spell confusion}, {@spell dimension door}
5th
{@spell mislead}

entries: Your spells might manifest in the form of shadows and whispers, creating blurry afterimages of your targets and even temporarily create dim ambient light as you cast them.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Shadowmasters of Telflamm are, by definition, members of a crime syndicate. Their devotion to Shar, Mistress of Night, is a common trait, and tends to color their attitudes and practices. Shadowmasters tend to be cunning, ruthless, shrewd, and, most of all, deceitful. You can use the following traits to flesh out your shadowmaster character or to draw inspiration from to create your own.

rows: Why tell the truth when I can get by only telling half of it?
I know more than people think, and I can't resist hinting at it.
Insults and intrigue are my specialty. Words can do just as much, if not more, damage than a knife.
I enjoy basking in shadows and darkness; The closer to our Mistress I am, the better.
I'm quick to start a fight, and quicker to end one.
I am, what you might call, "a control freak." I become nervous and irritated when things are out of my power.
I always look for anything to get me ahead or leverage over my enemies.
Fast-talk and doublespeak are my preferred styles of communication. If you can't keep up, that's not my problem.
Influence. By manipulating the world through the shadows, I can reshape it to my liking. (Evil)
Anarchy. There are few rules we actually need, and if the rest of the world were to see that, we would be truly free. (Chaotic)
Greed. The Shadowmasters are a means to an end, and that end sees me with all the gold. (Neutral)
Devotion. The will of Shar brings many blessings, by walking through shadow, I will be blessed. (Any)
Control. Through our schemes, we can control the masses. (Lawful)
Punishment. Those that stand against us will be consumed by the darkness. (Evil)
One of the shadowlords has taken a keen interest in me, and I would do anything to impress them.
Shar has spoken to me directly, and I fear nothing more than losing her favor.
My family knows nothing of my role in the Shadowmasters and I would prefer to keep it that way.
I spared someone during a mission once. If the guild were to find out, it would be the end of me.
I am in love with a member of one of our rival guilds.
I will stop at nothing to achieve the rank of Shadowlord.
I am quick to betray if it means my own gain.
I don't have allies, only pawns and tools.
Everywhere I go, I seem to make only enemies.
I don't trust anyone that says they want what is "good for everybody."
The first one to run is the last one to die, and I don't plan on dying.
My sharp tongue regularly creates trouble for me and my allies.

name: Shaman
entries: You live your life as a mediator, diviner, storyteller, healer, and psychopomp. Among your people you serve as a carrier of traditions and conduit of archaic wisdom. A shaman performs spiritual services for their community, paying obeisance to those spirits that will provide boons, and doing combat with spirits that would cause harm.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose two from {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Medicine}, and {@skill Religion}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: {@item Herbalism kit|phb}, {@item poisoner's kit|phb}, two sacred ritual items, and a belt pouch containing 5 gp

entries.name: Traditional Spirits
entries: As a shaman, you have learned to revere all spirits, but your learning is typically characterized by one type.

rows: Ancestral
Fey
Plant
Animal
Archetypal
Elemental
Undead
Astral
Fiend
Celestial

entries.name: Feature: Parley with Spirits
entries: Your knowledge of a variety of spirits increases your ability to interact with them. If confronted by any intelligent spirit (as listed above), you can invoke the ancient ways of communion between your kind and theirs. You make a great display of respect and tradition, and the entity is inclined to be more favorable to you and your party. Communing gives an opening: an intelligent spirit may give a chance to talk, a friendly spirit may be more helpful, and a hostile spirit may rethink a violent act.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Shamanistic practices are employed to preserve social order and benefit individuals in your society.

rows: I am slow to trust people that are not members of my social group.
I am deeply reverent of the spiritual world - people and cities are not important in comparison.
The spirit world is a terrible and brutal place, and so am I.
I have faced oppression for my beliefs, and I am reticent to express them.
Tradition is the backbone of any society, and following it gives much benefit.
The spirits are in control of our fate and we only act out the part.
The spirits have taught me to be tolerant and understanding of all creatures.
Mortal life is less real and important than the world of the spirits.
{@bold Tradition.} The ancient traditions of my ancestors must be honored and upheld. (Lawful)
{@bold Wild.} Nature abhors a wall. (Chaotic)
{@bold Wisdom.} The path to power and improvement is through the understanding of ancient wisdom. (Any)
{@bold Power.} Communion with the spirits can offer the path toward power and domination. (Evil)
{@bold Balance.} Both the mundane and spiritual world seek balance in all things. (Neutral)
{@bold Greater Good.}  It is my duty to use my abilities to help people and assist the ailing. (Good)
I must always protect my homeland and my people.
Protection of the spirits and the natural order is paramount.
I sold my soul for greater deeds and power. I hope to do great deeds and win it back.
My life is my devotion to my people and their traditions.
I have been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
I have been entrusted with a powerful secret, and I must not let it fall into the wrong hands.
I find it hard to take worldly matters seriously.
I only value the needs of my tribe and I do not care for other civilizations.
The spirits often interfere with my life and request things of me.
I am in awe of the spirits and am afraid to act against them.
I am flighty and prone to distraction.
I am deeply mistrustful of members of other faiths.

name: Shaman

_.special: one other pack of your choice

entries: You are a shaman, a protector of the less fortunate in the slums of Prismatic Falls or similar places that are in need of aid. You are a guide for the lost and use magic or herbal remedies to ensure the safety of those who have none other to look out for them.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Two of your choice from {@skill Religion}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, and {@skill Navigation|ccg}.

items.name: Spells (each in place of a tool or language):
items.entry: {@spell protection from evil and good}, {@spell augury}, {@spell lesser restoration}

items.name: Gear Packs:
items.entry: {@item Alchemist's supplies|ccg} or {@item chemist's tools|ccg}, as well as {@filter one other pack of your choice|items|type=regular gear pack;tool gear pack}.

entries.name: Feature: Returning the Favor
entries: You have provided aid to many in the slums of Prismatic Falls and beyond. Many of those who you have helped will often be willing to return the favor, in whatever small ways they can.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item Healer's kit|PHB}, a book of physiology, a needle and string, a doctor's uniform, and a pouch containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Xenobiology
entries: Having seen many strange things on your travels, you have developed an instinctive understanding of alien biologies. Whenever you encounter a creature you have never seen before, you are able to make a few observations and deductions about it, gaining an idea of how dangerous it could be, what its weaknesses might be, or how it would behave in response to a given stimulus.

entries.name: Medical Training
entries: By education, doctors tend to be experts in one branch of medicine, though serving on a ship means there is no one else to call on if something outside of their expertise should arise, so most ships' doctors possess broad medical skills. Choose a specialty or roll on the table below.

rows: Infectious diseases
Neurosurgery
Alien lifeforms
Orthopedic surgery
Ophthalmology
Cardiothoracic surgery
Psychiatry
Plastic/cyborg surgery

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: While medical practice often attracts analytical, gentle people, the life-shaping events that medics experience often have a lasting impact on their outlook.

rows: I obsessively clean my medical equipment.
I like to organize things into neat categories.
My handwriting is an atrocious scrawl.
I'm constantly reading something.
I'm not afraid of a bit of blood.
I expect people to jump when I say so, if not sooner.
High-pressure situations don't faze me.
I can be blasé about my own health.
Aid. I have dedicated my life to helping others. (Good)
Wealth. At the end of the day, I'm here for the money. (Evil)
Secrets. My goal in life is to learn as much as possible. (Neutral)
Duty. I swore an oath to "do no harm," and I mean to stick to it. (Lawful)
Freedom. I enable people to live the way they want by providing the medical care they choose for themselves. (Chaotic)
Peace. I have seen the results of war and conflict, so I want to do everything I can to foster peace and understanding. (Good)
I am looking for a cure to save someone I love.
I must track down the relatives of a deceased patient to tell them the bad news (and collect my fee).
A hospital on another planet has asked me to help deal with an emergency.
A terminal patient in my care charged me with completing their life's work.
My friends from medical school still keep in touch, even from across the galaxy.
I have a gaggle of medical students following me around everywhere.
I have nightmares about the people I have failed to save.
I have a problem with self-medication.
I focus solely on immediate problems and ignore the bigger picture.
My black humor sometimes unsettles those around me.
My qualifications are actually fake; I live in fear of being found out.
I am a dreadful hypochondriac.

entries: Aboard a ship, you must be prepared for anything. Whether exploring the far reaches of the 'verse, where untold alien pathogens lurk, going to war in one of the great space fleets and staring down alien weapons, or simply dealing with the crew's cybernetic implants going haywire, the ship's doctor never knows what challenges they might face from day to day.

Pragmatic out of necessity, but always seeking to provide the best possible care for their patients, shipboard medics are natural candidates to be made clerics of healing gods, and often possess an intellectual capacity well-suited to the demands of wizardry. Some, wishing to become self-sufficient in terms of potion supply, become interested in alchemy, while others make warlock pacts to gain more power with which to help more people. In this way, it's not uncommon for ships' doctors to transition into a more intense adventuring life.

entries: You operated and maintained the engines of war. What nation did you serve? Are you proud of your service, or haunted by your deeds? Did you serve and retire with distinction—or are you a folk hero who deserted to help innocents?

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item pouch|phb} containing 10gp, a holy symbol, a small vial of holy water, and a set of {@item common clothes|phb}

entries: You have dedicated your life to absolving the sins of others, offering them a chance at redemption within the fiery depths of Hell. Whether driven by a personal quest for atonement or a genuine desire to help others, you have taken on the burden of carrying the weight of their transgressions. Your ability to empathize with the darkest aspects of humanity sets you apart from others who fear the touch of sin.

entries.name: Feature: Sin Absolution
entries: Your unique ability allows you to absorb the sins of others, offering temporary relief and redemption. When you touch a willing creature, you can use your action to absorb their sins. This process lasts for 1 minute, during which the target is relieved of their guilt and experiences a sense of catharsis. Once you have used this feature, you must complete a long rest before you can use it again.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Sin Eaters are driven by their quest to absolve the sins of others and offer them a chance at redemption. They often carry a heavy emotional burden and are willing to confront the darkest aspects of humanity. Here are some suggested characteristics for a Sin Eater:

rows: I am haunted by the sins I have absorbed and constantly seek my own redemption.
I am empathetic and have a deep understanding of the struggles of others.
I speak softly and choose my words carefully, aiming to provide comfort and solace.
I am unyielding in my pursuit of absolution and refuse to give up on those who have sinned.
I am burdened by guilt and take personal responsibility for the sins of others.
I am calm and composed even in the face of the most heinous acts.
I am driven by a deep-seated desire to see the good in everyone, no matter their past actions.
I am tormented by visions of the sins I have absorbed, often struggling to sleep at night.
{@b Redemption.} Everyone deserves a chance at forgiveness and redemption.
{@b Atonement.} Through the absolution of sins, we can find true inner peace.
{@b Compassion.} I will always show empathy and understanding to those burdened by guilt.
{@b Justice.} Those who commit heinous acts must face the consequences of their actions.
{@b Sacrafice.} I am willing to carry the sins of others, even at great personal cost.
{@b Healing.} My purpose is to heal the souls of the damned and bring light to the darkest places.
I have a mentor who guided me on the path of becoming a Sin Eater.
I carry a sacred relic that serves as a reminder of the sins I have absolved.
I am devoted to a religious order that upholds the principles of redemption.
I seek to absolve the sins of a loved one who is trapped in Hell.
I am haunted by the memory of a sin I was unable to absolve.
I am driven to prove that even the most damned souls can be redeemed.
I am overly self-critical and find it difficult to forgive myself for past mistakes.
I struggle to see the good in those who have committed heinous acts.
I am so focused on absolving the sins of others that I neglect my own well-being.
I am haunted by the sins I have absorbed, leading to bouts of depression and despair.
I am prone to taking unnecessary risks to prove the redeemable nature of others.
I am judgmental of those who have not witnessed the depths of sin I have seen.

name: Skulls Hollow Seer
entries: You have personally been "passed through" (by their choice, not any deliberate act of yours) by one or more of the flying, glowing human skull apparitions of Skulls Hollow on the Green Road, and as a result you not only received the usual vivid visions of incidents from the past lifetimes of the Skulls, but you now often receive inside your head cryptic whispered messages from the Skulls, that only you hear, usually relating to something that happens in the future. These visions and messages come at random, and may or may not ever make sense to you or be useful to you, but seers who've paid attention to them have noticed they sometimes can be of aid in deciding what to do in the immediate future, in particular when magic or the undead are involved.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: One gaming set of your choice

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A gaming set of your choice, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Glimpses of the Past and Future
entries: As a result of this strange experience with the apparition of Skulls Hallow, you are an unwilling seer, of sorts. Visions of the past and messages about the future come to you unbidden and for no apparent reason. More frustrating than that is trying to figure out what these glimpses from other times and places mean. Occasionally, these visions and messages are easy to understand and can be quite helpful. However, more commonly, these random insights are inscrutable and confusing. Your DM may privately impart Skull messages to you from time to time.

entries.name: Dark Origin
entries: Skulls Hollow Seer are often a harried and frustrated lot. Having enigmatic visions of the past and unfathomable whispered messages of the future arrive unbidden at random times is generally not a positive for one's mental health. Some embrace this "gift" and seek to share or profit from this knowledge, while others suppress and ignore the undesired insights they receive. However, they feel about it, Skulls Hollow Seers have no choice in the matter and will continue to receive these insights be they welcome or not. Use the tables below, either making specific selections or rolling randomly, as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity.

rows: You tried to bargain for power, and in turn the demon you bargained with took a few liberties with the idea of granting you power.
You were intended as a sacrifice to a Demon Prince, but instead became their champion.
In a moment of trauma, the demonic ancestry in your bloodline manifested.
You were born this way, and were raised far away from society's judgemental eyes.
You took an unexpected trip to the Abyss, and did not return the same person.
After stealing a dark tome belonging to your master, you attempted to cast a spell from it, and things went horribly awry.
Little did you know, your past lover had actually been a demon, and their presence slowly changed you.
After having scorned a powerful spellcaster, this cursed form manifested over time.
You made a bet with a demon and lost.
After a night of debauchery, you woke up to find yourself like this.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Demon-tainted characters, underneath their unusual appearance and dark histories, are still people. Although you might draw your powers from darkness, nothing dictates that your character is truly evil. In fact, you might be drawn to try to find healing and closure through good deeds. Alternatively, your character could feel drawn to darker ambitions and deeds as they struggle with the pull of the supernatural corruption within them.

rows: I feel anxious and on edge almost all the time.
I am almost never surprised by anything.
I only speak if spoken to, and answer with as few words as possible.
I make sure to loudly and broadly proclaim any bit of insight or wisdom that comes to me.
I try to find the positive in any experience, no matter how terrible it might seem at the time.
I am suspicious of just about everyone as I feel that everyone wants to use me for their own purposes.
I am a real talker. In fact, I really never stop talking.
I am a dour person, sulky and sour about the circumstances of my life.
Aspiration. I've seen a hint of greatness in my future, and I work hard to achieve it. (Any)
Manipulation. My gifts give me the perfect leverage to move others to my tune. (Evil)
Freedom. Knowledge of what may come allows for greater choice. (Chaotic)
Serenity. I seek fulfillment with whatever I see in the future. (Neutral)
Truth. I am a servant of the truth, and I will share it for good or ill. (Lawful)
Compassion. My gifts can bring comfort to the suffering and peace to the troubled. (Good)
I told the fortune of the man who then destroyed my family, but I ignored the warning. I must find him and put it right.
My grandmother passed a token to me when she explained our gift of the Sight. It's my most prized possession.
I told one fortune whose meaning I still don't understand, but I know it has great importance.
My family travels the land, and I send most of the money I earn to them.
I told the fortune of the person I loved, and that led them to the arms of another.
I'm driven to read the fortune of powerful people.
I saw a truth once that I refused to speak, and tragedy was the result. It haunts me to this day.
I have terrible nightmares about the dark futures I've glimpsed.
No matter how I try, very few ever believe my fortunes.
I can't resist embellishing a fortune to try to earn a few more coins.
I loathe charlatans and tricksters who take advantage of those who seek their fortunes, and I do what I can to discredit them.
I'm terribly jealous of any positive fortune I read, since I can read any palm but my own.

entries: {@skill Explore|TLotRR}, {@skill Nature}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Navigator's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Patient, Wary

name: Slave
entries: {@i This background intentionally undershoots the mechanical precedent and guidelines laid out in the PHB and DMG, providing fewer proficiency opportunities and gear- most distinctly, lacking any role play items whatsoever. Additionally, the feature deliberately introduces more problems and threats to the PC, offering only one limited circumstance in which their past may be useful to them. The intention is that this background function somewhat like a "hard-mode" option- as a slave, you are specifically disadvantaged by your lack of opportunities in your earlier life. This manifests as a reduction of mechanically relevant options in play.}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: You have proficiency with any one {@filter tool|items|type=tools} entry with a value no greater than 15gp.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: One {@filter tool|items|type=tools} you are proficient with, or one {@filter simple melee weapon|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=melee weapon;simple weapon}, a set of {@filter clothes|items|miscellaneous=mundane|search=clothes} appropriate to your master's status and your slave purpose, and a small {@item pouch|phb} containing 1gp.

entries.name: Feature: The Hard Road
entries: Slaves face great difficulty everywhere they go. Escaped slaves are often on the run if not from their former owners, then certainly from the law. Few are educated or have any practical experience to make a way for themselves. Most have limited social skills which give away their social status. Slavers may notice freemen as "unclaimed property" and try to "claim" them as slaves. People sense a sort of "inferiority" about slaves and freemen, and they will likely either ignore you or boss you around. Many freemen turn to crime to make ends meet and so anyone who doesn't assume you a slave immediately, will likely assume that you are a criminal. If you can ever really leave the slavery mindset knowing what it's like to be a slave, then you can pose as a slave with little difficulty and without raising much suspicion. People seem to do things in front of you that they would normally only do when they are alone.

entries.name: Purpose
entries: A slave is set to a task by their master for a reason– their purpose for even being alive.

rows: I existed to do hard labor, such as mining or construction.
I existed for someone else's amusement, entertainment, or recreation.
I existed to serve some dedicated menial task, such as cooking or cleaning.
I existed as the personal servant of a given person, family, or group.
I existed to fulfill the tasks of some professional assistant, such as a furnace operator for a smithy.
I existed to serve the function of an inanimate object, such as a signpost or furniture, or to operate such things, like opening and closing a specific door all day long.
I existed to fight and die in the place of someone else, as a soldier or bodyguard.
I existed to serve all, as an untouchable-a slave to even other slaves.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: {@b Slaves} belong to their masters and cannot openly make the decisions that they want to, their destiny is defined by the wills of their masters. You may be a "star" slave and actually make a statement to your master, or your life may be nothing more than serving a pointless end. If you are an unlucky slave, then your life will be for nothing more than fighting a lost campaign or treating a person with no power as an exemplar. If you are a lucky slave then maybe you can see escape without slaughter, or even talk to your clients and perform some subterfuge. Escaped slaves exist in an awkward situation where they are lost/stolen property which they are guilty of stealing/kidnapping themselves. Life as an escaped slave is extremely difficult, and hiding your past may require intuitively practicing skills you would normally never have learned as a slave.

A {@b freeman} is a person who was a slave but has been freed by legitimate means. Most freemen are actually convicts who were put to slave labor in a work prison as their punishment. Alternatively, some slaves escape via criminal means and become legitimate exiles in another land, where their former status of slave is meaningless. Many freemen rise from old servile rebellions, or from counter-slavery laws passed by gentler rulers. A rare few are granted their freedom willingly by their masters. This is so extremely uncommon, most people don't even imagine it as an option. Freemen face almost as many challenges as escaped slaves, but have no reason to hide their past, aside from personal shame.
Being a slave actually makes things harder for you. It is an impediment to be overcome.

rows: No matter how bad things get, I never complain-I've seen worse.
I do not say anything unless someone says something to me.
I call everyone "Master" and "Lord" without thinking about it.
I try to hide as much of my body as possible.
I tend to disappear in a crowded room, becoming part of the backdrop with ease.
I am terrified of ropes, chains, and whips.
I do all kinds of basic chores and errands for those around me out of habit.
I am haunted by confusing memories and dreams about my life before slavery.
{@b Equality.} We all bleed red, we all suffer together. (Good)
{@b Apathy.} I only think about what is within my power. Anything else is just circumstance. (Neutral)
{@b Spite.} Those who would own others shall belong to me. (Evil)
{@b Status Quo.} Status is defined by clear rules which are the foundation of civilization. (Lawful)
{@b Indifference.} People are just people-who they are matters more than what they are. (Neutral)
{@b Freedom Fighter.} All slaves must be freed- by law, by coin, by shadow, or by blade. (Chaotic)
I dream of returning to my homeland or family.
All I have left of my former life is this trinket.
My identity as a slave is marked on my body permanently as scars or tattoos.
I am in love with someone who is not a slave, possibly in my master's house.
I know many secrets thanks to my innocuous presence in intimate social environments.
I heard a story about some grand place, and deeply want to go there.
I secretly liked being a slave.
My former master, or the law, will stop at nothing to have me executed.
I do not share my things with friends, and I will fight to keep personal belongings within my full control.
As a defense mechanism, I lie and misdirect everyone around me, and steal and hide anything I can.
I always say the truth when asked, even by an enemy.
When I am told to do something by an enemy, I might do it.
I cannot stop myself from reveling in material pleasures.
I am a coward.

images.title: Iron Ring Slaves by Jason Engle

entries: For some significant portion of your life, you have been someone else's property. This part of your life happened either by abduction, as punishment for a crime, sworn to a debt of life, or you were born into it. How did you become a slave? Are you a slave or a freeman? Who was your master and where are they? What were the conditions of your slavery? What did you do as a slave? Were you treated well, or were you abused? How much privilege or freedom did you experience, and was this granted to you, or taken by you? How would you treat your master after your servitude? Can you ever really leave your background behind you? Do you really even need to escape, or will you remain a slave for the rest of your journey? Do you have the willpower to create slavery-free actions, or has your background tainted your history and the actions that you can take later in your career? What would you do with your slaves?

name: Slave

_.special: small bauble taken from your former master's home

entries: You spent a sizable portion of your life as a slave or servant, living as nothing but a piece of property. Whether you were freed after years of faithful service, escaped, or were set free by outside forces, you've finally found yourself the master of your own fate.

With your freedom comes a host of new opportunities, but plenty of new fears to go along with them. You are unfamiliar with the way the world works and often make mistakes. Still, even the worst day of freedom is better than what you left behind. You face each day with a gratitude and optimism that those who haven't experienced your hardships simply can't understand.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Two tools of your choice, a set of common clothes, a small bauble taken from your former master's home, and a pouch containing 5 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
entries: During your time as a slave, you learned to remain beneath the perception of your overseers. Being noticed meant being punished. Even though you have gained your freedom, you are still very good at avoiding attention. When someone who has met you, but does not know you well, tries to recall information about you, they only vaguely recall you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Slaves are typically accustomed to long days of grueling work, so many freed slaves are still exceptionally hard-working, and in some cases, don't know what to do with their spare time, having never had that luxury before. They often have a greater appreciation for the freedom they've gained and the world around them than others. Some are bitter and want revenge for their years of slavery, or for friends and family they may have lost or been separated from during their servitude. Roll or choose one characteristic on each of the following tables.

rows: I always speak quietly, and only when spoken to.
I always keep my eyes down, never looking at those to whom I speak.
I love good food, and I will always avail myself of the opportunity to sample something new.
I can't stand bullies.
I eat quickly, and I always store anything I can't eat away for later.
When someone gives me an order, I feel rage welling up inside of me.
I never raise my voice in an argument or discussion.
I am loud and rambunctious, availing myself of every opportunity I missed during my servitude.
Freedom. All people should be free to do and be what they want. (Chaotic)
Safety. I want to make the world a place where everyone feels safe. (Good)
Retribution. My captors, my masters, and their families will suffer for what I had to endure. (Evil)
Adventure. The world and everything it has to offer are mine for the taking if I'm brave enough! (Chaotic)
Solitude. I want to live alone, far away from the people who made my life a living hell. (Neutral)
Redress. Slavery is just one of many foul (and illegal) practices, and those who pursue any of them must be brought to justice. (Lawful)
I never learned how to read, but I have a book that is precious to me that I always keep with me.
I killed my former master, and his family are still seeking revenge.
I sacrificed the lives of other slaves to secure my escape. I'll never forgive myself.
I can't sit idly by and let the strong prey on the weak.
I will never trust a Drow (or another race, depending on your slavers)
I have a horrible brand, marking me as property. Despite my being set free, many people mistake me for a slave because of it.
I'm so used to taking orders that I'll still usually do what people tell me to do, forgetting I can refuse.
I will refuse almost every order or request that I receive, simply because I can.
I treat those below me in station the same way I used to be treated.
My hatred for my slavers transcends all reasonable thought.
I never stand up for myself.
I always think someone is out to get me.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Belt {@item pouch|phb} with 10gp, a {@item magnifying glass|phb}, and a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}

entries.name: Feature: Cozy With The Law
entries: Your work often brings you within close proximity of the authorities. Maybe you were nearly mistaken for an illegal trespasser yourself or you helped with an investigation as part of a hired gig. One way or another, some people in law enforcement can foresee your involvement in cases and are possibly friendly to you. Discuss with your DM the nature of this relationship. Perhaps you have a contact within the law that sends you small bits of information or gossip in exchange for help on their own matter. Or, maybe there are particularly close eyes on your activities from the local guards. These relationships are only slightly interventionist and they will not intervene on your behalf if it will endanger their own skin.

entries.name: Sleuth Type
entries: Sleuths come in various shapes and sizes. Some actually are the hired kind, like detectives. Others are more specialized in certain cases of their fancy. Their skills make them niche investigators sometimes, such as locators, who specialize in finding people, or surveillance, which specializes in watching and monitoring.

rows: Policing Mysteries (Murder)
Surveillance (Stake Out)
Locating (Missing Persons)
Background Search (Dirt Digger)
Fraternizer (Stool Pigeon)
Dowser (Item Finder)
You are always sticking your nose where it doesn't belong.
You have an eye for detail, always analysing.
Many years on the streets have prepared you for every eventuality.
You always introduce yourself with a smile, it helps getting the info you want.
You like to contemplate everything you encounter with careful thought.
You are prepared to roll up the sleeves when required.
You have a case file on everyone you're friends with.
You have plenty of wisecracks on hand, whether helpful or not.
{@b Truth.} I must hold the law, dishing out justice to those who break it. (Lawful)
{@b Corrupt.} Sometimes to rise up others must fall, whether guilty or not. (Evil)
{@b Honourable.} I help out even the smallest of people, they deserve justice. (Good)
{@b Reckless.} To solve a crime you may need to commit a crime. (Chaotic)
{@b Greedy.} Sure, I'll help you, for a price. (Neutral)
{@b Duty.} It's my job, someone's gotta do it. (Any)
My partner died because of me, it won't happen again.
There is a mob boss who wants me dead.
My tutor showed me what the real world is like, I respect them for that.
A strange figure helped me out on my toughest case, i must repay them for their help.
I've been stuck on this case for many years, I will solve it one day.
My badge of office is more important to me than anyone else.
Everything can be evidence, even the silverware.
I'm not above beating the information out of people.
I can be deceptive in order to get what I want.
Once I find something of interest, it will take over my life.
I can easily be persuaded by gold.
I can't resist a pretty face.

entries: An eye for mystery, an ear for trouble and a nose to sniff out the answers. Those are the most touted traits of any good sleuth. They are like detectives, but with a penchant for the more unsavory kinds of investigation. Sleuthing originally was a term for animals who had a nose for scents. Nowadays, it means people trying to figure things out. But sleuths do still have that connotation of a lesser kind of investigator, compared to the often state-sanctioned detective. Sleuths are scrappier and work at their own leisure, much like private eyes or private hires, rather than policeman detectives.

When making a character of this background, keep in mind the key feature: curiosity. Sleuths rarely have a good sense of privacy. They'll peep and pry to get down to the bottom of things like sharks to blood. Their own lives are often second to an investigation, meaning many of them are quite reckless and meet some ill-fated end. However, that is not to say all sleuths follow their noses without a brain. Sleuths are best known for their deductive thinking capabilities and questioning faculties, which is what keeps the wheels turning and the plot thickening. Mysteries are their daily bread and butter.

When making a sleuth character, ask yourself these questions: What prompted your character down this path of investigation? Justice? Pure curiosity? What was the biggest discovery your character ever made in their career? Or is this just some side hobby to amuse their boredom? Do you dive straight into a good story, or do you like to take a step back and wait for more clues to appear? Do you even care if you're peeping in a bath or snooping in someone else's house?

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Binoculars|DarkMatter24}, {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, {@item Igniter|DarkMatter24}, {@item Log Keeper|DarkMatter24}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (trenchcoat), and 18 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: In another life you scoured for clues and chased down wrongdoers. Perhaps you worked as a police detective or a private investigator, or even as a "fixer," unraveling quagmires for major factions. You may have a cold case that still eludes you or the scars of an arrest gone wrong, but you maintain an eye for detail and keen investigative instincts.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Belt {@item pouch|phb} with 10gp, a {@item magnifying glass|phb}, and a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}

entries.name: Feature: Cozy With The Law
entries: Your work often brings you within close proximity of the authorities. Maybe you were nearly mistaken for an illegal trespasser yourself or you helped with an investigation as part of a hired gig. One way or another, some people in law enforcement can foresee your involvement in cases and are possibly friendly to you. Discuss with your DM the nature of this relationship. Perhaps you have a contact within the law that sends you small bits of information or gossip in exchange for help on their own matter. Or, maybe there are particularly close eyes on your activities from the local guards. These relationships are only slightly interventionist and they will not intervene on your behalf if it will endanger their own skin.

entries.name: Sleuth Type
entries: Sleuths come in various shapes and sizes. Some actually are the hired kind, like detectives. Others are more specialized in certain cases of their fancy. Their skills make them niche investigators sometimes, such as locators, who specialize in finding people, or surveillance, which specializes in watching and monitoring.

rows: Policing Mysteries (Murder)
Surveillance (Stake Out)
Locating (Missing Persons)
Background Search (Dirt Digger)
Fraternizer (Stool Pigeon)
Dowser (Item Finder)
You are always sticking your nose where it doesn't belong.
You have an eye for detail, always analysing.
Many years on the streets have prepared you for every eventuality.
You always introduce yourself with a smile, it helps getting the info you want.
You like to contemplate everything you encounter with careful thought.
You are prepared to roll up the sleeves when required.
You have a case file on everyone you're friends with.
You have plenty of wisecracks on hand, whether helpful or not.
{@b Truth.} I must hold the law, dishing out justice to those who break it. (Lawful)
{@b Corrupt.} Sometimes to rise up others must fall, whether guilty or not. (Evil)
{@b Honourable.} I help out even the smallest of people, they deserve justice. (Good)
{@b Reckless.} To solve a crime you may need to commit a crime. (Chaotic)
{@b Greedy.} Sure, I'll help you, for a price. (Neutral)
{@b Duty.} It's my job, someone's gotta do it. (Any)
My partner died because of me, it won't happen again.
There is a mob boss who wants me dead.
My tutor showed me what the real world is like, I respect them for that.
A strange figure helped me out on my toughest case, i must repay them for their help.
I've been stuck on this case for many years, I will solve it one day.
My badge of office is more important to me than anyone else.
Everything can be evidence, even the silverware.
I'm not above beating the information out of people.
I can be deceptive in order to get what I want.
Once I find something of interest, it will take over my life.
I can easily be persuaded by gold.
I can't resist a pretty face.

Do you dive straight into a good story, or do you like to take a step back and wait for more clues to appear? Do you even care if you're peeping in a bath or snooping in someone else's house?

name: Slow Metabolism
entries: You descend from some slow metabolism Animal Spirits such as Crocodile or Spider Spirits. You can live off half the amount of food normally required.

items.name: Specialty
entries: During your time as a soldier, you had a specific role to play in your unit or army. Roll a d8 or choose from the options in the table below to determine your role:

rows: Officer
Scout
Infantry
Cavalry
Healer
Quartermaster
Standard-bearer
Support staff (cook, blacksmith, or the like)

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You began training for war as soon as you reached adulthood and carry precious few memories of life before you took up arms. Battle is in your blood. Sometimes you catch yourself reflexively performing the basic fighting exercises you learned first. Eventually, you put that training to use on the battlefield, protecting the realm by waging war.

The horrors of war combined with the rigid discipline of military service leave their mark on all soldiers, shaping their ideals, creating strong bonds, and often leaving them scarred and vulnerable to fear, shame, and hatred.

rows: I joined the militia to help protect my community from monsters.
A relative of mine was a soldier, and I wanted to carry on the family tradition.
The local lord forced me to enlist in the army.
War ravaged my homeland while I was growing up. Fighting was the only life I ever knew.
I wanted fame and fortune, so I joined a mercenary company, selling my sword to the highest bidder.
Invaders attacked my homeland. It was my duty to take up arms in defense of my people.
I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my military experience relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.
Greater Good. Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Good)
Responsibility. I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)
Independence. When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)
Might. In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Evil)
Live and Let Live. Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)
Nation. My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)
I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I made a terrible mistake in battle that cost many lives—and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blinding and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

_.special: a piece of chalk connected to a string

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Arcana} and either {@skill Persuasion} or {@skill Intimidation}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Artisan's tools ({@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}), {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, a pocket knife, a piece of chalk connected to a string, a chapbook of esoteric symbols, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Channel Essence
entries: You can call upon your inner reserves to recover from debilitating, long-term Injuries. As part of a short rest, you can offset a reduction to one of your ability scores by expending a number of Hit Dice equal to twice the amount of the reduction that you want to negate. When used in this manner, the Hit Dice do not confer other benefits, such as additional hit points.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Soul channelers are drawn to the Dark Arts and the manipulation of available resources to achieve their goals. For some this might include using their own capabilities, but an easier (and more common) method employs summoned creatures, Undead servants, and duped allies. Not every soul channeler chooses to exploit such opportunities, but the Temptation is there for all.

rows: I realize that gaining power comes at a cost, and I am prepared to pay that cost, whatever it is.
My companions are useful for the abilities they contribute and the Protection they provide me.
I am comfortable in places where the dead are gathered. I find solace and Strength in the Crypts, graveyards, and necropolises of the land.
I loathe any who profess faith, duty, and devotion to an entity or a cause without ensuring they will be compensated for their service.
I care nothing for the suffering, pain, and plight of others. Their concerns are not mine.
I will sacrifice my possessions, my needs, and my well-being for my trusted companions.
I detest myself for the depths of depravity I have plumbed to gain the power I now wield.
I mistrust any who have power over me or others.
{@b Will.} Embarking on the pursuit of greatness is not enough. I must have the will to do what others shy away from in order to accomplish my goals. (Any)
{@b Sacrifice.} I believe that sacrifice—personal, emotional, or otherwise—is necessary to achieve greatness. (Any)
{@b Abstinence.} I cleanse myself of Distractions to achieve purity of Purpose. (Lawful)
{@b Deception.} I never tell the whole truth, even if there is no apparent need to lie. The truth has been used against me too many times. (Evil)
{@b Lunacy.} I embrace the turmoil in my mind and soul that comes with manipulating eldritch energies. (Chaotic)
{@b Diabolic.} I inflict pain, suffering, and strife with zeal and gusto. (Evil)
My spellcasting focus is a trinket I created. I cannot live without it.
My Self-Sufficiency provides me with comfort and confidence.
I am searching for an ancient text of esoteric, arcane knowledge. I try to make decisions and take actions that lead me to this goal.
I take advantage of any opportunities that crop up, regardless of the possible consequences.
I seek to harness living energies from plants, animals, and the magical world. I wish to see beyond flesh to the soul itself. All life is in my charge.
My loyalty is hard-won, but once earned it is unwavering.
I consider my companions and all those I meet as resources to be used and advantages to be gained.
I have no regard for my physical form. It is a tool and a source of energy, nothing more.
I prefer the company of gregarious, ebullient, and vociferous folk. They lift my somber spirits.
The easiest way is always the best way.
I allow myself to be driven by impulses. My first inclination is the course of action I pursue.
I distrust all who rely on fickle deities and unknowable patrons to acquire their spells, influence, and power.

entries: A quirk of fate, or a circumstance of birth, exposed you to the intoxicating power of Arcane Magic and changed you irrevocably. You spent your formative years learning about yourself, gauging your inner reserves and how much you are willing to sacrifice to achieve your goals.

items.name: Languages
items.entry: Choose two from Abyssal, Infernal, Celestial, and Deep Speech

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item pouch|phb} with 10gp, a {@item writing kit}, a trinket related to your studies, and a set of {@item common clothes|phb}

entries: Soulbound Scholars are dedicated seekers of knowledge, delving deep into the mysteries of Hell and its torments. With expertise in Arcana and History, they possess a wealth of information about infernal realms, their denizens, and the punishments that await souls. Their insatiable thirst for knowledge drives them to uncover the secrets of Hell, and their understanding of its lore grants them unique advantages when dealing with infernal creatures. Soulbound Scholars are often focused, detached, and driven by their pursuit of knowledge.

entries.name: Feature: Lore of the Infernal
entries: As a Soulbound Scholar, you have dedicated your life to studying the depths of Hell and the intricacies of its torments. Your relentless pursuit of knowledge about the infernal realms, their denizens, and the various punishments that await souls has granted you a wealth of information and insight. You are well-versed in the lore and legends of Hell, possessing a deep understanding of its history, hierarchy, and unique properties.

You have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to recall information about demons, devils, and other infernal creatures. Additionally, when interacting with creatures native to Hell, you can use your knowledge to attempt to gain advantage on Charismabased ability checks involving persuasion, intimidation, or deception.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Soulbound Scholars are typically driven individuals, consumed by their desire to understand the mysteries of Hell. They tend to be studious, analytical, and often have a certain detachment from emotions, focusing instead on the pursuit of knowledge. However, each Soulbound Scholar is unique, and their experiences in the infernal realms can shape their personality and motivations.

rows: I am fascinated by the torments of Hell and eagerly share tales of infernal punishments with anyone who will listen.
I have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and will stop at nothing to uncover the secrets of Hell.
I am often lost in thought, contemplating the complexities of the infernal realms and their implications.
I take great pride in my intellect and enjoy displaying my knowledge whenever possible.
I find solace in books and knowledge, preferring their company over that of others.
I am haunted by the horrors I've witnessed in Hell, often lost in nightmares and dark thoughts.
I have a dark sense of humor, finding amusement in the irony and absurdity of the infernal realms.
I am relentless in my pursuit of the truth, refusing to accept anything at face value.
{@b Knowledge.} The pursuit of knowledge is paramount, even if it means risking everything. (Neutral)
{@b Redemption.} I seek to understand the torments of Hell to find a way to save souls from eternal damnation. (Good)
{@b Power.} Knowledge is power, and I will use it to gain influence and control over infernal forces. (Evil)
{@b Balance.} The forces of Hell must be understood and kept in check to maintain equilibrium in the universe. (Lawful)
{@b Curiosity.} I am driven by an insatiable curiosity, always seeking new experiences and discoveries. (Chaotic)
{@b Acceptance.} Hell is an inevitable part of existence, and understanding it helps me accept the world's inherent darkness. (Neutral)
I made a pact with an infernal being to gain access to forbidden knowledge.
My family was affected by a terrible event related to Hell, and I seek to uncover the truth behind it.
I am determined to write the definitive tome on Hell, documenting its horrors for future generations.
I owe a debt to a powerful being from Hell and must fulfill a favor in return.
My mentor, a renowned scholar of Hell, disappeared under mysterious circumstances, and I am determined to find them.
I lost a loved one to the torments of Hell and will do anything to rescue their soul.
I can become lost in my studies, neglecting personal relationships and the world around me.
I am willing to take great risks to obtain forbidden knowledge, even if it endangers myself or others.
I struggle to relate to others and often come across as aloof or socially awkward.
My obsession with Hell and its secrets can lead me to disregard the consequences of my actions.
I am haunted by the visions and nightmares that plague my mind after witnessing the horrors of Hell.
I am easily tempted by the promises of power and forbidden lore, making it difficult to resist darker influences.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, {@item Omnitool|DarkMatter24}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (jumpsuit), {@item Vent Tape|DarkMatter24}, {@item Wristwatch|DarkMatter24}, 28 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: Your days were spent hauling heavy cargo across the 'Verse to the tune of timeless Etheradio hits. At the helm of a starship, you've seen the utter edge of the Galactic Frontier, the sprawling hubbub of core worlds, and a few celestial phenomena that bring a tear to the eye. You've become accustomed with the hazards and tribulations of space travel, and always find yourself looking toward the horizon, toward another ship and another world.

_.special: A letter of recommendation to a magic academy
A book from an ancestor of yours containing martial and meditative techniques

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Arcana}, plus one from among {@skill Acrobatics,}, {@skill Athletics} and {@skill Investigation}.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools or one gaming set|items|type=artisan's tools;gaming set} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a letter of recommendation to a magical academy, a book from an ancestor of yours containing martial and meditative techniques, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Sword and Sorcery
entries: You have associated yourself with both practitioners of the arcane and hard trained warriors. Always keeping an ear on the ground, you have a knack for blending in with these kinds of people. As a result, you always pick up rumors about magical shops and auctions of rare antiquities, as well as offers of mercenary work.

rows: I have a lot of acquaintances, not a lot of friends.
I smile in the face of the impossible.
I try to be discreet, but I can't help jumping into action.
I lose myself in the realm of possibilities.
I feel most comfortable in the company of books and blades.
I starve for knowledge and new experiences.
I suffer in the presence of ignorance.
I'm an open book, but people are illiterate.
{@b Community.} Knowledge is a gift to be shared. (Good)
{@b Balance.} The true wonders of the world lie within its principles. (Lawful)
{@b Freedom.} The freedom to travel is the freedom to learn. (Chaotic)
{@b Greed.} Power is a privilege of the strong. (Evil)
{@b Knowledge.} True knowledge is my conviction. (Neutral)
{@b Responsibility.} A life full of challenges is a life well lived.(Any)
My life's purpose is to perfect my art.
I always go out of my way to help those who earned my respect.
Actions speak louder than words.
Someone saw potential in me. To this day, I never refuse their guidance.
I respect warriors of all kinds.
I always see things through to the end.
My curiosity often puts me in dire situations.
I tend to misjudge my opponents.
I am willing to search anywhere for the right answers.
In my travels, I've encountered things that still haunt me.
I always try to correct mistakes, even if they're not my own.
I push people away to stay focused on my goals.

entries: Duality has always been in your nature. While aspiring youth gathered around trainers of sword or sages of magic, you found yourself in awe of not only one such path. Instead, mediating both, you dedicated twice the effort to carve a path of your own. Blending the wonders of magic and the might of the body, you strive to perfect this mixing art, to a tool of superiority. Always curious about the world, you strike out to meet new people, discover sights and obtain wisdom through experience. Knowledge from great adventures may perhaps lead you to a figure of lineage, who can unlock your true mighty potential.

{@note Note: this background is actually found in {@i The Weaveknight} v3.5, but it was {@link intended|https://www.reddit.com/r/UnearthedArcana/comments/16ue2t0/comment/k2ow5my/} to be included here.}

name: Spirit Kin

_.special: different {@filter common ingredients|items|source=ObojimaTallGrass|rarity=common|type=ingredient} (linked to your spirit allies)
special item gifted to you by a spirit

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item bedroll|PHB}, 10 {@item candle|PHB|candles}, two different {@filter common ingredients|items|source=ObojimaTallGrass|rarity=common|type=ingredient} (linked to your spirit allies), a special item gifted to you by a spirit, and 10 gold flowers.

entries: Though everyone living on Obojima comes in contact with spirits to one degree or another, your interaction with the Spirit Realm has always occurred with peculiar regularity.
