All your life you've had a special kinship with spirits that few share in. You've come to love their food, their culture, and their people more than the average material being. These habits have drawn fascination, suspicion, and confusion from locals, but that doesn't stop them from enlisting your talents when spirit stuff gets weird.

entries.name: Feature: Connections Beyond Material
entries: You have come to know two spirits by name, and through your relationship have learned special rituals and techniques that allow you to find them across the Physical and Spirit Realms.

By using two unique ingredients that you choose when taking this background, you can contact these spirits from any distance or plane of existence. The ritual you enact to utilize these ingredients and contact a spirit is uniquely your own—it might involve a tea ceremony, or perhaps the burning of the ingredients and partaking in the aromatic smoke they produce.

name: Spirit Nemesis
entries: Your ancestors have fought against a family of Spirits or Ancestors for generations. Once per day you can roll an attack against a member of that Family with advantage.

name: Spirit Tongue
entries: You descend from one of the great Spirit families and a lingering effect on you is that you intuitively understand their language (the DM should pick a Spirit Family).

name: Spirit's Ear
entries: You descend from an Animal Spirit with fine earring, such as a Fennec Spirit. Once a day you gain advantage on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check if in a specific biome (roll on {@table Biome List|WagaduChronicles|Biomes Table})

name: Spiritual Lies
entries: You descend from deceitful Spirits. Once per day you can roll Charisma ({@skill Deception}) with advantage to tell a lie. Before dawn you have to complete a task for this Ancestral Spirit or face their wrath for your ungratefulness.

name: Spiritualist

_: a spirit token (such as a carved talisman or a vial of consecrated water)
a personal relic (such as a piece of jewelry or a woven bracelet)

entries: You have always had a deep connection to the spirit world, and you have spent your life studying and practicing the art of communing with spirits. You can sense the presence of supernatural entities and communicate with them, and you frequently seek their wisdom and guidance.

entries.name: Feature: Spirit Guide
entries: You have a spirit guide who assists you in your spiritual work. This guide can not only provide you with insight and guidance, but also warn you of danger or threats. As an action, you can communicate with your spirit guide, who might be able to grant you information related to your current situation or quest. The GM determines what information your spirit guide offers you and how that information is conveyed to you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am a patient and thoughtful listener who is attentive to the whispers of the spirits.
I am deeply empathetic and compassionate, and I strive to help others overcome their spiritual struggles.
I am curious and adventurous and always seek to learn more about the spirit world.
I am introspective and reflective, and I often spend long periods of time in meditation and contemplation.
I am brave and courageous, and I am willing to face the unknown in my search for knowledge and understanding.
I am open-minded and accepting, and I allow new beliefs and experiences to shape my understanding of the spirit world.
I am wise and discerning, and I carefully consider all the advice I receive from spirits and other supernatural entities.
I am determined and resolute, and I never give up on a quest for spiritual knowledge.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Knowledge. It is my duty to seek out the secrets of the spirit world and to share what I learn with others. (Neutral)
Compassion. I strive to alleviate the suffering of spirits and mortals alike. (Good)
Balance. I seek to maintain equilibrium between the spirit world and the material plane. (Lawful)
Discovery. I am constantly pursuing new spiritual knowledge. (Chaotic)
Harmony. All living things are connected in a grand spiritual harmony. (Good)
Mystery. The unknown is a source of wonder and fascination. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I owe a great debt to the spirit that saved my life.
I am devoted to helping others on their spiritual journeys.
I will never forget the wisdom my mentor imparted to me.
I strive to protect the interests of my spiritual family.
I seek to unravel the mysteries of the spirit world.
I am determined to master the secrets of spiritual power.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I put too much trust in spirits and other supernatural entities.
I am easily swayed by the opinions of others.
I am too quick to believe in the impossible.
I rely too much on the guidance of the spirits.
I am too eager to take risks in the pursuit of spiritual knowledge.
I am too slow to accept new ideas or beliefs.

name: Spy

_: your choice of one set of tools (disguise kit, forgery kit, or thieves' tools)
a badly forged passport (a souvenir of your first attempt)

entries: You are an intelligencer, either a freelance operative or an agent of one of the Iron Kingdoms. Until recently, you've lived in a shadowy world of hidden truths and shifting alliances. From simple research to more direct means, you know numerous ways to gain the information your clients seek.

entries.name: Feature: Cover Identity
entries: In addition to establishing numerous cover identities for yourself, you have hidden troves of corroborating evidence in multiple cities across western Immoren. These stashes contain disguises, bogus documentation, forgery kits, and other useful items created for the purpose of proving that you are whoever you say you are. For each location you visit, you and your GM can discuss the likelihood that it contains one of these caches, as well as the difficulty of accessing it.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Whether for purposes nefarious or benign, spies look to glean the truth of any matter laid before them. Trust doesn't come easy, if ever, but it can be the difference between life and death.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am a consummate flatterer.
Collecting and telling stories are two of the greatest tools in my arsenal.
Gambling is one of my vices, but I try my best to resist it while on the job.
I always have a plan. I'm a born schemer.
I often use humor to deflect attention.
My patience is nearly endless.
I fall in and out of love easily and always have my eye on my next paramour.
I sometimes find it hard not to be sarcastic.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Independence. The best part of being a spy is that I can operate with nearly complete independence. (Chaotic)
Dedication. Being a spy is the greatest part of my life. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I will use anything and everything at my disposal to move up in the world. (Any)
Nation. I owe absolute loyalty to my home country. (Any)
Creativity. Never tell the same lie twice. (Chaotic)
Deception. If you want to keep everyone on their toes, learn to lie well. If you have to tell a truth, make sure it's only a partial one. (Chaotic)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I fell in love with someone while on duty but had to leave after my cover was blown.
Part of my agreement to become a spy was that my employer would take care of my sibling.
I was forced to commit a vile crime during one of my missions. No one must ever discover the truth.
I had to abandon a child in my care while pursuing one of my missions. I regret not making a different choice.
I will do anything to prove myself to my mentor.
The family of a powerful noble found out I was the one who revealed incriminating information about some unsavory activities. Despite losing most of their power, they still have it in for me.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: In my line of work, it is incredibly hard for me to trust anyone—even my allies.
I am at the apex of my craft. No one could ever fool me.
Living to fight another day sure beats dying and giving up the fight entirely.
I lie so often that the truth has become mostly irrelevant to me.
I'm always fretting that the other shoe will drop at any moment.
I can't resist a pretty face.

name: Spy Ring
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} You and the other members of your party are intelligencers employed by a kingdom, major organization, or private concern—perhaps members of the Cygnaran Reconnaissance Service, agents of a noble house, or simply freelancers in the employ of the highest bidder.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Each member must have the Greylords Covenant, Investigator, Resistance Veteran, Spy, or Vagabond background, or proficiency in Deception or Stealth.

entries.name: Downtime: New Identity
entries: If a cover identity becomes compromised, you can spend 7 days establishing new cover identities for all members. You purchase forged documents, develop cover stories, and seed the local region with rumors. Cost: 25 gp per member. Each member receives a plausible cover with appropriate documentation.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Prestige increases through acts such as: blackmailing someone beholden to a rival power; forging documents to misdirect opponents; uncovering a valuable secret known only to foes; infiltrating the inner circle of your target's trust; rescuing a captured ally; or sabotaging enemy assets worth at least 1,000 gp.

entries.name: Tier 1 – Infiltrators
entries: {@b Cover Story.} Your employer has set up your company with a credible cover and all documentation required for travel. Any papers you carry are forgeries sufficient to pass a cursory inspection.
{@b Expense Account.} You have access to a company account containing 50 gp per member, replenished at the start of each month. Any money not spent by month's end is reclaimed.

entries.name: Tier 2 – Operatives
entries: {@b Safe Houses.} Your employer sets up a network of safe houses with strong locks, stout doors, and at least one back entrance for quick escape.
{@b Contact Network.} You learn the identity of multiple contacts in your region who can provide intelligence, act as getaway drivers, and help find alternative routes. Contacts have CR 2 or lower.

entries.name: Tier 3 – Espionage Experts
entries: {@b Advanced Intel.} When you gain intelligence from your contact network, you can request specific information about a target. Depending on quality, you gain a +1 or +2 bonus on related ability checks and saving throws.
{@b Increased Expenses.} Your expense account increases by 50 gp per member per month.

entries.name: Tier 4 – Spymasters
entries: {@b Black Market.} Your company finds a supplier of black-market goods. You receive a 10 percent discount on illegal or difficult-to-obtain items and the vendor purchases stolen goods at three-quarters of their value.

{@b Everyone's Secrets.} If you spend at least 8 hours surveilling a location or shadowing a target, you learn one piece of information your target would prefer to keep undisclosed. You can use this to gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Intimidation) contests against that target.

_.displayName: trinket from the life you stayed behind to defend

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, thieves' tools

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A small knife, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a {@item trinket|phb} from the life you stayed behind to defend, a belt {@item pouch|phb} with 10 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Poor

entries.name: Overview
entries: "We need to leave, now!" Those words still haunt your dreams at night. When everyone was fleeing Phlan, you choose to stay. Whether out of an emotional attachment, or pursuit of riches, you made the decision that would affect the rest of your life.

Food became scarcer for those without connections. You became a beggar and to stay alive you bartered information to any interested party with food or gold to spare. You were good at what you did, and thought you were invincible. That changed when you were captured by the Tears of Virulence, the soldiers of Vorgansharax, the Maimed Virulence, for selling secrets to those bent on overthrowing the dragon. They locked you in the cells of Stojanow Gate. The first weeks you hoped to stay alive. As the weeks turned into months, and the interrogations continued you began to pray for death.

entries.name: Feature: Ex-Convict
entries: The knowledge gained during your incarceration lets you gain insight into local guards and jailors. You know which will accept bribes, or look the other way for you. You can also seek shelter for yourself from authorities with other criminals in the area. Note: This feature is a variant of the Courtier feature.

rows: I am a bully; others will suffer as I have.
I always say yes even when I mean no; it's just easier.
I aim to misbehave.
I go out of my way to frustrate or anger those in power.
I strive to obey the law. I will never again make the mistake of going against authority.
I always plan everything out. The one time I let others plan things it did not end well for me.
I take blame to protect others from pain.
I hoard information, you never know what may come in handy.
Loss. I freely give those who offend me what was so brutally denied me, death. (Chaos)
Dedication. I never betray those who trust me. (Law)
Vengeance. I use any means to get information I need; I have been well taught. (Evil)
Redemption. Everyone deserves a second chance. (Good)
Resilience. I can survive any challenge (Any)
Leadership. The best teams are made up of those that society has discarded.
I take up arms to help establish a free Phlan.
The horrors of my time in Stojanow haunt my dreams, only after a day of hard work can I find sleep.
I am indebted to those who freed me from prison, I will repay this debt.
My torturer survived the attack that set me free, I will find him/her.
I will not rest while others suffer fates similar to mine.
I am searching for a way to heal the scars of Stojanow, both physical and emotional.
During stressful times, I find myself crying for no reason.
My nerve endings are shot from the interrogations; I am numb to all but the harshest touch.
I am incapable of standing up for myself.
I folded under the torture, and gave information that I promised would be kept secret. My life would be in jeopardy if others found out.
Survival is worth more than friendship.
The ghosts from my past hinder my actions.

name: Stormfall Archer

_: a pendant featuring the emblem of the Retribution of Scyrah

entries: {@b Weapon Proficiencies:} Martial ranged weapons, shortswords.

The powerful bows used by the Iosan Stormfall archers launch arrows high into the air. When the arrows return, they detonate on impact. Such archers combine the destructive might of cannons and rockets with the mobility of skirmishers.

entries.name: Feature: Bombardment
entries: Stormfall archers can draw back powerful compound bows and launch explosive-tipped arrows of considerable mass. Because of the strength and training required to perform such a feat, you double the normal range of any bow you use.

entries.name: Feature: Skirmishers
entries: After you make a ranged attack, you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: A well-executed plan is critical to success.
I watch emotionlessly as my arrows obliterate my enemies from afar.
Victory requires committing to your orders, no matter the risk.
I must stay at the top of my training to best support my people.
Elders and superiors must always be shown respect.
I am at home in the wilderness.
I assume nothing, and I prepare for the worst.
I don't let people get close to me for fear of losing them.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Honesty. I speak my mind and do not lie. (Lawful)
Destruction. I send my enemies running for cover. (Chaotic)
Quiet. Only those who have something to hide speak the loudest. (Neutral)
Immolation. My enemies will be purged by fire and obliterated. (Evil)
Exploration. I am driven to seek out new horizons and search out the clues that may aid my people. (Neutral)
Charity. There are those in need, and I do what I can to help. (Good)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: My bow has been passed down through my family.
I have a sibling who has been missing since the Claiming, and I know they did not return to our homelands.
I carry a dog-eared Iosan novel that I read whenever I have the chance, and I take comfort from its familiar passages.
A rival of mine is a Nyss, and we compete to see who is the best archer.
My unit was destroyed in battle, and I am the last of them. I must live for all of them in these uncertain times.
A skorne warlock seeks revenge on me for killing his prize warbeast.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I solve even the most delicate things without any form of subtlety.
I am driven by the fear that my people are destined for extinction.
I approach every task with precision, no matter how small.
Traitors cannot be abided.
Memories of Ios distract me often.
Jokes often go over my head.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of common clothes, an eldritch item (a fetish, a doll, a mask), a set of artisan's tools (one of your choice), and a credit stick with 1000 credits.

entries.name: Feature: Cultish Connoisseur
entries: You can recognize and identify the signs of mystical cults, cabals, orders, and other shadowy groups and their members. You're familiar with several places of power and ritual sites where the border between worlds wears thin. You can always find a dealer of spell components and other arcane goods.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The demeanor and fashion sense of a street shaman are far more important for their purposes than actually having access to otherworldly powers. No one will believe a guy secretly harbors a host of haunting spirits when he dresses and talks like he works part-time at a gas station. Establishing an air of mystery is crucial.

rows: Why should I tell the truth when lies are more convenient?
I hold deep, unshakeable beliefs about the true nature of the world.
I've been reborn many times, and I sometimes recall things from a past life.
I speak in an enigmatic and ominous tone.
Wear enough dirt and garbage and nobody will look at you twice.
I talk with beings that others can't see.
There's nothing like peaceful meditation and tea after a stressful day.
I'm grouchy because the world made me this way.
There are forces at work to help people. I will be one of them. (Good)
There is a universal equilibrium that is disrupted at our peril. (Lawful)
Gods I can get along with, but religions have too many strictures. (Chaotic)
Dark forces make for good bargains when it comes to gaining power. (Evil)
We are small, unimportant specks in the grander scheme of existence. (Neutral)
I will unfold reality to discover the truth of these worlds. (Any)
I received a vision of something terrible that will occur unless I stop it.
There's a deep imbalance in our society and someone needs to rectify it.
I want to travel the world, see the sights, and plumb its depths.
I am under the effects of a powerful curse that I must cleanse.
People have started vanishing from my usual haunt. Where are they going?
I've got too much blood on my hands to attone. Instead, I obscure my past.
I have witnessed the void, and it has left its taint in me.
I reflexively attempt to weird out others to keep them at a distance.
I have a set of unwritten rules that I expect others to know and follow.
Other people can't handle the truth, I'd better keep it to myself.
I get uncomfortable anywhere with a fancy atmosphere or formal people.
Mundane people are so... mundane.

entries: Shrouded in the mysterious depths of dark alleyways, abandoned subways, and fetid sewer tunnels, there exist underground societies which practice the mystical arts. Street shamans come in many forms. You may be a psychic, a fortune teller, a healer, a witch, or any manner of practitioner of the enigmatic and arcane. While some may find your services dubious at best, and profane at worst, there's no denying the demand for them exists.

A.special: Ledger of Student Debt (50 gp owed to your academic institution)

items.name: Feat:
items.entry: {@feat Magic Initiate|XPHB} (Cleric) or {@feat Magic Initiate|XPHB} (Druid) or {@feat Magic Initiate|XPHB} (Wizard)

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, {@item Ink Pen|XPHB}, {@item Ink|XPHB}, {@item Book|XPHB}, {@item Paper|XPHB|5 pages of paper}, Ledger of Student Debt (50 gp owed to your academic institution)

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You immersed yourself in the study of a particular field, dedicating countless hours to the pursuit of knowledge. Whether at a prestigious academy, a secluded druidic circle, a seminary devoted to divine teachings, or even a bard college, your education has granted you insight into the arcane, natural, or divine. This rigorous training allows you to grasp the fundamentals of magic, blending scholarship and practice. Though your studies have often kept you from the broader world, your education and keen mind now prepare you to face its challenges. Whether by circumstance or choice, you now carry your lessons into the unknown.

rows: A pivotal experience, such as discovering an ancient artifact or surviving a calamity, ignited my thirst for knowledge.
I became fixated on a specific mystery, theory, or craft, and my studies began as an attempt to unravel it.
My family pushed me toward academic excellence, believing it was the path to success and prestige.
My studies provided a refuge from a difficult home life or dangerous environment.
I have always been fascinated by the mysteries of the world and couldn't resist the call to learn more.
A brilliant mentor recognized my potential and encouraged me to pursue my studies.
I struggle with social cues, preferring books and theories over people.
I am forgetful of things like meals or sleep when immersed in a fascinating subject.
I see the world as a grand experiment and often approach situations analytically rather than emotionally.
I tend to correct people's mistakes, even when it annoys them.
I view every challenge as a puzzle to be solved, regardless of how impractical that may be.
I quote famous scholars and their works in conversations, even if no one else understands them.
I carry a notebook and write down everything I find interesting, from magical theories to mundane gossip.
I am always seeking to learn, asking endless questions about everything and everyone.
Knowledge. The pursuit of knowledge is the noblest goal. (Neutral)
Curiosity. I believe that questioning everything is the path to true understanding. (Chaotic)
Improvement. Learning is a means to better myself and the world. (Good)
Ambition. I strive to become the foremost expert in my field of study. (Neutral)
Logic. Emotions are distractions; logic and reason must prevail. (Lawful)
Domination. Knowledge is power, and I will use it to bend others to my will. (Evil)
I owe everything to a mentor who recognized my potential and pushed me to succeed.
A rival student humiliated me once, and I seek to surpass them in every way.
I feel responsible for protecting a rare book or artifact entrusted to me.
My family sacrificed much to support my studies, and I want to make them proud.
I am dedicated to proving a controversial theory that no one else believes in.
I long to return to my place of study, where I felt most at home.
I am so focused on learning that I neglect practical concerns, like personal safety or well-being.
I am overly critical of those who I believe are less intelligent or educated than me.
I find it difficult to admit when I'm wrong, even in the face of overwhelming evidence.
I hoard knowledge, refusing to share what I've learned with others.
I can become fixated on a problem or mystery to the point of obsession.
I often disregard rules or traditions that I see as outdated or irrelevant.

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Sign language (mutually intelligible with thieves' cant) and one of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a {@item climber's kit|PHB}, silk rope (50 feet), and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 15 {@item gold|PHB}.

entries.name: Cell Specialty
entries: Every part of the Summit Road operates independently, and every cell is self-sufficient. Each group has scouts, trackers, smugglers, and magic users, and it's not uncommon for members to practice several professions at once. You can select a Specialty below or roll randomly, then add details to determine the other members of your cell.

entries.caption: Specialties
rows: Scout
Spy
Mage or psion
Smuggler
Cartographer
Thief

entries.name: Feature: Summit Cell
entries: As a member of the Summit Road, you have close contact with other members of your specific cell. Each cell has approximately five to eight guides, all of whom can operate independently but have a wide range of skills. Through your cell, you can easily send and receive messages throughout Adar. Your cell can also provide you with resources and magical services if need be, though you will be expected to return the favor.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The life of a Summit Guide is a hard one at best. Do you do this out of a sense of duty? Is this the only way you could survive being exiled for a crime? How do you handle one of the most dangerous jobs in Adar — and how have you survived despite the costs?

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I've been told a mule is nicer than me.
I try to be kind to the kids at least.
I always keep a dagger under my pillow... or just in my hand.
When it's safe, I love telling stories of my missions.
Paranoia and I are old friends.
The adrenaline rush of a mission never gets old.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Escape.} All that matters is getting people out; better to die than be captured. (Any)
{@b Order.} If we don't stick to our plans, we're as good as dead in this line of work. (Lawful)
{@b Chaos.} The less predictable we are, the less likely we are to be caught. (Chaos)
{@b Refuge.} We strive to get people to safety. (Good)
{@b Knowledge.} The more we know, the better chance we have to survive. (Any)
{@b Cruelty.} Only the strong survive this path; cut out the weak parts of our organization. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: My cell is my family now; everyone else has rejected me.
I was saved by the Summit Road; I want to go back for someone else.
Someone was captured and only I can save them.
I took up this job for the money; once I get enough, I want to go home to my family.
My mentor was cursed on a mission, and I want to find the cure.
One of my cell members defected to the Thousand Eyes, and I have vowed to stop them.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I'd rather die than be captured.
Given the choice between saving someone and staying alive, I will always choose myself.
I'm too nice, something I know will get me killed.
I believe people in my life have been replaced with spies.
I trust absolutely no one, not even myself at times.
The ends always justify the means.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Two of the following: {@skill Perception}, {@skill Survival}, {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Athletics}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Cook's utensils, one other set of artisan's tools

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Cook's utensils|PHB}, {@item climber's kit|PHB}, a {@item shovel|PHB}, a pair of thick gloves, a cloak with a hood.

rows: Being alone for so long means I am very used to conversing with myself out loud.
I eat things that others find disgusting. I have learned to love the delicacies of scavenged food in the ruins.
I have many scars across my body from barely scraping by.
I am missing a finger on one hand due to a horrible encounter I had in the ruins.
I keep a locket of someone I lost in the ruins. I stare at it every night before I fall asleep to remember what I am looking for.
I keep souvenirs of the monsters I have bested in these ruins, to remind myself how strong I truly am.
I can sleep just about anywhere, nothing really phases me anymore.
I often recite the names of people I used to know and lost so I can hold on to their memory.

entries.name: Feature: Makeshift Meals
entries: You know how to purify food and rations found in the ruins. When you take a short rest, you prepare a meal for a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus. Creatures who consume the food regain hit points equal to your level. Once they do, they can't regain hit points from another one of your meals until they finish a long rest.

entries.caption: Suggested Characteristics
rows: I always have an exit strategy in mind if things go poorly.
You can't survive in this grim city without a good sense of humor, but I have a taste for gallows humor.
I try to work in the thin grey area between the squabbling factions, squeezing under their radar when possible. The less I am seen, the better.
If you spot danger, it is best to avoid it, that's how you survive.
Drakkenheim is a dangerous place. But I can navigate it with my eyes closed. No one else I've ever met is as good as I am.
In order to survive the monsters of Drakkenheim, one must be a monster of Drakkenheim.
Take everything you can from the dead, take it from the living if you can. If you are to survive, you must take any opportunity to scavenge.
I will never give up until I reclaim what I lost in these ruins.
Self-Reliance. I won't risk my life for others. Everyone must fend for themselves—better you than me. (Evil)
Bravery. I find the thrill of surviving the monsters and magics of Drakkenheim exhilarating and thrive on the chaos. (Chaotic)
Safety. Whatever I can do to keep myself fed and keep a safe place to rest is good in my books. (Any)
Helpful. People need all the help they can get in the city, and I know I can provide it. (Good)
Hope. I believe there is something worth saving here, we must hold on to the idea of a better future. (Good)
Responsibility. I lived here before the meteor, I'll live here long after. I must protect my home and do what I can to make it livable again. (Lawful)
I had family in these ruins. I know not what became of them, but I must find out.
This city is my home, and I will fight for what's left of it until the very end.
I'll do any dirty work in the city if it means a hot meal, a warm bed, or some good company.
I've spent so long in these ruins, its the outside world that terrifies me now.
Why haven't I left Drakkenheim? Have you seen how much gold there is to be made here?
I am bound to the throne of Drakkenheim, and fight to see it one day reclaimed.
Any meal could be my last. I'll eat just about anything. I do what I must to survive.
I don't like being outside the Haze of the city for too long, I've gotten used to it.
I am convinced my family is alive in the city somewhere. I hear their voices call to me at night.
I don't trust anyone easily. I'll sleep with one eye open even around my companions, for Drakkenheim makes monsters of us all.
The years spent here have turned me to a vice, I very much rely on that vice to get me through my days.
I hear voices constantly. Sometimes I get distracted with conversations with people who are not there.

name: Swamp Angler

_: a set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)
a small collection of dried fish and other preserved foods

entries: You were born and raised in the murky swamps, where you learned the art of survival through fishing and hunting. As a swamp angler, you know the ins and outs of the swamp's ecosystem, from the best fishing spots to the dangers that lurk beneath the murky waters.

entries.name: Feature: Swampcraft
entries: You have a deep understanding of how to navigate and survive in the swamp. You have advantage on ability checks made to navigate a swamp, find food and potable water in a swamp, and avoid hazards such as quicksand and hostile swamp creatures. You also know how to construct shelters and rafts using natural materials found in swamps.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am always on the lookout for my next meal, no matter where I am.
I am cautious around strangers and always keep my guard up.
I am fiercely independent and prefer to rely on myself rather than others.
I am always looking for ways to improve my fishing and hunting skills.
I have a dry sense of humor that sometimes catches people off guard.
I am a bit of a hoarder, and I have trouble parting with items that I think might be useful.
I am often stubborn and willful, and I refuse to back down even when doing so might be in my best interest.
I am curious about the world beyond the swamp and often find myself daydreaming about far-off places.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Self-Reliance. I am responsible for my own survival, and I will do whatever it takes to stay alive. (Neutral)
Adaptability. Life in the swamp is unpredictable, and I must be ready to adapt to any situation. (Chaotic)
Resilience. Living in the swamp is tough, but I'm tougher. I can handle anything the swamp throws my way. (Any)
Cooperation. I prefer to work alone, but I know I sometimes need help from others to survive. (Lawful)
Freedom. I value my independence and will not be controlled by anyone or anything. (Chaotic)
Exploration. The world is vast and full of wonders, and I want to experience as much of it as I can. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I am fiercely protective of my family and will do anything to keep them safe.
I owe a debt to a fellow swamp angler who saved my life.
I have a deep connection to the swamp and feel a sense of duty to protect it from those who would harm it.
I have a prized catch that got off the hook. I'm going to catch it again one day, and this time, it won't be so lucky.
I am searching for a lost artifact that is rumored to be hidden somewhere in the swamp.
I have a secret that could destroy my reputation if it were ever revealed.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am so shortsighted that I focus too much on the present and end up ignoring the long-term consequences of my actions.
I take risks that others might consider foolish or dangerous.
I am paranoid and suspicious of others, even when there's no reason to be.
I have a deep-seated fear of leaving the swamp and become agitated or panicked when forced to travel beyond its borders.
I exaggerate my accomplishments and skills, which can get me into trouble when I can't back up my claims.
I hold grudges against those who wrong me, and I seek revenge even when it is not justified.

name: Swamp Chef

_: a recipe book containing your favorite swamp dishes
a selection of herbs and spices

entries: You have spent your life living off the land in the swamps and marshes of western Immoren. Along the way, you've learned how to cook up delicious and unique meals made from local flora and fauna, no matter how humble or unappetizing the ingredients.

entries.name: Feature: Swamp Cuisine
entries: You are a master of swamp cuisine, and your cooking skills are renowned throughout the region. As a part of a short rest you can prepare a meal that feeds up to 6 creatures. Each creature that consumes a meal you prepared regains a number of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am always happy to share my food and my knowledge with others.
I am resourceful and inventive, and I can create a meal out of almost anything.
I am outgoing and talkative, and I love to swap stories and recipes with others.
I am fiercely independent, and I prefer to rely on myself rather than others.
I am patient and calm, even in the face of adversity.
I am passionate and enthusiastic about cooking and the outdoors.
I am observant and always looking for new ingredients and ideas.
I am generous and always willing to help out those in need.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Generosity. Sharing is the greatest joy. (Good)
Adaptability. No matter the challenge, I can find a way. (Chaotic)
Independence. Relying on myself is the only way. (Neutral)
Exploration. There is always something new to discover. (Chaotic)
Creativity. Innovation is the key to success. (Any)
Resourcefulness. Nothing is ever truly wasted. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I owe a great debt to the person who taught me to cook.
I am loyal to my family and always put them first.
I have a deep connection with the swamp that I call home.
I have made a vow to cook with only the rarest ingredients.
I strive to create the most delicious dishes possible.
I will do anything to ensure that my recipes are passed down to future generations.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am overly competitive with others, especially when it comes to cooking.
I am easily distracted by shiny objects and new ingredients.
I have a hard time trusting people I don't know.
I take risks without considering the consequences.
I am slow to forgive those who wrong me.
I can't say no to a good meal.

name: Swimming Spirit
entries: You descend from a water Spirit such as a Dolphin Spirit. Once per day you can double your swim speed for one round.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}, Chest (with False Bottom), {@item Parchment|XPHB}, {@item Costume|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: Goods from one side of Etharis often fetch a fair price on the other side. Transporting such goods are a hassle—dealing with the bureaucracy of customs and taxes is an even larger one. Thankfully, as a representative of the Ebon Syndicate, you are there to eliminate at least part of the hassle.

Whether you move goods by land, sea, river, or air, crossing borders and avoiding detection are your specialty. Sometimes having a way to hide goods is the game. Other times falsifying paperwork or bribing guards does the trick. However you manage to do it, you get what people want into their hands for the right price.

_.special: tankard engraved with your own name

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Pipe and pipeweed, a tankard engraved with your own name, common clothes, a gaming set, and a pouch containing 5 gp in loose change.

entries.name: Reason for Leaving
entries: Fate tore you from your favorite bar stool, and you emerged blinking into the world outside. Choose a reason for leaving your tavern or roll on the table below.

rows: Your bar tab became untenable and you were barred until the debt was settled.
You fell out with the locals over a disagreement about sports.
You slept with the proprietor's spouse.
You made a drunken bet that you'd make yourself rich within the year.
The tavern keeper went bankrupt and the regulars are now gathering coin to buy the premises.
The tavern blew up.

entries.name: Feature: On the Tab
entries: You have a knack for avoiding payment for simple amenities. If an item or service is priced at less than 1 gp, you can acquire it for free. In addition, you receive free lodging and food at most cheap inns and taverns, allowing you to live a poor or modest lifestyle for free.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Tavern regulars are generally friendly souls who are quick to laugh and always ready with a humorous quip or anecdote. Each regular typically has a boorish area of expertise that they're unqualified to talk about, or a catchphrase they keep repeating.

rows: I love nothing more than the company of good friends.
I know dozens of tavern games and am happy to teach them to my friend.
I love to talk late into the night.
I'm friendly and welcoming; willing to invite anyone into the group.
I know a thousand songs and have one for any occasion.
I love pub food and am always eating.
I like to sit quietly and take in the room.
I believe the pub is the height of civilization. Its equal will never be created.
Community. We're all in this together, so let's hash out our problems over a pint of ale (Good).
Egotism. Everyone knows your name. You make sure of it. (Neutral)
Larceny. The raucous celebration of the common room is the perfect cover for my thievery. (Chaotic)
Exactitude. I always make sure everyone buys a round, we split the bill evenly, and tip the staff. (Lawful)
Dependency. I hate being alone. (Any)
Violence. I like to start barfights. (Evil)
My two bar buddies know more about me than anyone in this world.
I met someone across a smoky taproom one night and I've been searching for them ever since.
I want to share everything I know with others and drink makes me more gregarious.
A meal isn't a meal unless its shared with others.
I want to meet new people and try new things.
I like to hide in a crowd.
I'm always getting into debt.
I'm desperately lonely and latch onto anyone I think might connect with me.
I always drink too much.
I love to argue about politics, literature, or art. I'll take a side just to argue.
I have blackouts and don't remember what happened.
The more I drink, the more unpredictable and violent I become.

entries: You've spent your life propping up the bar at your local tavern. This beloved drinking hole was your second home, its patrons your extended family. Here you whiled away the hours, putting the world to right in a bar where everybody knew your name.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Brewer's supplies, one type of gaming set

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A frayed wash rag, an apron, a set of common clothes, a gaming set, brewer's supplies, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Tavern Tales
entries: Years in the taproom exposed you to myriad tall stories, urban legends, and gossip. Whenever you visit a new locale, there's a chance you'll recall some tidbits of local knowledge. The usefulness of this information could vary from knowing where to find the best barber, to remembering which tombstone Captain Walharrow buried his treasure under.

On the DMs discretion, roll a d20 whenever you enter a new location, with higher results gleaning more useful information. If the DM allows it, you can work with your group to determine what the information could be.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Most tavern workers have seen the best and worse in people. While they often have blunt natures, they also make great listeners and usually have practical advice to offer for common predicaments.

rows: I'm always willing to listen to problems and help if I can.
I love to be the center of attention and keep the party going.
I like it loud and boisterous.
Having tried it all, I'm a connoisseur of spirits and always match a patron with the right drink.
I want to know the world around me, so I love people watching.
I have a sharp, poisonous tongue.
I love hearing stories from faraway places and collect souvenirs from places I hope to someday visit.
I have a dark secret I hide behind a jolly exterior.
Sobriety. I've climbed back on that wagon, and I'm clinging on for dear life. (Lawful)
Enabling. There's always room for one more drink. Let me pour it for you. (Chaotic)
Helpful. I've heard it all and I like to look out for my patrons by giving helpful advice. (Good)
Greedy. The drunk are easiest to cheat. (Evil)
Joyous. I'm here for the party. (Any)
Searching. My life's mission is to craft a signature beverage for which I'll become famous. (Neutral)
I'm a sucker for a pretty face.
I'm closer to my regulars than my family.
This tavern means the world to me.
I inherited my position at the tavern. It's a family business.
I am a proud member of the Brotherhood of Booze. I can bond with anyone over a drink.
I like cleaning up after others before settling down for a rest.
I believe that all halflings are thieves, bad luck, or both.
I like to butt into other peoples' conversations.
I'll do anything for tips.
I love to collect stories and share them, so I'm a terrible gossip.
I collect stray animals which I let live in my tavern.
I love a game of chance and am always trying to get into a game. When gaming, I take risks that I shouldn't.

entries: You've spent years working in a tavern: pouring drinks for thirsty patrons, mopping floors, preparing food, or waiting tables. Your rough-and-tumble life has been lit by torchlight and wreathed in pipe smoke, but the experience has shaped you into the person you are now: sharp-tongued, thick-skinned, and worldly wise.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, {@item Pouch|XPHB|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

entries: You provided arcane assistance to an organization operating out of the public eye. Did you serve with the Royal Eyes of Aundair or the King's Citadel of Breland, crafting Common items for agents? Or was it a shadier operation like the Boromar Clan or House Tarkanan? Why did you shift to a life of adventure? What pieces of your old life could come back to haunt you?

_.special: A broken piece of a mysterious machine

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: {@item Mechanist's tools|DarkMatter}, one set of artisan's tools

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item tinker's tools|PHB}, a broken piece of a mysterious machine, a large pipe wrench (counts as a {@item mace|PHB}), a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a pouch containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Vent Tape and Elbow Grease
entries: Invariably, technologists find themselves needing to repair things without access to the proper tools, training, or spare parts, having to make do with temporary stop-gap measures and whatever they happen to have on hand. Your experience with this means that you can often cobble something together to keep a damaged system working for a few crucial minutes or hours, as long as you focus all of your attention onto it.

entries.name: Specialism
entries: Most technologists are highly trained in the workings of a handful of systems and have only theoretical knowledge of others. Decide which machines you have worked on, or roll on the table below.

rows: Dark Matter engines
Blasters
Arcane databases
Power systems
Shield generators
Automatons and construct cores
Cranes and docking systems
Climate control systems
Terrestrial/atmospheric vehicles
Industrial machinery

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Technologists are a breed apart, often preferring to work with machines than with people. Having to blend technical knowledge, manual skills, and a certain amount of creativity in order to succeed in their roles means that they are sometimes rather eccentric in character.

rows: I am extremely curious about everything.
I collect random pieces of junk.
I have strong opinions about different manufacturers of tools.
I prefer machines to people.
I have an encyclopedic knowledge of material properties.
Attention to details is my middle name.
I am very attached to my custom-built weapon.
I have an uncanny instinct for when a ship is about to break down.
Fix What's Broken. I see myself as a healer of the sick; someone who restores hope when things are going wrong. (Good)
Invent Something New. The purpose of life is to break the mold and do things that have never been done before. (Chaotic)
Build Deadlier Weapons. I derive pleasure from the thought that my machines might hurt people. (Evil)
Everything in Its Place. I believe it's important to make the universe more organized and efficient. (Lawful)
Just a Job. I do what's needed, but nothing more. Getting paid is what's important. (Neutral)
A Better Future. More technology will make this world a utopia! (Any)
I am extremely attached to a particular machine.
I am looking for a lost piece of technology.
I need to find an expert in an obscure science to help me complete my life's work.
My current employer has sent me to a distant system to do some specialist work.
An important device has been entrusted to me for maintenance and repair.
I formed a strong bond with my ship's crew.
I compulsively disassemble any machinery that isn't in use right now.
I can't bring myself to trust magic-users.
I am incapable of communicating my ideas clearly and concisely to other people.
I suffer from very rigid logic and struggle to think outside of the box.
I jump in trying to fix things before properly assessing what the problem is.
I'm completely uninterested in history, art, or culture.

entries: The galaxy is filled with machines—machines that often break down. Technologists are experts in repairing, tuning, and decommissioning the devices that other people rely on for their employment, comfort, and safety. Therefore, they are in constant demand everywhere, from heavily-industrialized foundry worlds near the galactic core, to the Frontier worlds on the rim. Moreover, any ship of significant size is likely to employ engineers to keep it flying, regardless of where it finds itself in the 'verse.

Technologists come in all shapes and sizes, so there are lots of reasons why they might become adventurers. It could be that they are drawn to the challenge, or that they seek to uncover arcane secrets that can be incorporated into their machines. Some might have gotten their start as hired helpers for an established adventuring party, while a surprising number turn to druidry, having become so sick of malfunctioning technology that the only option is to cut it out of their lives altogether!

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Interface Rig|DarkMatter24}, {@item Omnitool|DarkMatter24}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB} (overalls), {@item Vent Tape|DarkMatter24}, 13 CR; or (B) 50 CR

entries: Grease-stained overalls and the smell of solder have been with you since an early age. Machine servos and Construct programming have always come easy to you, perhaps culminating in a job as a ship mechanic or automaton repairperson. Whenever your work station is free of clutter, you fill it again with a new project, an endless conveyor belt of inventions and experimental builds. A huge project probably occupies the periphery of your mind, a white whale that'll require all of your skills and a bit of luck to finish.

name: Temple Flameguard

_: a holy symbol of Menoth called the Menofix

entries: You are a true soldier of the Menite faith. Originally tasked with guarding a sacred temple, you have since marched to war, guided by the hand of the Creator and his priests.

entries.name: Feature: Fiery Courage
entries: Your years of service to the Temple have been filled with flame—both in the rituals of your belief and in the arms you carried into battle. While carrying a fiery item such as a torch or a flame spear, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and effects caused by flames cannot frighten you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Faith honed to a razor's edge by a life spent in service has left little room for doubt in the minds of the Temple Flameguard. Quick to act, they know right from wrong, whether or not others agree.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I have an uncanny knack for twisting every conversation to the subject of my faith.
I'm boisterous whenever I'm off duty, which is all the time now.
Scripture is my guide to most moral dilemmas.
I'm a serious person and have little time for those who aren't.
Once I set my mind to something, I do my best to achieve it.
I revere a particular hero of the Protectorate and often inject my idol into conversations.
I have always been an optimistic soul.
I see the world in black and white.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Duty. Even though I no longer serve the Protectorate directly, I still aim to better the lives of the faithful through my actions. (Lawful)
Power. I joined the Flameguard as a means of gaining strength and standing. (Evil)
Greater Good. I fight for the good for the many, not just the good of the church. (Good)
Faith. The Creator's tenets are sacrosanct and should be followed to the letter. (Lawful)
Ambition. I left the Flameguard in order to fulfill my great potential. (Any)
Vengeance. Realizing that I could not claim true vengeance against those who blaspheme the Creator, I struck out on my own to rectify this impiety. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: The Claiming left me with only one family member, whose safety and happiness are very important to me.
During my service, I made friends with a superior officer who still holds a position in the Flameguard.
I left the Flameguard in order to recover an ancient relic.
I was left at a church as a baby. I still owe a debt to the clergy there for raising me.
Despite having left the church's direct service, I still follow any command it gives.
I left the Flameguard because an officer had it in for me. Time has clouded the reason for this conflict but has not lessened the officer's enmity.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: No one sees my true greatness; clearly, others are just jealous of me.
I judge everyone harshly, myself included.
I am so courageous that many call me foolish.
Violence is always the correct solution.
Those who do not show my faith the proper respect shall be punished.
I lost my faith years ago. Guilt gnaws at my heart, and I fear the gaze of the scrutators.

_.special: a memento from a member of your platoon or commander (Tharchion, Tharchioness, or Zulkir)
a small booklet of Thayan propaganda

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Choose two from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Survival}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Choose one type of {@item gaming set|PHB} and one vehicle

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Thayan trinket|TLotRW}, Thayan citizenship papers, a memento from a member of your platoon or commander (Tharchion, Tharchioness, or Zulkir), a small booklet of Thayan propaganda, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp.

entries.name: A Step Too Far
entries: Before you decided that enough was enough and abandoned your post, you were commanded to perform one questionable activity after another. The memory of the final command haunts you to this day.

entries.caption: The Final Command
rows: You discovered your commander was magically charming other members of your platoon. When you voiced concern, you were awarded a promotion and removed from field duty.

After several weeks of raids that left caravans destroyed and their supplies completely raided, you found the raider's lair. Upon discovering that the raiders weren't quite adults, you were told to recruit them or to let the necromancers do it.

You had guarded the tollhouse for several mostly uneventful months near the distant border. One day while inspecting a wagon, you found it was full of children who were being smuggled out of Thay while their parents stayed behind, so the children might have a better life. Their plight resonated with you on a deep level.
War is terrible for many reasons, but you've been unable to reconcile your bloody actions against the reasoning that your commanders kept presenting.
Your unit was always assigned to clear the battlefield. The aftermath became too much to bear, and the dead seem to be getting younger and younger.

After being told for years that the outside world was filled with monstrous people, you were shown kindness after sustaining a life-threatening injury. Their openness has caused your perceptions to shift.

entries.name: Feature: Heart of Darkness
entries: Those who look into your eyes can see that you have faced unimaginable horror and that you are no stranger to darkness. Though they might fear you, commoners will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they will even take up arms to fight alongside you, should you find yourself facing an enemy alone.
{@note (This feature originally appeared in {@background Haunted One|VRGR|Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft}.)}

name: The Brand of Odom
entries: {@b Adventuring Company.} Through the centuries, the conclaves of the Brand of Odom have passed down their traditions, indoctrinating all Rhulic wizards into the Brand. Some of these arcanists are tasked with affairs of state, and venture forth to root out heretics, traitors, and arcane secrets.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: Members are citizens of Rhul, and at least one member should be a Rhulic arcanist who is a member of the Brand and follows the oaths and laws laid down by Great Father Odom.

entries.name: Company Accomplishments
entries: Your company's prestige increases through acts such as: negotiating a contract for rare minerals; discovering a unique magical device; discovering and destroying rogue Rhulic arcanists; fabricating a mechanikal item worth at least 1,500 gp; defeating an arcane threat to Rhul.

entries.name: Tier 1 — The Branded
entries: {@b Arcane Lodge.} You maintain a modest lodge with a common room, guest quarters, workshops, laboratories, a library, a kitchen, and stables. You can stay at the lodge and maintain a modest lifestyle at no expense. You gain a single hireling with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower to act as the butler.

{@b Scholars of Magic.} You can replace one proficiency gained from your race or background with proficiency in the Arcana skill. If you are a spellcaster, you learn one additional cantrip from your spell lists.

entries.name: Tier 2 — Adepts of the Arcane
entries: {@b Arcane Forge.} As a downtime activity, you can produce {@dice 1d3} 1st-level spell engines or learn a new mechanika rune with a rune point cost of 2 or lower. The cost of crafting components for mechanikal items is reduced by 20 percent.

{@b Muscle and Metal.} You gain your choice of {@dice 1d6} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower, one Grundback Snapper steamjack with a challenge rating of 1 or lower, or an ogrun master-at-arms with a challenge rating of 1 or lower.

entries.name: Tier 3 — Mystics-at-Arms
entries: {@b Full Metal Arcanist.} As a downtime activity before a combat engagement, your company's spellcasters can choose any two spells of 2nd level or lower and replace them with two different spells, both primarily magical attacks. Non-spellcasters can spend downtime changing runeplates and charging capacitors.
{@b Law and Order.} When interacting with others, you can replace Wisdom (Insight) checks with Intelligence (Arcana) checks.

entries.name: Tier 4 — Elders of Odom
entries: {@b Company of Iron.} You gain your choice of {@dice 1d6} hirelings with a challenge rating of 1 or lower, or {@dice 1d4} ogrun with a challenge rating of 2 or lower.
{@b Foundry of Odom.} When crafting mechanikal items at your lodge, you receive a 30 percent discount on materials and reduce the time needed to craft by 20 percent.

entries.name: Quirks
entries: Roll or choose a quirk: (1) You have an anvil that dates back to the rebellion and the creation of the colossals; (2) You inherited the company after the passing of a friend; (3) You gained control of the lodge after winning an arcane duel—the former leader has left vowing revenge; (4) You discovered a vein of precious ore in a forgotten mine; (5) Your company has a long history with an ogrun tribe; (6) Your lodge sits upon a haunted mine from which spirits wander; (7) Your company was founded after you were witnesses in a trial and the defendant was executed; (8) Your lodge hides a secret: one of its founding members was a traitor; (9) Your lodge is an extension of a larger lodge; (10) Your lodge has the bones of some ancient beast rumored to have been slain by a legendary master of the Brand of Odom.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Nature}, {@skill Old Lore|TLotRR}, or {@skill Performance}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: A {@item musical instrument|SCAG} of your choice

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Patient, Subtle

name: The Cursed Raider
entries: Once you were an accomplished raider with a promising future, but you had also become arrogant and overly proud. You thought of yourself as a walking legend and your place in the Halls of Slain was surely guaranteed! Then you made the unfortunate mistake of allowing a rival clan's foul-tongued skald to survive after a raiding victory. That skald cursed you upon that battlefield:
No death shall find you, As you walk all paths, across all lands, Beyond and below, all living things, Till the wolf rises at the forever sunset.

You laughed off the curse but that evening you choked on the bones of a boar while celebrating your victory and died an inglorious death. Your clan left you on that beach in the middle of nowhere, to be claimed by Hel and brought to her Underworld. They mourned for you, knowing that your death was unworthy, and you would never enter the Halls of the Slain.

Yet you returned to life the very next day. Since then you have died several more times, but you always rise again, the following morning. Now you seek a way to end the curse so that you might die as a raider should and earn your place in the Halls of the Slain.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a {@item blanket|phb|winter blanket}, a boar's bone, {@item navigator's tools|phb}, a {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: A Raider's Rune
entries: You received a rune tattoo upon reaching adulthood in your clan but upon your first death, it changed. That tattoo now resembles the rune {@i |} and indicates the frozen north, the unchanging lands, and you have long seen it as a sign that you must introduce change into your life. At certain moments in the story additional runes will be drawn, adding to your story, your abilities, and your penultimate reason for existing.

entries.name: Feature: Curse of Undying
entries: No matter how much damage is delivered you are never killed outright. Additionally, if you fail three death saving throws, you do not die. Instead you appear dead, but at sunrise of the following day you are restored to 1 Hit Point, as if you had stabilized.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You have lived many lifetimes, a wanderer among all the raiding clans and you may have even spent time with the Baendur. You have been many different people, but some core characteristics have remained with you, throughout.

rows: Nobody believes me when I tell them about my past, so I hide it.
I speak in {@i kenning} using compound words such as ankle biter (young child) or battle-sweat (blood) or whale-road (the sea).
I cannot keep my mouth shut when I see others make mistakes. There is a right way to do things and it is my duty to tell others.
Sometimes I think I am living in the Halls of the Slain already and so are all those around me. Maybe nobody really dies? Maybe reality is not what it seems?
I hate singing of any kind and will go out of my way to avoid hearing it.
I think with each death I lose a bit of myself—memories or abilities or humanity. I am terrified of dying now.
Charity. It is my duty to help protect and provide for others. (Good)
Freedom. There is no point in any connections to others, for they will all wither and die. I go where I shall. (Chaotic)
Might. I have lived so long in order to hone my battle skills and I now take what I want from weaker folk. (Evil)
Live and Let Live. I am much like the wild forests, themselves. We live as we must. (Neutral)
Knowledge. One blessing of this long life is that I have time to learn many wondrous things. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I will free myself from this never-ending life. (Any)
I have given up on the Stone Court and worship Mirgal as the one true god of Grimnir.
I have had many children over the years and do my best to watch over them. I sometimes even travel with them, in disguise, to better protect them.
I am fond of a particular valley, forest, or mountain. Only the natural world remains for me to care about.
I believe the only future for Grimnir is to make real the prophecies of the völv and defeat our adversaries at Ragnarök.
I long for the life I lost and often return to my original homestead.
I hear voices from the darkened woods and am drawn to understand them better.
I fear I shall never enter the Halls, and so I act recklessly to prove myself.
Finding new experiences becomes harder and harder over the centuries and I will leap at the chance to do something different.
I am immensely jealous when I see another warrior act valorously, for I fear they will take my rightful spot in the Halls of the Slain.
I am terrified of being imprisoned, forced to live a life, or many lives, in restraints.
I would feel shame if others knew my secret.
I mock those that eat meat, since I've avoided it ever since choking to death.

entries.name: Starting Story Connection
entries: After your expedition to Kekkell with Hrolf you intend to part ways and find a mysterious seer that is rumored to live in the town of {@i Nowhere}. You start with knowledge of the rough location of that town on your world map.

items: {@b Find the Skald.} You must locate the skald that cursed you and decipher how to break free from the curse to end your relentless life.

{@b Seek the Components.} You must seek out any materials or knowledge you need to prepare yourself for ending the curse. Doing so will provide you with a magical item that will help you end your curse. {@b Reward.} You find a powerful item. Choose one of the following:
{@b A Deathbringer} weapon of your choice.
{@b A bronze horn of Valhalla} (usable only by you and without needing to meet the requirement for the item)

{@b End the Curse.} With the knowledge received from the skald, you must do whatever it takes to sever the curse's grip on your soul. {@b Reward.} You can now die as any other mortal might and when you do, you know you will enter the Halls of the Slain.

entries.name: Epic Goal: Enter the Halls of the Slain
entries: You have lived many lives and long for your place beside the great hearth fires of the Halls of the Slain. You must die honorably in an epic battle that atones for both your prior arrogance as well as the numerous minor deaths you have incurred during your eternal life.
{@b {@i {@optfeature Gift of Perseverance|ROTSSPGF}}} You have advantage on all saving throws.

name: The Fallen
entries: You are a wanderer of the world yet have no clear idea why this is so. Beyond the last few years, you have no firm memory of a past life or who (or what) you once were. You awoke in a sea damp cave along the coastline of the towering inner mountains. The cave was situated several hundred feet above the Serpent Sea, and you spent hours climbing down. Eventually you found your way to a small fishing village and found a place there. You have, over time, adjusted to life in Grimnir.

But who are you... where did you come from? Do you have a family? Why did you lose your memories? These questions plague you more in recent weeks as strange dreams have surfaced... dreams of another realm. Another you.
You sense that you must serve a great purpose and you yearn to discover what this must be.

Yay, the not belonging, its like skinning your hands on a rough rock you be movin'. Just keep pushing. You either widen that gap and walk on through... or push hard enough and the bastard rolls down a hill and crushes something.
entries.by: Hroarr Longspear, Jarl of the Knattle

items.name: Restrictions:
items.entry: Most options will work but the game master has the final decision and should be consulted when selecting this option

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: a {@item staff|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb} and a heavy fisher's wool sweater, a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Fate's Bite
entries: You have a scar on your hand that resembles the rune {@i ᛈ}. To the raider people this rune can represent chance or mystery. At certain moments in the story additional runes will be drawn, adding to your story, your abilities, and your penultimate reason for existing.

entries.name: Feature: The Maker
entries: You are connected to the world in ways that you do not understand. At times Grimnir itself guides your hand when you work with the artisan tools you have chosen. You always have advantage when using that tool. Additionally, once per long rest, if you fail a tool's check, you may choose to succeed.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The Fallen is a blank slate and can fill many roles in the community they find themselves in. Though lacking in knowledge, they are quick learners and are uncannily wise to the world around them, intuiting the correct way to act, even in unfamiliar situations. Some portion of the life they lived remains with them. Though possibly aloof, they tend to be liked, even respected, by their adopted communities.

rows: I adore the world I live in, and I want to add beautiful things to it.
I love a well-crafted insult, including those directed towards myself.
Despite all I know, I speak little and let others make decisions.
I dislike those that are unwilling to put in a hard day's work and am willing to call them out on it.
I am more comfortable in the deep woods, than I am around people.
I am always polite, even to my enemies.
Respect. I believe all living things are worthy of being treated well. (Good)
Logic. I measure everything in life the way I measure the materials of my trade... emotion is not important. (Lawful)
People. I am committed to those I travel with, not to any specific ideals. (Neutral)
Might. My swift anger is reason enough to put others in their place. (Evil)
Self-Improvement. I want to master the tools of my trade. (Any)
Truth. Discovering the truth of who I am is important and all I do must lead me to that truth. (Neutral)
I am fond of the village (and clan) where I have lived since coming down from the mountain.
I have a mentor who helped me a great deal; I would do anything for them.
I lost my temper and damaged a relationship that I seek to mend.
I adore the tools of my trade and treat them as well as I would treat a person.
I believe my honor and my glory are paramount.
I will suffer so that others will not.
Dreams (or nightmares) plague my sleep and I often have a cruel headache, making me bitter and irritable.
I work myself too hard to avoid thinking about what I might have been in the past.
II feel I must serve a greater purpose and if I need to, I will flee from battle to save myself until I know what that purpose is.
I hide this belief, but I do feel that others are beneath me. I am special, they are not.
Sometimes when I am standing at a high location, I feel the urge to jump.
Hating my own lost past, I refuse to keep secrets for others.

entries.name: Starting Story Connection
entries: When you heard about the völv's desire to explore the tower at Kekkell you were intrigued, for your most recent dreams have been showing you a strange ruin, to the south. You have seen yourself walking the halls of an ancient building and you believe you may find a trace of your past at Kekkell. You signed on to become a member of Hrolf's expedition.

items: {@b Your Truth.} You must learn what you actually are and where you are from. {@b Reward.} Choose any valid feat from the player's handbook as if you had reached the appropriate level to gain it (all other prerequisites must still be met). This represents remembering a small portion of the person you once were.
{@b Why are You Here?} You learn why you are in the world of Grimnir and a hint of how to restore your true self.

{@b Reclaim Your Past.} You must discover a way to return to your homeland and to restore as much of yourself as is possible. {@b Reward.} You find an item connected to your mysterious past. Pick one of the following:
{@b The Falcon Coat} allows you to fly and move between different locations across the world—and possibly between other lands.
{@b Dragon Scale Mail} (your choice of scales), gifted to you far in the past.

entries.name: Epic Goal: Redeem the past
entries: Once you discover your past, an ancient threat is revealed that you must vanquish. But it will involve a costly sacrifice and your decision may determine the fate of Grimnir.

{@b {@i {@optfeature Gift of the Slain|ROTSSPGF}}} Once per long rest you can teleport yourself between Grimnir and the {@i Halls of the Slain}, allowing you to walk the mortal lands and offer assistance as needed. You may elect instead to teleport a willing (and worthy) incapacitated raider from Grimnir to the {@i Halls of the Slain} (but not in the reverse direction).

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Hunting|TLotRR}, {@skill Intimidation}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Smith's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Fierce, Stern

name: The Royal Heir

_.displayName: Knife with your family's insignia on the pommel

entries: Your family once ruled a wealthy Baendur kingdom and your mother was a respected and remarkable queen. One winter's day, raiders invaded your lands. When your parents rode out to oust them from your lands, your family was defeated. You, the youngest of all your siblings, was taken prisoner and forced to watch your brothers and sisters slaughtered.

Since then you have lived with the raiders and have come to accept them as your own people. They eventually adopted you and you are no longer a thrall. Yet you have never forgotten your family or the lands that by birth are yours to inherit. Recently your adopted family died during a raid between rival clans. You survived but the location of your homeland was lost with the deaths of your raider family.
We bide. The savage raiders plunder, slaughter and capture us. But we bide, we do. Our time shall yet come.
entries.by: King Cenric Edgare of the Baendur

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: a {@item staff|phb}, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb} and a heavy fisher's wool sweater, a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Fate's Orphan
entries: You received a fate tattoo ({@i ᛊ}) upon becoming adopted into a raiding clan. This rune symbolizes the sun and the growth it brings the world, as well as indicating certain success for the rune wearer's ambitions. Later in the story other runes will be drawn, adding to your story and your abilities.

entries.name: Feature: True Survivor
entries: You thrive under adversity. Whenever an ally reaches 0 Hit Points (whether they die or recover), give yourself inspiration. Unlike other characters you may accumulate more than one inspiration.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The royal heir has always lived in two worlds the dead family they feel loyalty and kinship with, as well as the raider family that raised them. They also feel guilty because they care for their adopted family and this may come across to others as aloofness or surliness. Others are often drawn to the heir, despite this.

rows: Everything is always taken from me so why care for anything? I live life on my terms.
I suffer nightmares over the massacre of my birth family and their deaths trouble my waking hours.
As a child of two worlds, I see multiple perspectives, especially in an argument. I can often help others avoid conflict.
Death is inevitable and if it is my fate to die this day, so be it.
I am unshakeable in my belief that I am owed more from this world and nothing will deter me from accomplishing my objectives.
Having known much death, I live large and am eager to celebrate accomplishments and victories (whether they are mine or others).
Sincerity. I am what I am. (Neutral)
Freedom. I will never live in chains again, nor should any other. (Chaotic)
Responsibility. I must respect those above me, as those below me must respect me. (Lawful)
Retribution. I shall spill the blood of all those that wronged me. (Evil)
Compassion. Having been weak once myself, I seek to protect those that need it. (Good)
Aspiration. I must honor the legacies of both my birth and my adopted peoples. (Any)
I think of my birth family daily and will honor their memory one day by reclaiming my homeland.
My adopted family made me who I am today. I will retake my homeland in their name.
I am my own person. I will take what I want and rule as I desire.
I am connected to the land itself and owe no loyalty to either clan or kingdom.
I must produce an heir so that my lineage does not end.
I am still seeking a home, a place where I belong.
I seek the oblivion of sweet mead to forget my troubled past.
I believe I am protected by a higher power and will be unduly reckless.
Friendship and family are pointless if all others in my life are destined to die. Better to be on my own and rely only on myself.
I believe something I did led to the death of my parents and I hide this shameful secret.
If I see someone treated unfairly, I react without thinking through the consequences.
I am terrified of water and never learned to swim.

entries.name: Starting Story Connection
entries: After your raider family perished, you served as a guard for the völv and have recently joined Hrolf's expedition to Kekkell to earn glory and respect. You think with the plunder to be found in the south that you may soon own your own longship.

Such difficult lives that we live. Though unfit to become a seer, I have served many years, protecting these servants of fate. I found my purpose. I pray nightly to the Stone Court that all such others find theirs

items: {@b A Raider's Revenge.} The murder of your adoptive family cannot be left unatoned for. You must seek out and slay the raiders responsible for their deaths. {@b Reward.} You gain 1 bonus glory point.

{@b Find Homeland.} You only have a dim memory of the location of your kingdom it is in the west. Beyond that you are not sure, though you remember vineyards and gentle mountains and a more temperate climate than what you have experienced since then. {@b Reward.} Reaching the kingdom's location will put you in touch with former allies of your family, which will unlock new connections. You may also be able to recover a lost family heirloom. Choose one of:
{@b Helm of Awe} This is a powerful item once worn by your mother. It increases both a commander's prowess as well as their soldiers' ability to overtake the enemy on the field of battle.
{@b A very rare Ioun Stone} of your choice, a treasure of much value to your lineage and passed dutifully down through the generations.

{@b Return to Glory.} Once you have recovered the location of your homeland, it is your duty to return there and reestablish rulership, in the name of your mother and father. {@b Reward.} You gain 1 glory point.

entries.name: Epic Goal: Unify the Kingdoms
entries: Long have the Baendur been disjointed. Take control of all the scattered kingdoms and unite them into a single empire.

{@b {@i {@optfeature Gift of Glory|ROTSSPGF}}} You gain 3 glory points. As long as your glory is 15 or higher, you automatically succeed in any Persuasion or Intimidation check with the Baendur and have advantage on such checks with all others.

name: The Stranger
entries: You were part of a merchant's caravan making its way to a bustling port in your homeland, when a multicolored portal appeared, swallowing you and the rest of your caravan.
