You emerged on a barren coast, a tumultuous sea to your north. Many of the caravan wagons were damaged, or lost, entirely, having appeared in the hostile waters. You, and the other survivors, made your way along the coastal desert but all manner of unusual creatures assailed you. Many of your companions died and only a few of you found your way to Nowhere.

You joined this community of outcasts and are now a varang a clan less raider. Guided by the town's seer, you have made a journey west, to the Tower of Kekkell, with the hope that the secrets in the ancient building might help you understand how to return home.

Stories, I collect, I do. A truth, the raiders avoid, is that much is owed to newcomers. New stories, new ways. These stranded visitors, however they have arrived, improve us, they do. And eager, am I, to meet them all.

items.name: Player Interest:
items.entry: Wizard of Oz, The Fionavar Tapestry

items.name: Restrictions:
items.entry: Must be an explorer from another land (unlike other backgrounds, multiple characters may have this option)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} (missing an important piece), a borrowed mead horn, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a well-made {@item pouch|phb} containing 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: A Newcomer's Rune
entries: You have been tattooed with a traveler's rune ({@i ᚱ}), given to you by the rune master of the varang in Nowhere. At certain moments in the story additional runes will be drawn, adding to your story, your abilities, and helping you understand how you might return home.

entries.name: Feature: Resourceful
entries: When visiting an unfamiliar populated area, you can decide to socialize with the locals. If you make a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check at the end of six hours you can then live a modest lifestyle in that community for only 1 silver piece a day. This location becomes favorable to you as well and any Persuasion, Deception, or Insight checks are made with advantage in this community.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You have a deep longing for your homeland, having either family or friends there that you miss deeply. You would do anything to return home, but you are also aware that doing so requires you to accumulate glory and wealth, so you have the means to find a way. You have also begun to make connections and attachments, likely causing a division in your loyalties.

rows: I have learned to cook many different types of food since arriving here, and I am constantly on the hunt for more.
I often daydream of returning home, so much so that I do not always pay attention to what is going on around me.
I am enamored of this strange and wonderful place and often take notes of what's different about this world.
These raiders are just like any other—they want things and they can buy things. I will find a way to survive in this unusual world—and profit!
So many of my friends have died since arriving here but I have survived by keeping my head down and avoiding undue attention.
I am intimidated by the raiders, their physical prowess, and their risk-taking confidence, so I feel I must also prove my value.
Change. Expect the unexpected... I am capable of handling any situation thrown my way. (Chaotic)
Charity. I know that no venture succeeds without the help of allies; I ensure that I always give back to the community. (Good)
Fairness. I do not cheat or lie in my dealings; I will succeed because of my abilities. (Lawful)
Knowledge. I'll figure out a way to create trade routes between this world and mine; each has so much to offer the other. (Neutral)
Greed. These raiders are simple people, I'll learn a way to exploit them. (Evil)
Aspiration. I must find a way home. (Any)
A few of the townsfolk have gone above and beyond to ake care of me since arriving and I would do anything for them.
I am spreading word of my faith, to keep that connection to my old world alive.
I made the mistake of cheating at a game against a raiding captain a few weeks ago; I've been avoiding them ever since.
Many adventurers have been part of my caravans and I have always idealized them—if I were ever part of such a group, I would do my best by them.
I borrowed something from someone who has vanished, and I feel obligated to find them and return it.
I live for the game... if I see the right sign in the roll of the dice, I will change all my plans.
I am too optimistic regarding new information... I will follow even the vaguest of leads.
I worry that a portal may appear at any moment to take me to another world. I tend to carry everything important with me whenever I go anywhere.
I borrow money to partly pay off debts to others, so I have a complicated web of financial obligations.
I dislike getting my hands dirty and will compulsively wash dirt or blood from me.
Profit is always important; I always need to come out better in a deal.
I don't trust magic or those who use it.

entries.name: Starting Story Connection
entries: You have lived as well as you can in the town of Nowhere, since finding refuge there after being brought to Grimnir. You work odd jobs or help a more prosperous merchant manage their affairs. You have visited the rune master at least once and his rune casting is guiding you towards the Tower of Kekkell.

items: {@b The Nature of Portals.} Explore the Tower of Kekkell for a clue as to what might have transported you to Grimnir.

{@b Find Your Old Caravan.} Several important treasures went missing when you arrived in Grimnir. You must find them. {@b Reward.} A gem worth 2500 gp, 500 pp, and three uncommon or common potions of your choice and one rare potion of your choice.

{@b Recover a Powerful Item.} Your earlier clues will lead you to realize an ancient item must be restored before you may return home. You will recover a piece of the item. {@b Reward.} From the same secret treasure that you find the magical item you will also recover any one of the following:
{@b A frost brand} weapon of your choice.
{@b A ring of regeneration.}
{@b A crystal ball of scrying} (very rare).

entries.name: Epic Goal: Open a Portal Home
entries: You must fulfill your dream to open a portal home, either to return there, or to create a bridge between both your worlds.

{@b {@i {@optfeature Gift of the Traveler|ROTSSPGF}}}. In any urban location you can live a wealthy lifestyle for a mere silver piece a day. Additionally, while within 1 mile of any sort of portal (whether created by a gate spell or manifested by a magical item) you can do any of the following:

items: Automatically determine the exact location of the portal once within 1 mile of it.
Use an action to teleport to the portal (once per day).
Use an action to close the portal (once per day).

items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, {@item Bullseye Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

_.special: small article of jewelry that is distinct to your tribe

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Herbalism kit|phb}, a small article of jewelry that is distinct to your tribe, a {@item hunting trap|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Poor

entries.name: Overview
entries: You were born into a nomadic tribe that called the Ticklebelly Hills home. You migrated from location to location, living off the land with your tribe. The tribe would seasonally travel south into the Grass Sea and the Giant's Cairn, north into the Dragonspine Mountains, and even occasionally east across the Stojanow River to the borders of the Quivering forest.

In your migrations, your people have come to know the stone giant tribes that populate the Giant's Cairn. The dragon cultists came to the hills one day—magic-users wearing purple and riding horrid beasts, black-clad warriors wearing wicked masks, and even soldiers from the nearby town of Phlan. Then the dragon called Vorgansharax arrived and laired in the hills, causing horrid thickets to grow and animals to act unusually. The cultists began raiding nomad camps for victims to offer to the wyrm. Eventually, the dragon moved on to attack Phlan, but life was never again the same for the nomads of the Ticklebelly Hills.

entries.name: Feature: At Home in the Wild
entries: The wilderness is your home and you are comfortable dwelling in it. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate when out in the wild. This place of rest is secure enough to conceal you from most natural threats. Threats that are supernatural, magical, or are actively seeking you out might do so with difficulty depending on the nature of the threat (as determined by the DM). However, this feature doesn't shield or conceal you from scrying, mental probing, nor from threats that don't necessarily require the five senses to find you. Note: This feature is a variant of the Folk Hero feature.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Ticklebelly nomads only venture into civilization when necessary. You are social within your tribe, with tribes of other nomads, and even with the stone giant tribes that populate the Giant's Cairn. However, other communities tend to either put you on your guard or put you in a state of wonder. Was it this wonder that enticed you into a life of adventuring? On the other hand, you are fiercely protective of and dedicated to your tribe. Perhaps it was this dedication that led you to venture out; either of your own will or at the behest of your tribe's leaders.

rows: I eagerly inject myself into the unknown.
Villages, towns, and cities do not suit me. I'd rather be out in the wilderness any day.
I accomplish my tasks efficiently, using as few resources as possible.
It's difficult for me to remain in one place for long.
I loudly brag about my tribe every chance I get.
Having walked among giants, I am fearless in the face of bigger creatures.
I am quiet and reserved, but observant. Nothing escapes my attention.
My word is my bond. I see a promise to completion, even if it conflicts with my beliefs.
Kinship. Family is most important in life. Though I may be far from my own, the bonds of family must be protected in others' lives as well. (Good)
Preservation. Nature must not be despoiled by encroaching civilization. (Any)
Wanderlust. One must expand their horizons by seeing the world and exploring. (Chaos)
Isolation. My tribe and its ways must be protected and shielded from outside influence. (Neutral)
Protection. Threats to the land and to the people must be dealt with at any and all costs. (Law)
Belonging: All creatures have a place in the world, so I strive to help others find theirs. (Good)
I ache to return to my tribe and the family I left, but cannot until my obligations are fulfilled.
The dragon cultists that invaded my homeland stole away one of my tribe's people. I will not know rest until I've found them.
The dragon's presence in the hills destroyed valuable territory and resulted in deaths within my tribe. The creature must pay for what it has done.
I carry a trinket that spiritually and emotionally ties me to my people and my home.
I discovered a strange relic in the hills during my tribe's wanderings. I must discover what it is.
One of the stone giant clans from the Giant's Cairn has graced me with a mark of kinship.
I throw myself and my friends into situations rarely ever thinking about consequences.
Unfamiliar people and surroundings put me on edge.
I have absolutely no patience for slowpokes and those who prove indecisive.
My desire to experience new things causes me to make unsafe choices.
I am overly protective of nature, sometimes to the detriment of my companions and myself.
My lack of worldliness often proves my undoing in social, commercial, and hostile situations.

name: Time-Lost

_.special: a pair of gold bracelets worth 7 gp each

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A bone-dagger, {@item club|phb}, simple loin cloth, {@item herbalism kit|phb}, a gold necklace worth 30 gp, and a pair of gold bracelets worth 7 gp each

entries: The time-lost are those unfortunate individuals who have been propelled through time, either by accident or against their will. They find themselves in a strange land, surrounded by unfamiliar cultures and creatures.

entries.name: Feature: Way of the Wild
entries: While in an environment that is the same type as your origin, you are not slowed by difficult terrain generated by that environment.

entries.name: Environmental Origin
entries: In your previous time, you inhabited a particular environment and are most familiar with that terrain type. Roll a {@dice d8} and consult the table below or choose whichever you find most appealing.

rows: Jungle
You are unbothered by trekking through thick undergrowth.
Forest
You have a fondness of foraging for wild berries in forests.
Desert
The desert sun feels wonderful on your face and you like to bask in it.
Tundra
Getting chilly outside makes for a warmer, more welcoming, hearth at home.
Mountainous
You enjoy taking the difficult route, so long as it gives the best view.
Riverside
Catching fish is one of your favourite pastimes and is second nature to you.
Seafaring
You love diving and collect exotic shells you find on the seafloor.
Plains
You always enjoy the calming breeze blowing across the plains.

entries.name: Suggested Starting Feat and Ability Scores
entries: If you use your background to determine your ability score increases and provide a starting feat, we recommend the following:

items: {@bold Feat:} {@feat Alert} or {@feat Naturalist|DrDhrolinsDictionaryofDinosaurs}.
{@bold Ability Scores:} +2 Constitution, +1 Wisdom or Strength.

entries.name: Suggested Tool: Survivalist's Kit
entries: {@i Common, 1 gp, 9 lb.} This kit is used to carefully extract resources and medicines from plants and animals. It consists of a small flint-knapped blade, wooden tweezers, water-proof pouches, and adhesives. The kit provides expertise with Medicine checks, so long as you are in an environment with abundant plants/animals/fungi.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The time-lost come from many different periods of time, environments, and cultures. However, they all share a lack of knowledge of the modern world. How they respond to that lack of knowledge differs – they may find things frightening, exciting, or uninteresting.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I'm fearful of new technologies.
I love to collect beautiful feathers and adorn my clothes/armour with them.
Gold is commonplace to me, and I find it boring.
I find slaying certain creatures reprehensible.
I venerate creatures of great power.
Every new piece of technology is extremely interesting to me, but also confusing.
The sounds of a city keep me awake at night.
I keep the teeth of monsters I slay on a necklace or bracelet.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: I see myself as nature's protector. I want to bond with and protect the modern wilds.
I see myself as an explorer and there are so many new things to discover!
I'm an expert hunter. I want to find this time's most dangerous beast, and hunt it!
I'd like to return home. I need to learn about time travel and how I got here.
I seek to gain as much power and prominence as I can in this new time.
I miss the good ol' days. I want to change this world to be more like my time.

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I must find a way to return to my time.
My ancestors are out there somewhere. I must find them and reunite.
This new world is so strange, I'd like to explore what it has become.
There's a bounty of wealth that I never could have imagined, I'd like to sample it.
I'm the last of my kin. I must re-establish my clan/tribe.
I left without settling a score. I must find out whether my old enemy was destroyed.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: In my savage world, those who fell behind were left behind. I keep to this code.
I'm fearful of technology, it seems like evil magic to me.
I'm from a violent time, I act quickly and violently, worrying about consequences later.
I'm naive about the dangers of this world.
I think these modern comforts make people weak.
I'm gluttonous with the bounty of all this exotic food!

entries: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Explore|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Mason's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Eager, Merry

entries: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Riddle|TLotRR}

entries: {@item Potter's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Eager, Honourable

items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Stealth}

entries: {@item Cartographer's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Subtle, Wary

_.displayName: Sheriff's insignia (badge) a set of fine clothes

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Thieves' tools|phb}, a gray cloak, Sheriff's insignia (badge) a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and 17 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modest

entries.name: Overview
entries: You are one of the many people that make sure the trade routes are clear at ALL times. You assure that the Great Law of Trade is followed at all costs. You work by yourself or in groups to quell bandits and brigands who might stop trade routes from going through. You investigate potential ambushes and possible rumors as to someone wanting to rob or stop caravans. You are as much an investigator as you are law enforcement.

You are able to go into a town/village around the Hillsfar area and find a contact that is willing to give you information from rumor to fact. This sometimes comes at a cost of a minor bribe of 1-9 silver pieces.

entries.name: Feature: Investigative Services
entries: You are part of a small force outside of Hillsfar. You have a special way of communicating with others and they seem to be at ease around you. You can invoke your rank to allow you access to a crime scene or to requisition equipment or horses on a temporary basis. When you enter a town or village around Hillsfar you can identify a contact who will give you information on the local rumors and would help you simply because of your desire to get answers and information for anyone wanting to disrupt trade. Note: This feature is a variant of the soldier feature.

rows: I am always polite and respectful
I let my actions speak for themselves
I am haunted by my past having seen the murder of a close friend or family member and it is the one case I always needed to solve but have not been able to.
I am quick to judge and slow to vindicate
I can be very persuasive and am able to ask quest ions where others might not be able to.
I have a quirky personality that seems to take others off their guard.
My sense of humor is considered by most to be awkward.
Everyone has a choice, and they can always make the right choice, mine!
Hope. my job is to speak for the victim (Good)
Dedicated. Once I start an investigation, until told to do so, I do not quit, not matter where it leads. (Lawful)
Nation. My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)
Mercenary. When I do investigations, I expect answers immediately. (Any)
Eloquent. I use my words to sway others to give me answers. (Good)
Might. It is through threats and force that I get my answers. (Lawful)
To this day an unsolved case will always leave me haunted and bother me.
Through the might of my personality I will solve an investigation or puzzle.
It is my right to believe what I will, just try and stop me.
I need to prove my worth to my fellow Sheriffs
Someone I cared for died under suspicious circumstances. I will find out what happened to them and bring their killer to justice.
I speak for those that cannot speak for themselves.
I always over exaggerate my abilities.
I cannot bear to let those I care for out of my sight.
I took a bribe to tank an investigation and I would do anything to keep it secret.
I have little respect for those that are of "low" intelligence/race.
I always enjoy a good mug of ale... or five to cover up my past.
I speak for the First Lord of Hillsfar and make sure everyone knows it.

name: Trader
entries: You might have been a member of the Searforge Commission in charge of one of their trading posts outside of Rhul, or perhaps you spoke for a group of traveling gobber bodgers who hoped to pick up some odd jobs in the wake of passing armies. Whatever your past, you've always had a nose for a deal.

entries.name: Feature: Master Haggler
entries: Your business sense allows you to easily read markets and identify opportunities to make or save a little bit of coin. You have advantage on Charisma checks made while trying to establish the price of goods and services. Additionally, when setting out on a long journey, you can negotiate with a fellow trader either for passage in exchange for guarding a shipment or for information about which goods may be needed in your destination's markets. At the GM's discretion, if you know the destination of a significant journey, you can purchase any one type of common good in your starting location and sell it for a profit at your destination.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Whether they are of noble or common birth, traders know how to interact with—and get the best deal from—nearly everyone. A careful balance of pragmatism and optimism helps ensure they're prepared for the next deal that comes their way.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am committed to fairness in all transactions, and I respect those who feel the same.
I love turning a phrase. No blade is sharper than my wit.
Those who can't appreciate the finer things in life are barely worth my time.
I take great delight in completing a transaction.
Learning what makes people tick is an important part of my profession.
If it's worth doing at all, it should be done right.
I am always upbeat. Few events, if any, can sour my mood.
I could go on forever when someone gets me talking about my profession.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Profit. Honestly, I'm just looking to get paid. (Neutral)
Honesty. I'll never cheat or swindle someone who offers me a fair deal. (Lawful)
Superiority. Pulling one over on someone else means I'm cleverer than they are. (Evil)
Rarity. Common baubles don't interest me. I'm looking for the most unusual things I can find. (Any)
Freedom. This life makes me the master of my destiny. (Chaotic)
A Bargain. I'm happiest when I know I've gotten the best possible deal on something—on anything, really. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I have a deep hatred for a powerful noble who went back on a lucrative deal.
I work hard to provide for my family.
During the course of my dealings, I came across some scandalous information about a powerful person.
One of my trade deals went poorly. Even though it wasn't my fault, the other trader still has it in for me.
I hope that becoming wealthy will allow me to attain a specific person's love.
I am part of a merchant's guild that helped me a great deal when I was just getting started as a trader. I still feel I owe that organization a debt.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I'm constantly saving for a rainy day, to the point of almost never spending money.
Acquiring a noble title is a dream I would kill for.
I never trust anyone in a transaction. Everyone else is out to cheat me until proven otherwise.
I have sticky fingers and often pocket small tokens or coins even if they have little or no value.
Risking my life for rare and priceless items is certainly not out of the question.
To me, money is equivalent to power. Amassing both is my ultimate goal.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Stealth}  and one of {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill History}, {@skill Religion} or {@skill Nature}.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Weapon black (enough for one {@item shortsword|PHB}, or two {@item dagger|PHB|daggers}), face black (charcoal), a {@item grappling hook|PHB|grapple hook}, {@item caltrops (bag of 20)|PHB|caltrops} (p.151 PH), a set of {@item common clothes|phb} and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp. A vial of {@item Deathstalker Scorpion Venom (vial)|TWSAGU|Deathstalker Scorpion Venom (5 doses)}, a "{@item Sting of Steel|TWSAGU}" dagger with poison chamber (page 6).

entries.name: Feature: Mentor
entries: White Scorpions often a have a special bond with the person who trained them, especially as they will be one of the only members of the Order they deal with directly and regularly. In times of need they may go to this mentor for advice.

entries.name: Feature: Guild Membership
entries: Recruiting and training members is a slow and expensive process, meaning that the White Scorpions do their utmost to protect their members, especially as every member is also a guardian of many of the Order's secrets. As identities are not revealed unless absolutely necessary, locating other guild members can be difficult (see Secret Signs section on page 3) but if a member can locate another they can rely on them for shelter, food and even small loans. Towns with a Temple of Tyr, the God of Justice, are often a place of sanctuary, as priests of these temples sometimes serve as members of The Claw.

Guild membership comes with its obligations, and just as one might seek shelter or help, one must be ready to give it when another calls for it. Additionally members are expected to donate 20% of their income to the guild (usually by leaving it at a Temple of Tyr). They must also be ready to carry out Necrodicta and attend the Grand Confab at a moment's notice (see Rules, Duties and Regulations on page 7).

entries.name: Feature: Animal Poison Resistance
entries: As well as immunity to the Deathstalker Venom, the years they have spent ingesting this poison means White Scorpions have advantage on saving throws against the venom of naturally occuring animals and beasts, including giant beasts.
(They save against all magical poisons such as drow, wyvern and purple worm poison, as well as natural plant-based poisons, as per usual).

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The majority of White Scorpion acolytes are serious men and women, whose outlook on life is very much dictated by the mandates of the Order. Some however have never been able to completely stifle their own rage, passions and desires and have an internal struggle between faithful servitude of the Order and following their natural impulses. Some believe they can do both.

rows: My training is my life. I'm completely dedicated to fulfilling my destiny.
I resent the demands of my training, and I'm dreading the initiation ceremony.
My training has instilled iron discipline. I stay calm no matter what the situation.
Injustice fills me with rage. And when I get angry I get violent.
I'm always alert to danger. I survey my environment at all times and sit with my back to the wall.
I find it hard to make connections. So far in my life everyone's taken advantage of me.
Someone ruined my life. My heart is consumed by fervent dreams of revenge.
Words are meaningless. I am a (wo)man of action.
{@b Justice.} I hate seeing injustice go unpunished. (Good)
{@b Revenge.} I will go to any length to have my personal revenge. (Lawful)
{@b Greater Good.} I have sacrificed my life to make society a better place. (Chaotic)
{@b Order.} My role is to strike down those who bring chaos and anarchy to the realms of men. (Evil)
{@b Destiny.} The gods have given me a destiny and I won't flinch in fulfilling it. (Neutral)
{@b Death.} I'm fascinated by death, and take grim satisfaction from being its agent. (Any)
The Order rescued me from the streets and gave me a purpose. I owe them everything.
My mentor is like the mother/father I never had.
My only bond is to (s)he who wronged me. I will not rest until they are in the grave.
I have a younger sibling who I had to leave behind in a terrible situation. I will find them and save them.
The God of Justice is my patron. I have dedicated my life to serving him.
I have a secret love, even though the Order forbid it.
I have been treated so badly, I don't know how to trust and communicate.
I'm so obsessed with my goal I can't focus on anything else.
I don't believe in mercy or kindness, only justice.
I am impatient and believe myself ready, even if my mentor says otherwise.
The killing game ain't for the faint hearted. No wonder I need a drink, or five, afterwards.
I'm fearful and paranoid. I wake up every night in cold sweats.

entries.name: Trainee Assassin
entries: White Scorpions come from many backgrounds, such as Noble, Soldier, Urchin and even Criminals, recruited with a view to reforming them for a greater purpose. In gaming terms these characters would start off as ordinary 1st level Rogues and only later in their adventuring life enter the guild and start training to become an Assassin (normally having gained enough experience points to reach 3rd level as this is the level at which you can choose the Assassin archetype - p.97 of the Player's Handbook).
However some players, knowing in advance that they wish to select the Rogue's Assassin archetype, may wish to select this custom made White Scorpion Trainee Assassin as a background from level one.

Characters who select this background are assumed to be in training with the White Scorpion guild and have already learned some important skills in the arts of stealth and killing from their mentor. It is likely that they were recruited by the Order at a young age, and now they must go out into the world as an adventurer to gain vital experience before they are ready to finish their training.

entries.name: White Scorpion Trainee Assassin
entries: You were recruited at an early age as a potential White Scorpion assassin, and your life up until now has been dedicated to training with a view to becoming a fully fledged member of the Order (even if the name and details of that Order have been kept secret from you up until now).

To you the world is an ugly place full of chaos and injustice, which, prior to you preparing for life in the Order, gave you little but misery and suffering. The Order however has given you purpose, discipline, confidence and strength. You are determined to complete your training, survive the initiation ceremony, and rise to fulfil your destiny as a weapon of justice.

entries.name: Credits
entries: Reference {@link Hipster & Dragon|https://www.dmsguild.com/product/224166/The-White-Scorpions-Assassins-Guild}. Please credit if you repost elsewhere.

_.special: A trinket worn or carried by your previous form

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A trinket worn or carried by your previous form, a set of traveler's clothes, an {@item alchemist's supplies|phb|alchemist's kit}, an {@item explorer's pack|phb}, and a pouch containing 5 gp

entries.name: Life-changing Event
entries: You were previously a different kind of creature. How you became what you are, and what you know of your former existence, can vary greatly depending on the circumstances. Choose or randomly determine the lifechanging event that brought about your transformation.

rows: My bond was severed and my form irrevocably changed in a surge of wild, uncontrolled magic that claimed the life of the mage who called me their familiar.

The Pact of the Chain between my warlock and myself was dissolved unexpectedly with their passing. Their patron, not wanting to lose two advocates, granted me my current form as a reward for services rendered, and expects me to continue their works.
My service to, and partnership with, a mage of great power and cunning was rewarded with transmogrification into my new body.
I awoke in an unfamiliar body, with only dream-like memories of my prior service to a being of great arcane ability.
I broke my bond with my master, replacing it with a pledge of service to a higher power. Part of the bargain was providing me with a new form to more easily hide from my past.
I stood by my master's side as aide, ally, and advisor until an unknown enemy severed our connection, robbed me of my true body, and captured my master.
My master, infirm with age and senility, unintentionally released me and altered my body in an attempt to rejuvenate themselves.
I betrayed my master in a time of crisis, and their last act was to transform me into my current form, robbing me of my natural body forever.

entries.name: Feature: Familiar Insight
entries: You are a transformed familiar, and although your physical form has changed, you will never forsake the instincts and insights you were born with. When interacting with creatures of your original type, you have a +2 bonus on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks to detect their motives and the veracity of their claims.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Transformed familiars often display Personality Traits and Quirks that are holdovers from their prior lives. They might hold to these affectations consciously, or without realizing their behavior is unusual. Either way, every transformed familiar carries their past with them in some manner.

rows: I am fiercely independent, and do not form strong emotional connections to others.
I seek the advice and Guidance of others before Acting.
I continue to behave as if I'm in my original body.
I am lost in social situations, and the behaviors expected of me confound me.
I punctuate my exclamations with a subtle growl of emphasis.
I keep my own counsel, sharing my thoughts reluctantly, if at all.
I am fascinated by seeing familiar places through the eyes of my new body.
I react instinctually to Stress, problems, and challenges. My gut reaction is the right one.
{@b Loyalty.} Remaining Steadfast when there are no witnesses to see it or accolades to celebrate it is the measure of a person. (Any)
{@b Service.} The path to enlightenment lies in serving a greater cause. (Any)
{@b Freedom.} Better to die free than to live in chains. (Chaotic)
{@b Duty.} A pact, entered into freely, can never be taken back and must be fulfilled. (Lawful).
{@b Atonement.} It is my lot in my new life to make up for the failings in my first one. (Good)
{@b Family.} My Family is my port in the storm and my refuge from the world. (Any)
I am still friendly and even loyal to arcane casters, especially wizards.
I swear no oaths and make no promises to anyone else. I stand alone.
I loathe slavery and enchantments, and work to free those trapped by chains or magic.
I have not forgot my former Master, and I continue to honor my pledge to them.
I prefer to serve, aid, and protect my allies and Friends.
I dislike disguises or changing my form further; I want the world to see me as I now am.
I prefer to sleep in the same fashion that I rested when I was a familiar.
Transmutation magic of all kinds frightens me to the core. I will not willingly use it or have it used on me.
In my heart of hearts, I long for the life I left behind.
I sometimes speak in the language of my old form, or forget the Speech of Humanoids.
I still prefer the foods of my prior form, and sometimes refuse the foods commonly consumed by my new one.
Life was easier as a familiar, and I am wistful about those bygone times.

entries: Your connection to magic began with a term of service, or servitude, to a magician of power. Your partnership continued as expected for years, until the bond was abruptly broken. In the aftermath, you found yourself with a new body. Despite your new appearance, your actions often betray your Origin. The struggle between what you have become and what you once were rages within you.

_.displayName: round leather scroll case containing 10 pieces of parchment

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Perception}, plus your choice of one of the following: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Sleight of Hand}, or {@skill Survival}.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of tough, rugged clothing, a set of {@item trapmaker's tools|TreTra}, a small boot knife, string, a wooden hammer, box of 50 1-inch iron nails, a small envelope holding 15 hollow needles, a thimble, a round leather {@item map or scroll case|phb|scroll case} containing 10 pieces of {@item parchment (one sheet)|phb|parchment}, 5 small pieces of writing charcoal, a spool of wire, a spool of thin braided rope, a spring, a pulley, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Professional Courtesy
entries: When you come into contact with other trap makers with whom you share a language, you can talk shop. When you do this, you have a better chance of building professional rapport. At the GM's discretion, this might shift them away from being hostile, provide you a discount on materials, or they may decide to do you a small favor.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Being especially perceptive, you're always keeping a keen eye on your surroundings. Even in polite company, you're always looking for the nearest exit. You're rarely surprised since you have likely thought of many different ways a particular situation could go. You may also have some scars from your exploits, which you may or may not wear proudly.

rows: I'm persistent and don't give up easily.
It takes a lot to aggravate me but, once I reach that point, I explode like a powder keg.
I have a particular aversion to being confined in a space with no exit. My favourite places have no walls and no ceilings.
I'm trusting of those who seem genuine and always try to see the best in people.
I'm attracted to people with money and power.
I'm willing to risk everything for the sake of adventure.
I've regaled many a stunned crowd with stories of my adventures.
I'm especially sensitive, and resistant to criticism.
{@b Practical}. I use my skills to aid those with righteous intent. (Lawful)
{@b Reckless}. We may lose a few people along the way so the rewards better be worth it. (Chaotic)
{@b Supportive}. The coin I make from my skills goes to benefit the needy. (Good)
{@b Selfish}. Me, myself, and I. (Evil)
{@b Assignment}. It doesn't really matter who I'm working for, or to what end, as long as I get paid. (Neutral)
{@b Unpredictable}. People around me never know what I'm going to do next. (Chaotic)
Most of my earnings go to my guild.
I'm avoiding a manipulative and dependent family.
I regret putting my friend in a dangerous situation, one that led to their death.
Folk from far and wide will one day tell tales of my exploits.
I go it alone, and I always have.
I'm quick to make new friends, but also quick to lose them.
The desire to see what's beyond the horizon has gotten me in trouble more than once.
When I earn money I quickly, and foolishly, spend it.
It's every foolhardy adventurer for themselves when the plan goes sideways.
I have a loose relationship with the truth and will say whatever I need to if it's advantageous to me.
I am cowardly in the face of adversity.
I'm cheap and refuse to pay fair prices for goods and services.
I'm missing a digit or two.
I have a nasty scar on my face or head.
I have a prosthetic appendage.
A section of my body has been horribly burned.
I have a permanent limp.
I don't have any eyebrows, and they never grow back.

entries: You love traps and you always have. The satisfaction when something comes together {@i just} right is a feeling you're very familiar with. You have always enjoyed tinkering with things and finding ways to defend your home or place of business with dangerous devices. You understand that traps can be, and often are, harmful but you treat your profession with some degree of ethics, depending on whether or not you consider the potential victims of your traps to be deserving of their fate.

_.special: dark clothes with a hood and a face covering

_.displayName: signet ring of a fake lord

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Investigation} and one choice from the following: {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Insight}, or {@skill Perception}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Thieves' tools|PHB}, a set of dark clothes with a hood and a face covering. A {@item signet ring|PHB} of a fake lord, a fake identification, a set of weighted dice, and a deck of cards

rows: You keep a cryptic map to a lost treasure that you have always wanted to uncover.
You have a coin that is heads on both sides, helpful for winning a chance game.
You have a magnifying spyglass you use to examine items.
You have a ring that opens to reveal a small compartment inside.
Your left boot has a compartment for a hidden dagger.
You carry an old compass that doesn't point north, you hope it points towards a great treasure.
You have a collection of exotic coins and medals that are of personal value to you.
You have a rival treasure hunter who used to be a partner. You parted ways years ago.

entries.name: Feature: Detail-Oriented
entries: You double your proficiency bonus when making any ability check to search the ruins of Drakkenheim.

entries.caption: Suggested Characteristics
rows: I believe that I am destined for greatness, and nothing can convince me otherwise.
I always have a plan or plot to outwit my foes. It may not always be good, but it's almost always overly complex.
I love to flaunt my wealth and showcase the things I have bought with it.
I pay no mind to the risks of a situation. I always bet on myself and my abilities and it's gotten me this far. Never tell me the odds.
I have a quip, allegory, or joke for almost any situation.
I lie about anything and everything. I lie for almost no reason at all, sometimes just to see if I can fool the people around me.
I use flattery and honeyed words to get what I want.
I can't help it if valuable objects lying around end up in my pockets. It's for safe keeping.
Independent. No one tells me what to do. I make my own rules, and my own luck. (Chaotic)
Fair. I do not take anything from anyone who couldn't afford to lose it. I am a treasure hunter, not a thief. (Lawful)
Family. I care about material possessions and wealth, but not as much as I care about my friends and family. (Good)

Aspiration. Wealth is power. Wealth means you will be remembered. In this world making a name for yourself is as simple as acquiring enough gold to buy your way to victory. I intend to be remembered. (Any)
Danger. Every great discovery requires risk. The greater the risk, the greater the reward. It's the thrill of the hunt that I live for. (Any)
Dignity. The dead and their prized belongings deserve more than to waste away in the ruins. They deserve to be found, remembered, and taken care of. (Lawful)
My desire for wealth is out of a need to protect my family.
Something important to me was stolen. I've longed to get it back ever since.
I'm wanted for my many crimes and hope that where I am going, the law will not follow.
I made mistakes in my past that cost me the life of someone I loved. I will not let that happen again.
I plan to be the greatest thief or most cunning explorer of all time.
This is my last job, the big one. After this I hope to settle down with my wealth, maybe start a family.
My entire identity is layers of falsities presented to hide my true self, for I am not a good person. I've never told the truth for as long as I can remember and it's too late now to stop.
Every situation, every person, is only as valuable to me as what I can gain from them. I'm not afraid to pull strings to bend luck in my favour.
I jump to defensive measures as soon as someone catches me in a lie, or tries to call me out for anything.
I take what I want, and I want it all.
I like to show my skills, talk big, and take big risks in the hopes of impressing everyone watching.
I know for a fact I am the smartest person in the room, and if people are suggesting anything otherwise they are terribly mistaken.

name: Tree Hopper
entries: You descend from a Monkey Spirit or some similar entity. Once per day you gain advantage on a check for an acrobatic maneuver between two high places (e.g. two trees).

name: Trencher

_: a small souvenir of a specific battlefield

entries: You've fought on the front lines of numerous conflicts and have spent many miserable hours hunkered down in a trench or a foxhole between firefights. These experiences have taught you not only the value of allies, but also the importance of looking out for yourself first if necessary.

entries.name: Feature: Sleep Anywhere
entries: You have years of practice falling asleep in the most uncomfortable positions, even when battle looms. If you choose to spend one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points at the end of a short rest, you regain the maximum number of hit points for the first Hit Die you spend.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A mix of stoicism, grit, and sheer stubbornness keeps a trencher alive on the battlefield. Having been through the worst, they tend to be unflappable in bad situations.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I have a story to match every situation I find myself in before a fight.
I lead the charge when a battle begins, providing encouragement to allies who might hesitate.
I gesticulate a lot when I talk.
I can be rather callous and often do not recognize how others are feeling.
When I'm down, I try to hide it by staying positive and upbeat.
I often use vulgar language and tell bawdy jokes.
I don't consider myself lazy, but I try to avoid work when I can.
When faced with a problem, I prefer a simple, straightforward solution.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Responsibility. I always do what I can to adhere to authority. (Lawful)
Comrades. I fight for those who stand next to me. (Good)
Might. At the end of the day, power rests with those whose forces are strongest. (Evil)
Nation. I fight for my nation above all else. (Any)
Ambition. Rising through the ranks is my paramount goal. (Any)
Independence. My time as a trencher has taught me that blindly following orders is a path to ruin. (Chaotic)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: A comrade died saving me on the field of battle, and I do my best to provide for the surviving spouse.
My unit was ambushed and defeated. I will never forgive the commanding officer who led us into the trap.
There is little I wouldn't do for those I served beside.
I fight in the hope that no one else will have to experience this level of calamity.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
One of my parents was a high-ranking military figure who still holds sway within the Corps.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I react violently to those who question my courage.
There's nothing quite like the thrill of gambling.
Years of bitter war have left me with a blind hatred of my enemies.
My experiences on the battlefield have led me to believe that I am rarely wrong.
Memories of war often lead me to the bottom of a bottle.
I made a critical mistake that led to the deaths of several comrades. I will live with that shame for the rest of my life.

name: Tribal Councilor

_: a symbol of your tribal office (such as a necklace or medallion)
a tribal artifact (such as a carved totem or woven basket)
a token of appreciation from a fellow council member or tribal leader

entries: Born and raised in a close-knit community that values tradition and the wisdom of its elders, you were chosen by your tribe to serve on its council. You are respected for your knowledge of tribal law, your ability to negotiate with other groups, and your dedication to the well-being of your people.

entries.name: Feature: Wisdom of the Elders
entries: You have a deep understanding of your tribe's customs and beliefs, as well as a keen insight into the personalities and motivations of its members. You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks related to members of your tribe, and you have a network of contacts throughout the region who can provide you with information and assistance (at the GM's discretion).

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am a patient and understanding listener, and I value the opinions of others.
I have a talent for mediating and resolving conflict, and I strive to find peaceful solutions to disputes.
I am deeply loyal to my tribe and will do whatever is necessary to protect its interests.
I am a wise and respected leader, but I am also humble and willing to learn from others.
I am brave and courageous in the face of adversity, and I will not back down from a challenge.
I am passionate about justice and fairness.
I am generous and compassionate toward my fellow tribe members, and I strive to create a safe and supportive environment for them.
I am determined to achieve my goals, and I will not give up until I have succeeded.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Unity. We are stronger together than we are on our own. (Lawful)
Community. The well-being of my tribe is my highest priority. (Good)
Honor. I will uphold the traditions and values of my people. (Lawful)
Growth. I will use my knowledge and experience to help my tribe thrive. (Neutral)
Exploration. I will seek out new paths and possibilities for my people. (Chaotic)
Justice. I will ensure that all are treated fairly and with respect. (Good)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I am fiercely loyal to my tribe and will do whatever it takes to protect them.
I have a deep connection to the natural world, and I strive to protect and preserve it.
I have a strong sense of responsibility to my family and ancestors.
I am committed to helping my tribe members, no matter the cost.
I owe a debt of gratitude to those who have helped me in the past.
I have a personal mission to expand my people's knowledge and understanding.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am overly trusting of strangers and too quick to take them at their word.
I am stubborn and have a hard time admitting when I am wrong.
I am too proud and have a hard time asking for help when I need it.
I am often swayed by emotional appeals and can be easily manipulated.
I am fervently loyal to my tribe, to the exclusion of other considerations.
I am too quick to jump to conclusions and often make rash decisions.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item donkey|PHB} or {@creature mule|MM} with {@item bit and bridle|PHB}, a set of {@item cold-weather|IDRotF} or warm-weather clothes, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: Shelter from the Storm
entries: You have spent years hunting in the harshest environments of the world and have seen tents blown away by gales, food stolen by hungry bears, and equipment destroyed by the elements. While traveling in the wilderness, you can find a natural location suitable to make camp by spending 1 hour searching. This location provides cover from the elements and is in some way naturally defensible, at the GM's discretion.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Most trophy hunters are skilled hobbyists and find strange relaxation in the tension of the hunt and revel in the glory of a kill. You may find great personal joy in hunting, in the adoration of peers, or simply in earning gold by selling pelts, scales, and horns.

rows: Nothing gets my blood pumping like stalking a wild animal.
I like things {@i big}! Trophies, big! Food, big! Money, houses, weapons, possessions, I want 'em big, {@i big, BIG}!
When hunting, it's almost as if I become a different person. Focused. Confident. Ruthless.
The only way to kill a beast is to be patient and find the perfect moment to strike. The same is true for all the important things in life.
Bathing is for novices. I know that to catch my smelly, filthy prey, I must smell like them to throw off their scent.
I eat only raw meat. It gets me more in tune with my prey.
I'm a connoisseur of killing implements; I only use the best, because {@i I} am the best.
I thank the natural world for its bounty after every kill.
{@bold Ambition.} It is my divine calling to become better than my rivals by any means necessary. (Chaotic)
{@bold Altruism.} I hunt only to protect those who cannot protect themselves. (Good)
{@bold Determination.} No matter what the laws say, I will kill that beast! (Chaotic)
{@bold Cruelty.} My prey lives only for my pleasure. It will die exactly as quickly or as slowly as I desire. (Evil)
{@bold Sport.} We're just here to have fun. (Neutral)
{@bold Family.}  I follow in my family's footsteps. I will not tarnish their legacy. (Any)
I like hunting because I like feeling big and powerful.
I hunt because my parents think I'm a worthless runt. I need to make them proud.
I was mauled by a beast on my first hunting trip. I've spent my life searching for that monster.
The first time I drew blood, something awoke within me. Every hunt is a search for the original ecstasy of blood.
My hunting companions used to laugh at me behind my back. They aren't laughing anymore.
A close friend funded my first hunting expedition. I am forever in their debt.
I'm actually a sham. All of my trophies were bagged by someone else. I just followed along and watched.
I'm terrified of anything larger than myself.
I can't express anger without lashing out at something.
I need money. I don't care how much or how little I have; I need more. And I would do anything to get it.
I am obsessed with beauty in animals, art, and people.
I don't trust my hunting partners, whom I know are here to steal my glory!

entries: You hunt the mightiest beasts in the harshest environments, claiming their pelts as trophies and returning them to settled lands for a profit or to decorate your abode. You likely were set on this path since birth, following your parents on safaris and learning from their actions, but you may have instead come to this path as an adult after being swept away by the thrill of dominating the natural world.
Many big game hunters pursue their quarry purely for pleasure, as a calming avocation, but others sell their skills to the highest bidder to amass wealth and reputation as a trophy hunter.

_.displayName: A meager hoard, containing cheap gemstones and a mix of various coins totaling a value of 30 gp

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A meager hoard, containing cheap gemstones and a mix of various coins totaling a value of 30 gp

items.name: Optional Class Features:
items.entry: Use the rules for {@classFeature Resolution|Demi-Dragon|TheDemiDragon|1|TheDemiDragon|Resolution}, replacing Devour Magic

entries.name: Feature: Dragon's Lair
entries: Your natural lifespan is counted in the thousands of years, and you never suffer any ill effects from old age.

Additionally, you have a knack for locating a suitable lair. This lair can be anything from an abandoned cave to an underwater cove, an old fort, a forest glade, a hollow glacier, or a forgotten house. The lair gains no special benefits, but readily provides you with a safe haven away from prying eyes.

entries.name: Inherent Nature
entries: Each of the fiften draconic bloodlines share certain traits common to their kind. Although it is possible for an individual to defy their nature, they can never get rid of it. A chromatic dragon may be raised with difficulty to act out of sincere kindness, but the temptation to give in to their darker side will always remain-likewise, a metallic dragon may fall prey to evil influence, but must actively reject their own tendency towards virtue in order to be swayed to an evil worldview.

rows: Black

You have a predisposition towards cruelty, and find great satisfaction in bringing ruination to all that is more beautiful than you. You are best at home when you are unseen, hidden by darkness or beneath fetid swamp waters.
Blue

To your ordered mind, everything has its place in the world-it's just that most of it exists purely for your benefit. Other creatures are merely a means to an end, and those who don't understand their place deserve to be made an example of.
Green

You see others as tools that can be manipulated with subtlety and cunning to get you what you want. Your long-lasting plots and schemes are often strongly motivated by short bursts of emotion such as anger, fear, or envy.
Red

You are better than everyone and everything, and all should learn to grovel before you or face your wrath. You revel in destruction, brutality, and conquest, and often invent complex strategies to improve your odds of victory.
White

You delight in your physicality, living in the moment and expressing yourself through movement and action, viewing all others as prey to be chased. You disdain speech, and have trouble grasping abstract concepts or promises.
Brass
You can't help but enjoy the sound of your own voice, and can talk ceaselessly for hours on end about practically anything. You find gossip and the motivations of lesser creatures to be fascinating.
Bronze
You have an inquisitive mind, and can't help but want to right wrongs and bring evildoers to justice. You tend to prefer anonymity, and only open up to a few people that are close to you.
Copper

You have an appreciation for wit, wordplay, and humor. Dazzling others with your cleverness-whether by pranking them, sharing an insightful story, or causing them to laugh-has a certain intrinsic appeal to it.
Gold

Reserved and insightful, you tend to consider before speaking, and view others in the light of your own high standards of order, piety, and morality. You come up with complicated plans that are meant to help others, but often miss the obvious in favor of the esoteric.
Silver

You are open, honest, and tolerant, and you can't help but sympathize with those in need-especially lesser creatures who are down on their luck. The history and actions of the mortal races is a subject of your endless fascination.
Amethyst

You are detached and aloof. You believe yourself the wisest of dragonkind, seeking neutrality and wisdom-the prattling and conflicts of your lessers will not distract you from unraveling the true secrets of the world.
Crystal

You are curious and friendly, always pleased to meet new people and learn new things. You wish everyone could just get along, but you won't miss a chance to have a good snow fight or engage in some other mischief.
Emerald

You are paranoid and isolationist. You stick together only with others for the safety that comes with strength in numbers, but you don't trust anyone easily and prefer your own kind or that of the sapphire bloodline over all others.
Sapphire

You are confident in yourself and dependable to friends, but distrustful of strangers. You don't like when others intrude into your space, and you can be quite menacing, but really you just want to be left alone.
Topaz

You can't help but be unfriendly and curmudgeonly. Your patience is short and you hate the nosy interference of others, especially the bronze bloodline. You like the peace of a quiet day spent sunning yourself and enjoying the breeze. Moisture annoys you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Dragons view the world differently than the humanoid races, with their perspective shaped chiefly by their inherent nature, and secondarily by their surroundings and experiences. Most dragons are lonesome outsiders that never truly belong around others-and prefer it that way-and only a few ever find genuine companionship.

rows: I want to be remembered as a mythical dragon of which tales are told and songs are made.
I consider myself a knowledgeable scholar of a particular subject, which holds my eternal fascination.
I love exploring the land and trying new experiences.
I want to change how mortals view dragonkind.
I want to defy my inherent nature through great effort, but it is a constant, daily struggle.
I am faithful to a god, whose decree I seek to carry out.
I idolize a particular ancient dragon, whose stories and legends I model myself after.
I try to rebel against the expectations that people often have of dragons, and go out of my way to be different.
Justice. I will use my strength to protect others from those that would cause harm. (Good)
Authority. The mortal races must be led by those who know better. (Lawful)
Freedom. I will not be beholden to anything or anyone. My path is mine alone. (Chaotic)
Might. The power to do as I please is all that matters. (Evil)
Treasure. Wealth is an anchor for dragon magic. I must amass treasure to expand my domain. (Any)
Arrogance. In fact, I am better than everyone else. (Any)
My relationship with my siblings or parents drives me to continually seek to exceed expectations.
I was all alone when I hatched, and an unpleasant experience soon taught me not to trust strangers.
I was raised by a humanoid, and though I love my foster parent, I never really fit in.
I haven't had many to speak with, and have filled the void with an imaginary friend that I talk to.
One day, I met and befriended an explorer. We still regularly speak or exchange letters.
My only companions are the weak minions that I subjugate to do my bidding.
I am flawless. Those who say otherwise earn my ire.
I like to be worshiped or praised, and will aggressively encourage others to do so.
I am full of boasts and clever jests that drive home how much better than the mortal races I am.
I hate being questioned or second-guessed.
I am often unpleasantly surprised when others don't give me the attention that I clearly deserve.
As I view it, in this world, there are only predators and prey, and I will be a predator.

entries: Born a true dragon, you are legend embodied and heir to countless myths and stories. Though true dragons don't usually lead lives of adventure-often preferring to safely amass power by growing older-something has pushed you to seek out such a life.

name: Undertaker
entries: You have spent your life in service of preparing, interring, and protecting the dead. You tend to the dead, preparing corpses in a manner in keeping with your craft and preferred by the family of the deceased. The handling of the dead is taboo in many societies, so the undertaker's role is to do what others would not - many find themselves shunned by the people they serve. Though undertakers may be ridiculed and ignored, they are a necessary part of their communities.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A holy symbol (a gift to you when you became an undertaker), a hammer, a set of fine clothes, a small knife, a vial of perfume, a needle, thread, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp.

entries.name: Feature: Respect for the Dead
entries: While most are repulsed by or shy away from it, you have made your living handling the dead. You are familiar with the religious rites, funerary services, and corpse treatments of most societies. Your experience often results in you having unquestioned access to unsavory places, such as crime-scenes, morgues, and cemeteries. In addition, due to the unpleasant nature of your trade you are less likely to attract scorn for possession of corpses, bones, and other normally taboo items.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: An undertaker is defined by the place held in their community and the expertise of their craft.

rows: I do not believe that all things in life are worth suffering for.
I pay no mind to others' status and wealth.
My trade is my art. Through my art I can provide warmth, sympathy and understanding from those of the deceased.
I am constantly aware of my own mortality, and it terrifies me.
I have internalized my community's scorn.
I prefer the company of the dead to the living.
The living are not so bad - it's the faces of the dead that haunt me.
I will not mourn for the dead, but celebrate the life they endured.
{@bold Tradition.} The traditions and knowledge of my craft must be continued through myself and spread to others (Lawful)
{@bold Generosity.} I will gladly pay out of my own pocket for the proper preparation and burial for those who can afford none. (Good)
{@bold Community.} To those who die, and have none to attend, I will stand at their wake to lay their soul to rest. (Neutral)
{@bold Fairness.} Before death, even the highest of elven lords and the lowest of peasants are judged equally. (Any)
{@bold Freedom.} The nature of my trade lets me freely partake in the taboos of my craft. (Chaotic)
{@bold Power.} The bones and bodies of my craft will continue to serve me in this life and into the next. (Evil)
I owe my training to my family, and the skill they gave to me will not pass from this world when it's my time to go.
My job has a complex importance in the world, and I know that I must put all dead that I encounter to rest.
It is my duty to protect the dead from mutilation, desecration, and defilement.
I feel compelled to work to preserve and improve the cemeteries that I come across in my travels.
I have an affinity for the dead, but I am sworn to hate the undead in all its forms.
I feel an intimate affinity with those that have lost, as I have also felt their pain.
I've spend so much time around death that I have no qualms with bringing it to others.
I am socially inept at interacting with the living.
I believe that bodies are, essentially, meat - even when they are living.
I steal from the dead - what good will money do them in the afterlife?
I overindulge in the delights of the world to make up for the dead who cannot.
I become irrationally angry at those who speak ill of the recently deceased.

items.name: Proficiencies and Languages
items.entry: {@i Special.} Whenever you attempt a skill, use a tool or try to comprehend a language you are not already proficient with, roll a {@dice d20}. On a natural 20, you have recalled one of your pre-trauma talents and gain that proficiency; otherwise you must finish a long rest before you can make this check for the same proficiency again. Once you have recalled five proficiencies with this feature, you no longer make this check.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Just the clothes on your back, 1 gp in your boot.

entries.name: Feature: Gradual Recall
entries: Each time you meet a new NPC or visit a new location, once per character level, you can decide that they feel familiar. This place or person is somehow related to your life leading up to the trauma that caused your amnesia. This will not divulge much information, but will provide some further clue. You should work with your DM to fit this new element into your background, aiming to give full disclosure by the middle of the third tier.

items: Level 1–4:

The NPC incidentally recognizes you but doesn't know you. They remember you performing some act, such as speaking to a mysterious figure (and overhearing a few words), buying an item from a store, or being involved in a fight.
Locations might be places you visited but once, or passed through on your way to somewhere else.
Level 5–8:

The NPC knows you only by a nom de guerre and a little about what happened to you, but is evasive in giving you information. If forced to speak, they give only one clue before circumstances end the interrogation (he simply escapes, or he's in a position of power, or a vicious storm rocks the boat...)
Locations might be taverns or dungeons that you frequented.
Level 9–12:

The NPC was directly involved with your trauma, and knows your real identity. Some conflict must be resolved before their relationship to you is fully understood: this could be a combat encounter or fulfilling a request made by them.
A location might be your family home, your place of work, your secret hideout, or some other place very personal to you that will reveal your identity through investigation.

entries: This feature may drag you into involvement with secret societies, nobility, evil armies, hidden temples, and other intrigues. Once you have total recall about your life and your trauma, one of these story elements can be used to create a new background feature to replace Gradual Recall.

entries.name: Clue
entries: When you woke as an amnesiac, you discovered one thing about yourself that could provide a clue as to what happened to you.

rows: A tattoo
You have an unusual tattoo on your arm, depicting a strange building, part of a map or gnostic symbols.
A curious wound
Running across your face and head is a long scar, only recently healed.
Something hidden on you
There was a key sewn under the skin of your belly.
A personalized piece of jewelry
Gripped in your hand was a locket, in which is a portrait of a young lady or man.
A punishment
Your little finger was severed and is missing.
You were found somewhere unusual
You woke shut in a sea trunk, washed up on the beach.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Whatever your personality, you are compelled to find out more about your past.

rows: I sometimes adopt a persona of child-like innocence, which comes through stronger when I try to remember my past.
When I rest I write copious notes on the events of the day, and keep them safe.
I am plagued by confusing nightmares which leave me feeling anxious all day.
I am aloof and dislike being with riff raff: I'm sure I have noble blood.
I am completely obsessed with keeping my belongings with me at all times.
Whenever I can't remember recent events it makes me nervous and distant.
I find myself staring into mirrors for long periods of time, wondering who I am.
I am sometimes overcome with fluctuating bouts of depression and euphoria.
{@b Truth.} I want to know what's real-not just about my past, but the world and people around me. (Any)
{@b Revenge.} I can't touch the demons of my past, so I take my frustration out on those who make even the slightest infractions against me. (Evil)
{@b Heart.} Although I woke as a blank slate, my first act was to rescue a trapped animal. There must be inherent kindness in people, even if hidden deeply. (Good)
{@b Pretense.} Personal identity is an illusion. We can adopt personae as we see fit. (Chaotic)
{@b Destiny.} What happened to me happened for a reason. I accept it and have no regrets. (Lawful)
{@b Enlightenment.} I'm glad I can't remember my past. It gives me more time to focus on my future. (Any)
I owe a debt to the family that found me, took me in, and nursed me back to health.
Somebody, somewhere, stole my life. I will find them and make them suffer.
I remember living in luxury-I must have a personal fortune or estate somewhere, and I'm going to find it!
The only thing I recall is that I was searching for someone I loved, someone who was in danger.
I remember a child and that the child was important, but I can't remember why or who they were.
I told someone of a great darkness before my trauma. I must find them and remember what I said.
I intermittently suffer short-term memory loss, and often forget why I went to a place or what I was talking about.
I'm overly suspicious of strangers-for all I know I might not a be a stranger to them, and why would they keep quiet about that?
I hate secrets and cannot be trusted with them. Everything should be out in the open.
Everything is always my fault!
I get overindulged in knowledge and will do questionable things to obtain it.
I believe everyone is talking about me behind my back.

entries: Your background is unknown to you because you suffered some trauma that has inflicted you with amnesia. You woke one day, not knowing who you are or how you got here. Your origin and family are a mystery to you. You are not sure if you have allies or enemies from your past. If you have skills beyond what your class training details, you struggle to recall them.

Who looked after you while you recuperated? Were your class skills taught to you after your trauma, or are you slowly recalling them from your past? Do you have flashbacks or dreams hinting at your ordeal?
