items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Old Lore|TLotRR}, {@skill Riddle|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Mason's tools|PHB}, {@item potter's tools|PHB}, or {@item smith's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Fair-spoken, True-hearted

name: Urban Nomad

_: a ring made by a jeweler from your homeland

entries: {@b Weapon Proficiencies:} Simple ranged weapons, shortswords.

Like the Nyss, the Iosans are a people without a homeland. Living within the cities of the Iron Kingdoms requires these nomads to adjust to their new lives and environs, as they cope with culture shock, exclusion, and distrust. However, nomads often have particular skills and knowledge that are rare to find within the Iron Kingdoms.

entries.name: Feature: Free Runner
entries: The cities of the Iron Kingdoms are cramped, full of tall buildings, and heaving with people. Rather than just walk the streets, you often take to the rooftops, navigating the city with dexterous, death-defying leaps. You can move through non-magical difficult terrain in urban environments provided it is made up of crowds, rubble, structures, and similar items.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: There are so many interesting foods to try in the cities of Cygnar.
Sometimes I just want to sit and watch the world go by.
I amuse myself reading the lurid tales of city life. Hardly the prose of my homeland, but amusing nonetheless.
I try as much as I can to blend in and not betray my heritage, even adopting much of the local slang.
When I meet others like myself, I try my best to be as friendly as I can.
I always have an escape route planned.
I trust only myself in these strange cities.
I love to discover the hidden artistic gems of the city.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Insight. I cannot help but piece together puzzles and mysteries. (Neutral)
Cutthroat. My enemies will never see me coming. (Evil)
Self-Sufficiency. I have survived alone in the city so long that I can't rely on others. (Chaotic)
Homeland. My lands are barred to me, and so I must make a home here. (Any)
Privacy. Few know my true name, where I am from, or where I sleep at night. (Chaotic)
Daredevil. Sometimes you must just leap and have faith. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I have fallen in love with someone in this strange city, and I fear if I commit that I will lose a sense of where I came from.
To secure my future, I must score big for my gang.
Enemies from my past hunt me within the city.
A noble from whom I stole a painting wants it back and is trying to have me imprisoned.
There is a ghetto with more of my people living there, and I try to give them food and money when I can.
Each night I gaze out from the rooftop. Through one window, I watch a local family sitting down together for a meal.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I have a habit of leaving without paying.
My sense of humor is not the same as that of the people of this kingdom.
I end up insulting people by simply telling the truth.
I can't swim, and so I panic if I am in a body of water.
It takes me a long time to calm down after being angered.
I forgive no one for their transgressions.

name: Vagabond

_: a small memento from your homeland

entries: In the last few decades, life in certain parts of the Iron Kingdoms has been irrevocably disrupted. Although many exiles found a new place to settle, some embraced the life of a wanderer and found themselves drifting from one adventure to the next.

entries.name: Feature: Danger Sense
entries: Your life as a wanderer began in the aftermath of an unfortunate event. You have advantage on initiative rolls. When you roll a 1 on a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check, you can reroll the die but must use the new roll.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Whether they bemoan or celebrate the turn of events that led them to life on the road, vagabonds call wherever they are home. Adaptable and energetic, they are inspired by the hope that whatever they seek might be just over the next hill.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I've seen it all. Nothing surprises me anymore.
I truly enjoy serving those in need.
I am keenly aware of how others are feeling.
My constant interactions with refugees have left me jaded.
I'm a daydreamer who often gets lost in potential futures.
I make friends quickly. For whatever reason, people tend to like me.
Having seen several different cultures now, I have great respect for different perspectives.
I'm always prepared for things to go wrong and am often the first to react.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Community. I work to better the lives of those who suffer as I have. (Good)
Tradition. Preserving the ways of the past keeps me going. (Lawful)
Reform. The world must change if we are to survive. (Chaotic)
Gloom. The world is a cruel and heartless place. I will do anything to survive it. (Evil)
Dignity. No matter what the circumstances, everyone deserves to be treated with dignity. (Neutral)
Liberty. I will maintain my freedom even if I have to sleep in a gutter. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I lost everything after the Claiming, but I continue to search for my long-lost sibling.
For whatever reason, I keep coming across the same antagonist.
Staying on the move is the only thing that brings me solace anymore.
I always do what I can to help those who are lost.
One day, I hope to thank the soldier who saved my life.
My journey has become one of self-improvement.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I have dark thoughts of eventually getting my revenge on all who look down on me.
I am easily distracted by minor mysteries.
A life on the road has made me slow to trust others.
I tend to overindulge in all kinds of intoxicants.
I don't respect anyone who hasn't had a life as hard as mine.
I believe in throwing caution to the wind and living life to its fullest.

items.name: Variant: Myriad Operative
entries: Your skill set might be similar to that of many members of the {@book Clasp|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|The Clasp}, but you work for a criminal organization that is far more sophisticated—and even less scrupulous. As a {@book Myriad|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|The Myriad} operative in Tal'Dorei, you might have been given a specific task that furthers that syndicate's hunger to expand beyond Wildemount, or which gives them an edge in their rivalry with the {@book Clasp|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|The Clasp}. Moreover, you understand the wisdom of keeping your activities secret from fellow criminals as well as law enforcement, since the agents of the {@book Clasp|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|The Clasp} will show you no mercy if your true identity is ever revealed.

name: Variant Continental Nobility (Last of the Line)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a scroll of pedigree, and a purse containing 25 gp

entries.name: Variant Noble (Disgraced)
entries: Though you're a member of the aristocracy, your family has lost favor with its peers. The source of your disgrace might be a debt or defeat shared between all members of your house, or a particular family member might've been accused or convicted of heinous crimes.

entries.name: Feature: Scandalous
entries: Your family name and your alleged failures are known far and wide. Nobles and loyal commoners may put up a polite front as propriety demands, but they are inclined to think the worst of you. Meanwhile, there are plenty who seek to capitalize on your position. You can always seek a secret meeting with a noble who is not the current head of their house, or with a local criminal leader.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Nobles are born and raised to a very different lifestyle than most people ever experience, and their personalities reflect that upbringing. A noble title comes with a plethora of bonds—responsibilities to family, to other nobles (including the sovereign), to the people entrusted to the family's care, or even to the title itself. But this responsibility is often a good way to undermine a noble.

rows: My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.
No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.
I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.
Respect. Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Responsibility. It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)
Independence. I must prove that I can handle myself without coddling from my family. (Chaotic)
Power. If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Evil)
Family. Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)
Noble Obligation. It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Good)
I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.
Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.
I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.
My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.
I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.
In fact, the world does revolve around me.
By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a scroll of pedigree, and a purse containing 25 gp

entries.name: Variant Noble (Displaced)
entries: The Mourning and the Treaty of Thronehold have remade the borders of the Five Nations and beyond. Your home estates have been annexed, gifted to another family, or enveloped by the dead-gray mists. Unfortunately, you can no longer enjoy the direct benefits of your titles, but your family's legacy lives on.

entries.name: Feature: Remembered Loyalty
entries: Many people still remember the old days. When you arrive in a new settlement, talk to your DM about creating an NPC you know from your old life. If you make contact, they treat you favorably and offer you food and shelter. This NPC might be a member of your household or a commoner who used to live under your aegis, or you can roll on the table below to choose.

rows: Household guard
Farmer or brewer
Court magewright
Chamberlain or treasurer
Valet or butler
Chaplain or priest
Groom or horsemaster
Smith or armorer

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Nobles are born and raised to a very different lifestyle than most people ever experience, and their personalities reflect that upbringing. A noble title comes with a plethora of bonds—responsibilities to family, to other nobles (including the sovereign), to the people entrusted to the family's care, or even to the title itself. But this responsibility is often a good way to undermine a noble.

rows: My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.
No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.
I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.
Respect. Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Responsibility. It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)
Independence. I must prove that I can handle myself without coddling from my family. (Chaotic)
Power. If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Evil)
Family. Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)
Noble Obligation. It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Good)
I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.
Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.
I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.
My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.
I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.
In fact, the world does revolve around me.
By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a scroll of pedigree, and a purse containing 25 gp

entries.name: Variant Noble (Rising)
entries: Your family has risen to the aristocracy very recently. Service to the crown, a heroic deed, or an extraordinarily generous donation may have contributed to your success. Though older and more entrenched noble families meet their obligations toward you, they may still look on you with disdain. Meanwhile, there is no shortage of other folks looking to ride your coattails to a new and better life.

entries.name: Feature: Rising Star
entries: Your name is known among monied individuals in your home country. You generally enjoy the utmost respect of non-aristocratic upper and middle classes. You can expect reasonable accommodations and inside information from such people in return for a simple non-monetary favor, such as passing their name or details of their business along to another noble.

name: Variant Survivor (Veteran of the Civil War)

items.name: Variant: Grey Hunter
entries: As elite as they are, the members of the {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps} do not represent the apex of firearms skill in {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone}. A clandestine group of elite soldiers and survivalists is drawn secretly from the Rifle Corps ranks. Called the {@book Grey Hunters|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Grey Hunters}, these soldiers are special operatives of the de Rolo family, and loyally serve as spies, bodyguards, and even assassins when the job requires it. Though few officially know of them, rumors of the {@book Grey Hunters'|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Grey Hunters} existence swirl constantly throughout the city-state, often in response to their activities after having been loaned out to protect {@book Whitestone's|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} allies.

You are one of these {@book Grey Hunters|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Grey Hunters}, even if just a trainee (if you're starting your campaign at low levels). You have the ear of the lord and lady of {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone}, though you must exercise this privilege graciously lest you lose it.

entries.name: Background Features
entries: Vassals come from a great many varied backgrounds. As your background feature, you select the background benefit that corresponds to a particular Sovereign. These background benefits belong to the backgrounds detailed in the Player's Handbook. Your choice of Sovereign does not necessarily need to be the same one that granted you your background proficiencies, because as a vassal you feel that all the Sovereigns influence your life greatly at some point or another.

entries: You might profess to be a Vassal in public, but secretly you venerate the darker side of the pantheon. While the Dark Six themselves are almost all evil, not everyone who seeks their favor is. Many sailors openly call to Arawai for a safe journey, but secretly pray to The Devourer to forestall his wrath. Likewise, a smith tired of mastering the same old pattern of armor may seek a gift of inspiration from the Traveler in order to create something innovative (though one should always, always beware the gifts of the Traveler).

entries: The country you grew up in, the lifestyle you led, the job you had before setting out to become an adventurer—none were quite so important to you as your faith in the Sovereign Host.

As a vassal, you may not be rigorously religious, like adherents of the Church of the Silver Flame are, and may not be classically trained in religious studies, but you still believe that all life flows from the Sovereigns. In every swing of a master smith's hammer, there is Onatar. In every sunrise, there is Dol Arrah. In every city wall, standing strong, there is Boldrei. The Sovereigns are all around you and you draw comfort in them.

Vassals may venerate the Host as a whole, but usually find themselves gravitating to one or two Sovereigns in particular. Your background grants you equipment, plus skill and tool proficiencies specific to a Sovereign that speaks to you particularly clearly.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A small knife, a {@item healer's kit|PHB}, an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, a set of heavy gloves, a smock to protect clothing, and a pouch containing 15 gp

entries.name: Focus of Practice
entries: Most veterinarians tend to the needs of specific types of creatures. You can work with your GM to determine a type of creatures that you work with, or you can choose from or roll on the table below to determine a focus of practice for your character.

rows: Aquatic
Companion
Equine
Exotic beasts
Livestock
Non-beasts
Small beasts
Wildlife

entries.name: Feature: House Call
entries: Anyone who knows of your trade and has a beloved pet or animal companion which has experienced any kind of ailment will welcome you into their home. You can usually find a place to hide, rest, or relax with such a person, and they will shield you from the law or from anyone else who is searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A vet's life is one of tough work, with moments of triumph and happiness when a beloved pet or a needed working animal is saved, and moments of loss when they creatures cannot be healed. Vets must steel themselves against the dark times and always look forward to the light.

rows: I can't bring myself to harm another living creature, unless it's necessary.
When I see a creature in distress, I automatically leap into action.
I am constantly taking notes about the strange things I see.
I wash my hands constantly to remain clean.
I like to narrate what I am doing out loud.
I can't help but diagnose common ailments I see at all times.
I enjoy telling stories of the times I felt like a hero by saving a creature's life.
I am calm and cool under pressure.
{@b Oath.} I swore an oath to give all creatures as long and as healthy a life as possible. (Lawful)
{@b Healer.} No creature should suffer from an ailment that I could prevent. (Good)
{@b Knowledge.} We can always learn from others, and we should teach others what we know. (Neutral)
{@b Greed.} I heal beloved companions, so people are willing to pay whatever I want for the service. (Evil)
{@b Turmoil.} I do what I can, but the power over life and death does not lie in my hands. (Chaos)
{@b Medic.} No creature should have to live with suffering that could be prevented. (Any)
My beloved pet was killed by an ailment I now know how to prevent; I must keep others from suffering as I did.
A blight has befallen the creatures from my home, I must find the cure.
I am gathering as much knowledge as possible so I can educate others.
I must hide from the wrath of a powerful ruler who blames me for the death of an animal companion.
I haven't been home in some time, always finding myself called to new places for aid.
I advertise my services as a healer of animals, but I actually work for the criminal underground, healing them from injuries that would be difficult to explain.
I allowed a creature to die due to a personal grudge with its owner.
I fell into this trade by accident, and don't actually like animals.
I am willing to let a creature suffer if I can learn something from it.
The sight of blood makes me feel faint.
I am haunted by the memory of every creature I could not save.
I tend to rush my work, making mistakes I wouldn't otherwise make if I were more meticulous.

_.special: A token belonging to your captor

_.displayName: a sack of stolen or gifted valuables totaling 15 gp

items.entry: A set of {@filter tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=tools}, a token belonging to your captor, a {@item sack|phb} of stolen or gifted valuables totaling 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Thaumaturgic Rites
entries: You've witnessed firsthand the application of blood magic or some other form of metamorphic power. With the right preparation, research, and access to materials, you believe that you could duplicate the same rites that were inflicted upon you, creating another demi-dragon.

entries.name: Oppressive Captor
entries: Your captor has been a brief but influential figure in your life. You may have had time to watch them perform their thaumaturgic work, or perhaps even gotten to know them. While a captor may be a cruel and selfish lunatic from whom you must escape, they may just as easily be eccentric or misguided, and may have offered you your freedom of their own choice. Work with your DM to determine who your captor is, what your relationship to them is like, or use the table below.

rows: A crazed wizard abducted you and used you as a test subject in their mad pursuit for immortality.
An ancient dragon destroyed your home and offered you a choice: die, or serve and be transformed.
The Cult of the Dragon chose you to trial their blood magics, as the first of many more to come.
You were a ritual offering to a god. The god offered you transformation in exchange for servitude.
An abishai used you as part of an experiment to break free from Tiamat's control, and now roams the Material Plane with an agenda of their own.
A powerful entity punished a wyrmling dragon with mortality, and swapped your form for the dragon's. Now the dragon roams the world with your old body.

entries.name: Lingering Quirk
entries: Your unique experiences have left their mark on you. Choose what this means for you, or roll on the table below.

rows: Your form is a mishmash of different dragon types.
You are haunted by the voice of your captor or another captive, and sometimes hear that voice speak to you.
Your body is artificial and is made of stone, wood, or metal, akin to a gargoyle or draconic warforged.
When you look at your reflection, it's the old you staring back.
You bear the memories of a wyrmling dragon, which you've learned was slain by your captor.
You are scaleless-flawed and incomplete.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You've had your body changed against your will. You might embrace this change, or rage against it.

rows: I am cautious in my dealings with others.
I am always fiddling with tools, vials, and other components relevant to my new studies and research.
The life I left behind was dull, and I don't regret trading it for one of adventure.
I judge people by how they treat others, rather than by what they say or how they appear.
I joke about my condition as if it doesn't matter to me.
It's not all bad. I love flying and exploring new places!
I get angry easily, and afterwards, I can't help but be a little afraid of myself.
I must battle this monster I've become, lest I slip and hurt someone I care for.
Confrontation. I adventure to make the world a safer place, and to exorcise my own demons. (Good)
Progress. We must advance our knowledge for the good of the world, even of darker subjects. (Lawful)
Self-Determination. Everyone should be free to make their own choices, be they good or bad. (Chaotic)
Depravity. I've seen what one dark ritual can do, and I harbor an unshakable hunger to know more. (Evil)
Change. Life is constant change, and I will learn to adapt to any circumstance. (Neutral)
Destiny. I believe that my circumstances are a road to be traveled, and that my journey has just started. (Any)
I seek to undo what's been done to me, and will pursue a way to do so by any means necessary.
I got to know one of my captor's other captives. They didn't survive, and I now seek to carry on their legacy.
Though I didn't have a choice, my captor wasn't so bad after all, and I now work for them.
I miss my family, but I can't face them like this.
The few people who are nice to me are like a beacon of hope. They matter more than anything else.
I stick up for anyone who is treated poorly.
I don't trust people easily.
I feel like I don't deserve to go on when there are so many others who didn't make it.
I will shout loudly at anyone who makes mean comments about my form until they shut up.
Others are afraid of me now. I like that.
I've never felt more distanced from others, and sometimes I will cry myself to sleep in loneliness.
I always expect the worst from others. I am genuinely surprised when they occasionally prove me wrong.

entries: You've met an unfortunate fate. Against your own will, you were plucked from your old life and forced to give up your humanity at the behest of your captor. Transformed and held against your will, you had plenty of time to plan, and eventually mustered an escape or reached an agreement with your captor or another entity. Regardless of how you've won your freedom, your life can never be the same again.

name: Voice of the Ancestors
entries: You descend from skillful diplomats. Once remembered, you can perform a ritual offering (worth 100 cowries) that provides you with a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) bonus on a check. This blessing fades if unused before dawn.

entries: You worked your way up in House Cannith or the Arcane Congress, studying at a trade school and working in an industrial forgehold. While you've abandoned the factory in favor of adventure, you still have strong ties in the Fabricator's Guild.

entries.name: Feature: Wage Slave Job
entries: Hey, at least you aren't homeless on the mean streets. Love it, hate it, or just tolerate it, you require income from your job in order to live. You may have even been forced to take on multiple jobs. Choose one to three wage slave jobs or roll on the table below to define your 'career'.

rows: Store clerk
Office clerk
Secretary
Customer service
Transportation
Janitor
Teacher
Factory worker
Fast food worker
Accountant
Software developer
Data analyst

entries.name: Feature: Urban Survivor
entries: You know the cheapest thrift stores, pawn shops, restaurants, and other stores where you can find discounts on everyday goods. You're good at finding coupon codes and cut-rate prices for online shopping, event tickets, and public transportation. Additionally, you can make meals even when resources are very limited, such as from a fridge containing only condiments.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Being kept on a constant financial treadmill, where a wage slave's continued employment allows them to just barely keep up with their bills, can do funny things to a person's head, especially when there is little chance of improving their station. Often their lives are marked by a mix of desperation, drudgery, and boredom. While the vast majority of wage slaves are content just to survive, some few may try to pursue their escapist dreams.

rows: I'm usually quiet, and speak when spoken to.
I'm probably the world's biggest fan of...
The emotions I bottle up will eventually escape explosively.
I'm diligent and hardworking, and that's why people like me.
There's always more ways to save money if you look hard enough.
I'm constantly slacking off on the job.
My free time is precious, and I hate when people waste it.
I'm afraid of dying alone.
{@bold Fate.} The world wasn't designed for me to succeed. (Any)
{@bold Compassion.} At least I can make someone else's day a little brighter. (Good)
{@bold Citizen.} The best way to get by is to keep your head down. (Lawful)
{@bold Desperation.} I've got nothing to lose. (Chaotic)
{@bold Ruthlessness.} I'd do anything to improve my standard of living. (Evil)
{@bold Passion.} I'm a creature of obsession. (Any)
Important people forget that I'm there, so I overhear a lot of juicy secrets.
I've got a goal for retirement, but it won't be easy to reach.
When I'm in charge, there's going to be some changes around here.
I was fired from my job and I want revenge against my employer.
I'm drowning in debt and I'm willing to go to extremes to get out of it.
I've been waiting my whole life for my time to shine. Finally, I've found my chance.
I can't get through the day sober.
I freeze up when I'm the center of attention.
I don't care what happens to me, my life is pointless anyway.
I'm about as gullible as they come.
I crave approval from others and I'll do anything to get it.
Everyone knows I'm a nobody, and who am I to disagree?

entries: Observe the modern wage slave. Packed into cubicles, offices, and behind service desks, they engage in a life-or-death struggle with boredom, impossible deadlines, impatient customers, and sadistic supervisors. They trek home on sketchy subways and vandalized buses to their coffin apartments, spending their meager paychecks on garbage instant noodles, barraged with endless attention-grabbing advertisements along the way.

They devote their precious free hours to watching comfortingly bland sitcoms and playing whatever game is most popular before passing out well after they should have gone to bed. They dream of success, of wealth, of fame, and other things they can never have.
The next day, the cycle begins again.

name: Wasteland Commando

_: clothing cobbled together from bits and pieces you have recovered
a trophy weapon from an enemy (a dagger or a broken pistol)

entries: {@b Weapon Proficiencies:} Simple rifles, martial rifles, grenades.

Among the Farrow raiding parties, skorne remnants, and Idrian tribes of the Bloodstone Marches are a breed of cunning and murderous commandos. These commandos are not just mindless savages or opportunistic bandits but are calculating tacticians, planning attacks deep behind enemy lines or laying punishing ambushes.

entries.name: Feature: Guerrilla Tactics
entries: You sow chaos and destruction deep behind enemy lines as you destroy ammo caches and fuel depots and sabotage equipment and weapons. You gain a +2 bonus on initiative rolls, and you can't be surprised by humanoids in wilderness environments.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I take what I want and damn the consequences.
Amongst the tribe, I am a perfect specimen.
I enjoy trying new dishes using new meats and vegetables.
I take great efforts to maintain the firearms and weapons I recover.
My snoring keeps up the camp, and I could sleep through a war.
I get so excited that I can't sit still.
You can find me just sitting and watching the world go by.
I enjoy winding up others with my pranks.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Wrath. I will slaughter those who get in my way. (Evil)
Anarchy. Lawlessness will reign thanks to me. (Chaotic)
Loyalty. Traitors to the tribe must be dealt with harshly. (Lawful)
Opportunity. A good fight is always worth it. Especially if you get some loot. (Chaotic)
Oathbound. I uphold a bond to another, just as I expect them to uphold their end of the bargain. (Lawful)
Force of Nature. I look to the Wurm and its myths for direction in life. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: The ornate blade I carry was recovered during a momentous victory.
I was exiled from my old tribe for making a grievous error.
My crew and I are bound by a blood oath that we have upheld for years.
I desire to be respected by my tribe for my martial skills.
Revenge for my murdered sibling drives me.
A relic from my family was stolen, and I have made it my life goal to recover it and so honor my family.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I flee the moment a fight is not in my favor.
When it comes to food, I come first.
I put my foot in my mouth all the time.
Coin is all that matters to me.
I have a bad habit of misplacing things.
If I get woken up too soon, I will lash out.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Explore|TLotRR}, {@skill Perception}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: {@item Cartographer's tools|PHB}

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Secretive, Stern

items.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You grew up on the streets surrounded by similarly ill-fated castoffs, a few of them friends and a few of them rivals. You slept where you could and did odd jobs for food. At times, when the hunger became unbearable, you resorted to theft. Still, you never lost your pride and never abandoned hope. Fate is not yet finished with you.

rows: My family was displaced by war, and I was left to fend for myself as we scattered.
I was betrayed by someone I trusted and cast out into the streets with nothing.
A natural disaster destroyed my home, forcing me to wander in search of safety.
A gang of outlaws took me in, and I survived by running errands and doing odd jobs for them.
I refused to conform to the rigid rules of my home and was cast out for my independence.
A mysterious wanderer inspired me to leave everything behind and seek my destiny on the open road.
I'm always looking for an escape route or a hidden corner to vanish into.
I find joy in simple things, like a warm meal or a clear night sky.
I trust no one until they prove their loyalty—twice.
I make jokes, even in grim situations, to keep my spirits up.
I'm slow to speak about myself but quick to learn about others.
I hoard food and supplies, even when I don't need to.
I'm quick to befriend outcasts and misfits, seeing them as kindred spirits.
I despise anyone who abuses their power over the helpless.
Freedom. No one should have to bow to another or be chained by fate. (Chaotic)
Community. The only way to survive is by helping those around you. (Good)
Resilience. The strongest are those who endure the most. (Neutral)
Ambition. I'll rise above the streets and prove I'm worth more than people think. (Any)
Survival. The world is harsh, and you do whatever it takes to make it through. (Evil)
Justice. No one else should suffer what I've been through. (Lawful)
My closest friend from the streets is the only family I have, and I'll protect them at all costs.
There's a place I used to sleep or hide that I still think of as home.
I owe a debt to someone who helped me when I was at my lowest.
I'm searching for the parent or sibling I was separated from as a child.
A rival from my past still haunts me—I won't rest until I best them.
I promised myself I'd help other street kids escape the life I once knew.
I don't trust anyone who wasn't in the gutter with me.
I'm haunted by the people I had to betray to survive.
I can't resist stealing shiny or valuable things, even when I know it'll cause trouble.
I push people away before they can hurt or abandon me.
I'm reckless with my own safety, feeling I've already survived worse.
I hold a deep grudge against the wealthy and powerful, even when they've done me no harm.

name: Web-Weaver
entries: You are a part of a tradition that goes back for generations in areas with large concentrations of spiders. Whether you are from an infested wood, live near an abandoned spider-infested castle, or call the Underdark your home, you have been a weaver of the silken strands for many years. Your craftsmanship is excellent, and you have learned to use your skills to make exceptionally durable creations.

Your profession comes with no small amount of danger with regards to harvesting the necessary materials, and as such, you are no stranger to the wilds. People may whisper behind the back of a weaver, telling stories that far surpass the actual dangers you have faced. Though they respect your craft, many fear you or consider you foolhardy for taking the risks necessary to achieve excellence.

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of common clothes, a set of weaver's tools, five fine spider-silk bags, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

entries.name: Favored Silks
entries: Every weaver prefers different silks, taken from very specific kinds of spiders or spiderlike creatures. Roll or choose a favored silk from the Favored Silks table below.

entries.caption: Favored Silks
rows: Giant Wolf Spider silk
Giant Spider silk
Ettercap silk
Phase Spider silk

entries.name: Feature: Weaver's Craft
entries: Your reputation both as a craftsman and a fighter precedes you. People are generally curious about you and your unusual occupation. You can secure free lodging for yourself and your companions provided you spend time regaling the other guests with stories of your exploits.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Weavers tend to keep to themselves and are often more at home in the wilds while harvesting components for their craft than they are in the company of others. They tend to be recluses, and may find being in the spotlight less than desirable. Roll or choose one characteristic on each of the following tables.

rows: I am more at home in the wilds than in "civilized" lands.
I prefer not to speak unless absolutely necessary.
I will eat almost anything, often to the surprise and horror of those around me.
I am keenly aware of tiny details I notice and tend to make mention of them constantly.
I have no regard for personal space.
I can't stand braggarts. One's work and actions should speak for themselves.
I can't help but explore every nook and cranny I find in the wild.
I name every spider I take silk from.
Craftsmanship. I will show the world what a master can accomplish. (Any)
Creativity. My life and work are expressions of my emotions. (Chaotic)
Beauty. I want my efforts to inspire those who benefit from them. (Good)
Knowledge. I will unlock all the secrets held by the creatures of this world. (Any)
Exploitation. Nature is a tool that only the most wise and powerful can wield effectively. (Evil)
Functionality. I don't really care about the accolades; I just want to create functional goods that get the job done. (Neutral)
My rival bested me in a contest of craft. I will not rest until I can prove myself the superior artist.
I can't help but improve upon the lackluster quality of items that are poorly made.
I can get lost studying the intricacies of another's work for hours on end.
I stole trade secrets from a rival who has vowed revenge.
An experiment gone wrong cost my mentor their life.
I wagered my life's work on a game of chance and lost. Now I must find a way to earn it back.
I am constantly pointing out the inadequacies in other people's work or actions.
I find it nearly impossible to forgive an insult.
No matter how useful an item or tool may be, I will not use it if it is ugly
I am easily duped by those promising knowledge or secrets.
I never turn down a chance to humiliate an inferior person.
If it's not my plan, it's not a good plan.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of two of the following: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Perception}, or {@skill Survival}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Your choice of a {@item musket} or a {@item pistol}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Legacy of Secrecy
entries: You have been entrusted with the use and care of a weapon both powerful and terrifying. The rifle you wield might transform the face of warfare and life in Tal'Dorei. It is a weapon that haunts the mind of its creator, {@creature Percival de Rolo|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}, manifesting as a pain that lives always behind his kind eyes.

You were granted a {@item musket} or a {@item pistol} by your commander in the {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps}. This weapon is a symbol of your status, and when you display it, other folk around you—particularly adventurers, mercenaries, guards, engineers, and weapons enthusiasts—treat you differently. You might be seen as a noble defender of the people, a selfish hoarder of power, or anything in between, at the GM's discretion.

entries.name: Feature: Rifle Corps Relationship
entries: You are—or were—a member of an elite and trusted band of {@book Whitestone's|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} staunchest defenders. Work with your GM to determine your current relationship with the Rifle Corps. If your campaign starts in {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone}, you might be an active member of that unit. Otherwise, you can use the Rifle Corps Relationships table for suggestions.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Relationships
rows: I retired honorably from the Rifle Corps—and now it's time for me to pursue my own adventures.
I'm on an important mission to protect {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} or guard one of our allies.
{@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} is in trouble, and I was sent away to seek help.
I don't think firearms technology should be kept secret, so I escaped from the Rifle Corps with my weapon and am on the run.
I was on a mission with my company when I got separated from them. Now I need to find my way back home.

My weapon was stolen. I built a new one, but I can't return home until I've tracked down the thief and recovered the original. ({@book Whitestone Hunter|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Grey Hunters} variant only)

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Those who join the {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps} become members of an elite and trusted band known as the city-state's staunchest defenders. But this means working with your GM to determine why you're not at home protecting {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone}. Perhaps you took on a mission to guard someone on behalf of the de Rolo family, or you might have been separated from your company while on an assignment. Either way, you find yourself embroiled now in a series of new adventures as you try to make your way back home.

Your bond is likely associated with your comrades-in-arms or with {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} itself. Your ideal could be tied to justice or protection, but could also be a secretive, selfish perversion of those virtues.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Personality Traits
rows: I want to make a good impression at all times. That means keeping my clothes and gear clean and in top condition.
I don't like being the center of attention. I'd rather let someone else do the talking while I watch their back.
I feel safe only if I'm carrying my trusty rifle. And my dagger. And my concealed pistol. Oh, and of course my....
I don't trust people with my secrets easily, so it feels like a big deal when someone else shares a secret with me.
I like coming up with solutions to problems using my esoteric knowledge of natural philosophy.
Everyone around me takes things so seriously. Sometimes I just want to let loose and have fun!
Knowing things that other people don't know makes me feel special and important.
I'm most at home in woods and mountains, where everything feels at once familiar, always growing and changing.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Ideals
rows: {@b Responsibility}. I have a duty to protect the people of {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} and to uphold the trust placed in me by the de Rolos. (Lawful)
{@b Militarization}. Everyone should have access to the most powerful weapons available, so they can defend themselves effectively. (Evil)
{@b Cooperation}. Any problem can be solved as long as people are willing to work together. (Good)
{@b Camaraderie}. It's important to have people you can trust to help out in a fight—and to uncork a bottle together afterward. (Any)
{@b Context}. There are no universal rights or wrongs. Every choice depends on the details of the situation. (Chaotic)
{@b Secrecy}. Information is valuable, but it can also be dangerous. I'll keep my mouth shut and gather as much intel as I can. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Bons
rows: I never knew what to do with myself until I joined the Rifle Corps. Now I have a purpose and comrades to give me direction.
One of my fellow Rifle Corps soldiers saved my life—and then I saved theirs. That kind of bond lasts forever.

{@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} is the best city in all of Tal'Dorei. Nowhere else has been blessed by the {@deity The Dawnfather|Exandria|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Dawnfather} and has a clock that tracks the movement of the stars!
My quick thinking saved a noble from assassination, and she showed me great kindness in return. I daren't say it, but I'm more loyal to her than I am to the de Rolos.
My weapon is my life. I clean it, repair it, and care for it—and it serves me loyally in return.
The people of {@book Whitestone|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Whitestone} cared for my family when we had nothing. I promise to repay their compassion with my service.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Flaws
rows: Who cares about keeping this gun safe? "Don't let it fall into the wrong hands!" Ha! It's only a matter of time before someone slips up and these weapons are everywhere.
I think being part of the Rifle Corps is so cool. I love telling people about my position so I can impress them.
My weapon was stolen. I built a new one, but I can't return home until I've tracked down the thief and recovered the original.
I'm tired of protecting spoiled people who don't know how to protect themselves.
I shoot first and ask questions later.
The first and only time I killed someone, it changed my life. I still dream about it, and I'll never be the carefree person I was before.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff|PHB}, {@item Weaver's Tools|PHB}, {@item Basket|PHB} (with dry reeds ready to weave), {@item Book|PHB} (druidic lore), {@item Iron Pot|PHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB}, 19 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Ability Scores:
items.entry: Increase one of your starting ability scores by 2 and another by 1, or increase three scores by 1 each.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff|XPHB}, {@item Weaver's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Basket|XPHB} (with dry reeds ready to weave), {@item Book|XPHB} (druidic lore), {@item Iron Pot|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 19 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Languages
items.entry: you can speak as well as understand Auran

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: a wind {@filter Musical Instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), an ornate cloak, a symbol of the wind, {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Title and Blessing
entries: For some birdfolk, the moniker of Wind-Touched is merely a title, a symbol of their devotion to the wind and the natural world. Others have been told since birth that they were blessed by the wind, much in the way the Amaranthine Reya was in the old tales. Decide what your character believes, or roll on the table below to understand how they feel.

rows: I am truly blessed and have power over the wind itself.
I am devoted to the wind spirits, in action and title.
I believe in nature and goodness.
I will work tirelessly to earn the respect of those who give me this title.
I accept this honor but have my doubts.
I feel nothing for this title, and carry it against my will.

entries.name: Feature: Supernatural Presence
entries: Whether or not you are truly Wind-Touched, there are folk all across Everden that believe that you have been divinely blessed. If you make a show of power or skill that can be attributed to the wind or air, such as feats of acrobatics or commanding unseen forces, those believers will be bolstered by your supernatural presence. They will support you and, depending on how well you have convinced them of your powers, treat you with reverence and possibly even worship.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The wind-touched are revered by believers and scrutinized by skeptics. For better or worse, they find themselves in a world of expectations they struggle to live up to.

rows: I never back down from a challenge.
I always end up being the center of attention.
I am gifted by the wind and destined for greatness.
I have no time for those who doubt me.
I seek out challenges to test myself.
I am better than everyone else.
I avoid showing my power at all costs.
I remain humble despite my blessing.
Responsibility. The powers I have been gifted with are meant to serve the common good. (Good)
Heroism. The wind chose me to be a brave warrior and leader, so shall it be. (Lawful)
Egotism. My powers situate me above others. The masses should know their place. (Evil)
Mysticism. Connected to nature, I speak for the wind and divine its will for others. (Neutral)
Cynicism. What matters isn't whether or not my powers are genuine, but what advantages I can reap because of that belief. (Evil)
Naturalism. The wind speaks to my soul, and I am bound to go wherever it directs me. (Chaotic)
I am guided by a wise elder who prepares me for my destiny.
I am estranged from my parents who don't believe in my blessing.
I seek to discredit the person who burdened me with this moniker.
I live in the shadow of my mentor, seeking their approval.
I have a sibling who is not blessed, which causes tension
I am one with the wind. Personal relationships are fleeting.
I can't accept another's suggestion once I've set my path.
I expect nothing less than reverence from common people.
I blindly trust in the power of my blessing.
I am overly concerned about how others see me.
I will prove my worth, even if it means putting myself and my friends in danger.
I am burdened with responsibility, and find it hard to make even the simplest decisions.

entries.name: Coupled with Power
entries: While this background primarily focuses on the beliefs and perceptions of yourself and your community, pairing this background with a character who actually can manipulate the wind through magic could potentially set them up to become a holy figure, a prophet, or a fabled hero.

name: Winter Guard

_: a trophy taken from an enemy (a dagger, broken weapon, or tarnished medal)

entries: Having failed to prove yourself as capable as the best conscripts your age, you spent your required years of service to the Motherland in the Khadoran Winter Guard. As a soldier, you engaged the Motherland's enemies on the front lines, where you formed lasting bonds of fellowship and learned of numerous possibilities beyond the township of your birth.

entries.name: Feature: Bond of Service
entries: Every Khadoran town and village is filled with former veterans and trained military personnel. You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks when interacting with current or former members of the Winter Guard. In addition, you can call on aid from older veterans when times are tough. Your GM determines the amount and extent of any aid other Winter Guard provide.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Veterans of the Winter Guard are proud and notoriously durable. Service is a badge of honor they carry with them into many situations, even long after they've served.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: My friends know that they can rely on me.
I am haunted by the memories of all the comrades I have lost.
The horrors of war have left me nearly fearless.
I am always polite and respectful.
I try to insert my war stories into as many conversations as possible.
Once I'm off duty, I'm the life of the party.
I enjoy making crude jokes.
I always prefer to respond in a calm, measured manner.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Protection. I use my talents to protect the vulnerable. (Good)
Obedience. Following the orders of those above us keeps us all safe. (Lawful)
Variety. I approach each task as a new opportunity to prove myself. (Chaotic)
Comrades. I am committed to those who fight by my side, not just to ideals. (Neutral)
Ambition. By rising in rank, I can wield more power over others. (Evil)
Uniformity. A simple life is its own reward. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: Before joining the Winter Guard, I was a mess. I owe a debt to my superior officer for whipping me into shape.
I fight so that others don't have to.
An enemy once spared my life. I hope to meet that person again one day.
My comrades in arms are worth dying for.
I became close to a fellow Winter Guard but never confessed my attraction.
Honor is the most important thing in my life.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: My experiences on the battlefield have left me skittish.
Those who have never experienced a harsh winter cannot be trusted.
I'm quick to anger and slow to forgiveness.
I always try to avoid responsibility.
I require a very regimented lifestyle.
As a child, I overheard many terrible stories told by traveling sages. I still have nightmares about those tales.

name: Witch Doctor

_: a set of common clothes (customary for your tribe)

entries: You are a practitioner of ancient, primal magic, and you draw upon the spirits of the earth, the sky, and your ancestors to heal the sick, divine the future, and protect your tribe. Your mysterious powers are often misunderstood by outsiders, but you have spent your life honing your craft and developing a deep understanding of the natural world.

entries.name: Feature: Spiritual Healer
entries: You can use your knowledge of herbs and magic to heal injuries and cure diseases. If you spend 10 minutes treating a wounded creature, it regains a number of hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I am a deeply spiritual person who always tries to understand and connect with the spirits of the natural world.
I am knowledgeable and wise, and I have a deep understanding of the natural world and its many secrets.
I am patient and methodical, and I can wait for the right moment to act or make a decision.
I am fiercely loyal to my tribe and will do whatever it takes to protect them from harm.
I am driven by a desire to help and heal others, no matter the cost.
I am a natural leader who can inspire and motivate others with my words and actions.
I am bold and daring, and I am not afraid to take risks or stand up to those who threaten my people.
I am a master of disguise who can blend in with any crowd or situation.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Balance. The natural world is in perfect harmony and must be protected and respected at all costs. (Lawful)
Knowledge. I strive to learn as much as I can about the natural world and its many mysteries. (Neutral)
Power. I use my power for the benefit of my people and to protect them from harm. (Lawful)
Growth. I use my knowledge and power to help my people grow and prosper. (Good)
Freedom. I do what I must to ensure my people's freedom and independence. (Chaotic)
Tradition. I honor and uphold the traditions of my people, no matter the cost. (Lawful)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I will do whatever it takes to protect my tribe and its secrets.
I am devoted to helping and healing those in need.
I will seek revenge against those who have wronged my people.
I seek to obtain powerful artifacts that will benefit my people.
I strive to maintain balance and harmony in the natural world.
I will find a way to restore the ancient traditions of my people.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I am too trusting of others and can be easily manipulated.
I am overly protective of my people and their secrets.
I sometimes forget to consider the consequences of my actions.
I am quick to judge others and overlook important details.
I often make rash, impulsive decisions.
I let my emotions get the better of me and am easily angered.

name: Witch Doctor
entries: You are a local authority on magic, medicine, nature, or spirits. You are well versed in a variety of fields, and many come to you when they have trouble or need guidance. You may be known as a medicine man or wise woman, or are known simply as a witch doctor. Many may look up to you, while others may fear you and your abilities.

When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine what kind of witch doctor you are, how the local common folk and nobility view you, and what kind of experiences you have had as a witch doctor. Are you someone who communicates often with spirits and animals? Or are you someone who focuses on medicine, magic, and herbology?

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose two from {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion},

items.name: Languages
items.entry: One exotic language (Abyssal, Celestial, Deep Speech, Draconic, Infernal, Primordial, Sylvan, or Undercommon)

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|phb}, an {@item herbalism kit|phb}, a dozen small bones, a walking stick, a small {@item dagger|phb}, a {@item vial|phb} of holy water, a small {@item book|phb} discussing otherworldly creatures, three scarves, and a black candle

entries.name: Feature: Witch Knowledge
entries: You occasionally see spirits or visions during your journeys that others cannot see. These spirits and visions can be pleasant, or can be ominous and frightening. Your DM may occasionally use this as a guide, or may tie it into a story or plot. Your DM may also allow you to voluntarily evoke these visions through some mechanic of their choice.

Additionally, you have an excellent knowledge of not only the local territory, but also its terrain and natural resources. You can usually call upon the hospitality of locals, and some may even approach you to employ your services regarding the afterlife, medicine, or nature.

rows: I like to dress in simple clothing, or even barefoot.
If more people focused on the old ways, there would be fewer problems in the world.
I take pity on those who fear death and the dead.
People are too scared of what they don't understand.
I like knowing that I can help out others in troubling times.
When I have to take from nature, I try to give something in return.
Those who harm nature or animals without cause are vile.
I like to study the arcane as much as I do the divine.
Nature. Nature does not wait for anyone. (Neutral)
Trickery. I often play pranks on others and delight in deception. (Chaotic)
Assistance. I try to help out those who come to see me. (Good)
Death. Death is not the end, as some make it out to be. (Any)
Greed. I only help those who do favors for me or can provide me great compensation. (Evil)
Order. I try to work in regards to the natural order and laws of the land. (Lawful)
The one who taught my was a village elder.
Animals and the dead are more friends to me than the living are.
I speak with spirits as often as I can.
I once had a small village work for me and my command.
I have many friends in local tribes and villages.
For the past few years, I have been in hiding from local witch hunter and authorities.
I don't help people unless they have something they can give in return.
I am slow to trust people from larger cities.
I envy those who never have to deal with spirits.
I secretly think that those who cannot use magic are lesser than me.
I am secretly afraid of ghosts and undead.
I don't like to share secrets of my trade.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Persuasion}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: A {@item gaming set|PHB} of your choice

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Fair-spoken, Merry

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
entries: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Riddle|TLotRR}

items.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: A {@item gaming set|PHB} of your choice

items.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Eager, Fair-spoken

_.special: a key to an important location

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, a small rusted knife, a key to an important location, a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 1 gold piece

entries.name: Feature: Bottom Dweller
entries: Having been discarded by society, you're familiar with desperation. You know the darkest corners of the city like the back of your hand. Whether it's the dank sewers, abandoned buildings, or the shadowy back alleys, you can navigate these places with ease and can often find shelter or a safe passage where others would see only squalor and danger. You require half as much food and water as a regular member of your race to survive, and have advantage on all Survival checks made to maintain a Wretched lifestyle.

entries.name: Optional Feature: Worthless
entries: {@i With your GM's approval you can pick this feature instead of Bottom Dweller.}

You are worthless, but you show a sliver of potential. When you choose this background at 1st level, reduce your highest ability score until the sum of your six ability scores is equal to 72 or fewer. Then, reduce each ability score by 1.

When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2 or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 18 using this feature.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Your life has been defined by neglect and devaluation. Deemed worthless by those around you, you've developed a grit and tenacity that allows you to thrive in the harshest conditions. Your perceived weakness could be your greatest strength, and in spite of your circumstances, you remain hopeful of proving your worth.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I am quiet and withdrawn, preferring to remain in the background and observe.
I am fiercely determined to prove my worth and show that I am more than just a waste of skin.
I am quick to mistrust, always suspecting others' motives due to my past experiences.
I've developed a sharp sense of humor as a coping mechanism.
I have a tendency to hoard items, never knowing when I might need them.
I am always scheming, to be ready for whatever life throws at me.
I often underestimate my worth and potential, always expecting to fail.
I've grown to appreciate the little joys in life, as they are far and few between.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Perseverance}. No matter how many times I'm knocked down, I will keep getting back up. (Any)
{@b Growth}. I seek to find my hidden potential and make a difference in this harsh world. (Good)
{@b Independence}. I will rely on no one but myself. I am all I need. (Chaotic)
{@b Vengeance}. I will show those who discarded me the error of their ways. (Evil)
{@b Acceptance}. I strive to find a place where I am accepted as I am. (Neutral)
{@b Redemption}. I seek to prove that everyone, even someone like me, can change for the better. (Lawful)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I will protect the few friends I have made in this dark city, as they have shown me kindness when others would not.
I am searching for a person who can help me unlock my true potential and find my place in this world.
I am determined to create a better life for the other discarded souls in the city.
I harbor a desire to confront those who cast me aside and show them how far I've come.
Precious memories, the only thing I have from my past, drives me to keep going.
I've made a secret promise to myself that I'd rather die than stay worthless

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I possess a crippling fear of abandonment, leading me to cling to unhealthy relationships even when they are detrimental to my well-being.
My self-destructive tendencies manifest in addictive behaviors, using substances or vices as a means to escape from my own perceived worthlessness.
I have a hard time letting go of any perceived slights or insults, often holding grudges.
My survival instincts can make me selfish, often choosing my wellbeing over others.
I tend to push people away, afraid that they will eventually discard me like the rest.
I am often reckless, after all, I have nothing to lose.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB}, sewer grate key, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 5 GP; or (B) 10 GP

_.displayName: partially filled journal filled with notes and questions you have not yet been able to answer

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill Investigation}; choose one from {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Survival}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: A {@item ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, a quill, a small knife, a partially filled {@item book|PHB|journal} filled with notes and questions you have not yet been able to answer, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Research Group
entries: Your research search group is a loose network of wycademy graduates who each typically work in a different village that you share knowledge with. Their studies can help you with your hunts and investigations. You can select what you research from the Group Research table or roll randomly.

entries.caption: Group Research
rows: Endemic Life
Lynians
Botanical
Mineralogical (Ore)
Piscine (Fish)
Archeologist
Ancient Civilization
Exotic Monsters from Far Off Lands

entries.name: Feature: Investigation
entries: Expanding the knowledge of your research is an important aspect to your job at the Wycademy. When you discover new information about a creature or resource related to your research, you can bring that information to a Wycademy owned location to receive a stipend. Discuss with your DM what that amount is and if you can make more depending on what you discover or as you level up.

rows: I am quiet and analytical.
I am tireless when researching or learning, which I always seem to be doing.
I try to travel to all the important places of a region to see them firsthand.
I am a voracious reader, and spend every spare moment learning about new things or writing.
I enjoy an intellectual challenge.
I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries–or I like to boast that I have.
I have learned that doing your research before a hunt, leads to a safer hunt.
I'm convinced that people are always trying to steal my secrets.
Improvement. Understanding history give us a chance to make a better world (Good)
Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)
Discovery. Knowledge can accomplish anything; you cannot hope to master it, only marvel at it (Chaotic)
Vanity. I deserve to be treated as an important person because of what I know (Evil)
Logic. Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking. (Lawful)
Self-Improvement. The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)
I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets that must not fall into the wrong hands.
I work to preserve a library, university, scriptorium, or monastery.
My life's work is a series of tomes related to a specific field of lore.
I investigated a fascinating and beautiful monster; I must see it again.
I am determined to cure the disease that killed my family.
I need to be known for my contributions, discoveries, and skill.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
What's the point of secrets? All knowledge should be shared.
I feel superior to uneducated folk, but quietly so.
Unlocking an ancient mystery is worth the price of a civilization.
I will endanger my friends and family if I think it will advance my research.
I prove my intellect by pointing out others mistakes.

entries: Having graduated from the wycademy, you chose to continue your studies dedicating your life to becoming an expert in your chosen field. Now you have struck out to increase your knowledge, for good or evil, for everyone or for yourself, that is up to you to decide.

_.displayName: 4 blank pieces of parchment and a few with notes and questions

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill History}; choose one from {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Religion}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies
items.entry: Choose one from: {@item Alchemist's Supplies|phb}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|phb}, {@item Herbalism Kit|phb}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Empty {@item book|PHB}, quill and {@item ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|ink}, 3 {@item candle|PHB|candles}, {@item map or scroll case|PHB|scroll case} with 4 blank pieces of {@item parchment (one sheet)|PHB|parchment} and a few with notes and questions, one set fine {@item robes|PHB}, {@item traveler's clothes|PHB|travelling clothes}, {@item pouch|PHB} with 10gp

entries.name: Feature: Unrestricted Access
entries: The Wycademy possess and maintain their own restricted system of libraries which often include extremely detailed knowledge of creatures and secrets of the surrounding area. You are allowed access to these restricted areas, as well as most other major libraries as a matter of scholarly courtesy. You are also allowed lodging in many wycademy owned or sponsored schools or major sites of research as a student and pilgrim.

rows: I am observant and ask a lot of questions.
I am easily excitable and passionate.
I take myself very seriously and have no sense of humor.
I am meticulous and organized.
I constantly ask questions about areas and important people when I'm somewhere I've never been.
I get excited and speak quickly when discussing topics that interest me.
I have learned that doing your research before a hunt, leads to a safer hunt.
I like to use big words to showcase my intelligence.
Education. Learning and teaching others can benefit everyone (Good)
Knowlege. We better ourselves by learning (Neutral)
Order. Understanding the order of things is essential (Lawful)
Achievement. Learning and knowing are essential.
Self-Improvement. The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)
Power. Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Evil)
I had a romantic relationship with a fellow student, I still love them.
I have a rival, we still compete to this day.
I've been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
My notebook is made from the last creature my father hunted.
I will do anything to prove myself greater than my siblings or ancestors.
I idolize a historical scholar, and measure my accomplishments against theirs.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
If my teacher calls me, I'll abandon what I'm doing to go to them.
A scandal prevents me from returning to my place of education, I'm trying to stay ahead of the rumors.
I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
I prefer a dusty tome to conversation.
I feel superior to uneducated folk, but quietly so.

entries: As a child you were always curious about the world, whether it was exploring lost ruins near home, collecting bugs and plants, or drawing the khelbi that graze in the nearby fields. In your formative years you made your way to the wycademy with a goal in mind, to learn all you can and deciding what you are going to do with the rest of your life. Now that your first year is over, its time to head out into the field and learn first hand.

name: Wychlaran

_.special: twig or leaf from a place you consider sacred

entries: Your arcane or divine prowess marked you as different from those around you. The powerful wise women of your land sought you out to bring you into the fold. You've either spent your years practicing your magical abilities on your own as an Unproven or willingly joined the witches to train and be numbered among their ranks. When you choose this background, work with your DM to determine whether you're a true wychlaran or a durthan, how far through the ranks you progressed, and what kind of experiences you have had.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies
items.entry: {@skill History}, plus your choice of two from among {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, and {@skill Religion}

items.name: Equipment
items.entry: Herbalism Kit, set of common and fine clothes, a mask, a stone, twig or leaf from a place you consider sacred, and a pouch containing 15 gold pieces.

entries.name: Rank
entries: In the Sisterhood there are different ranks of varying power and responsibility. You had specific responsibilities and experiences based on which rank you are.

rows: Unproven. Those who choose not to become ethrans, or perhaps did not have the inclination or aptitude for further study.
Ethran. A low-ranking initiate, but still bearing the full responsibility and authority of being a witch.
Hathran. Leaders of the sisterhood. They can doo now wrong and their word is law.
Othlor. The wisest and most experienced. Perhaps only a dozen or so individuals exist.
Durthan. A forbidden splinter group who believe in using any means necessary to defeat Rashemen's enemies, including the use of forbidden dark magic.
Former Member. You have left the order either voluntarily or were asked to leave.

entries.name: Spell List
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}
As a member of the wychlaran, the following spells are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.
